source_locator: Official Codeforces API introduction, methods and object definitions for contests, problems, submissions, verdicts, test sets, standings and rating changes; official Codeforces rating-system documentation
evidence_summary_en: Codeforces is a continuously operated competitive-programming platform and problem source, not one standalone benchmark with a canonical paper, item count, split, prompt, attempt budget, judging route or score. Official API objects expose contests, problem statements and metadata, difficulty ratings, tags, standings, submissions, test sets, resource consumption, points, penalties and verdicts. A model report must define the contest window and problem subset, contamination and eligibility rules, prompt, language, tools, number of attempts, and whether code is submitted to Codeforces or judged by a separately specified offline harness. Online runs inherit platform verdicts; fixed-set Accuracy/Pass@k and contest rank/rating are alternative report-specific aggregations and cannot be interchanged without an identical protocol.
evidence_summary_zh: Codeforces 是持续运行的竞赛编程平台与题源，而不是具有规范论文、固定题数、划分、提示、尝试预算、判题路径和分数的单一 benchmark。官方 API 对象公开比赛、题目与元数据、难度 Rating、标签、排名、提交、测试集、资源消耗、得分、罚时和 verdict。模型报告必须自行声明比赛时间窗与题目子集、污染和纳入规则、提示、语言、工具、尝试次数，以及代码是提交 Codeforces 还是由另行说明的离线框架判定。在线运行沿用平台 verdict；固定题集的 Accuracy/Pass@k 与比赛排名/Rating 是不同的报告专属聚合，协议不一致时不能直接互换比较。

source_locator: VoiceBench Sections 3.1-3.2 and Tables 1, 3-4; official MatthewCYM/VoiceBench dataset and evaluation instructions
evidence_summary_en: CommonEval is a VoiceBench subset, not a generic bilingual text benchmark. The authors manually collect information-seeking questions from Mozilla Common Voice recordings made by diverse speakers on personal devices in realistic conditions. The final English subset contains 200 human-recorded open-ended QA items with an average of 8.06 words and 4.83 seconds of audio. VoiceBench runs paired settings using the ground-truth text instruction or the original speech instruction, then asks a voice assistant or ASR-plus-LLM pipeline to respond. It scores text-response content rather than speech-output or transcription quality. GPT-4o-mini-2024-07-18 assigns a response-quality score from 1 to 5 against the ground-truth instruction; the official repository selects commoneval/test with text or audio modality, applies api_judge.py and aggregates with the open evaluator.
evidence_summary_zh: CommonEval 是 VoiceBench 子集，而不是通用双语文本 benchmark。作者从 Mozilla Common Voice 的多样说话人、个人设备与真实条件录音中人工收集信息寻求类问题。最终英文子集含 200 条真人录制开放式问答，平均 8.06 个词、4.83 秒音频。VoiceBench 配对运行标准文本指令与原始语音指令两种设置，由语音助手或 ASR+LLM 流水线回答；评测的是文本回答内容，而非语音输出或转写质量。GPT-4o-mini-2024-07-18 对照标准指令给回答质量打 1—5 分；官方仓库选择 commoneval/test 的文本或音频模态，运行 api_judge.py，再用 open evaluator 汇总。

source_locator: OpenAI MRCR v2 dataset card and scorer; Context Arena FAQ/dashboard methodology; Claude Opus 4.6 system card Section 2.18.1
evidence_summary_en: Context Arena publishes externally run OpenAI MRCR v2 results. GPT-4o creates needles and distractors across multiple writing media and topics, forming a unique synthetic multi-turn conversation per test. The test contains 2, 4 or 8 identical requests whose responses are scattered among distractors; the final query asks for the nth response and requires a random hash. Using o200k_base, cases are placed in context bins from 4-8K through 1M with 100 tests per bin. A missing or wrong hash scores zero; otherwise the valid hash is removed and Python difflib SequenceMatcher compares the response with the expected needle. The dashboard reports mean match ratio by length and normalized trapezoidal AUC at 128K and 1M, alongside token-efficiency and cost views. The Claude system card identifies these as external-evaluator results and uses the hardest eight-needle variant with five trials for its internal table.

source_locator: Teaching CLIP to Count to Ten data-curation and CountBench evaluation sections, figures and supplementary implementation details
evidence_summary_en: CountBench is built from LAION-400M image-caption pairs. The authors keep captions with spelled counts from two through ten, remove ages, times, dates, addresses and other non-visible number uses, and use an off-the-shelf detector to count each object class. Assuming the caption refers to the most prevalent detected class, they retain count-matching candidates. The candidates are severely imbalanced, from more than 158,000 examples of two to about 100 of ten, so they first balance to roughly 100-200 per count, manually verify that the counted objects are clearly visible, and rebalance to 60 images for each of nine counts: 540 held-out test images with no overlap with the counting training set. Evaluation pairs each image with one correct and eight counterfactual captions, selects the number with maximum image-text similarity, and reports Counting Accuracy and Mean Count Deviation.
evidence_summary_zh: CountBench 从 LAION-400M 图文对构建。作者保留英文拼写的 two 至 ten 数量词，移除年龄、时间、日期、地址及其他不可见数字用法，再用现成目标检测器统计各对象类别。假设描述指向检测结果中数量最多的类别，只保留数量一致的候选。候选极不平衡，从超过 158,000 条 two 到约 100 条 ten，因此先把每个数量平衡到约 100—200 条，人工确认被计数对象清晰可见，再重平衡为 9 个数量各 60 张：共 540 张独立测试图，且与计数训练集不重叠。评测为每张图配置 1 条正确和 8 条反事实描述，选择图文相似度最高的数量，报告计数准确率和平均数量偏差。

source_locator: Olmo 3 Section 3.5 and Appendix A.3.1, especially CraneMath and Table 41; official Dolma 3 Dolmino pool and 100B mix dataset cards
evidence_summary_en: CraneMath is synthetic math midtraining data, not an evaluation benchmark. Olmo 3 independently reproduces the SwallowMath rewrite recipe to avoid its Llama-license restriction: it applies the published SwallowMath prompt to FineMath4+ and uses Qwen3-32B as the rewrite model. The released source pool contains 5.62B English tokens and 6.55M documents. CraneMath contributes 5.63% of the Olmo 3 100B Stage-2 Dolmino mix, whose released mixed form lists 7.24M CraneMath documents. Data quality is validated by microanneals from a base model that has seen 6T pretraining tokens, using 50% web text and 50% candidate source, and comparing the pre-anneal baseline, FineMath4+, SwallowMath, CraneMath variants and source-document combinations. source_locator: CritPt v4 Sections 2-3; official CritPt website and coverage page; CritPt-Benchmark/CritPt generation pipeline; Artificial Analysis grading interface
evidence_summary_en: CritPt means Complex Research using Integrated Thinking – Physics Test; it does not test recognition of physical critical points. More than 50 active researchers from over 30 institutions create unpublished, self-contained entry-level research projects across 11 physics disciplines. Problems must be search-proof but solvable from public knowledge, guess-resistant and machine-verifiable, with explicit symbols, conventions and units. Each composite challenge is decomposed into two to four checkpoints and iteratively receives expert and high-level peer review, averaging more than 40 expert hours. The release has 71 challenges and 190 checkpoints: one public example with solutions and 70 test challenges with private answers. Standard evaluation runs five epochs, generates a free-form solution and then fills a code template with numeric, symbolic, array, categorical or Python-function answers. Complete 70-problem batches go to the private physics-informed grader; missing IDs are rejected. The headline metric is average challenge accuracy over five runs and 70 tests.

source_locator: CRUXEval Sections 3-4 and Appendices A/D; official facebookresearch/cruxeval generation prompts, input_prediction.py, evaluator and sandbox
evidence_summary_en: CRUXEval uses Code Llama 34B and 69 Python standard-library methods—47 str, 11 dict and 11 list—to generate 102,000 functions, each prompted with two varying few-shot examples and five test inputs. Executing candidates yields 489,306 input-output pairs. Compile filters require every argument to be used, 75-300 code characters, valid syntax and an assertion. Runtime and safety filters exclude floating operations, true division, imports, nondeterminism, side effects, exceptions and runs exceeding two seconds. The authors randomly select 800 distinct 3-13-line functions. CRUXEval-I gives the function and target output and asks for any valid input; direct or CoT prompts return an assertion in answer tags. Post-processing extracts f(...), then the sandbox checks target_output == f(generated_input) with a three-second timeout. Any execution-equivalent input passes. Per-item unbiased pass@k values are averaged and the official evaluator reports Pass@1 and Pass@5.

source_locator: CSR-Bench Sections 3-5 and Figure 7; official amazon-science/CSR-Bench repository
evidence_summary_en: CSR-Bench starts from over 1,500 top-star GitHub repositories associated with more than ten major computer-science conferences. Candidates are grouped into NLP, computer vision, LLM, machine-learning and interdisciplinary areas, ranked by stars, and manually screened for sufficient README instructions, deployable code, self-containment, topic diversity and permissive licensing, leaving 100 repositories. The README is the primary deployment source and other repository content is supplementary. Command Drafter creates Bash commands for setup, download, training, inference and evaluation. Script Executor runs them in standardized Docker/Bash; an LLM maps stdout/stderr to a return state. Failures progress through Log Analyzer, BM25 retrieval over repository Issues, and Perplexity web search with limited retries. Completion rate is successful commands divided by all executed commands and is reported by deployment stage.

evidence_summary_en: CURE-Bench publishes twelve therapeutic task families spanning treatment recommendation, adverse events, drug labeling, warnings, dependence, dosage, special populations, pharmacology, clinical and nonclinical information, and patient information. Its TxAgent-derived validated pipeline is documented as QuestionGen for clinically plausible questions, TraceGen for grounded multi-step traces, and ToolGen for biomedical tools and retrieval. Outputs are described only as thousands of examples containing questions, traces and tool-based solutions. Track 1 allows internal knowledge only; Track 2 allows external tools and real-time information. Submissions include traces, answers, token use and model metadata. A predefined weighted score combines correctness, robustness, efficiency, agentic factuality and clinical relevance, with human experts validating top submissions. Exact item counts, splits, weights, prompts, judge configuration and benchmark instances are not public.

source_locator: CURIE Sections 3-4 and Appendix Tables 3-4; official google/curie repository
evidence_summary_en: CURIE uses one to three Ph.D. experts in each of six scientific disciplines to define ten realistic tasks that are solvable from supplied context and expert-evaluable. Experts select permissively licensed papers or scientific records, create ground truth, assign difficulty and cross-review extraction annotations. The dataset has 580 pairs from 429 documents, averaging about 15k words, across DFT-S, DFT-P, DFT-C, MPV, HFD, HFE, QECC, GEO, BIOGR and PDB. Standard zero-shot prompts include task, output format and complete paper; BIOGR uses a map image/caption and PDB uses structure text. Primary aggregate metrics are LLMSim-F1 for DFT-S/DFT-P/MPV, ROUGE-L for DFT-C/HFD/HFE/QECC/GEO, IoU for BIOGR and sequence identity ratio for PDB. Scores normalize to [0,1] and average across ten tasks. Experts audit 10-12% of outputs as good, okay or bad.

evidence_summary_en: CursorBench is an internal suite based on real Cursor engineering sessions. Cursor Blame traces committed code to the agent request that produced it, yielding a developer-query and ground-truth-solution pair. Tasks mainly come from Cursor's internal codebase and controlled sources, are refreshed every few months, and use intentionally short, ambiguous descriptions. Version 3.0 focused on editing, refactoring and bug fixes; 3.1 adds codebase understanding, bug finding, planning and code review and revises some edit grading. Agents run in initialized codebases and agentic graders accept multiple valid solutions. Internal axes include correctness, code quality, efficiency and interaction; the public leaderboard reports Score, average cost per task, tokens and steps. Controlled online experiments cross-check developer outcomes. Scores are comparable only within one version. Tasks, suite size, grader rubrics, harness and per-item results remain proprietary.

source_locator: CValues Sections 2.1-2.3 and Figure 3; official X-PLUG/CValues repository
evidence_summary_en: CValues defines two ascending Chinese-value criteria: Level 1 safety and Level 2 responsibility. For safety, crowdworkers attack an early ChatPLUG chatbot under a ten-scenario taxonomy; successful triggers are retained as 1,300 prompts. For responsibility, eight professional experts each write 100 induced questions, yielding 800 prompts. These 2,100 prompts form the human set. Three annotators majority-vote safety responses and the safe ratio is scored. Responsibility human evaluation uses ChatPLUG-13B as a representative: three candidates per prompt are judged by the originating expert, who chooses the best or neither and scores it 1-10; domain means are reported. For automatic evaluation, multiple LLM responses are human-categorized, ChatGPT rewrites a response if an opposite class is missing, opposite responses are paired, and option order is swapped. The 4,312 MCQs include 2,600 safety and 1,712 responsibility items and report accuracy with and without refusals.

source_locator: CWEval Sections III-V and Figure 2; official Co1lin/CWEval repository
evidence_summary_en: CWEval is an independent secure-code-generation framework, not a Qwen-specific repair benchmark. Self-contained tasks are derived from CWE documentation and isolate third-party dependencies. Specifications contain signatures, docstrings and optional examples, preserve security semantics, avoid leaking security awareness, and remain unambiguous. Dynamic functionality oracles check expected behavior; security oracles may inspect outputs, time, memory or state integrity. A secure reference passes both suites while a functional-but-insecure reference passes functionality and fails security, and experts verify vulnerability reproducibility plus feasible mitigation. CWEval-bench has 119 tasks covering 31 CWEs and five languages, including 11 C memory tasks. Model samples run against both suites; func@k requires functionality and func-sec@k requires both, using unbiased pass@k-style estimators.
evidence_summary_zh: CWEval 是独立的安全代码生成框架，不是 Qwen 专属漏洞修复评测。任务依据 CWE 文档设计为自包含形式并隔离第三方依赖；规格包含函数签名、文档字符串和可选样例，保留安全语义、不泄漏安全意识且无歧义。功能动态判定器检查预期行为，安全判定器可检查输出、时间、内存或状态完整性。安全参考实现通过两套测试，功能正确但不安全的参考实现通过功能测试且安全测试失败；专家验证漏洞可复现且可在不损功能时修复。CWEval-bench 含 119 个任务、31 类 CWE 和 5 种语言，其中 11 个是 C 内存漏洞任务。模型样本同时运行两套测试；func@k 要求功能正确，func-sec@k 同时要求功能与安全，并采用无偏 pass@k 式估计。

evidence_summary_en: DeR2 recruits 81 PhD annotators working within their specialties to turn 2023-2025 theory-oriented papers from 15+ disciplines into instruction, concepts, CoT, answer, and document-set items. evidence_summary_en: DLC-Bench is distinct from the companion DLC-SDP training pipeline. It selects 100 challenging masked objects from an Objects365 v2 validation subset with human segmentation masks. GPT-4o, Gemini-1.5-Pro, and Claude-3.5-Sonnet propose properties for 34, 35, and 31 regions. Positive questions cover true object/part details; negative questions cover typical-but-absent or out-of-region details. evidence_summary_en: DUDE manually queries archive.org, Wikimedia Commons, and DocumentCloud by category and filters for permissive licenses, visual diversity, and privacy/legal safety, producing 5,019 English documents dated 1860-2022 with mean 5.72 pages. In Phase 1, crowdworkers author extractive, abstractive, and list QA and mark evidence boxes; five PhD linguists primarily author non-answerable items. Validity rules and duplicate clustering precede Phase 2 independent answers. Inter-answer ANLS above 0.8 is accepted; lower agreement goes to Best-MTurker Phase 3 adjudication, with linguists correcting outliers. Optional Phase 4 reviews test items and labels complexity, evidence, operations, and answer form. The 41,541 questions are 42.39% extractive, 38.25% abstractive, 6.62% list, and 12.74% none; evaluation reports ANLS overall and by diagnostic slice.

evidence_summary_en: EgoTempo starts from Ego4D videos and timestamped first-person narrations. Narration windows are derived from local/global timing, then consecutive segments are grouped up to 120 narrations or 120 seconds. Gemini 1.5 Pro captions each clip and generates open-ended QA for ten capabilities spanning action/event/object sequences and counting, future prediction, spatial relations, and object grounding. Humans verify QA against video, remove irrelevant or non-temporal pairs, and exclude any pair Gemini answers from a single frame. The final 500 pairs are balanced 50 per capability over 365 clips from 221 videos and 40 scenarios. Models run under text-only, single-frame, and controlled multi-frame evidence; Gemini 1.5 Pro judges predictions as correct/incorrect against ground truth. Reports include overall/category accuracy and single-frame-to-video gain. MultiQA applies only to the EgoSchema comparison.

source_locator: EHRSQL Sections 3-4, Figure 3, and Tables 2-5; official glee4810/EHRSQL NeurIPS 2022 release
evidence_summary_en: EHRSQL polls 222 Konyang University Hospital staff and collects 1,742 real information needs. Responses are filtered, scoped to no/individual/group patient, merged, extended, and templatized into 174 answerable plus 56 unanswerable templates. Paired NL-SQL time templates cover global, within-event, and exact filters. Four graduate students spend five months manually labeling SQL with one labeler and a reviewer per MIMIC-III/eICU database, favoring nested queries. Preprocessing adds a cost table, shifts records to 2100-2105 with a fixed current time, and shuffles values across patients. Operation, time, and condition values instantiate templates; executable answerable pairs require at least one result. Human/T5/back-translation paraphrases pass RoBERTa, perplexity, edit-distance, and unanimous three-group crowd QA, averaging 47 per template. The 24,411 pairs use 9.3K/1.1K/1.8K splits per database, with 33% unanswerable only in validation/test. Trustworthy parsing reports F1ans, Pexe, Rexe, and F1exe.

source_locator: EmbSpatial-Bench ACL 2024 Sections 2.1-2.2, Figure 2, and Tables 1-2; official mengfeidu/EmbSpatial-Bench repository
evidence_summary_en: EmbSpatial-Bench uses MP3D test scenes, ScanNet validation scenes, and AI2-THOR frames from seven ALFRED task types across 93 scenes. Random viewpoints or PDDL-selected key frames yield RGB-D images. Camera parameters and 3D coordinates project objects to 2D boxes; non-overlapping boxes and mean depth define viewer-centric above, below, left, right, close, and far triples. Five templates create directional MCQs, while aggregated triples create closest/farthest questions. Box-size filtering, relation balancing, and per-sample human checks produce 3,640 QA over 2,181 images, 277 scenes, and 294 object categories. Zero-shot evaluation reports generation and maximum-likelihood option accuracy. EmbSpatial-SFT is a separate training set.

source_locator: EMMA Sections 3.1-3.2 and 4.1, Figure 4, and Table 1; official EMMA-Bench/EMMA repository
evidence_summary_en: EMMA gathers multimodal candidates from MathVista, Math-Vision, RAVEN, OlympiadBench, EXAMS-V, and MMMU. GPT-4o captions candidate images; Llama-3-70B-Instruct, GPT-4o, and Qwen2-72B-Instruct each answer the original text plus captions ten times, and a candidate is discarded if any model is correct at least five times. Retained questions define subject-specific skill taxonomies. Experts then source or author aligned physics, chemistry, and visualization-coding tasks, using RDKit/SMiCRM and chemistry PhD annotation where applicable. The final 2,788 questions combine 992 filtered source items and 1,796 new items across four subjects: 2,002 MCQ, 786 free-form, and 298 multi-image. Expert-verified skill labels and short ground truth enable zero-shot direct/CoT accuracy without an MLLM judge.

source_locator: Original EQ-Bench December 2023 paper Sections 2.6 and 3.1-3.10; official EQ-bench/EQ-Bench repository
evidence_summary_en: EQ-Bench is the original 2023 emotional-understanding benchmark, not a benchmark created by the later Qwen3-VL report. Random location, author-style, and broad-scenario seeds prompt GPT-4 to write conflict or tension dialogues. The author chooses each question, four diverse emotions, and 0-10 reference intensities, yielding 60 English items. Exact zero-shot prompts request first-pass ratings, stepwise critique, and revised ratings. Parsing starts at temperature 0.01; failures increase temperature by 0.15 until parseable or attempts exceed five. Each four-emotion vector is normalized to sum 10 and receives 10 minus the sum of absolute reference differences. First-pass and revised runs are averaged separately and the better whole run is selected, not per-question maxima. Fewer than 50 parseable answers fails; random response is calibrated to 0 and perfect alignment to 100.

source_locator: FigureQA Sections 3.1-3.3, Tables 1-2, and Appendix C; official Maluuba/FigureQA repository
evidence_summary_en: FigureQA is the original 2017 synthetic visual-reasoning corpus, not a benchmark introduced by a 2025 vision-language report. Numerical data are sampled from constrained uniform ranges and linear, quadratic, or bell-shaped families with perturbations. A modified Bokeh renderer creates vertical/horizontal bars, line, dot-line, and pie charts while extracting element boxes. Appearance uses 100 X11 colors far from white, randomized fonts and gridlines, and occupancy-aware legend placement. Fifteen binary templates generate one Yes and one No question when applicable, followed by per-type answer balancing. Disjoint color halves create unseen color-plot combinations for validation/test, with same-scheme variants also released. Train contains 100k images and 1.3M questions; validation and test each contain 20k images and more than 250k questions. Evaluation reports binary accuracy overall, by template, and by color scheme.

source_locator: GAIA Sections 2-4 and appendices; official gaia-benchmark/GAIA dataset release
evidence_summary_en: GAIA uses 466 human-designed and annotated questions with concise unique factoid answers. Authors and paid annotators combine trusted stable web sources, attached multimodal files, or self-contained puzzles and record the answer, tools, steps, time, and evidence metadata. Two new annotators independently answer each item; all three answers must agree, otherwise the question is repaired or removed. The paper reports 68% accepted unchanged and about two human-hours per retained question. Level 1 permits at most one tool and five steps, Level 2 takes roughly 5-10 steps and multiple tools, and Level 3 permits long sequences and arbitrary tool mixes. The release has 166 annotated development questions and 300 test questions with hidden answers. Zero-shot assistants use reasoning, browsing, code, and tools as needed; type normalization plus quasi-exact match yields accuracy.

evidence_summary_en: GDPVal selects nine U.S. sectors above 5% of GDP and 44 predominantly digital occupations using GPT-4o classification of O*NET activities plus wage and employment data. source_locator: GenEval Sections 3-5 and Appendices C-D; official djghosh13/geneval repository
evidence_summary_en: GenEval defines six compositional text-to-image tasks: single object, two objects, counting, colors, position, and color attribute binding. Template vocabularies use 80 MS-COCO object classes, 10 generation colors, counts 2-4, and four relative positions. Sampling 100 candidates per task and deduplicating yields 553 prompts; each model generates four images per prompt. COCO Mask2Former checks presence, count, and centroid relations, while CLIP ViT-L/14 classifies masked crops for color. Every requested element must pass for binary image correctness. Scores average over four generations, by task, then across tasks. A 6,000-annotation study on 1,200 images reports 83% human-evaluator agreement, 88% inter-annotator agreement, and 91% agreement on unanimous cases.

evidence_summary_en: GenExam defines an ISCED-F-aligned taxonomy with 10 subjects and 10/40/132/236 categories across four levels. About 40K exam/textbook and seven-dataset candidate images are technically filtered, then GPT-5 rates text richness, domain, complexity, and subject-knowledge density to retain 6.5K. GPT-5 drafts exam prompts and weighted atomic yes/no scoring points. Three PhD annotators cross-validate images, prompts, and scoring points, producing 1,000 samples. The level-three-stratified Mini has 487 items in official results. GPT-5 compares each generated image with the reference: weighted semantic correctness is 0-1, and spelling, logical consistency, and readability are 0-2. source_locator: OLMo 3 Section 3.3, Appendix A.4, and Table 46; official OLMES TASK_SUITE_CONFIGS[olmo3:base:gen]
evidence_summary_en: GenQA is not a standalone dataset or paper. OLMo 3 pools about 23K results from 70 open-weight models, uses Ward hierarchical clustering on model rankings, and aligns clusters with task format. The official olmo3:base:gen suite macro-averages nine tasks: HellaSwag, WinoGrande, LAMBADA, BasicSkills with six subtasks, DROP, Jeopardy, NaturalQs, SQuAD, and CoQA. Rank-choice/continuation tasks use task-defined accuracy; generated short answers use F1 against answer banks. Most tasks are 5-shot, LAMBADA is 0-shot, and CoQA uses built-in examples. Generative decoding uses temperature 0 and top-p 1 with 50 or 100 token limits. Incomplete answer banks can create false negatives; Gen2MC is a separate remedy.
evidence_summary_zh: GenQA 不是独立数据集或论文。OLMo 3 汇集约 70 个开源权重模型的 2.3 万条结果，以 Ward 层次聚类按模型排名相似性分组，并按任务格式对齐。官方 olmo3:base:gen 套件对九个任务取宏平均：HellaSwag、WinoGrande、LAMBADA、含六子任务的 BasicSkills、DROP、Jeopardy、NaturalQs、SQuAD 和 CoQA。排序选择/续写任务用各自准确率，生成式短答案对答案库算 F1。多数任务为 5-shot，LAMBADA 为 0-shot，CoQA 使用内置示例。生成解码温度 0、top-p 1，最多 50 或 100 tokens。答案库不完整会造成假阴性；Gen2MC 是单独的补救方案。

source_locator: Global MMLU Sections 2-4 and relevant appendices; official CohereLabs/Global-MMLU-Lite paper-release and current dataset cards
evidence_summary_en: Global MMLU begins with about 14K English MMLU questions in 57 subjects. Its cultural branch uniformly samples 2,850 questions, engages 200 professional/community annotators, and collects at least three cultural, geographic, or dialect labels per item to derive CS/CA membership. Its language branch translates MMLU into 41 target languages with Google Translate while replacing or post-editing outputs through professional MMMLU, a paid Gold Set, and native communities, improving 25 languages. The paper-release Lite retains 15 fully human-translated or post-edited languages and balances each at 200 CS plus 200 CA items, 6,000 total. Exact option matching reports overall, language, CS, and CA accuracy. The maintained v3 has since expanded to 23 languages and about 14K rows.

source_locator: Official dataset card sections Data schema, Extraction and Grading, and Changelog; current dataset files and rows
evidence_summary_en: GraphWalks has no companion construction paper, so undocumented graph sampling details are not inferred. The current official release has 1,150 rows in one train split: 550 BFS and 600 parents, with prompt, answer_nodes, prompt_chars, problem_type, and date_added fields across two context-length parquet files. Prompts serialize directed edge lists with hashed nodes, every node has degree at least one, and fixed worked examples define the contract. BFS answers contain nodes reachable at exactly the requested depth, excluding the start and revisits; parents answers are incoming neighbors excluding the target. A 2026 fix corrected 24 of 400 short parent labels that included the root. The parser accepts only Final Answer: [...] on the last response line; malformed output is empty. Set precision, recall, and F1 are reported, with empty/empty F1 equal to one.

evidence_summary_en: HEAD-QA extracts Spanish public-health specialization exams from 2013 onward in medicine, pharmacology, psychology, nursing, biology, and chemistry. source_locator: HELMET Section 2, Tables 3-4, and Appendices B-C; official princeton-nlp/HELMET repository
evidence_summary_en: HELMET answers four long-context evaluation flaws with seven application-centric categories and 21 dataset/task configurations: RAG, citation generation, passage re-ranking, many-shot ICL, long-document QA, summarization, and synthetic recall. Evidence tasks vary passages and gold positions; ICL varies balanced shots; long documents truncate from the end; synthetic tasks control generated length and placement to 128K tokens and beyond. Most tasks use two-shot prompts, while ICL uses variable shots and RULER keeps its original setting. Direct metrics include SubEM, citation metrics, NDCG@10, accuracy, and ROUGE F1. GPT-4o evaluates NarrativeQA as fluency times normalized correctness and summaries as atomic-claim precision/recall F1 times fluency. The paper profiles 59 LCLMs across categories and lengths.

source_locator: Current HLE revision Sections 3-4 and Appendices B-C; official cais/hle dataset release
evidence_summary_en: HLE-Full is a reporting label for complete HLE, not a separate construction. Nearly 1,000 experts from 500+ institutions in 50 countries submit questions across 100+ subjects with answer specifications, rationales, subject, and affiliation. Strict criteria require precise, unambiguous, solvable, non-searchable, original or nontrivially synthesized closed-ended questions. Several frontier LLMs precheck difficulty; more than 70,000 attempts yield about 13,000 candidates for graduate-expert review. Each receives 1-3 first-round reviews before organizer/expert approval. The current release has 2,500 public questions plus a private held-out set: 24% multiple choice, the rest exact match, and around 14% image-dependent. Full multimodal no-tool evaluation requests reasoning, final answer, and confidence; O3-mini checks equivalent answer forms. Metrics are accuracy and RMS calibration error.
evidence_summary_zh: HLE-Full 是完整 HLE 的报告标签，不是独立构建流程。近 1,000 名专家来自 500 多家机构、50 个国家，覆盖 100 多学科；投稿包含答案规范、解析、学科与机构。严格准则要求封闭式题目精确、无歧义、可解、不可快速检索，且为原创或非平凡综合。多个前沿 LLM 预检难度；超过 7 万次作答筛出约 1.3 万候选交由研究生层级专家评审。每题先获 1-3 次评审，再由组织者/专家批准。当前版本公开 2,500 题并保留私有测试集：24% 选择题、其余精确短答，约 14% 依赖图像。完整多模态无工具评测要求推理、最终答案与置信度，O3-mini 接受等价答案形式；指标为准确率与 RMS 校准误差。

source_locator: Current v3 Sections 3-5 and Figures 1-3; official SKYLENAGE-AI/HLE-Verified repository
evidence_summary_en: HLE-Verified audits all 2,500 HLE items by decomposing problem (including image), final answer, and rationale. Stage I combines independent domain-expert judgments, multi-model pass@8 replication with answer normalization/equivalence, and conservative internal adjudication without editing. It yields 668 unchanged Gold items, which bypass repair. Stage II sends flawed but repairable items through two independent Problem Fix, Solution Fix, and Answer Fix proposals, model-assisted auxiliary checks, and final minimal expert adjudication while preserving evaluation intent. The current v3 release has three disjoint subsets: 668 Gold, 1,143 revised-and-certified, and 689 Uncertain items with source/expertise tags, traces, and a 19-category defect taxonomy. Raw and verified full/edited subsets are compared with accuracy and calibration error, usually on text-only items.

evidence_summary_en: MathArena selects recent, reputable, difficult competitions and extracts official problems and answers before standardizing formats and manually checking typos, inconsistencies, and presentation. Its HMMT February 2025 configuration fixes 30 problems and a boxed-answer instruction. Four independent responses per problem use provider-recommended settings without benchmark tuning. A custom LaTeX-to-SymPy parser tests symbolic equivalence and Gemini 2.5 Flash handles semantic equivalence. Short outputs, parser failures, answers appearing in reasoning traces, and parser/judge disagreements are manually reviewed. Reporting averages pass@1 accuracy over four runs and includes score/rank confidence intervals; competition/model release dates flag potential contamination instead of silently treating later models as clean.

source_locator: Section 3.1 and Appendix A Curation, Statistics, and Evaluation; official DreamMr/HR-Bench repository and dataset card
evidence_summary_en: HR-Bench starts from 200 8K images from DIV8K and the Internet. Annotators mark bounding boxes around relevant objects; crops within the boxes are passed to GPT-4o to generate query-answer pairs; human experts filter incorrect or ambiguous queries. The final 200 unique questions split evenly between Fine-grained Single-instance Perception (attribute, OCR, visual prompting) and Fine-grained Cross-instance Perception (map, chart, spatial relation). Each question is evaluated against an 8K full image and a 4K crop, so those views are not separate unique questions. Multiple-choice answers are cyclically permuted so every option appears in every position, and accuracy is averaged across permutations; a pilot uncertainty score quantifies positional instability.

evidence_summary_en: HaluEval contains exactly 35,000 samples. The task-specific branch contributes 10,000 examples each from HotpotQA QA, OpenDialKG knowledge-grounded dialogue, and CNN/DailyMail summarization. ChatGPT generates candidate hallucinations through one-pass and conversational instruction learning with task-specific patterns, then a ground-truth-enhanced filter keeps the most plausible difficult counterpart to a normal answer. The general branch draws Alpaca queries, samples three ChatGPT responses, ranks queries by low average pairwise BERTScore, and retains 5,000. Three qualified annotators per response label yes/no, affected spans, and unverifiable/nonfactual/irrelevant aspects; majority voting across 30 annotators reaches Fleiss kappa 0.811 and finds 977 hallucinatory cases. Evaluation randomly presents a normal or hallucinated output and reports recognition accuracy by scenario.

evidence_summary_en: HalluQA has 450 Chinese questions across 30 domains: 175 misleading, 69 misleading-hard, and 206 knowledge questions. The misleading branch adapts 20 TruthfulQA-style patterns plus Chinese culture patterns, expands six manual seeds with five GLM-130B outputs, and retains questions that trigger imitative falsehoods in at least three of five runs. Misleading-hard items come from recent Chinese web confusions and ChatGPT 3.5 adversarial failures. Ten Chinese-native graduate interns write knowledge candidates; both ChatGPT and Puyu must fail at least three of five runs, and an NLP expert filters about 1,000 candidates to 206. Items receive correct/wrong answers and evidence, then independent author/expert review removes ambiguity. GPT-4-0613 applies five criteria with five votes; refusal counts as hallucination except for unanswerable questions. The metric is non-hallucination rate, while 93.5% human consistency is a judge check.

source_locator: Sections 2-4 and appendices on behavior curation, splits, classifiers, and evaluation; official centerforaisafety/HarmBench behavior CSVs and classifier code
evidence_summary_en: HarmBench distills acceptable-use policies from OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta, and Inflection with GPT-4, then authors manually design and repeatedly curate harmful behaviors while removing or rewriting dual-intent cases. Its 510 behaviors span seven semantic categories and four functional groups: 200 standard, 100 copyright, 100 contextual, and 110 multimodal. The fixed split contains 100 validation and 410 test behaviors, with stratification and manual adjustment; methods must not tune on test or semantic duplicates. A red-team method generates test cases, target models produce standardized greedy completions, a held-out open Llama-2-13B classifier judges non-copyright behavior, and a hash-based classifier judges copyright. The official metric is attack success rate.

source_locator: Sections 2-4 and appendices on environments, task construction, verification, and evaluation; official som-shahlab/health-admin-bench repository
evidence_summary_en: HealthAdminBench follows more than 100 hours of real healthcare-administration workflow shadowing and implements an EHR, two payer portals, and fax as deterministic GUI environments with synthetic patients, typed schemas, policy checks, failure modes, and persistent state. Practicing administrators design 135 tasks: 60 prior authorization, 60 appeals/denials, and 15 durable medical equipment. A stratified 40-task audit assigns two revenue-cycle experts per task and propagates corrections. The tasks decompose into 1,698 binary subtasks across six capability groups: 1,177 deterministic JMESPath checks and 521 GPT-5.4 free-text judges. A 60-sample audit reports 93.3% judge agreement. Agents use screenshots or accessibility trees and browser actions; reporting includes subtask success and strict task success, which requires all subtasks, with 95% bootstrap confidence intervals.

source_locator: Sections 2-4 and Appendix B on physician recruitment, conversation generation, rubrics, and scoring; official openai/simple-evals HealthBench implementation
evidence_summary_en: HealthBench was built over 11 months with 262 vetted physicians from 60 countries and 26 specialties. Advisors choose domains and situations, write prompt seeds and consensus criteria, train contributors, and review work. Conversations primarily come from tailored LM generation over physician-enumerated situations, plus physician red teaming and HealthSearchQA query rewrites. They alternate user/assistant turns, start and end with the user, and are filtered for realism, self-consistency, physical-health relevance, and completeness. Physicians author positive and negative example rubrics and assign seven themes and five behavioral axes; majority-supported reusable requirements form 34 consensus criteria. The final 5,000 conversations have 48,562 unique criteria. A model grader returns a boolean per criterion; earned signed points are normalized by maximum positive points, and clipped aggregate means are reported with bootstrap uncertainty and slices.

source_locator: Baichuan-M3 Section 4.3 HealthBench-Hallu and Section 3.3 Fact-Aware Verification pipeline
evidence_summary_en: HealthBench-Hallu is not described as an independently authored question set. The Baichuan-M3 report runs its high-precision factuality pipeline over model responses generated on HealthBench tasks and does not disclose a separate item count. GPT-5 extracts medical factual claims; coreference is resolved, claims are atomized, noise and distractors are discarded, and duplicates are removed while preserving order. A multi-turn search process retrieves current authoritative sources and clinical guidelines rather than cached evidence. Claims are labeled Supported with weight 0, Uncertain with weight 0.5, or Refuted with weight 1. Weighted Hallucination Rate averages those weights and is accompanied by Refuted Rate and Uncertain Rate, distinguishing erroneous medical knowledge or fabricated evidence from insufficient support.

source_locator: Sections 2-4 and 8 on task creation, three-stage review, stratified selection, human baseline, rubric grading, and length adjustment; official OpenAI release and dataset schema
evidence_summary_en: HealthBench Professional is a separate 2026 open benchmark, not a system-card split. Across care consult, writing/documentation, and medical research, 190 physicians with experience in 50 countries and 26 specialties author or review real ChatGPT for Clinicians conversations from good-faith use and deliberate red teaming. Stage 1 creates the task, signed example-specific rubric, and Likert 1-7 difficulty rating; Stage 2 checks realism, difficulty, and rubric quality, with two independent physicians verifying difficult cases; Stage 3 adjudicates ambiguity and removes subjective criteria. Metadata tags support stratified selection of 525 tasks from 15,079 candidates, enriching difficult examples about 3.5 times; roughly one-third are red-team cases. Specialist-matched physicians answer every task with unbounded time and web access. GPT-5.4 at low reasoning grades each rubric criterion independently; signed points are normalized by maximum positive points, empirically adjusted for response length, clipped, averaged, and sliced by use case and specialty.

source_locator: Sections 3.1-3.2 and 4.5 on HealthSearchQA construction and clinician/lay human evaluation; official Google Research publication page
evidence_summary_en: The arXiv MultiMedQA paper consistently reports 3,375 HealthSearchQA questions. Medical conditions and associated symptoms seed retrieval of publicly available commonly searched questions generated by a search engine and shown to users entering those terms. The English benchmark is open-domain, free-response, and question-only, with no reference answers or automatic accuracy metric. Clinician focus groups refine 12 evaluation axes, and a pilot uses triplicate ratings of 25 question-answer tuples per dataset. The detailed blinded study samples 100 HealthSearchQA, 20 LiveQA, and 20 MedicationQA questions, disjoint from prompt tuning. One of nine clinicians rates each answer on scientific consensus, harm, comprehension, retrieval, reasoning, content, and bias dimensions; five lay raters assess intent and helpfulness/actionability. One hundred bootstrap replicas yield 95% percentile intervals. The sampled 140-question study is evaluation, not construction of the full 3,375-query dataset.

source_locator: Sections 3.1-3.3 and Appendices A.1-A.2 on exam selection, OCR, expert verification, marking schemes, annotations, grading, and medal mapping; official SciYu/HiPhO repository
evidence_summary_en: The HiPhO paper snapshot selects 13 official 2024-2025 exam papers from seven influential physics Olympiads based on influence and availability of human scores. OCR converts PDFs to markdown while preserving LaTeX; question and solution indices are matched, then experts manually verify every QA pair and correct OCR, matching, and answer errors. Seven exams supply official marking schemes, converted into model-readable step rubrics, and four support multiple official solutions. Post-processing completes context, structures dependent subquestions, and records required units. The final paper benchmark has 360 problems, 519 subquestions, 308 English and 52 Chinese problems, five physics fields, four modalities, six answer types, and three difficulty levels. Answer grading first uses a rule-based math verifier and then a strong model for failed equivalent matches. Exams with schemes receive step-level partial credit and take the best valid official solution path; other exams use answer-level grading. Scores sum by exam and map to official medal thresholds.

source_locator: Figure 2, Sections 3.1-3.3, execution-based repair, and Appendix Table 15; official Snowflake AgentWorldModel repository and AgentWorldModel-1K scenario/task files
evidence_summary_en: HireBench is not a standalone benchmark. The Agent World Model paper lists 'HireBench Coding Graduate Pipeline' as one generated scenario, and the AgentWorldModel-1K release maps it to ats_applicant_tracking_system_4 with ten tasks spanning requisitions, coding assessments, candidate profiles, submissions, interviews, offers, bulk pipeline updates, and recruiting analytics. The common AWM pipeline expands 100 domain-name seeds into stateful CRUD scenarios, classifies and embedding-deduplicates them, generates ten API-solvable post-authentication tasks per scenario, synthesizes SQLite schema and sample state, emits a minimal typed FastAPI/MCP interface, and generates task-specific before/after-state verifiers. Components execute in isolation and feed failures back for up to five repair iterations. During evaluation the agent acts through MCP tools against persistent state; structured database signals and the trajectory feed a code-augmented LLM judge, producing Completed, Partially Completed, Agent Error, or Environment Error.

evidence_summary_en: DeepSeek reports use HumanEval-Mul for Python, Java, C++, C#, JavaScript, TypeScript, PHP, and Bash under the dataset's original protocol with default prompts, Pass@1, and a maximum output length of 8,192 tokens. The official DeepSeek-Coder harness links the source to MultiPL-E rather than defining a new translation pipeline. MultiPL-E translates HumanEval function signatures, first-order hidden tests, type annotations, doctests, and Python-specific terminology while leaving function bodies for the model. Target-language exclusions for unsupported or untranslatable constructs produce 164 Python, 161 C++, 158 Java, 161 PHP, 159 TypeScript, 158 C#, 158 Bash, and 161 JavaScript tasks, totaling 1,280 language-problem instances; exclusions are per target and do not reduce the 164 Python originals. Evaluation cleans language-specific completions, compiles where needed, executes hidden tests under timeouts in containers, requires every test to pass, and reports functional-correctness Pass@1 across tracks.

source_locator: Paper Sections 2-4 and appendices; official allenai/IFBench test JSONL, verifier code, and IFBench_multi-turn dataset configuration
evidence_summary_en: The paper and release define 58 manually authored out-of-domain test constraints across seven categories with executable Python verifiers, held-out WildChat tasks checked for compatibility, 300 single-turn prompts, and exactly 1,387 IFBench multi-turn rewrite conversations. Strict evaluation checks raw output; loose evaluation also applies limited boundary-line and font-modifier cleanup. IFTrain's 29 training constraints and IF-RLVR training are separate from test construction.
evidence_summary_zh: 论文与发布数据定义了七类 58 个手工设计的域外测试约束及可执行 Python 验证器，并将留出 WildChat 任务做人工兼容性检查，得到 300 个单轮提示和精确 1,387 个 IFBench 多轮改写对话。严格评测直接检查原始输出；宽松评测额外做有限的首尾行与字体修饰清理。IFTrain 的 29 个训练约束和 IF-RLVR 训练与测试构建分离。
construction_steps_en: Collect difficult unseen constraint ideas from LM-user feedback and manual coverage analysis
Organize 58 test constraints into count, ratio, words, sentence, format, custom, and copy categories
Implement each test constraint as an executable Python verifier
Sample WildChat tasks unseen at release time and manually remove task-constraint conflicts
Instantiate 300 single-turn prompts, including 256 one-constraint and 44 two-constraint cases
Create 1,387 multi-turn conversations as task, assistant response, and constraint-based rewrite request
Release IFTrain's 29 unseen training constraints and optional IF-RLVR data as a separate training branch
construction_steps_zh: 从模型用户反馈与人工覆盖分析中收集困难未见约束想法
把 58 个测试约束组织为计数比例词语句子格式自定义和复制七类
为每个测试约束实现可执行 Python 验证器
抽取发布时未见的 WildChat 任务并人工移除任务与约束冲突
实例化 300 个单轮提示，其中 256 个单约束、44 个双约束
按任务助手回复约束改写请求的结构创建 1,387 个多轮对话
把 IFTrain 的 29 个未见训练约束与可选 IF-RLVR 数据作为独立训练分支发布
evaluation_steps_en: Generate the final response at temperature 0 and extract the answer from thinking models when required
Run strict verification directly on the raw output
Run loose verification with permitted first/last-line and selected font-modifier cleanup
Report prompt-level accuracy, emphasizing loose accuracy and separating single-turn from multi-turn results
evaluation_steps_zh: 以温度 0 生成最终回复并在需要时从思考模型输出中提取答案
对原始输出直接执行严格验证
在许可的首尾行与特定字体修饰清理后执行宽松验证
报告提示级准确率并以宽松准确率为主同时区分单轮与多轮结果

source_locator: Paper sections on IMO-AnswerBench and AnswerAutoGrader; official google-deepmind/superhuman imobench/answerbench_v2.csv and README correction note
evidence_summary_en: The paper handpicks 400 national, regional, and international Olympiad problems, balances exactly 100 each across algebra, combinatorics, geometry, and number theory, reformulates proof-heavy items into unique non-trivial short answers, robustifies them, and vets them with medalists and mathematicians. A Gemini 2.5 Pro AnswerAutoGrader is validated on 800 judgments and reports overall and category accuracy, usually over eight runs; the official v2 file preserves 400 corrected rows.
evidence_summary_zh: 论文手工筛选 400 道国家级地区级和国际奥赛题，在代数组合几何数论四类各平衡 100 道，将证明型题改写为唯一且非平凡的短答案并做稳健化，再由奖牌得主和数学家复核。Gemini 2.5 Pro AnswerAutoGrader 通过 800 次判断验证，报告总体与分类准确率且通常运行八次；官方 v2 文件保留修正后的 400 行。
construction_steps_en: Collect national, regional, and international Olympiad candidate problems
Handpick 400 problems with verifiable short answers
Balance 100 problems in each of algebra, combinatorics, geometry, and number theory across four difficulty levels
Reformulate proof-heavy items to yield unique, clear, non-trivial short answers
Robustify problems by paraphrasing, renaming objects, changing values, or adding distractors
Apply a consistency gate and vet the set with medalists and mathematicians holding 10 gold and 5 silver medals collectively
Publish the 400-row AnswerBench and issue the 400-row v2 correction for ambiguous statements or incorrect answers
construction_steps_zh: 汇集国家级地区级和国际数学奥赛候选题
手工筛选 400 道具有可验证短答案的问题
在代数组合几何数论四类各平衡 100 道并覆盖四个难度层级
把证明型问题改写为唯一清晰且非平凡的短答案
通过释义重命名对象改变数值或增加干扰项做稳健化
执行一致性门槛并由合计持有 10 金 5 银的奖牌得主与数学家复核
发布 400 行 AnswerBench 并用同为 400 行的 v2 修正歧义题面或错误答案
evaluation_steps_en: Generate model solutions while preserving reasoning and the final answer, usually over eight runs
Use the Gemini 2.5 Pro AnswerAutoGrader to extract the final answer and compare it semantically with the ground truth
Apply equivalent-format, inconsistent-answer, and missing-answer decisions
Report overall and four-category accuracy plus original-versus-robustified analysis
evaluation_steps_zh: 生成保留推理与最终答案的模型解答并通常运行八次
使用 Gemini 2.5 Pro AnswerAutoGrader 提取最终答案并与标准答案做语义比较
处理等价格式答案不一致和缺失答案判定
报告总体与四分类准确率以及原题与稳健化题对比

source_locator: Paper sections on AnswerBench, ProofBench, GradingBench and automatic graders; official imobench answerbench_v2.csv, proofbench_v2.csv, gradingbench.csv, and README
evidence_summary_en: The paper snapshot defines three complementary benchmarks: AnswerBench with 400 verifiable short-answer problems; ProofBench with 60 proof problems split into 30 Basic and 30 Advanced, where Advanced contains 18 novel medalist-authored, 6 IMO 2024, and 6 USAMO 2025 problems; and GradingBench with 1,000 advanced-proof model solutions and human 0-7 grades balanced into labels 7, 6, 1, and 0. Their metrics are answer accuracy, expert proof points, and grading accuracy plus MAE.
evidence_summary_zh: 论文快照定义三个互补基准：400 道可验证短答案题的 AnswerBench；60 道证明题且分为基础 30 与高级 30 的 ProofBench，其中高级集含奖牌得主原创 18 道、IMO 2024 六道和 USAMO 2025 六道；以及 1,000 条高级证明模型解答和人工 0 至 7 分并平衡为 7、6、1、0 标签的 GradingBench。三者分别用答案准确率专家证明得分以及评分准确率与 MAE。
construction_steps_en: Use the medalist and mathematician panel to build three complementary paper benchmarks
Construct AnswerBench from 400 robustified short-answer problems balanced across four categories
Construct ProofBench with 30 Basic and 30 Advanced proof problems
Compose the Advanced proof set from 18 novel medalist-authored problems, 6 robustified IMO 2024 problems, and 6 USAMO 2025 problems
Have experts grade candidate proofs on the integer IMO 0-7 scale with references and problem-specific guidelines
Construct GradingBench from 1,000 advanced-proof model solutions and human grades
Map and balance GradingBench labels as Correct 7, Almost 6, Partial 1, and Incorrect 0
construction_steps_zh: 由奖牌得主与数学家评审团构建论文中的三个互补基准
以四类均衡的 400 道稳健化短答案题构建 AnswerBench
以基础 30 道和高级 30 道证明题构建 ProofBench
高级证明集由奖牌得主原创 18 道稳健化 IMO 2024 六道和 USAMO 2025 六道组成
专家依据参考解与题目专用细则按 IMO 整数 0 至 7 分评价候选证明
由 1,000 条高级证明模型解答及人工分数构建 GradingBench
把 GradingBench 映射并平衡为正确 7 几乎正确 6 部分正确 1 错误 0
evaluation_steps_en: Evaluate AnswerBench with semantic final-answer grading and report overall and category accuracy
Evaluate ProofBench with the problem, candidate, reference, and guidelines; report percent of maximum points by basic, advanced, and source slices
Treat ProofAutoGrader as a rank-correlation-validated scalable proxy, not a replacement for primary human grades
Evaluate GradingBench with only the problem and proposed solution; report four-way accuracy and mean absolute error
Combine the three outputs into a profile of answer correctness, proof quality, and proof-grading ability
evaluation_steps_zh: 以最终答案语义评分评测 AnswerBench 并报告总体与分类准确率
向 ProofBench 评审提供题目候选解参考解与细则并按基础高级来源切片报告占最高总分百分比
把 ProofAutoGrader 视为经排名相关性验证的规模化代理而非主要人工分数替代品
仅向 GradingBench 提供题目与候选解并报告四分类准确率和平均绝对误差
将三项输出合并为答案正确性证明质量和证明评分能力画像

source_locator: Paper Sections 2-4, dataset composition and subset tables, and regionality analysis; official CohereLabs/include-base-44 dataset card
evidence_summary_en: The paper builds 197,243 MCQAs from 1,926 exams in 44 languages, 15 scripts, 52 countries, and 58 domains. Native communities collect three exam-source families, multi-format extraction and native-speaker quality control yield 118,606 new questions, and six existing multilingual exam datasets add 78,637. Exam-level taxonomy and regionality labels support the paper's BASE 22,635 and LITE 10,770 subsets and multilingual prompt analyses.
evidence_summary_zh: 论文构建了来自 1,926 场考试、44 种语言、15 种文字、52 个国家与 58 个领域的 197,243 道 MCQA。母语社区收集三类考试来源，多格式抽取和母语者质检得到 118,606 道新题，六个既有多语言考试集补充 78,637 道。考试级学科分类与地域性标注支持论文的 BASE 22,635 和 LITE 10,770 子集及多语言提示分析。
construction_steps_en: Recruit native speakers and regional associations to collect academic, professional-certification, and regional-license exams
Extract questions, options, and correct answers from PDF, JavaScript/HTML, and other formats
Compare extracted items with originals, manually correct errors, remove image or table dependencies, and preserve required context
Produce 118,606 newly parsed and verified MCQAs from 1,926 exams
Consolidate 78,637 questions from ArabicMMLU, ChineseMMLU, TurkishMMLU, PersianMMLU, VNHSGE, and EXAMS
Form the 197,243-question complete set over 44 languages, 15 scripts, 52 countries, and 58 domains
Annotate language, topic, academic level, country, a two-level exam taxonomy, and four regionality classes
Curate four-option BASE with 22,635 questions and LITE with 10,770 questions under paper sampling rules
construction_steps_zh: 组织母语者与地区协会收集学术考试职业认证和地区执照考试
从 PDF JavaScript/HTML 等格式抽取问题选项与正确答案
与原件比较并人工纠错移除图像或表格依赖且保留必要上下文
从 1,926 场考试生成 118,606 道新解析并核验的 MCQA
合并 ArabicMMLU ChineseMMLU TurkishMMLU PersianMMLU VNHSGE 与 EXAMS 的 78,637 道题
形成覆盖 44 种语言 15 种文字 52 个国家与 58 个领域的 197,243 题完整集
标注语言主题学术层级国家两层考试分类和四类地域性
按论文采样规则整理四选项 BASE 22,635 题与 LITE 10,770 题
evaluation_steps_en: Evaluate with five-shot prompting and zero-shot chain of thought
Compare in-language and English prompts with optional region prefixes
Parse one of four answer options and separately track formatting failures
Report total accuracy, answer accuracy, and language, domain, and regionality analyses
evaluation_steps_zh: 使用 5-shot 提示与零样本思维链评测
比较本地语言和英文提示并可选加入地区前缀
解析四个选项之一并单独记录格式失败
报告总准确率答案准确率以及语言领域和地域性分析

source_locator: Paper Sections 4.1-4.3 and tables on Basic, UGE, multi-turn evaluation, GPT-4o rubrics, FakeShield and ImgEdit-Judge; official PKU-YuanGroup/ImgEdit benchmark release
evidence_summary_en: The paper builds an 811-case benchmark from a 734-case Basic suite, 47 manually curated UGE cases, and 30 multi-turn cases with three turns each. Single-turn outputs use repeated native-resolution generation and gated GPT-4o ratings; multi-turn outputs use a separate human yes/no protocol, while FakeShield and the optional open ImgEdit-Judge remain auxiliary.
evidence_summary_zh: 论文构建 811 个案例，其中 Basic 734 个、人工整理的 UGE 47 个、多轮案例 30 个且每例三轮。单轮输出按原生分辨率重复生成并使用带评分门控的 GPT-4o 量表，多轮输出走独立人工是非评分；FakeShield 与可选开放 ImgEdit-Judge 均为辅助项。
construction_steps_en: Define Basic proficiency, complex understanding-grounding-editing, and real-world multi-turn capability lanes
Manually collect Basic images online across six super-categories and ten concepts each
Use GPT-4o to propose instructions for nine common edit tasks and manually filter them into 734 Basic cases
Manually curate 47 complex images with occlusion, repeated instances, camouflage, or uncommon subjects
Write UGE prompts for spatial, multi-object, compound, fine-grained, and large-scale edits
Create 30 multi-turn cases over content memory, content understanding, and version backtracking with three turns each
construction_steps_zh: 定义基础编辑复杂理解定位编辑和真实多轮使用三条能力路线
按六大类且每类十个概念从网络人工收集 Basic 图像
由 GPT-4o 为九类常见编辑提出指令并人工过滤为 734 个 Basic 案例
人工整理 47 张包含遮挡重复实例伪装或非常见主体的复杂图像
为空间多对象复合细粒度和大尺度编辑编写 UGE 指令
按内容记忆内容理解和版本回退构建 30 个每例三轮的多轮案例
evaluation_steps_en: Generate single-turn edits at each model's native resolution and repeat experiments three times
Rate instruction adherence, editing quality, and detail preservation from 1 to 5 with task-specific GPT-4o rubrics
Cap editing-quality and detail-preservation scores at the instruction-adherence score
Use FakeShield artifact-localization recall only as an auxiliary fakeness measure
Generate sequential multi-turn edits with full history and versions and score them by detailed human yes/no guidelines
Report Basic task means, UGE mean, multi-turn success, and the auxiliary fake score; keep ImgEdit-Judge optional
evaluation_steps_zh: 按各模型原生分辨率生成单轮编辑并将实验重复三次
用任务专用 GPT-4o 量表对指令遵循编辑质量和细节保留打 1 至 5 分
将编辑质量与细节保留分数限制为不高于指令遵循分数
仅把 FakeShield 伪影定位召回率作为辅助伪造感指标
保留完整历史与版本顺序生成多轮编辑并按详细人工准则做是非评分
报告 Basic 各任务均值 UGE 均值多轮成功率与辅助伪造分且保持 ImgEdit-Judge 可选

source_locator: ACL 2024 paper Sections 2-3, Table 1, language-resource groups, prompting and fine-tuning analyses; official google-research-datasets/indic-gen-bench files and README
evidence_summary_en: IndicGenBench contains five paper tasks over 29 Indic languages, 13 scripts, and four language families: CrossSum-IN, bidirectional FLORES-IN, XQuAD-IN, XorQA-IN-XX, and XorQA-IN-EN. Professional translators extend four source datasets into multi-way parallel data, and evaluation uses ChrF for summarization and translation plus SQuAD Token-F1 for QA.
evidence_summary_zh: IndicGenBench 包含覆盖 29 种印度语言、13 种文字和 4 个语系的五项论文任务：CrossSum-IN、双向 FLORES-IN、XQuAD-IN、XorQA-IN-XX 与 XorQA-IN-EN。专业译者把四个源数据集扩展为多路平行数据，摘要和翻译用 ChrF，问答用 SQuAD Token-F1。
construction_steps_en: Start from CrossSum, FLORES-200, XQuAD/SQuAD, and XOR-TyDi sources
Select English examples per task and reuse existing Indic translations where available
Have professional contract translators complete missing task fields across 29 languages
Organize languages into nine high-, seven medium-, and thirteen low-resource groups
Form CrossSum-IN 20.3k, FLORES-IN 58.2k, XQuAD-IN 16.6k, and shared XorQA-IN 32k components
Release task, language, and split JSON with source-dependent licenses and a benchmark canary
construction_steps_zh: 从 CrossSum FLORES-200 XQuAD/SQuAD 与 XOR-TyDi 四个来源开始
按任务筛选英文样本并在可用时复用现有印度语言译文
由专业合同译者补齐 29 种语言缺失的任务字段
把语言划分为高资源 9 种中资源 7 种和低资源 13 种
形成 CrossSum-IN 20.3k FLORES-IN 58.2k XQuAD-IN 16.6k 与共享 XorQA-IN 32k 组件
按任务语言和划分发布 JSON 并保留来源许可证与 benchmark canary
evaluation_steps_en: Run the main one-shot generation setting with task-language examples
Evaluate zero-, one-, and five-shot or task-specific few-shot variants where reported
Score CrossSum-IN and both FLORES-IN directions with ChrF
Score XQuAD-IN, XorQA-IN-XX, and XorQA-IN-EN with SQuAD Token-F1
Compare English, Hindi, and test-language prompts and multilingual fine-tuning
Report language-level scores, high/medium/low-resource averages, and the gap from English
evaluation_steps_zh: 以任务语言示例运行主要 one-shot 生成设置
按论文报告评测零样本单样本五样本或任务专用少样本变体
用 ChrF 评价 CrossSum-IN 与 FLORES-IN 两个方向
用 SQuAD Token-F1 评价 XQuAD-IN XorQA-IN-XX 与 XorQA-IN-EN
比较英文印地语与测试语言提示及多语言微调
报告各语言分数高中低资源均值和相对英文差距

source_locator: Paper Sections 3-5, dataset collection, annotation, QA taxonomy, split statistics and ANLS definition; official DocVQA InfographicVQA page
evidence_summary_en: The paper filters more than 10,000 web infographics through perceptual-hash and Textract/Jaccard deduplication, then replaces a noisy crowd pilot with 13 trained annotators and a two-stage annotation protocol. After answer filtering and image-disjoint splitting, the final release has 30,035 questions over 5,485 images and uses ANLS plus exact accuracy.
evidence_summary_zh: 论文把超过 10,000 张网页信息图依次经过感知哈希和 Textract/Jaccard 去重，并因众包试点噪声过高改用 13 名受训标注者执行两阶段标注。经答案过滤与图像级互斥划分后，最终发布 5,485 张图像上的 30,035 个问题，以 ANLS 和严格准确率评价。
construction_steps_en: Download more than 10,000 images from Google and Bing with the query infographics
Remove nearly 2,000 duplicates with perceptual hashing
Run Amazon Textract OCR and token-Jaccard deduplication to form about 7,000 candidates
Replace the greater-than-40-percent noisy crowd pilot with an internal tool, webinar, quiz, and 13 supported annotators
Collect question-answer pairs in Stage 1 and permit unsuitable-image rejection until the corpus exceeds 30k questions
Create roughly 80/10/10 image-disjoint train, validation, and test splits
On validation and test, collect an independent second answer from a different worker and assign answer-source, evidence, and operation types
Remove 1.9 percent cannot-answer questions, lowercase and deduplicate references, and preserve multi-span permutations
construction_steps_zh: 以 infographics 查询从 Google 与 Bing 下载超过 10,000 张图像
用感知哈希移除近 2,000 张重复图像
运行 Amazon Textract OCR 并按文本词元 Jaccard 二次去重得到约 7,000 张候选图
因众包试点噪声超过 40% 改用内部工具研讨会测验和 13 名受支持标注者
第一阶段收集问答对并允许拒绝不适合的图像直至超过 3 万个问题
按图像互斥方式建立约 80/10/10 的训练验证测试划分
在验证与测试集由不同标注者独立补充第二答案并标注答案来源证据和操作类型
移除 1.9% 无法回答问题统一小写并去重参考答案且保留多片段排列
evaluation_steps_en: Run VQA from image, question, Textract OCR text, and bounding boxes
Allow extractive, multi-span, and numeric non-extractive answers
Lowercase predictions and select the best score across unique references
Compute ANLS with normalized edit similarity and a 0.5 cutoff plus exact accuracy
Use volunteer answers for every test question as the near-perfect human reference
evaluation_steps_zh: 基于图像问题 Textract OCR 文本和边界框运行 VQA

Use a BERT question detector and regex to remove statements, billing, and logistics, yielding about 26K candidates
Have medical professionals retain 1,212 stand-alone questions and assign ICD-10 condition labels

通过协作共识标注 892 条必需陈述与 697 条可选陈述

Treat the model answer as NLI premise and each physician statement as hypothesis
Use GPT-4 few-shot chain of thought to classify entailment or contradiction
Validate on 50 question-answer pairs and 402 statements with three physicians, majority vote, and Fleiss kappa 0.70
Report comprehensiveness over entailed Must Have statements and hallucination rate over contradicted gold statements

construction_steps_en: Synthesize twelve question subsets from prefill, assessment seeds, code snippets, documentation, and prior synthetic data
Deduplicate within each subset using all-mpnet-base-v2 embeddings and FAISS nearest neighbors
Have GPT-4o-0513 jointly generate a Python solution and pytest cases
Execute tests and require all tests to pass with 100% branch coverage
Allocate up to ten fresh solution-test attempts to hard questions while retaining only non-decreasing coverage
Retain 279K verified triplets and create 168K function-signature/example style conversions
Release 447K verified RL-ready question-solution-test triplets
Sample three DeepSeek-R1 reasoning responses per question and retain only test-passing outputs for KodCode-SFT

在 HumanEval(+)、MBPP(+)、BigCodeBench 与 LiveCodeBench V5 上使用贪心解码

Fix 1,729 unique single-hop or multi-hop QA pairs across six English and five Chinese datasets
Mix supporting documents with sampled distractors, shuffle passages, and disperse multi-hop evidence
Materialize every QA pair at 16K, 32K, 64K, 128K, and 256K words or Chinese characters
Insert GPT-4-generated and human-revised confusing facts into six datasets
Apply human-designed keyword or phrase replacements to 1,924 pairs across six datasets and review new conflicts
Have five full-time master's-level annotators review 557 confusing-fact and 955 answer-keyword instances
Release 8,645 contexts with ground truth, confusion metadata, and answer keywords
construction_steps_zh: 选择公开问答和文本源并构建九个改编问答集与两个合成事实回忆集
在六个英文和五个中文数据集中固定 1,729 个单跳或多跳独特问答对
混合支持文档与采样干扰文档打乱篇章并分散多跳证据
将每个问答对生成 16K 32K 64K 128K 和 256K 词或汉字五级上下文
为六个数据集插入 GPT-4 生成且经人工修订的混淆事实
在六个数据集的 1,924 个问答对上应用人工设计的关键词或短语替换并复查新冲突
由五位全职硕士标注员复核 557 个混淆事实和 955 个答案关键词实例
发布含标准答案混淆元数据和答案关键词的 8,645 个上下文

Middle-truncate unsupported contexts while preserving the head and tail
Require manually marked answer-keyword recall at the dataset threshold
Remove blacklisted non-informative words and compute English or Chinese QA F1 or the defined task-native ROUGE metric
Report scores by all 11 datasets, five length levels, and single-hop versus multi-hop tasks

按 11 个数据集五个长度层级及单跳多跳任务汇报分数

Programmatically generate 750 SeqQA questions across 15 subtasks and 650 DbQA questions across ten subtasks
Have authors and contracted biology experts write 248 LitQA2, 102 SuppQA, 226 FigQA, 305 TableQA, 135 ProtocolQA, and 41 CloningScenarios questions
Use model suggestions only as optional inspiration and require experts to correct every retained item
Calibrate new authors on their first 5–10 questions and continue author review, revision, approval, or rejection
Assemble 2,457 MCQs with gold answers, plausible distractors, provenance, and contamination canaries
Retain about 20 percent private and release about 80 percent public within each subtask
construction_steps_zh: 定义八类实际生物研究能力与 30 个子任务

Compare with PhD biology researchers who may use research tools but no AI tools and mark answer certainty

每个模型重复三次并汇报大类及子任务结果

Have a separate LabelBox annotator isolate the figure image, caption, relationship boxes, DOI, and source metadata
Serve figures to author or contracted biology experts in the authoring interface
Write a question, ideal answer, and plausible distractors that integrate multiple figure elements

由独立 LabelBox 标注员分离图像图注关系框 DOI 和来源元数据
在出题界面向作者或签约生物学专家呈现图像
编写需要整合多个图像元素的问题标准答案与合理干扰项
GPT-4 Turbo 建议仅用于可选头脑风暴且保留内容必须由专家纠正

校准每位作者前 5 至 10 题并持续审核修订

evaluation_steps_en: Provide only the figure image and multiple-choice question to a multimodal model

Parse the selected option and compute accuracy, precision, and coverage

解析所选选项并计算准确率精确率和覆盖率

source_locator: arXiv:2604.09554v2 Sections 2.1.1, 2.2.1, 2.3.1, 2.4.1, and 2.5; official EdisonScientific/labbench2 repository snapshot c028ecdcf144b55ffcd92b68be45081df5628c20
evidence_summary_en: Expert-authored literature, protocol, and cloning tasks run in parallel with hybrid DbQA2 and programmatic SeqQA2 construction; review yields 1,912 open-response tasks with realistic image/PDF/retrieval and inline/file/retrieval modes plus task-specific graders.
evidence_summary_zh: 专家编写的文献实验方案和克隆任务与混合构建的 DbQA2 及程序生成的 SeqQA2 并行；审核形成 1,912 个开放式任务，包含真实图像论文检索和内嵌文件检索输入方式及任务专用评分器。
construction_steps_en: Define five realistic research families: literature, data access, molecular biology, protocol troubleshooting, and experiment planning
Have contracted and internal domain experts create literature, protocol, and cloning tasks through multiple review rounds
Build SourceQuality from excluded studies in 100 open systematic reviews and manually inspect answerability
Analyze 1,000 recent bioRxiv papers, expert-curate 43 data sources, and draft and review 86 DbQA2 tasks
Have an in-house biologist define 20 SeqQA2 templates and expand each to 20 designed or real-sequence variants
Introduce an unambiguous negative-result error into public or expert-supplied protocols for 125 ProtocolQA2 tasks
Create 14 end-to-end restriction-ligation, Gibson, or Golden Gate CloningQA scenarios with a parseable DSL
Assemble 1,912 open-response tasks with sources, gold answers, files, and grader metadata
construction_steps_zh: 定义文献数据访问分子生物学实验方案排错和实验规划五类真实科研能力
由签约和内部领域专家通过多轮审核创建文献实验方案与克隆任务
从 100 篇开放系统综述的排除研究构建 SourceQuality 并人工检查可回答性
分析 1,000 篇近期 bioRxiv 论文由专家整理 43 个数据源并编写审核 86 个 DbQA2 任务
由内部生物学家定义 20 个 SeqQA2 模板且每个扩展为 20 个设计或真实序列变体
在公开或专家提供的实验方案中引入导致明确失败的错误形成 125 个 ProtocolQA2 任务
创建 14 个覆盖限制性连接 Gibson 或 Golden Gate 的端到端 CloningQA 场景和可解析领域语言
汇总含来源标准答案文件和评分器元数据的 1,912 个开放式任务
evaluation_steps_en: Materialize FigQA2 and TableQA2 in image, full-paper PDF, and retrieval modes and sequence tasks in inline, file, or retrieval modes
Run base systems without tools and tool-augmented systems with web search and code execution
Apply open-answer or source-grounded graders and task-specific verifier functions
Perform in-silico validation for SeqQA2 and parse and validate CloningQA DSL outputs end to end
Report accuracy overall and by research family, tool condition, input mode, and subtask
evaluation_steps_zh: 将 FigQA2 和 TableQA2 生成为图像完整论文与自主检索三种方式并将序列任务生成为内嵌文件或检索方式
运行无工具基础系统以及提供网络搜索和代码执行的工具增强系统
应用开放答案或来源一致性评分器及任务专用验证函数
对 SeqQA2 执行计算机模拟验证并端到端解析验证 CloningQA 领域语言输出
按总体科研能力工具条件输入方式和子任务汇报准确率

source_locator: Official lechmazur/writing repository snapshot 0286ecfcac37fbb3e19be4465662264de1e3ea98; current README comparison-leaderboard workflow
evidence_summary_en: Four hundred fixed ten-element creative briefs generate completed 600–800-word stories; matched same-brief stories are judged in both visible orders by multiple evaluators, position bias is corrected, opposite-order margins are averaged, global Thurstone scores are fitted, and stories plus evaluators are bootstrapped.
evidence_summary_zh: 400 个含十项必备元素的固定创意简报生成 600–800 字完整故事；同简报故事由多个评判模型按两种可见顺序比较，经位置偏差校正和反向顺序差值平均后拟合全局 Thurstone 分数，并同时对故事和评判模型 bootstrap。
construction_steps_en: Publish 400 fixed creative briefs, each specifying ten required narrative elements and a 600–800-word tagged output format
Generate one story per model and brief and retain completed stories without imputing scores for refusals
Match only stories written from the same brief and compare only models with completed stories
Judge each pair in both visible story orders with multiple independent evaluator models
Parse winner labels and signed margins while rejecting unparseable evaluator outputs
Estimate and correct each evaluator's measured side-position bias
Average opposite-order judgments per story pair
construction_steps_zh: 发布 400 个固定创意简报且每个简报规定十项必备叙事元素和 600–800 字标签输出格式
每个模型对每个简报生成一个故事且拒答不补分只保留完整故事
只匹配来自同一简报的故事且只比较完成故事的模型
由多个独立评判模型按两种可见故事顺序评判每一对故事
解析胜者标签与带符号差值并排除无法解析的评判输出
估计并校正每个评判模型实测的左右位置偏差
对每一对故事的相反顺序判断取平均
evaluation_steps_en: Aggregate signed story-level pair margins into a global comparison graph
Fit global Thurstone comparison scores and derive win probability against the model pool
Bootstrap both stories and evaluator models to compute 95 percent confidence intervals
Report comparison scores, win probabilities, confidence intervals, evaluator agreement, and word-count compliance
evaluation_steps_zh: 将带符号故事级成对差值汇总成全局比较图
拟合全局 Thurstone 比较分数并推导相对模型池的获胜概率
同时对故事和评判模型 bootstrap 以计算 95% 置信区间
汇报比较分数获胜概率置信区间评判一致性和字数合规率

source_locator: arXiv:2403.04132 Sections 2–4 and January 21, 2024 snapshot; official FastChat repository snapshot 587d5cfa1609a43d192cedb8441cac3c17db105d
evidence_summary_en: Anonymous users prompt two side-randomized models and cast one of four preference labels after multi-turn conversations; quality controls and blind expert validation produce a paper snapshot of 243,329 battles, followed by non-uniform-sampling correction and reweighted Bradley–Terry ranking with robust uncertainty.
evidence_summary_zh: 匿名用户向左右随机放置的两个模型自由提问并在多轮对话后投四类偏好标签；质量控制和专家盲复标形成论文快照的 243,329 场对战，再校正非均匀采样并用重加权 Bradley–Terry 与稳健不确定性估计排名。
construction_steps_en: Maintain a live pool of open and proprietary chat models
Anonymously sample two models, randomize left and right placement, and prioritize uncertain pairs through active sampling
Crowdsource unrestricted free-form prompts and permit multi-turn conversations until users can judge
Collect left-better, right-better, tie, or both-bad votes and reveal identities only after voting
Filter model-identity keywords, flag unsafe requests, and detect anomalous users or IPs
Build the paper snapshot of 243,329 battles from 90,051 users over 50 models and 149 languages
Blindly relabel 160 battles with graduate experts who may fact-check externally and measure 72–83 percent crowd–expert agreement
construction_steps_zh: 维护开放与闭源聊天模型的在线模型池
匿名采样两个模型随机安排左右位置并通过主动采样优先选择不确定模型对
众包不预设问题的自由提示且允许多轮对话直到用户可以判断
收集左侧更好右侧更好平局或两者都差四类投票且投票后才显示身份
过滤模型身份关键词标记不安全请求并检测异常用户或 IP
构建含 90,051 名用户 50 个模型 149 种语言和 243,329 场对战的论文快照
由可外部查证事实的研究生专家盲复标 160 场对战并测得 72–83% 众包专家一致率
evaluation_steps_en: Estimate a pairwise win matrix while accounting for non-uniform model-pair sampling and ties
Fit reweighted Bradley–Terry scores with maximum likelihood rather than the retired Elo workflow
Compute robust sandwich confidence intervals and uncertainty-aware approximate ranks
Publish Bradley–Terry scores, win rates, ranks, confidence intervals, and battle counts on an evolving leaderboard
evaluation_steps_zh: 在考虑非均匀模型对采样和平局的情况下估计成对获胜矩阵
通过最大似然拟合重加权 Bradley–Terry 分数而不是已弃用的 Elo 流程
计算稳健夹心置信区间和不确定性感知近似排名
在持续更新的排行榜发布 Bradley–Terry 分数胜率排名置信区间和对战数

visual_review.result: Both 1913 by 469 diagrams preserve anonymous pair sampling, all four vote outcomes, paper-snapshot counts, blind expert validation, non-uniform-sampling correction, and Bradley–Terry uncertainty without clipping, overlap, connector crossings, or incorrectly labeling the paper method as Elo.

source_locator: arXiv:2511.06346v2 benchmark construction and evaluation; official ByteDance-Seed/LPFQA dataset snapshot 8bf9f2ee879396909f940b512c9239be121a2505
evidence_summary_en: Experts vet more than 50 professional forums, preserve recent discussions as screenshots, and use VLM extraction plus LLM filtering before manual verification and 6–8-model difficulty calibration; the paper release contains 430 tasks, while the later official dataset expands to 502 records.
evidence_summary_zh: 专家审核 50 多个专业论坛并以截图保留近期讨论，经 VLM 抽取与 LLM 过滤后进行人工验证和 6–8 模型难度校准；论文发布 430 题，后续官方数据集扩展为 502 条。
construction_steps_en: Have domain experts submit and cross-review professional forums for specialization, authenticity, and permitted use
Collect more than 2,000 post-January-2025 threads from over 50 vetted forums across seven months
Store discussions as screenshots to preserve layout, formatting, and question–answer relationships
Use a VLM to extract questions, candidate answers, explanations, and context into structured fields
Use an LLM to remove vague, missing-answer, controversial, or incorrect discussions
Convert knowledge tasks to one-correct 4–6-distractor MCQs and reasoning or calculation tasks to short answer
Retain about 1,000 candidates and have the 209-member project expert panel verify long-tail value, clarity, and correctness
Run each item through 6–8 frontier models, assign difficulty from pass rates, and remove overly trivial items
Release 430 paper tasks: 249 multiple-choice and 181 short-answer across 7 primary and 21 secondary domains
construction_steps_zh: 由领域专家提交并交叉审核专业论坛的专业性真实性和允许使用情况
在七个月内从 50 多个已审核论坛收集 2,000 多个 2025 年 1 月后讨论串
将讨论保存为截图以保留布局格式和问题答案关系
使用 VLM 将问题候选答案解释和上下文抽取到结构化字段
使用 LLM 删除模糊缺失答案有争议或错误的讨论
将知识题转成一个正确项加 4–6 个干扰项的选择题并将推理计算题转成简答题
保留约 1,000 个候选且由 209 人项目专家组验证长尾价值清晰性和正确性
每题交给 6–8 个前沿模型并按通过率划分难度且删除过于简单的题
发布论文版 430 题其中 249 道选择题 181 道简答题覆盖 7 个一级和 21 个二级领域
evaluation_steps_en: Generate one answer per released multiple-choice or short-answer task
Following the paper contract, provide the question, expert reference answer, and model output to the judge
Judge final-answer semantic equivalence as a binary correct or incorrect verdict
Average binary correctness over 430 tasks and report primary-domain and difficulty breakdowns
evaluation_steps_zh: 对每个发布的选择题或简答题生成一个答案
按论文合同向评判模型提供问题专家参考答案与模型输出
将最终答案语义等价性判为二元正确或错误
在 430 题上平均二元正确性并按一级领域与难度拆分汇报
