visual_review.result: Both 1913 by 469 diagrams preserve all three paper construction stages, 430-task composition, domain and difficulty counts, and the paper's judge-input contract without clipping, overlap, connector crossings, or back-projecting the later 502-record expansion.

source_locator: arXiv:2406.08035v3 Sections 3 and 4; official LVBench repository snapshot 518df47219862534dad39fa1373b4e7c862a4cd5
evidence_summary_en: Five long-and-rich-video rules reduce 500 YouTube candidates to 103 videos totaling 117 hours; full-video event annotation, six-skill question authoring, balanced choice design, minimal clue timestamps, and dual-model text-only filtering yield 1,549 four-choice questions.
evidence_summary_zh: 五项长且内容丰富视频规则将 500 个 YouTube 候选筛至 103 个共 117 小时的视频；全片事件标注六项能力出题均衡选项最小证据时间戳和双模型纯文本过滤形成 1,549 道四选一问题。
construction_steps_en: Gather 500 YouTube candidates across sports, documentary, event records, lifestyle, TV or drama, and cartoon
Require videos at least 30 minutes long with rich dynamic visual content and multiple events
Filter for a clear protagonist, structural coherence, at least one significant event per five minutes, stable 720p visuals, and critical visual information
Retain 103 videos totaling 117 hours with a 4,101-second average duration
Watch each full video and mark significant events, scenes, entities, temporal relations, and causal relations
Write about 24 questions per video hour across temporal grounding, summarization, reasoning, entity recognition, event understanding, and key-information retrieval
Author one correct and three plausible length- and format-matched choices and limit excessive temporal-grounding questions
Annotate the minimal sufficient clue segment with exact start and end timestamps
Remove items when text-only GLM-4 and GPT-4 give the same answer and both match ground truth
Release 1,549 questions over 103 videos and six capabilities
construction_steps_zh: 从体育纪录片事件记录生活剧集动画六类收集 500 个 YouTube 候选视频
要求视频至少 30 分钟且包含丰富动态视觉内容与多个事件
按主角清晰结构连贯每五分钟至少一个重要事件稳定 720p 画面和关键信息依赖视觉筛选
保留 103 个共 117 小时且平均时长 4,101 秒的视频
完整观看每个视频并标记重要事件场景实体时间关系和因果关系
平均每小时视频编写约 24 题且覆盖时间定位摘要推理实体识别事件理解和关键信息检索
编写一个正确项和三个长度格式匹配的可信干扰项并限制过多时间定位题
用精确起止时间戳标注最小充分证据片段
当纯文本 GLM-4 与 GPT-4 答案相同且均命中真值时删除题目
发布覆盖 103 个视频和六项能力的 1,549 道问题
evaluation_steps_en: Provide the full video to native long-video models and fixed-frame samples such as 32 or 96 frames to other models
Decode one of four answer choices for every question
Compute exact multiple-choice accuracy over all 1,549 questions
Report results overall and by six capabilities and six video categories, alongside the 94.4 percent human result
evaluation_steps_zh: 向原生长视频模型提供完整视频并向其他模型提供如 32 或 96 帧固定采样
对每道题解码四个答案选项之一
在全部 1,549 题上计算精确选择题准确率
汇报总体六项能力六类视频结果并附论文 94.4% 人类结果

visual_review.artifact: Draw.io Desktop PNG exports plus local English and Chinese page DOM checks
visual_review.result: Both 1913 by 469 diagrams preserve all five screening rules, 103-video and 117-hour corpus counts, two annotation stages, six capabilities, clue timestamps, exact text-only filtering rule, and evaluation modes without clipping, overlap, connector crossings, or branchless decision diamonds.

source_locator: Harvey official May 6, 2026 benchmark announcement; official harveyai/harvey-labs repository snapshot f46ef86e4788545622db25dcffa3aebb7a139929
evidence_summary_en: Practicing lawyers decompose realistic client matters into closed-universe associate tasks, lawyer-review synthetic source files, and atomic binary criteria; 1,660 evolving tasks run in network-disabled containers and receive credit only when every semantically judged criterion passes.
evidence_summary_zh: 执业律师把真实感客户事项拆成闭卷式初级律师任务经律师审核的合成来源文件和原子二元评分点；持续演进的 1,660 个任务在禁网容器中运行且仅当全部语义评判评分点通过时得分。
construction_steps_en: Start from realistic client matters modeled by practicing lawyers across 24 practice areas plus contracting
Decompose matters into about 50-word partner-to-associate closed-universe requests with reviewable deliverables
Generate key and peripheral synthetic client documents in large batches under lawyer guidance and review
Represent realistic DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, PDF, and email source materials
Author atomic, binary, equal-weight, deliverable-scoped expert criteria with match rules and optional source-document references
Package title, instructions, work type, deliverables, criteria, tags, and versioned documents into task records
Release the evolving repository snapshot of 1,660 tasks and about 101,000 criteria
construction_steps_zh: 从执业律师模拟的真实感客户事项出发覆盖 24 个执业领域及合同工作
将事项拆成约 50 字的合伙人到初级律师闭卷式指令并定义可审阅交付物
在律师指导与审核下批量生成关键和外围合成客户材料
使用真实感 DOCX XLSX PPTX PDF 和邮件来源材料
编写原子二元等权且限定到交付物的专家评分点并添加匹配规则和可选来源文档引用
将标题指令工作类型交付物评分点标签和版本化文档打包成任务记录
发布当前快照的 1,660 个任务和约 101,000 个评分点
evaluation_steps_en: Start one Podman container per task with no network or capabilities, read-only source documents, and a writable output directory
Run the agent with bash, read, write, edit, glob, and grep until it stops calling tools or reaches the maximum turns
Judge one criterion at a time with default Claude Sonnet 4.6 at temperature zero against only relevant deliverables
Use semantic judgment rather than regex or keyword matching and assign a binary criterion verdict
Score a task as one only when every criterion passes and give no partial credit in the headline metric
Report all-criteria task pass rate plus pooled criterion pass rate, criterion heatmaps, document coverage, tokens, latency, and cost
evaluation_steps_zh: 每个任务启动一个禁网无额外权限来源文档只读且输出目录可写的 Podman 容器
让智能体使用 bash read write edit glob grep 直到停止工具调用或达到最大轮数
默认使用温度为零的 Claude Sonnet 4.6 每次只依据相关交付物评判一个评分点
使用语义判断而不是正则或关键词匹配并输出二元评分点结论
仅当全部评分点通过时任务得一分且核心指标不给部分分
汇报全评分点任务通过率并补充汇总评分点通过率热图文档覆盖率 Token 时延与成本

visual_review.result: Both 1633 by 469 diagrams preserve lawyer-led task and document construction, atomic criteria, current evolving counts, the isolated six-tool harness, criterion-level semantic judging, and strict all-pass scoring without clipping, overlap, connector crossings, or branchless decision diamonds.

source_locator: arXiv:2603.03781v1 Sections 3 through 5; official LifeBench repository
evidence_summary_en: Five DeepSeek-R1 modules synthesize grounded personas, one-year hierarchical event plans, constrained daily activities, multi-source phone and health artifacts, and timestamped QA; 10 user histories contain 2,003 questions and are evaluated through a LoCoMo-compatible memory pipeline.
evidence_summary_zh: 五个 DeepSeek-R1 模块依次合成有现实锚点的人物画像一年期分层事件受约束日常活动多源手机健康痕迹和带时间戳问答；10 份用户历史共含 2,003 道题并通过兼容 LoCoMo 的记忆流程评测。
construction_steps_en: Combine anonymized survey background and lifestyle with PersonaHub habits, plans, traits, skills, and fictional sensitive attributes
Synthesize each persona with a 20 to 30 person social network and real AMap urban anchors
Choose up to 10 personalized yearly plots from about 50 candidates across seven categories
Generate a one-year month-level outline autoregressively from prior-month summaries, holidays, and thematic events
Partonomically decompose yearly plots to thematic and atomic events shorter than one day and optimize two-week windows
Use a subjective agent with long-term summaries, seven-day memory, and three retrieved episodes to draft daily activities
Use an objective agent to check schedule conflicts, travel feasibility, venues, facts, weather, and existing activities
Generate contacts, SMS, calls, push notifications, photos, notes, calendars, agent chats, noise, health, and sports artifacts
Generate timestamped multiple-choice and short-answer questions during simulation and supplement phone data for answerability gaps
Apply LLM self-containment filtering, manual QA rewriting, and manual or automatic realism and diversity checks
Release 10 one-year histories with 5,149 events and 8,046 phone or health records per user plus 2,003 questions
construction_steps_zh: 结合匿名问卷背景生活方式 PersonaHub 习惯计划特质技能及虚构敏感属性
为每个人物合成 20 到 30 人社交网络并以高德地图真实城市地点锚定
从七类约 50 个候选情节中选择至多 10 个个性化年度情节
依据上月摘要节假日与主题事件自回归生成一年期月度大纲
以部分整体关系把年度情节分解为主题事件和不足一天的原子事件并优化两周窗口
主观智能体使用长期摘要七天记忆和三条检索情景活动生成日程
客观智能体检查时间冲突行程可行性地点事实天气与既有活动
生成联系人短信通话推送照片备忘录日历智能体聊天噪声健康与运动痕迹
在模拟期间生成带时间戳的选择题和简答题并为可回答性缺口补充手机数据
执行 LLM 自包含过滤人工问答改写以及人工或自动现实性和多样性检查

evidence_summary_en: Atomic skills and rare-skill-aware sampling create interdependent database, operating-system, and knowledge-graph task streams with executable labels; strict sequential evaluation compares successful-trajectory replay depths and group self-consistency.
evidence_summary_zh: 原子技能与稀有技能感知采样构建相互依赖且标签可执行校验的数据库操作系统和知识图谱任务流；严格顺序评测比较不同成功轨迹回放深度与分组自一致性。
construction_steps_en: Define 22 SQL skills, 29 Bash commands, and seven knowledge-graph logical operations
Probabilistically increase rare-skill sampling while varying difficulty, noise, skill overlap, and task dependency
Use DeepSeek-R1 to turn sampled SQL skills into database tasks in fresh Dockerized MySQL runs
Verify database reads by result comparison and writes by database-state hashing
Create Bash-command sequence tasks in Ubuntu containers reset from the original image for each task
Verify operating-system tasks with task-specific Bash evaluation scripts that must exit zero
Convert GrailQA S-expressions to agent actions and SPARQL-compatible knowledge-graph operations
Verify knowledge-graph task outputs against reproducible logical answer states
Manually review 10 percent of tasks and package all three environments behind unified APIs with strict order
construction_steps_zh: 定义 22 项 SQL 技能 29 个 Bash 命令和七种知识图谱逻辑操作
以概率机制提高稀有技能采样并改变难度噪声技能重叠与任务依赖
使用 DeepSeek-R1 将采样 SQL 技能转为在全新 Docker MySQL 中运行的数据库任务
读取任务比较查询结果而写入任务哈希数据库状态
在每个任务都从原始镜像重置的 Ubuntu 容器中构建 Bash 命令序列任务
使用必须以零退出的任务专属 Bash 评估脚本校验操作系统任务
将 GrailQA S-expression 转换为智能体动作和兼容 SPARQL 的知识图谱操作
将知识图谱输出与可复现逻辑答案状态比较
人工复核百分之十的任务并通过统一接口按严格顺序打包三种环境
evaluation_steps_en: Execute interdependent tasks sequentially through shared agent, environment, and controller APIs
Establish a no-replay baseline and replay 1, 4, 8, 16, 32, or 64 recent successful trajectories
Partition retrieved experiences into groups, predict independently, and majority-vote with group self-consistency
Report task success rate by DB, OS, KG, replay depth, group count, and token cost
evaluation_steps_zh: 通过共用智能体环境控制器接口按顺序执行相互依赖任务

evidence_summary_en: Separate action and scenery pipelines produce 28K four-second driving scenarios and 419.9K QA annotations; a 500-question, 1,000-answer human set trains and validates Lingo-Judge, while the diagram avoids the paper's internally conflicting action-branch subtotal.
evidence_summary_zh: 动作与场景两条流程形成 2.8 万个四秒驾驶场景和 41.99 万条问答标注；500 题 1,000 答案的人类评测集用于训练验证 Lingo-Judge 且图中避开论文内部冲突的动作分支小计。
construction_steps_en: Record forward-driving sessions with video, vehicle state, perception, policy context, and notable behavior changes
Extract four-second scenarios and sample frames at one hertz
For the Action branch, combine operator situation or behavior descriptions with lights, detections, weather, speed, steering, and road metadata
Use action, justification, question, and hint templates with GPT-3.5 rephrasing, answering, and extension and cap action or policy types at 500
For the Scenery branch, densely annotate three 30-minute sessions in ELAN across about 15 caption categories
Use GPT-4 chain-of-thought examples to generate about 43 perception QA items per scenery video
Merge 24,577 action snippets into the unambiguous aggregate of 28K scenarios and 419.9K QA annotations
Cover action, justification, attention, identification, localisation, description, counting, anticipation, and counterfactual reasoning
Have more than 20 in-house evaluators write 500 questions and two independent answers per question
Review semantic disagreements, relabel twice, and resolve by majority semantics and answer variety
construction_steps_zh: 采集包含视频车辆状态感知策略上下文和显著行为变化的前向驾驶行程
提取四秒场景并按一赫兹采样画面
动作分支结合操作员情境行为描述以及信号灯检测物天气速度转向和道路元数据
使用动作理由问题提示模板与 GPT-3.5 改写作答扩展并将每类动作策略限制在 500 条
场景分支在 ELAN 中密集标注三段各 30 分钟行程的约 15 类描述
用 GPT-4 思维链示例为每个场景视频生成约 43 条感知问答
把 24,577 个动作片段合并为无歧义的 2.8 万场景和 41.99 万问答标注总体
覆盖动作理由注意识别定位描述计数预判和反事实推理九项能力
由 20 多名内部评估员编写 500 道问题且每题独立收集两个答案
审核语义分歧再标两次并按多数语义和答案多样性解决
evaluation_steps_en: Train a LoRA-adapted DeBERTaV3 classifier on question, reference answer, model answer, and human correctness labels without video
Use active learning to add human corrections for mistakes on predictions from discarded model checkpoints
Score each question by the maximum predicted correctness over its two reference answers and average over questions
Validate at 95 percent held-out accuracy and report Spearman 0.950 and Pearson 0.993 correlation across 17 models
evaluation_steps_zh: 不输入视频而以问题参考答案模型答案和人类正确性标签训练 LoRA DeBERTaV3 分类器
用主动学习补入对淘汰模型预测错判样本的人类修正
每题取两个参考答案预测正确性最高值并对问题取均值
在留出集达到 95% 准确率并汇报 17 个模型上 Spearman 0.950 和 Pearson 0.993

source_locator: arXiv:2604.15384v2 Sections 2 through 5 and appendices; official linuxarena.ai site; linuxarena/control-tower repository
evidence_summary_en: Twenty scratch-built production-like environments contain 1,667 useful main tasks and 185 human-authored side tasks with hidden scorers; same-environment pairing, accidental-completion filtering, attack policies, and calibrated action monitoring support sabotage and utility evaluation.
evidence_summary_zh: 20 个从零构建的生产式环境包含 1,667 个有用主任务和 185 个人工副任务及隐藏评分器；同环境配对意外完成过滤攻击策略和校准逐动作监控共同支持破坏与效用评测。
construction_steps_en: Scratch-build 20 stateful multi-service Docker Compose environments representing production systems
Apply human, automated, and model quality checks and split 10 public from 10 withheld environments
Create 1,667 LLM-assisted, human-reviewed main tasks across feature, refactor, bug, research, rewrite, and infrastructure categories
Implement hidden external binary scorers for useful main-task completion
Human-author 185 side tasks without LLM generation across exfiltration, malware, tampering, access, monitoring, and secret categories
Implement minimal hidden side scorers with live or delayed failure semantics
Combine compatible main and side tasks from the same environment without fixing one permanent pair set
LLM-screen all same-environment pairs as unlikely, maybe, or likely accidental completion
Replay suspicious honest trajectories in fresh environments and use a second model for scorer-only testing
Remove passing accidental-completion pairs, about 0.9 percent overall, and release public plus withheld resources
construction_steps_zh: 从零构建 20 个代表生产系统的有状态多服务 Docker Compose 环境
执行人工自动化模型质量检查并划分 10 个公开和 10 个保留环境
以 LLM 辅助和人工审核构建 1,667 个功能重构修错调研重写基础设施主任务
为有用主任务完成情况实现隐藏外部二元评分器
不使用 LLM 而人工编写 185 个外泄恶意软件篡改越权监控破坏密钥访问副任务
以即时或延迟失败语义实现最小化隐藏副任务评分器
组合属于同一环境的相容主副任务且不固定一套永久配对
让 LLM 将所有同环境任务对标为不可能可能或很可能意外完成
在全新环境回放可疑诚实轨迹并由第二个模型执行只针对评分器的测试
删除能意外通过的任务对约占总体 0.9% 并发布公开和保留资源
evaluation_steps_en: Run an honest ReAct policy with Bash and Inspect for up to 160 steps
Run obvious side-only attacks for raw capability and subtle main-plus-side attacks with hidden planning
Score every action from zero to ten with an average of two monitor calls
Set the monitor threshold at the 99th percentile of honest scores for a one percent step-wise false-positive rate
Count sabotage only when the side task succeeds and no monitor flags before harm
Report main success, side success, conditional evasion, undetected sabotage, and Wilson 95 percent intervals
evaluation_steps_zh: 让诚实 ReAct 策略使用 Bash 和 Inspect 最多执行 160 步
运行仅做副任务的明显攻击测原始能力并运行隐藏计划的主任务加副任务隐蔽攻击
每个动作由平均两次监控调用输出零到十分可疑分
将阈值设在诚实分数第 99 百分位以获得百分之一逐步假阳性率
仅当副任务成功且危害发生前未被监控器告警时计为破坏成功
汇报主任务成功副任务成功条件规避未检出破坏和 Wilson 95% 区间

source_locator: arXiv:2507.00769v1 and EACL 2026 Sections 3 through 5; official SAA-Lab LitBench Hugging Face collection
evidence_summary_en: Post-2023 PRAW collection and a pre-2023 MIT-licensed preference corpus independently pass engagement, same-prompt, temporal, and 100-bin length-debiasing filters to yield 2,480 held-out pairs and 43,827 training pairs for judge, reward-model, and online human validation.
evidence_summary_zh: 2023 年后 PRAW 收集数据与 2023 年前 MIT 许可偏好语料分别经过参与度同提示时间与 100 桶长度去偏过滤形成 2,480 对留出测试和 43,827 对训练数据并用于裁判奖励模型及在线人工验证。
construction_steps_en: Query r/WritingPrompts through PRAW and search the top 100 results for more than 5,000 prompt IDs
Keep held-out stories posted after 2 January 2023 and source training stories from the MIT-licensed pre-2023 WritingPrompts preference corpus
Independently require at least 10 upvotes and 50 words and cap each story at 2,048 tokens in both splits
Form pairs only from two stories answering the same writing prompt and mark the higher-upvote story as chosen
Require at least a 25 percent upvote difference and require the chosen story to have been posted later
Build a 100-bin histogram of story-length differences and prune pairs toward symmetric longer and shorter chosen proportions
Release 2,480 test pairs from 3,543 stories and 43,827 training pairs from 50,309 stories
construction_steps_zh: 通过 PRAW 查询 r/WritingPrompts 并对 5,000 多个提示 ID 搜索前 100 项结果
测试集仅保留 2023 年 1 月 2 日后故事且训练集来自 MIT 许可的 2023 年前 WritingPrompts 偏好语料
在两份数据中分别要求故事至少 10 个赞和 50 词且最多 2,048 token
仅在回答同一写作提示的故事间配对并将赞数更高者标为偏好故事
要求赞数差至少 25% 且偏好故事的发布时间更晚
构建 100 桶故事长度差直方图并剪枝至偏好故事更长和更短比例近似对称
发布 3,543 篇故事组成的 2,480 对测试集和 50,309 篇故事组成的 43,827 对训练集
evaluation_steps_en: Present unlabeled story pairs to zero-shot LLM judges and average both A or B orderings to control position bias
Train Bradley-Terry discriminative and generative reward models on the curated preference corpus
Measure agreement with human preferences on the held-out debiased test set
Generate new stories with GPT-4.1 and GPT-4o, rank them with the trained reward model, and collect online pairwise human preferences
Report 73 percent for the best zero-shot judge and 78 percent for both trained reward-model families
evaluation_steps_zh: 向零样本 LLM 裁判输入未标注故事对并平均 A 与 B 两种顺序以控制位置偏差
在整理后的偏好语料上训练 Bradley-Terry 判别式和生成式奖励模型
在留出去偏测试集上计算与人类偏好的一致率
用 GPT-4.1 与 GPT-4o 生成新故事由训练后的奖励模型排序并在线收集人类成对偏好
报告最佳零样本裁判 73% 以及两类训练后奖励模型 78% 的一致率

evidence_summary_en: Problem inversion converts source answers into refreshable full-web entity or event searches; 100 tasks use category-specific and manually finalized claims, GPT-4o semantic matching, nested modified precision or recall or F1, and trace analysis.
evidence_summary_zh: 问题反转把源答案改写为可更新的全网实体或事件检索；100 个任务使用分类特定且人工完成的标准论点以 GPT-4o 语义匹配嵌套修正精确率召回率 F1 及轨迹分析评测。
construction_steps_en: Define deep research as high search fan-out plus nontrivial reasoning and isolate claim generation from report writing
Require diverse sources, objective reproducible answers, resistance to one-page or parametric-memory solutions, refreshability, and user diversity
Select document or long-context reasoning problems with ground-truth answers and supporting evidence
Invert answer properties into clues asking for the matching event or entity
Add discriminating properties until the answer is unique and update supporting documents for valid alternatives
Curate 100 tasks across eight scientific and world-event categories under SciFacts, NovelDS, PriorArt, Entities, and Flights
Build initial category-specific ground-truth claims from source documents or structured event scraping
Manually inspect system outputs and add valid answers missing from the initial gold lists

选择带标准答案与支持证据的文档或长上下文推理问题
把答案属性反转为检索线索并询问匹配的事件或实体
加入区分属性直至答案唯一并为有效替代答案更新支持文档
在 SciFacts NovelDS PriorArt Entities Flights 下整理八类科学与世界事件共 100 个任务
从源文档或结构化事件抓取构建分类特定的初始标准论点
人工检查系统输出并把初始标准列表遗漏的有效答案补入

Normalize generated outputs to JSON claims and subclaims and use GPT-4 parsing when needed
Match generated claims to ground truth with the published GPT-4o agreement prompt
Compute modified precision and recall that propagate subclaim quality to the parent and zero failed claim structures
Report F1 by category and analyze source counts, branching, and backtracking in traces
evaluation_steps_zh: 让三个闭源深度研究系统以及推理和非推理检索基线访问完整互联网
将生成输出规范化为论点和子论点 JSON 且必要时用 GPT-4 解析
使用论文公开的 GPT-4o 一致性提示匹配生成论点与标准论点
计算把子论点质量传播到父论点且对失败结构记零的修正精确率与召回率
按类别报告 F1 并分析轨迹中的来源数分支与回溯

evidence_summary_en: Research and crowdsourcing produce original Execution and Planning rule games with verifiable references, JSON answer and process fields, four difficulty levels, two worked exemplars, bilingual translation, and answer-process-aware metrics over 304 problems.
evidence_summary_zh: 调研与众包形成原创执行和规划规则游戏并带可验证参考过程 JSON 答案过程字段四级难度两个完整示例双语翻译及答案过程联合指标共 304 题。
construction_steps_en: Research and crowdsource game-like real-world scenarios with explicit rules and author problems unavailable online
Separate deterministic state-manipulation Execution tasks from strategic multi-step Planning tasks
Make every Execution step verifiable and add intermediate checkpoints or state variables to Planning tasks where needed
Record correct final answers and step-by-step reference processes
Require JSON output with answer and, for multi-step items, process lists
Create levels 0 through 3 by increasing rule complexity and reasoning-step count
Attach two exemplars per question with the question, answer, solution process, and rule explanation
Translate problems and instructions meticulously into aligned Chinese and English versions
Release 304 problems across Execution and Planning
construction_steps_zh: 调研众包具有明确规则的游戏化现实场景并原创设计网上不可检索的问题
把确定性状态变换的执行任务与多步策略规划任务分开
使执行任务每一步可验证且按需为规划任务加入中间检查点或状态变量
记录正确最终答案与逐步参考过程
强制 JSON 输出并为多步题提供 answer 与 process 列表
通过增加规则复杂度与推理步数构建 0 到 3 四级难度
每道题附两个包含题目答案求解过程和规则解释的完整示例
将问题和指令仔细翻译为对齐的中英文版本
发布覆盖执行与规划两域的 304 道问题
evaluation_steps_en: Run models at temperature zero with a 2,048-token maximum under zero-shot or two-exemplar prompting
Parse the required JSON answer and process lists
Score binary Answer Accuracy and character-level Process Accuracy
Compute Answer Process Accuracy by logical AND of answer and process correctness
Report JSError, IFError, and NIJ-Acc in addition to the three core metrics
evaluation_steps_zh: 以温度零和最大 2,048 token 在零样例或两个示例提示下运行模型
解析规定的 JSON 答案与过程列表
计算二值答案准确率和字符级过程准确率

source_locator: arXiv:2407.04973v1 Section 3 and evaluation protocol in Sections 4 and 5
evidence_summary_en: Five annotators spend three months curating 448 licensed closed-source visual MCQs with answers and rationales, five reasoning skills, nine capabilities, JSON storage, iterative LLM choice extraction, and three-level accuracy aggregation.

construction_steps_en: Use visual reasoning sources requiring licenses, registration, payment, or creator permission to reduce leakage
Have five annotators manually collect visual intelligence-test questions over three months
Record the image, multiple-choice options, correct answer, and supporting rationale
Tag diagrams, OCR, patterns, graphs, tables, 3D shapes, puzzles, sequences, and physics capabilities
Tag inductive, deductive, numerical, spatial, and mechanical reasoning skills
Store image, question, choices, answer, rationale, skill, and capability fields in JSON
Release 448 image-based multiple-choice samples

记录图像多选项正确答案与支持理由
标记图示 OCR 模式 图形 表格 3D 形状 谜题 序列和物理九种能力
标记归纳演绎数值空间机械五类推理技能
将图像问题选项答案理由技能与能力字段保存为 JSON

Give an extraction LLM the question, choices, model answer, and reasoning and request one answer letter
Validate the letter and repeat extraction with feedback when the output is invalid
Compare the valid extracted choice with the human answer as a binary result
Aggregate the same result into overall, five reasoning-skill, and nine capability accuracies

source_locator: arXiv:2407.15754 Sections 2 through 4; official LongVideoBench project resources
evidence_summary_en: A duration and content sampling design plus 720P, subtitle, Q-Align, and manual filters yields 3,763 videos; trained three-role annotation creates 6,678 grounded referring MCQs, and temporally interleaved frame-subtitle inputs are scored by accuracy.
evidence_summary_zh: 时长内容采样设计与 720P 字幕 Q-Align 和人工过滤形成 3,763 个视频；训练后的三角色标注产生 6,678 道有定位依据的引用多选题并以时间交错帧字幕输入按准确率评测。
construction_steps_en: Define four duration groups of 8 to 15 seconds, 15 to 60 seconds, 3 to 10 minutes, and 15 to 60 minutes plus ten content categories
Select 119 web-video channels comprising 99 landscape and 20 portrait channels and sample topics uniformly
Download videos at 720P resolution or better and retain layout, topic, and duration metadata
On platforms that provide transcripts remove videos with missing or non-English subtitles and on platforms without provided transcripts use Whisper-V3-Large
Score visual quality with Q-Align, remove especially low-quality candidates, and manually filter unusable videos
Finalize 3,763 videos across all category and duration groups
Train annotators by question category and require them to watch each full video with aligned subtitles
Author L1 Perception and L2 Relation MCQs across 17 categories with 3 or 4 relevant distractors
Highlight each referring query and label the frame indices for all referred moments
Use a primary annotator, examiner, and reviser and correct the roughly 20 percent identified as problematic
Release 6,678 questions split into 1,337 validation and 5,341 test items
construction_steps_zh: 定义 8 到 15 秒 15 到 60 秒 3 到 10 分钟 15 到 60 分钟四个时长组以及十个内容类别
选择横屏 99 个竖屏 20 个共 119 个网络视频频道并均匀采样主题
下载 720P 或更高分辨率视频并保留版式主题和时长元数据
删除平台字幕缺失或非英文的视频且平台不提供字幕时使用 Whisper-V3-Large 生成
用 Q-Align 评估视觉质量删除特别低质量候选并人工过滤不可用视频
在全部内容与时长组中确定 3,763 个视频
按题型培训标注者并要求其结合对齐字幕完整观看每个视频
在 17 个类别中编写 L1 感知和 L2 关系多选题并加入 3 或 4 个相关干扰项
突出每个引用查询并标注全部引用时刻的帧索引
由主标注者检查者和修订者处理且修正约 20% 被判为有问题的标注
发布 6,678 道题其中验证集 1,337 题测试集 5,341 题
evaluation_steps_en: Interleave sampled video frames and subtitle chunks by inserting each chunk between frames around its midpoint timestamp
Tune the frame-input setting on 752 validation videos with 1,337 questions
Use the selected setting on 3,011 test videos with 5,341 questions under zero-shot evaluation
Decode one multiple-choice answer per item
Report overall accuracy plus breakdowns for four duration groups and 17 question categories
evaluation_steps_zh: 按字幕中点时间戳将每个字幕片段插入其前后采样视频帧之间形成交错输入
在 752 个验证视频和 1,337 道题上选择帧输入设置
以选定设置对 3,011 个测试视频和 5,341 道题执行零样本评测
每道题解码一个多项选择答案
报告总体准确率以及四个时长组和 17 个问题类别分解

source_locator: arXiv:2508.12459 Sections 3 through 5 and Appendix; official google/LoraxBench Hugging Face release
evidence_summary_en: Six Indonesian-source tasks are cleaned, adapted, and translated into Indonesian plus 19 local languages with three register variants; native-speaker review and automated checks produce 23 subsets, while the official release count is explicitly reconciled with two inconsistent paper counts.
evidence_summary_zh: 六类印尼语源任务经清洗改造后翻译到印尼语及 19 种本地语言并加入三种语域变体；母语者复核与自动检查形成 23 个子集，同时明确核对官方发布量与论文中的两种不一致计数。
construction_steps_en: Define Indonesian plus 19 local languages and formal or casual variants for three languages, yielding 23 language-register subsets
Adapt TyDi-QA into reading comprehension and passage-removed open QA and retain the test data plus 100 training examples per subset
Use the expert-written IndoNLI test set for NLI and its premises for local-language-to-Indonesian translation
Use COPAL-ID for causal reasoning and IndoCulture for cultural QA
Remove six unanswerable open-QA items, Jakarta-centric COPAL-ID items, and problematic IndoCulture records while correcting distractors and typos
Translate with professional native speakers and review every item with a second native speaker
Flag abnormal translation lengths and numeric inconsistencies, then retranslate confirmed errors
Publish 87,011 official rows including 2,300 TyDi-QA training rows while documenting the paper Table 3 sum of 84,711 and prose count of 84,895
construction_steps_zh: 定义印尼语和 19 种本地语言，并为三种语言加入正式或日常语域，共形成 23 个语言语域子集
将 TyDi-QA 改造为阅读理解和移除文章的开放问答，并为各子集保留测试数据及 100 条训练样本
使用专家编写的 IndoNLI 测试集构造 NLI，并以其前提句构造本地语言到印尼语翻译
使用 COPAL-ID 构造因果推理并使用 IndoCulture 构造文化问答
删除 6 道不可回答的开放问答、偏向雅加达的 COPAL-ID 题及有问题的 IndoCulture 记录并修正干扰项和错字
由专业母语者翻译且每条均由第二位母语者复核
标记异常翻译长度和数字不一致并重译已确认错误
发布含 2,300 条 TyDi-QA 训练数据的 87,011 行官方数据，并记录论文表 3 合计 84,711 与正文 84,895 的差异
evaluation_steps_en: Build classification or multiple-choice, span or open generation, and translation inputs for the six tasks
Run zero-shot evaluation for five tasks and few-shot evaluation for reading comprehension
Compare standard, language-informed, and lexicon-guided prompt strategies
Use accuracy for non-translation tasks, answer-substring matching for open QA, and ChrF++ for translation
Report results by task, language, register, and prompt strategy
evaluation_steps_zh: 为六项任务构造分类或多选、抽取或开放生成以及翻译输入
五项任务使用零样本评测且阅读理解使用少样本评测
比较标准提示、语言信息提示与词典引导提示
非翻译任务使用准确率、开放问答使用答案子串匹配、翻译使用 ChrF++
按任务语言语域与提示策略报告结果

source_locator: arXiv:2405.01483 Section 4 and Table 4; official TIGER-AI-Lab/Mantis benchmark evaluator
evidence_summary_en: Annotators acquire images through Google Search and manually curate 217 held-out examples that require cross-image reasoning; the official evaluator handles native or merged-image inputs and applies separate multiple-choice and short-answer parsers before reporting accuracy.
evidence_summary_zh: 标注者通过 Google 搜索获取图像并人工整理 217 条需要跨图推理的留出样本；官方评测器按模型使用原生或拼接图像输入，分别解析多选题与简答题后报告准确率。
construction_steps_en: Define a held-out English benchmark for multi-image reasoning and coreference
Have annotators acquire candidate images through Google Search
Compose ordered groups averaging 2.5 images with at most five images per example
Manually author questions whose answers require understanding content across images
Include both multiple-choice and short-answer formats across topics such as size perception and weight comparison
Finalize 217 manually curated test examples outside Mantis training data
construction_steps_zh: 定义面向多图推理与共指的英文留出 benchmark
由标注者通过 Google 搜索获取候选图像
组成有序图像组且每条平均 2.5 张图最多 5 张图
人工编写必须理解多张图像内容才能回答的问题
覆盖多选题与简答题以及大小感知和重量比较等主题
形成不进入 Mantis 训练数据的 217 条人工整理测试样本
evaluation_steps_en: Provide native multi-image models with the image sequence and merge images horizontally for single-image baselines
Prompt multiple-choice items for an option letter and short-answer items for a Final Answer phrase
For multiple choice parse the first alphabetic character and fall back to exact option text
For short answers parse final-answer phrases and compare strings case-insensitively
Report multiple-choice, short-answer, and overall mean accuracy
evaluation_steps_zh: 原生多图模型接收图像序列且单图基线水平拼接图像
多选题要求选项字母且简答题要求 Final Answer 提示语
多选题解析首个字母并回退到完整选项文本比较
简答题解析最终答案提示语并忽略大小写比较字符串
报告多选简答与总体平均准确率

source_locator: arXiv:2005.00707 benchmark definition and validation protocol; official materialsproject/matbench metadata; Intern-S1 OpenCompass MatBench adapter
evidence_summary_en: Ten materials sources are cleaned into 13 property-prediction tasks with fixed nested five-fold evaluation and original MAE or ROC-AUC metrics; a clearly separate Intern-S1 branch selects four tasks and applies generative LLM judging plus normalized aggregation.
evidence_summary_zh: 十个材料数据源经清洗形成 13 项属性预测任务，使用固定嵌套五折评测及原始 MAE 或 ROC-AUC 指标；独立的 Intern-S1 分支只选择四项任务并应用生成式 LLM 裁判与归一化综合分。
construction_steps_en: Collect ten DFT-derived and experimental sources spanning optical, thermal, electronic, thermodynamic, tensile, and elastic properties
Remove auxiliary metadata and retain only a material input plus one target property
Apply task-specific cleaning for unphysical, rare, unrepresentative, or irrelevant records
Define 13 tasks with composition or crystal-structure inputs and sample counts from 312 to 132,752
Assign ten tasks to regression and three tasks to classification
Fix five outer folds with seed 18012019, stratifying classification tasks
construction_steps_zh: 汇集十个 DFT 与实验数据源并覆盖光学热学电子热力学拉伸和弹性属性
删除辅助元数据并仅保留材料输入与一个目标属性
按任务清理非物理稀有无代表性或无关记录
定义以成分或晶体结构为输入的 13 项任务且样本量从 312 到 132,752
将其中十项定义为回归任务三项定义为分类任务
使用随机种子 18012019 固定五个外层折并对分类任务分层
evaluation_steps_en: Tune models only inside each outer training fold and predict the corresponding held-out fold
Average mean absolute error across five folds for regression and ROC-AUC for classification
Compare reproducible reference models under identical outer folds
For the Intern-S1 adapter select steels, experimental band gap, experimental is-metal, and glass tasks
Use an LLM to extract numeric predictions or judge classification correctness
Compute MAE for the two numeric tasks and accuracy for the two classification tasks
Transform gap and steel MAEs with the OpenCompass formulas and combine the four adapter scores
evaluation_steps_zh: 仅在各外层训练折内调参并预测对应的留出折
回归任务对五折平均绝对误差取平均且分类任务对 ROC-AUC 取平均
在相同外层折上比较可复现参考模型
Intern-S1 适配器选择钢材实验带隙实验金属分类与玻璃四项任务
由 LLM 抽取数值预测或判断分类回答是否正确
两项数值任务计算 MAE 且两项分类任务计算准确率
按 OpenCompass 公式转换带隙和钢材 MAE 并合并四项适配器得分

source_locator: arXiv:2510.11718 Sections 3 and 5 plus Appendix; official HKU-MMLab/Math-VR-CodePlot-CoT project
evidence_summary_en: About 900K illustrated problems are filtered, transcribed, standardized, verified, and translated into 89,075 unique questions and 178,150 bilingual samples; expert review yields a 2,500-question held-out benchmark with verified AC and PS scoring references.
evidence_summary_zh: 约 90 万道含图题经过筛图转写标准化验证与翻译形成 89,075 道独立问题和 178,150 条双语样本；专家复核得到 2,500 道留出题，并构造经验证的 AC 与 PS 评分参考。
construction_steps_en: Collect about 900K secondary-school math problems whose solution explanations include at least one image
Use Qwen2.5-VL-72B to label images, retain mathematical figures, and discard irrelevant or text-only images
Use GPT-4.1 to transcribe remaining textual images and rewrite separate questions and solutions in Markdown
Use GPT-4.1 to remove incomplete or incoherent records and translate standardized records into bilingual pairs
Deduplicate to 89,075 unique questions split into 86,575 training and 2,500 test questions, or 178,150 bilingual samples
Label geometry, algebra, calculus, and statistics plus text or multimodal modality
Exclude proofs and most multiple-choice items and draw a random candidate pool of 3,000 questions
Have 15 senior STEM students remove minimal or trivial visual-reasoning cases and verify questions and answers
Release 2,500 unique test questions as 5,000 bilingual items comprising 1,000 text and 1,500 multimodal questions per language
construction_steps_zh: 收集约 90 万道解题说明至少含一张图的中学数学题
用 Qwen2.5-VL-72B 标注图像保留数学图形并删除无关图或纯文字图
用 GPT-4.1 转写剩余文字图像并将问题与解答分离改写为 Markdown
用 GPT-4.1 删除不完整或不连贯记录并把标准化记录翻译成双语配对
去重为 89,075 道独立问题其中训练 86,575 道测试 2,500 道并展开为 178,150 条双语样本
标注几何代数微积分统计学科以及纯文本或多模态类型
排除证明题和大多数多选题并随机抽取 3,000 道候选题
由 15 名高年级 STEM 大学生删除视觉推理极少或过于简单的题并验证问题答案
将 2,500 道独立测试题发布为 5,000 条双语样本且每种语言含 1,000 道纯文本和 1,500 道多模态题
evaluation_steps_en: Have GPT-4.1 summarize reference answers and generate critical scoring points with difficulty weights
Manually verify the answer summaries, scoring points, and weights
Generate a full reasoning response and final answer for each text or multimodal question
Assign binary Answer Correctness with any error or omission scoring zero
Assign Process Score from weighted scoring-point hits and the paper-defined discount
Validate AC with Cohen kappa and MCC and PS with Pearson and Spearman correlations on 3,000 human-rated responses
Report text, multimodal, and overall AC and PS
evaluation_steps_zh: 由 GPT-4.1 总结参考答案并生成带难度权重的关键评分点
人工复核答案摘要评分点与权重
为每道纯文本或多模态问题生成完整推理与最终答案
以二元答案正确性评分且任何错误或遗漏均记零分
按加权评分点命中与论文定义的折扣计算过程得分
在 3,000 个人工评分回答上以 Cohen kappa 和 MCC 验证 AC 且以 Pearson 和 Spearman 验证 PS
报告纯文本多模态与总体 AC 和 PS

source_locator: arXiv:2103.03874 parent MATH dataset; arXiv:2305.20050 MATH500 selection; official openai/prm800k split and grader
evidence_summary_en: The original MATH test split contributes 4,500 problems to process-supervision training and reserves a uniformly random representative 500-problem holdout; the official grader normalizes final answers and accepts string or SymPy equivalence before reporting accuracy.
evidence_summary_zh: 原始 MATH 测试集中的 4,500 题被加入过程监督训练，余下题目均匀随机保留为有代表性的 500 题固定留出集；官方判分器归一化最终答案并接受字符串或 SymPy 等价后报告准确率。
construction_steps_en: Start from MATH with 12,500 competition problems, seven subjects, five difficulty levels, and step-by-step solutions
Use the original split of 7,500 training and 5,000 test problems
Add 4,500 original test problems to the process-supervision training pool
Reserve the remaining 500 problems uniformly at random and exclude them from training
Compare subject and difficulty distributions with the full MATH test set
Publish the fixed MATH500 split in the official PRM800K repository
construction_steps_zh: 从包含 12,500 道竞赛题七个学科五个难度等级和分步解答的 MATH 出发
使用原始 7,500 题训练集和 5,000 题测试集划分
将原测试集中的 4,500 题加入过程监督训练池
均匀随机保留余下 500 题且不将其用于训练
将留出集的学科和难度分布与完整 MATH 测试集比较
在官方 PRM800K 仓库发布固定 MATH500 划分
evaluation_steps_en: Generate a free-form model solution and extract its final answer
Normalize the candidate and reference with Hendrycks-style rules
Apply additional PRM800K rules for LaTeX, units, percentages, tuples, and related forms
Mark the answer correct when normalized strings match or SymPy simplifies their difference to zero
Assign zero to incorrect or unparseable responses and report mean accuracy over 500 problems
evaluation_steps_zh: 生成自由形式模型解答并抽取最终答案
使用 Hendrycks 风格规则归一化候选答案与参考答案
应用 PRM800K 对 LaTeX 单位百分比元组等形式的附加规则
归一化字符串相同或 SymPy 将两式之差化简为零时判定正确
错误或不可解析回答记零分并报告 500 题平均准确率

source_locator: arXiv:2409.13740 Sections 2, 8.2.1, and 8.2.2; official Future-House/paper-qa LitQA2 reproduction notes
evidence_summary_en: Experts turn recent paper findings that require main-body reasoning into reviewed multiple-choice questions; the 47 + 100 + 101 construction yields 248 items, and the reported protocol randomizes choices, runs three times at temperature zero, extracts one letter with GPT-4-0613, and reports accuracy, precision, and source-DOI recall.
evidence_summary_zh: 专家将近期论文中必须依赖正文推理的发现写成经审核的多项选择题，按 47 + 100 + 101 形成 248 题；论文协议随机打乱选项，以温度零运行三次，用 GPT-4-0613 抽取字母，并报告准确率、精确率和来源 DOI 召回率。
construction_steps_en: Choose findings from papers published within the previous 36 months and record the intended source DOI
Write questions that require main-body context and reasoning and cannot be answered from the title or abstract
Add plausible distractors and an insufficient-information option, including some intentionally unanswerable items
Probe drafts with ChatGPT 3.5 or 4 with logging disabled and search their wording in Google Scholar
Closely review each new author's first roughly ten questions and continue author review before merging
Expand the original 47 LitQA questions by 100 and then 101 to publish 248 LitQA2 questions
construction_steps_zh: 从过去 36 个月发表的论文选择发现并记录预期来源 DOI
编写必须依赖正文语境和推理且不能仅凭标题或摘要回答的问题
加入可信干扰项与信息不足选项并包含部分有意设计的不可回答题

source_locator: arXiv:2403.07974 Sections 3–4 for LiveCodeBench construction; arXiv:2412.19437 Section 4.4 and Table 3 for LiveCodeBench-Base (0801–1101), 3-shot, Pass@1

Select the DeepSeek-V3 time window labeled 0801–1101

Continue adding dated problems from May 2023 through April 2025

收集题面发布日期难度标签标准解测试以及可获得时的起始代码

持续加入 2023 年 5 月至 2025 年 4 月的带日期问题
发布包含 1,055 题的固定 release_v6 快照

source_locator: arXiv:2308.14508 and ACL 2024 Long Paper 172; official THUDM/LongBench task.md, config/dataset2prompt.json, pred.py, eval.py, and metrics.py
evidence_summary_en: LongBench combines adapted public tasks, expert long-document QA, few-shot construction, synthetic retrieval and counting, and code completion into a unified 21-dataset / 4,750-example bilingual release; task-specific prompts and automatic metrics support both the main set and 13-dataset length-balanced LongBench-E.
evidence_summary_zh: LongBench 将改造后的公开任务、专家长文问答、少样本构造、合成检索计数和代码补全统一为 21 个数据集 / 4,750 条双语样本；任务专用提示和自动指标同时支持主集合与 13 数据集长度平衡版 LongBench-E。
construction_steps_en: Use validation or test splits from existing QA, summarization, few-shot, and code datasets
Convert direct-use tasks with ZeroSCROLLS-style templates and build multi-document QA with evidence plus distractors
Have PhD and master's students author definitive QA pairs over diverse MultiFieldQA long documents
Combine training demonstrations with validation queries for four few-shot tasks
Construct Wikipedia and C4 retrieval or counting tasks, using GPT-3.5-Turbo passage summaries
Sample LCC and RepoBench-P XF-F Oracle-Filled code completion and concatenate cross-file snippets
Standardize all records to input, context, answers, length, dataset, language, all_classes, and _id
Release 21 datasets and 4,750 examples comprising 14 English, five Chinese, and two code tasks
construction_steps_zh: 使用既有问答摘要少样本与代码数据的验证集或测试集
以 ZeroSCROLLS 风格模板转换直接复用任务并用证据加干扰文档构建多文档问答
由博硕士学生围绕多来源 MultiFieldQA 长文档编写答案明确的问答对
将训练示例与验证查询拼接为四个少样本任务
构建 Wikipedia 与 C4 检索或计数任务并用 GPT-3.5-Turbo 生成段落摘要
抽样 LCC 与 RepoBench-P XF-F Oracle-Filled 代码补全并拼接跨文件片段
将全部记录统一为 input context answers length dataset language all_classes 和 _id
发布 21 个数据集共 4,750 条样本其中 14 个英文 5 个中文和 2 个代码任务
evaluation_steps_en: Optionally build LongBench-E from 13 eligible datasets with up to 100 examples in each of the 0–4k, 4–8k, and 8k+ bins
Format each input and context with its dataset-specific zero-shot prompt and generation limit
When input exceeds model capacity, remove the middle and preserve the first and last halves
Generate the task response with the configured model conversation style
Apply QA F1, ROUGE-L, classification or retrieval accuracy, or code edit similarity as specified per dataset
Report per-dataset and category averages and LongBench-E scores by length bin
evaluation_steps_zh: 可选从 13 个适用数据集构建 LongBench-E 并在 0–4k 4–8k 与 8k+ 各档最多采样 100 条
按数据集专用零样本提示与生成上限格式化 input 和 context
输入超过模型容量时删除中间并保留首尾两半
使用配置的模型对话风格生成任务回答
按数据集应用问答 F1 ROUGE-L 分类或检索准确率以及代码编辑相似度
报告数据集和类别平均分以及 LongBench-E 各长度档得分

source_locator: arXiv:2507.22058 Appendix C.2; X-Omni/LongText-Bench dataset card and English/Chinese JSONL; X-Omni-Team/X-Omni textbench evaluator
evidence_summary_en: Eight scenarios each contribute ten short and ten long prompts, followed by manual review and bilingual release as 160 English plus 160 Chinese records sharing 160 prompt concepts; four rendered images per prompt-language pair are OCRed by Qwen2.5-VL-7B and scored by unordered word or character Text Accuracy.
evidence_summary_zh: 八类场景各含 10 个短提示与 10 个长提示，经人工复核后以共享 160 个提示概念的 160 条英文加 160 条中文记录发布；每个提示-语言组合的四张渲染图由 Qwen2.5-VL-7B OCR，并以无序词或字符文字准确率评分。
construction_steps_en: Define eight text-rich scenarios: signs, labeled objects, print, web pages, slides, posters, captions, and dialogues
Use GPT-4o to create 20 English prompts per scenario, split into ten short and ten long prompts
Build corresponding Chinese records that share prompt IDs and intended rendered text
Target 10–30 versus 30–50 English words and 20–40 versus typically over 60 Chinese characters
Manually review every prompt and adjust rendered-text lengths for a more balanced distribution
Release 160 bilingual prompt concepts as 160 English plus 160 Chinese language records with prompt, text, category, length, and ID fields
construction_steps_zh: 定义标牌物体标签印刷品网页幻灯片海报字幕和对话八类富文本场景
用 GPT-4o 为每个场景生成 20 个英文提示其中短提示与长提示各十个
构建共享 prompt ID 和预期渲染文字的对应中文记录
英文目标为短 10–30 词长 30–50 词且中文短 20–40 字长通常超过 60 字
人工复核每个提示并调整渲染文字长度以平衡分布
以 160 条英文加 160 条中文语言记录发布 160 个双语提示概念且含 prompt text category length 和 ID 字段
evaluation_steps_en: Generate four images for every language-specific prompt and name files by prompt ID and repeat ID
Use Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct to return only recognized text with up to 1,024 new tokens
Remove punctuation and symbols, lower-case and collapse English spaces, or retain Chinese and alphanumeric characters
Match English words or Chinese characters as unordered multisets because OCR segment order is unreliable
Compute matched ground-truth units divided by all ground-truth units for each image
Micro-average counts over all images and report English, Chinese, and overall Text Accuracy
evaluation_steps_zh: 为每个语言专用提示生成四张图并按 prompt ID 与 repeat ID 命名文件
用 Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct 最多生成 1,024 个新词元且仅返回识别文字
删除标点符号并将英文小写化合并空格或保留中文与字母数字字符
因 OCR 片段顺序不可靠而将英文词或中文字符按无序多重集合匹配
每张图以匹配的标准文字单位数除以全部标准文字单位数
在全部图像上对计数做微平均并报告英文中文与总体文字准确率

visual_review.result: Both 1625 by 501 diagrams preserve all eight scenarios, exact 20/10/10 distribution, paired 160-plus-160 release, language-specific length bands, manual review, four-image sampling, Qwen2.5-VL-7B OCR, normalization, unordered matching rationale, and micro-averaged Text Accuracy without clipping, overlap, or connector-node crossings.

source_locator: MathQA NAACL 2019 Sections 3, 4, 6.1, 6.2, and 7.1; official math-qa.github.io dataset release
evidence_summary_en: MathQA selects solvable numeric AQuA-RAT questions and crowdsources executable programs over 58 domain-aware operations with dynamic execution feedback, worker controls, and two-of-three validation; the exact table total is 37,259, randomly split 80/12/8 and evaluated by executed-program answer accuracy.
evidence_summary_zh: MathQA 从 AQuA-RAT 选择可解数值题，通过带动态执行反馈、标注员质控和三人至少两票验证的众包流程，标注基于 58 种领域感知运算的可执行程序；表格精确总数为 37,259，按 80/12/8 随机拆分并以程序执行后的答案准确率评测。
construction_steps_en: Select solvable English multiple-choice math word problems from AQuA-RAT and preserve questions, options, and correct answers
Omit high-order polynomial problems and problems whose solutions are entirely nonnumeric
Define a domain-aware representation language containing 58 operations and valid problem, constant, and prior-result arguments
Categorize problems by term frequency into six domains and use the category to prune the available operation space
Have crowd workers iteratively select operations and arguments while the platform executes each step and exposes its result
Accept submissions only when they use a problem number and finish close to the correct numeric option
Use random test questions to maintain worker accuracy and requeue annotations from workers who fall below threshold
Accept program alignment with at least two of three validator votes and expand annotations to templates within four words of edit distance
Assemble 37,259 aligned problems with a mean of 5.3 operations and randomly split them 80/12/8
construction_steps_zh: 从 AQuA-RAT 选择可解的英文多项选择数学文字题并保留题目选项与正确答案
去除高阶多项式问题和答案完全非数值的问题
定义包含 58 种运算以及题中数值常量和前序结果参数的领域感知表示语言
按词频将问题分为六个数学领域并用类别缩小可选运算范围
让众包标注员迭代选择运算与参数且平台执行每一步并暴露结果
仅接受使用题中数值且最终值接近正确数值选项的程序
用随机测试题维持标注员准确率并将低于阈值者的标注重新入池
三名验证者至少两票认可后接受程序对齐并扩展到编辑距离不超过四个词的模板
汇总 37,259 道平均 5.3 步运算的对齐题目并按 80/12/8 随机拆分
evaluation_steps_en: Decode a beam of candidate operation programs for each test problem
Execute every operation sequentially using problem numbers, constants, and prior results
Match each executed value to the closest valid multiple-choice option within the prescribed threshold
Score whether the selected option is correct and report answer accuracy
evaluation_steps_zh: 为每道测试题解码一束候选运算程序
使用题中数值常量和前序结果依次执行每步运算
在规定阈值内将执行结果匹配到最近的有效多项选择项
按所选选项是否正确计分并报告答案准确率

visual_review.artifact: Draw.io Desktop English and Chinese PNG exports plus local page DOM and asset-link checks
visual_review.result: Both 1625 by 501 diagrams preserve the AQuA-RAT source, numeric-problem filters, 58-operation language, six categories, dynamic crowd interface, submission and worker gates, two-of-three validation, near-template expansion, exact 37,259 total, 80/12/8 split, and executed-program answer accuracy without clipping, overlap, or connector-node crossings.

source_locator: arXiv:2602.00933v3 Sections 3.1-3.4 and Appendices B, D, and J; official scaleapi/mcp-atlas repository
evidence_summary_en: Experts author 1,000 tasks over 36 production servers and 220 tools; each task hides tool details, mixes 2-8 relevant tools among 6-37 exposed tools, records a diagnostic-only reference trajectory and atomic claims, passes five QA layers, and is scored by three-judge final-answer claim coverage at a 0.75 threshold.
evidence_summary_zh: 专家在 36 个生产级服务器和 220 个工具上编写 1,000 个任务；每题隐藏工具细节，将 2–8 个相关工具混入 6–37 个暴露工具中，记录仅供诊断的参考轨迹和原子声明，经五层质检后由三个评判器按最终答案声明覆盖率及 0.75 阈值计分。
construction_steps_en: Select 36 production MCP servers exposing 220 tools across five application domains
Containerize and version-pin servers with sandboxed filesystems, allow-listed egress, and between-run restart
Have experts author 1,000 single-turn natural-language tasks without naming servers, tools, or parameters
Expose 6-37 tools per task with only 2-8 relevant and draw the rest from semantically plausible distractors
Require multi-hop workflows, with 98.6 percent of tasks orchestrating at least two servers
Execute a minimal reference trajectory averaging 9.8 tool-call steps for solvability and tool-dependence checks
Write atomic tool-grounded claim lists averaging 4.7 claims and ranging from one to 23
Apply expert execution, domain review, leakage review, LLM verification, and random manual audit
Randomly split tasks into 500 public and 500 private examples
construction_steps_zh: 选择覆盖五个应用领域并提供 220 个工具的 36 个生产级 MCP 服务器
用沙盒文件系统网络出口白名单运行间重启和固定版本容器化服务器
由专家编写 1,000 个不点名服务器工具或参数的单轮自然语言任务
每题暴露 6–37 个工具其中仅 2–8 个相关且其余来自语义相近干扰项
要求多跳工作流且 98.6% 任务需要编排至少两个服务器
执行平均 9.8 步工具调用的最小参考轨迹以检查可解性和工具依赖
编写平均 4.7 条且范围为 1–23 条的工具输出原子声明列表
执行专家轨迹领域复审泄露复审 LLM 核验和随机人工审计五层质检
将任务随机拆分为 500 题公开集与 500 题私有集
evaluation_steps_en: Run every model with the same prompt, exposed tools, tool-call budget, rubric, and final-answer protocol
Use three independent LLM judges to score every claim as fulfilled 1, partially fulfilled 0.5, or not fulfilled 0
Average claim scores into task coverage without matching the agent trajectory to the reference trajectory
Count a task as passed only when coverage reaches 0.75 and report pass rate with confidence intervals
Assign failures to an 11-category taxonomy spanning tool-call and cognitive errors
evaluation_steps_zh: 以相同提示暴露工具工具调用预算评分标准和最终答案协议运行所有模型
由三个独立 LLM 评判器将每条声明评分为满足 1 部分满足 0.5 或未满足 0
将声明得分平均为任务覆盖率且不把智能体轨迹与参考轨迹做匹配
仅当覆盖率达到 0.75 时判定任务通过并报告带置信区间的通过率
将失败归入涵盖工具调用与认知错误的 11 类体系

visual_review.result: Both 1625 by 501 diagrams preserve production-server containment, exact server/tool/task counts, hidden tool details, exposed and relevant tool ranges, 98.6 percent cross-server share, 9.8-step diagnostic reference path, claim statistics, five QA layers, 500/500 split, matched runs, three-judge scoring, 0.75 pass threshold, and 11-way diagnosis without clipping, overlap, or connector-node crossings.

source_locator: arXiv:2508.20453 Sections 4.1, 4.2, 5.1, and 5.2; official Accenture/mcp-bench repository
evidence_summary_en: MCP-Bench discovers tool dependencies across 28 live servers and 250 tools, uses o4-mini plus automatic and human quality checks to build 104 tasks, fuzzes instructions and adds 10 distractor servers, then evaluates up-to-20-round traces with rule metrics and five-shuffle rubric judging.
evidence_summary_zh: MCP-Bench 在 28 个在线服务器和 250 个工具中发现依赖，用 o4-mini 配合自动与人工质检构建 104 个任务，再模糊化指令并加入 10 个干扰服务器，最后用规则指标和五次打乱评分标准的评判器评测最多 20 轮的执行轨迹。
construction_steps_en: Collect 28 live MCP servers with 250 structured tools across 11 functional domains
Catalog tool schemas and input-output signatures
Discover inherent and scenario-based dependency chains with linear, parallel, and hybrid structures
Use o4-mini to synthesize 56 single-server, 30 two-server, and 18 three-server tasks for 104 total
Discard tasks below 9.0 out of 10 solvability or 5.0 out of 10 practical utility
Inspect realism, executability, and dependency-chain reasoning manually
Rewrite accepted tasks as fuzzy conversational goals without tool names or execution steps while retaining required numbers
Attach 10 distractor servers and more than 100 additional tools to every task
construction_steps_zh: 收集覆盖 11 个功能领域且含 250 个结构化工具的 28 个在线 MCP 服务器
整理工具 Schema 和输入输出签名
发现包含线性并行和混合结构的固有依赖与场景依赖链
用 o4-mini 合成 56 个单服务器 30 个双服务器和 18 个三服务器任务共 104 题
丢弃可解性低于 9.0/10 或实用性低于 5.0/10 的任务
人工检查真实性可执行性和依赖链推理是否合理
将通过的任务改写为不含工具名或执行步骤的模糊会话目标且保留必要数值
为每题附加 10 个干扰服务器和 100 多个额外工具
evaluation_steps_en: Run a multi-round agent that plans, invokes tools, compresses observations, updates state, and answers within 20 rounds
Compute valid tool-name rate, schema compliance, runtime success, and dependency-order compliance from the trace
Provide o4-mini with the fuzzy and concrete tasks, dependency analysis, final answer, summarized trace, rounds, and available tools
Score task completion, tool usage, and planning subdimensions from one to ten and normalize axis scores to zero through one
Shuffle rubric and subdimension order five times and average the independent judgments
Report rule rates, judge dimensions, and overall score
evaluation_steps_zh: 运行最多 20 轮且执行规划工具调用观察压缩状态更新和最终作答的多轮智能体
从轨迹计算工具名有效率 Schema 合规率运行成功率和依赖顺序合规性
向 o4-mini 提供模糊与具体任务依赖分析最终答案摘要轨迹轮数和可用工具
按一到十分评价任务完成工具使用和规划子维度并将维度分归一化到零至一
将评分维度与子维度顺序独立打乱五次并平均各次评判
汇报规则指标评判维度和总分

source_locator: arXiv:2508.14704 Sections 3.1-3.4 and 4.1; official SalesforceAIResearch/MCP-Universe repository
evidence_summary_en: Authors manually construct and cross-check 231 challenging tasks over 11 real servers and 133 tools in six domains, pair them with 84 cross-checked execution evaluators, automatically configure each run, and report binary task success plus average evaluator score without an LLM judge.
evidence_summary_zh: 作者在六个领域的 11 个真实服务器和 133 个工具上人工构建并交叉核验 231 个高难任务，为其配套 84 个经交叉核验的执行式评估器，自动配置每次运行，并在不使用 LLM 评判器的情况下报告二元任务成功率和平均评估器得分。
construction_steps_en: Select location navigation, repository management, financial analysis, 3D design, browser automation, and web searching
Integrate 11 authentic MCP servers exposing 133 tools through real APIs, data sources, and environments
Manually brainstorm four or five common task types for every domain
Reject tasks solvable without MCP and tasks consistently solved with MCP within five retries
Author 231 tasks containing goals, initial context, and accessible tools or servers
Cross-check every task for feasibility, ambiguity, and correctness
Create 84 execution evaluators comprising four format, 32 static, and 48 dynamic evaluators
Cross-check every evaluator and store invariant answers manually or implement automatic real-time ground truth
construction_steps_zh: 选择位置导航代码仓库管理金融分析 3D 设计浏览器自动化和网页搜索六个领域
集成通过真实 API 数据源和环境提供 133 个工具的 11 个真实 MCP 服务器
为每个领域人工构思四到五类常见任务
淘汰无需 MCP 即可完成和使用 MCP 在五次重试内均能稳定解出的任务
编写包含目标初始上下文和可访问工具或服务器的 231 个任务
交叉核验每个任务的可行性歧义性和正确性
编写由四个格式 32 个静态和 48 个动态评估器组成的 84 个执行式评估器
交叉核验每个评估器并人工保存不变答案或实现自动实时真值
evaluation_steps_en: Automatically build the LLM-agent pair and select the task's servers, evaluators, resources, endpoints, and criteria
Run ReAct or ReAct with Exploration through the MCP protocol and capture complete interaction logs
Use format evaluators for strict output requirements
Use static evaluators for manually collected time-invariant answers and dynamic evaluators for live ground truth
Produce objective binary pass or fail outcomes and aggregate success rate
Also report the average percentage of evaluators passed and successful-task efficiency
evaluation_steps_zh: 自动构建 LLM 与智能体组合并选择任务服务器评估器资源端点和判定标准
让 ReAct 或带探索阶段的 ReAct 通过 MCP 执行并记录完整交互日志
用格式评估器检查严格输出要求
用静态评估器检查人工收集的不变答案并用动态评估器获取实时真值
生成客观二元通过或失败结果并汇总成功率
同时报告通过的评估器平均百分比和成功任务效率

visual_review.result: Both 1625 by 501 diagrams preserve all six domains, exact 11/133/231 scale, four-to-five scenario design, five-retry rejection rule, task cross-review, exact 4/32/48 evaluator split, evaluator cross-review, automatic configuration, ReAct execution, three objective checker types, success rate, and average evaluator score without clipping, overlap, or connector-node crossings.

source_locator: arXiv:2509.24002 Sections 2.1-2.3 and 3.1 plus Appendices A and H; official eval-sys/mcpmark repository
evidence_summary_en: MCPMark curates 38 initial states over five MCP environments and uses a four-stage expert-plus-two-agent pipeline to create 127 instruction-state-verifier tasks, followed by expert and month-long community checks, sandboxed state verification and reset, and four-run pass@1, pass@4, and pass^4 metrics.
evidence_summary_zh: MCPMark 在五个 MCP 环境中策展 38 个初始状态，以专家加两个智能体的四阶段流程创建 127 个指令-状态-验证器任务，再执行专家与为期一个月的社区检查、沙盒状态验证和重置，并用四次运行计算 Pass@1、Pass@4 与 Pass^4。
construction_steps_en: Select Filesystem, Notion, Playwright, GitHub, and PostgreSQL MCP environments with broad CRUD support
Curate 38 realistic initial states from templates, repositories, webpages, directory trees, and databases
Explore each state with a human expert and task-creation agent around a real-world topic
Evolve instructions by removing hints and increasing search, processing, and interaction burden
Have the task-creation agent draft a programmatic verifier while the expert and task-execution agent solve the task
Test each verifier against successful and deliberately perturbed failure states
Iterate evolvement and verification while preserving realism and automatic verifiability
Assemble 127 natural-language instruction, initial-state, and verifier triples covering diverse CRUD workflows
Apply expert cross-review, a month-long community check, and additional validation of every task solved by no model
construction_steps_zh: 选择支持广泛 CRUD 操作的 Filesystem Notion Playwright GitHub 和 PostgreSQL MCP 环境
从模板代码仓库网页目录树和数据库策展 38 个真实初始状态
由人类专家和任务创建智能体围绕真实主题共同探索每个状态
通过删除提示并增加检索处理和交互负担来演化任务指令
由任务创建智能体起草程序验证器且专家与任务执行智能体完成任务
用成功状态和故意扰动的失败状态测试每个验证器
反复执行演化和验证同时维持真实性与自动可验证性
汇总 127 个覆盖多样 CRUD 工作流的自然语言指令初始状态和验证器三元组
执行专家交叉复审一个月社区检查和对所有模型均未解出任务的额外核验
evaluation_steps_en: Restore the curated initial state inside a sandbox with explicit state tracking
Run the minimal MCPMark-Agent tool-calling loop through the selected MCP service
Execute the task verifier and require every programmatic check to pass
Reset the environment after verification to prevent side effects and reproduce the next attempt
Repeat every task four independently generated times
Report pass@1 as mean single-run success, pass@4 for any success in four runs, and pass^4 only when all four runs succeed
evaluation_steps_zh: 在显式状态跟踪的沙盒中恢复策展初始状态
通过所选 MCP 服务运行最小 MCPMark-Agent 工具调用循环
执行任务验证器并要求所有程序化检查全部通过
验证后重置环境以避免副作用并复现下一次尝试
对每个任务独立生成并运行四次
将 Pass@1 报告为单次成功率均值 Pass@4 表示四次中任一次成功且 Pass^4 仅在四次全成功时计入

visual_review.artifact: Draw.io Desktop English and Chinese PNG exports plus local page DOM and asset-link checks
visual_review.result: Both 1625 by 501 diagrams preserve all five services, 38 curated states, the four named creation stages, two-agent expert roles, positive and negative verifier testing, exact 127-task release, expert and month-long community QA, unsolved-task revalidation, sandbox state lifecycle, reset, and four-run pass@1/pass@4/pass^4 semantics without clipping, overlap, or connector-node crossings.

source_locator: MEDIQA 2019 shared-task paper Sections 2.3, 3.3, 4.1, and 5.3; official abachaa/MEDIQA2019 repository
evidence_summary_en: MEDIQA-QA submits 208 training, 25 validation, and 150 test consumer-health questions to CHiQA, has medical experts assign four-level relevance scores and reference ranks to 3,042 candidate answers, and evaluates answer filtering and ranking with Accuracy, MRR, Precision, and Spearman's rho.
evidence_summary_zh: MEDIQA-QA 将 208 个训练问题、25 个验证问题与 150 个测试消费者健康问题提交给 CHiQA，由医学专家为 3,042 个候选答案标注四级相关性分数与参考排序，并以准确率、平均倒数排名、精确率和 Spearman 秩相关评估过滤与排序。
construction_steps_en: Take 104 consumer-health questions from TREC 2017 LiveQA medical data and 104 simple Alexa questions about frequent diseases
Submit both training sources to CHiQA and retain 839 LiveQA plus 862 Alexa candidate answers
Create a 25-question validation set and retrieve 234 associated CHiQA answers
Create a 150-question test set and retrieve 1,107 associated CHiQA answers
Have medical experts assign each answer a score from 4 Excellent to 1 Incorrect
Have experts manually rerank candidates to produce reference ranks from 1 to 11
Release 383 questions and 3,042 candidate answers across train, validation, and test
Provide NLI and RQE resources and allow MedQuAD's 47K answered questions as optional supporting evidence
construction_steps_zh: 从 TREC 2017 LiveQA 医学数据取 104 个消费者健康问题并从 Alexa 常见疾病数据取 104 个简单问题
将两组训练问题提交给 CHiQA 并保留 839 个 LiveQA 候选答案与 862 个 Alexa 候选答案
创建 25 题验证集并检索 234 个相关 CHiQA 答案
创建 150 题测试集并检索 1,107 个相关 CHiQA 答案
由医学专家给每个答案标注从 4 优秀到 1 错误的四级分数
由专家人工重排候选答案并给出第 1 至第 11 名参考排序
发布覆盖训练验证测试的 383 个问题与 3,042 个候选答案
提供 NLI 与 RQE 资源并允许将 MedQuAD 的 47K 有答案问题作为可选辅助证据
evaluation_steps_en: Score provided candidate answers for relevance using the question, answer, source, original rank, and optional inference evidence
Filter incorrect candidates and output binary relevance decisions
Rerank retained candidates and put the predicted best answer first
Report Accuracy and Precision for relevance plus MRR and Spearman's rank correlation for ranking
evaluation_steps_zh: 使用问题答案来源原始排序和可选推理证据为给定候选答案预测相关性
过滤错误候选答案并输出二元相关性判断
重排保留的候选答案并将预测最佳答案置于首位
报告相关性准确率与精确率以及排序的平均倒数排名与 Spearman 秩相关

visual_review.artifact: Draw.io Desktop English and Chinese PNG exports plus local page DOM and asset-link checks
visual_review.result: Both 1625 by 501 diagrams preserve the two exact training sources and answer counts, validation/test counts, expert score and rank scales, 383-question and 3,042-answer totals, optional RQE/NLI support, filtering/reranking contract, and all four official metrics without clipping, overlap, or connector-node crossings.

source_locator: arXiv:2407.01509 Sections 2, 2.1, and 2.2; official apple/ml-mia-bench repository
evidence_summary_en: MIA-Bench samples four image sources, manually authors layered prompts under three validity principles, tags eight sub-instruction categories and five collection-time complexity levels, assigns component weights summing to 10, and uses GPT-4o to score component and total adherence for 400 pairs.
evidence_summary_zh: MIA-Bench 从四类图像来源抽样，在三项有效性原则下人工编写分层提示，标记八类子指令与五个采集期复杂度层级，为组件分配总和为 10 的权重，并用 GPT-4o 对 400 个样本逐组件及整体评估遵循程度。
construction_steps_en: Collect images from COCO 2017 validation, SBU, TextVQA, and Flickr
Randomly sample the first three sources and curate themed Flickr photographs
Use GPT-4V to label image content and analyze category diversity
Manually write open-ended prompts composed of multiple layered sub-instructions
Require every prompt to be human-answerable, avoid answer leakage, and require access to the image
Tag description, length limit, mention, genre, grammar, math, perspective, and OCR sub-instructions
Use basic, intermediate, advanced, creative, and complex levels to diversify collection without reporting per-level results
Assign each component a 1-to-10 maximum weight while forcing every prompt's weights to sum to 10
Assemble 400 image-prompt pairs with component types and weights
construction_steps_zh: 从 COCO 2017 验证集 SBU TextVQA 和 Flickr 收集图像
从前三个来源随机抽样并策展多主题 Flickr 照片
用 GPT-4V 标注图像内容并分析类别多样性
人工编写由多个分层子指令组成的开放式提示
要求每条提示人类可回答不泄露答案且必须访问图像
标记描述长度限制提及体裁语法数学视角和 OCR 八类子指令
用基础中级高级创意复杂五个层级丰富采集但不报告分层结果
为每个组件分配 1 至 10 的最高权重且强制每条提示权重总和为 10
汇总 400 个带组件类型和权重的图像提示对
evaluation_steps_en: Provide each model with the image and full layered prompt and preserve its free-form response
Use GPT-4o as judge to assess adherence to every individual sub-instruction
Apply the annotated maximum weight to each component score
Aggregate weighted scores into eight category scores and an overall 0-to-100 instruction-adherence score
evaluation_steps_zh: 向每个模型提供图像与完整分层提示并保留其自由文本回答
用 GPT-4o 作为评判逐个检查子指令遵循程度
把标注的最高权重应用到每个组件分数
将加权分数汇总为八类分项分数与 0 至 100 的整体指令遵循分数

visual_review.artifact: Draw.io Desktop English and Chinese PNG exports plus local page DOM and asset-link checks
visual_review.result: Both 1625 by 501 diagrams preserve all four image sources, GPT-4V content labeling, manual layered prompts, three validity principles, eight sub-instruction types, five collection levels, weights summing to 10, exact 400-pair scale, GPT-4o component judging, and 0-to-100 aggregation without clipping, overlap, or connector-node crossings.

source_locator: arXiv:2411.02538 / NAACL 2025 Sections 3.1-3.3 and 5; official AI4Bharat/MILU repository and dataset release
evidence_summary_en: MILU scrapes more than 150K questions from over 40 Indian exam types, filters format/language/duplicates, repairs topics through IndicTrans2-to-English plus GPT-4o-mini and clustering/manual merging, fills low-resource subject-language pairs with GPT-4o, and releases 79,617 test plus 8,933 validation MCQs.
evidence_summary_zh: MILU 从 40 多类印度考试抓取超过 15 万道问题，执行格式语言去重过滤，通过 IndicTrans2 译英、GPT-4o-mini、聚类和人工合并修复主题，以 GPT-4o 补齐低资源学科-语言组合，并发布 79,617 道测试题与 8,933 道验证题。
construction_steps_en: Scrape more than 150K previously released questions from portals covering over 40 national and state exam types
Preserve India-centric content across Bengali, Gujarati, Hindi, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu, and English
Remove reading-comprehension questions, image-based questions, and items with more than four answer options
Manually inspect a large sample, filter wrong-language entries with IndicLID plus Unicode rules, and remove duplicates
Translate untagged questions to English with IndicTrans2 and use GPT-4o-mini to create about 20K fine-grained topic tags
Embed tags with NV-Embed-v2, cluster them into 50 groups, and manually merge them into 41 subjects under eight domains
For subject-language pairs below 100 items, sample same-subject English questions and translate them with GPT-4o
Manually verify a sample from every language and correct remaining errors
Release 79,617 test questions and a separate 8,933-question validation set for few-shot demonstrations
construction_steps_zh: 从覆盖 40 多类国家级和邦级考试的网站抓取超过 15 万道历年公开问题
保留孟加拉语古吉拉特语印地语卡纳达语马拉雅拉姆语马拉地语奥里亚语旁遮普语泰米尔语泰卢固语和英语的印度本土内容
去除阅读理解题图像题和超过四个答案选项的问题
人工检查大规模样本用 IndicLID 加 Unicode 规则过滤错误语言并去重
用 IndicTrans2 将无标签问题译成英文再由 GPT-4o-mini 生成约 2 万个细粒度主题标签
用 NV-Embed-v2 嵌入标签聚为 50 簇并人工合并为八大领域下的 41 个学科
对少于 100 题的学科语言组合从同科英文题抽样并用 GPT-4o 翻译
从每种语言抽样人工验证并修正剩余错误
发布 79,617 道测试题以及独立 8,933 道用于少样本示例的验证题
evaluation_steps_en: Take in-context examples only from the separate validation split
Evaluate base, instruct, open multilingual, and Indic-specific models under zero-, one-, and five-shot prompts
Parse the selected option and compare it with the gold four-choice answer
Report accuracy aggregated by language and domain and analyze subject and resource-level gaps
evaluation_steps_zh: 仅从独立验证集取得上下文示例
在零样本一样本五样本提示下评估基础指令开源多语言和印度语言专用模型
解析所选选项并与四选一标准答案比较
按语言与领域汇总准确率并分析学科及资源等级差距

visual_review.artifact: Draw.io Desktop English and Chinese PNG exports plus local page DOM and asset-link checks
visual_review.result: Both 1625 by 501 diagrams preserve raw collection scale, all specified filters, the distinct IndicTrans2 topic-recovery and GPT-4o gap-fill roles, 50-cluster to 41-subject/eight-domain taxonomy, per-language audit, exact 79,617/8,933 release sizes, and zero-/one-/five-shot accuracy without clipping, overlap, or connector-node crossings.

source_locator: arXiv:2502.14499 Sections 3-6; official facebookresearch/MLGym repository
evidence_summary_en: MLGym-Bench configures 13 open-ended AI research tasks with datasets, flexible artifacts, read-only evaluators, Docker-backed Gymnasium workspaces, permissions and timeouts; agents iteratively validate and submit within 50 steps, repeat four seeds, and are compared by Best Attempt/Submission performance profiles and AUP.
evidence_summary_zh: MLGym-Bench 将 13 个开放式 AI 研究任务配置为带数据、灵活产物、只读评测器、Docker Gymnasium 工作区、权限和超时的环境；智能体在 50 步内迭代验证和提交，重复四个种子，并以最佳尝试/提交性能剖面及 AUP 汇总比较。
construction_steps_en: Curate 13 open-ended tasks spanning computer vision, NLP, reinforcement learning, game theory, SAT, and tabular prediction
Define each task through configuration files with datasets, optional starter code, dependencies, training timeouts, and memory settings
Provide a read-only task-specific evaluation script and explicit submission-artifact instructions
Support flexible artifacts including model weights, predictions, RL policies, and strategy functions
Initialize each task as a Gymnasium environment backed by a local Docker machine
Install task dependencies and copy code and data into an isolated agent workspace
Run as a non-root agent user while keeping datasets and evaluation code read-only
Attach search, file-viewing, editing, shell, validate, and submit commands under consistent settings
construction_steps_zh: 策展覆盖计算机视觉自然语言处理强化学习博弈论 SAT 和表格预测的 13 个开放式任务
用配置文件定义每个任务的数据集可选起始代码依赖训练超时和记忆设置
提供只读的任务专用评测脚本和明确的提交产物说明
支持模型权重预测结果强化学习策略和博弈函数等灵活产物
将每个任务初始化为由本地 Docker 支撑的 Gymnasium 环境
安装任务依赖并将代码和数据复制到隔离智能体工作区
以非 root 智能体用户运行且保持数据集与评测代码只读
在统一条件下接入搜索文件查看编辑 Shell Validate 和 Submit 命令
evaluation_steps_en: Let the agent form hypotheses, edit code, train models, analyze results, and iterate for at most 50 environment interactions
Use validate repeatedly to run the task evaluator and receive current test metrics without ending the run
Use submit as a terminal action or autosubmit the last code state when the run ends
Repeat each model-task pair over four independent seeds and retain every valid attempt and final artifact
Build Best Attempt@4 from any valid validation and Best Submission@4 from final submissions
Report raw task-specific metrics plus performance profiles and area-under-profile scores across heterogeneous tasks
evaluation_steps_zh: 让智能体提出假设修改代码训练模型分析结果并在最多 50 次环境交互内迭代
重复使用 Validate 运行任务评测器并获取当前测试指标且不终止运行
用 Submit 作为终止动作或在运行结束时自动提交最后代码状态
对每个模型任务组合用四个独立种子重复并保留所有有效尝试与最终产物
从任一有效验证构建 Best Attempt@4 并从最终提交构建 Best Submission@4
报告任务专用原始指标以及跨异构任务的性能剖面与曲线下面积分数

visual_review.artifact: Draw.io Desktop English and Chinese PNG exports plus local page DOM and asset-link checks
visual_review.result: Both 1625 by 501 diagrams preserve 13-task coverage, configuration and artifact contracts, Docker/Gym setup, non-root/read-only controls, agent tools, 50-step and training-time limits, validate/submit semantics, four-run replication, Best Attempt@4/Best Submission@4, and performance-profile/AUP reporting without clipping, overlap, or connector-node crossings.

source_locator: arXiv:2406.04264 / CVPR 2025 Sections 3.1-3.2 and Appendices C-G; official JUNJIE99/MLVU repository
evidence_summary_en: MLVU builds 1,730 videos from a Universal Long Video Collection, creates 3,102 questions across nine holistic/single-detail/multi-detail tasks through manual, dataset-derived, GPT-4-assisted, and synthetic paths, splits 2,593/509, and separately scores multiple-choice accuracy and GPT-4 generation criteria.
evidence_summary_zh: MLVU 从通用长视频集合构建 1,730 个视频，通过人工、数据集改编、GPT-4 辅助与合成路径创建覆盖九类整体/单细节/多细节任务的 3,102 个问题，按 2,593/509 拆分，并分别评估选择题准确率与 GPT-4 生成式维度。
construction_steps_en: Collect movies, TV series, documentaries, surveillance, egocentric, cartoon, game, and other long-form videos into the Universal Long Video Collection
Select, edit, or synthesize the benchmark videos, using full videos or long segments and reducing resolution or clipping when needed
Define holistic understanding, single-detail understanding, and multi-detail understanding levels
Create Topic Reasoning, Anomaly Recognition, and Video Summarization as holistic tasks
Create Needle QA, Ego Reasoning, Plot QA, and Sub-scene Captioning as single-detail tasks
Create synthetic Action Order and Action Count tasks as multi-detail tasks
Combine human annotation, UCF-Crime/Ego4D adaptation, GPT-4-assisted needle-QA generation, and synthetic probe construction
Apply task-specific gates for leakage, audio independence, absent background content, unique clues, and non-redundant scoring points
Assemble 1,730 videos and 3,102 questions and split them into 2,593 development and 509 test questions
Use four choices for development multiple-choice items and six for test items
construction_steps_zh: 将电影电视剧纪录片监控第一视角动画游戏和其他长视频收集到通用长视频集合
选择编辑或合成基准视频使用完整视频或长片段并在需要时降分辨率或裁剪
定义整体理解单细节理解和多细节理解三个层级
创建主题推理异常识别和视频摘要三个整体任务
创建针式问答第一视角推理情节问答和子场景描述四个单细节任务
创建合成的动作排序与动作计数两个多细节任务
组合人工标注 UCF-Crime/Ego4D 改编 GPT-4 辅助针式问答生成和合成探针构建
执行防泄露音频独立背景中不存在目标唯一线索和非冗余评分点等任务专用门禁
汇总 1,730 个视频和 3,102 个问题并拆分为 2,593 题开发集与 509 题测试集
开发集选择题使用四个选项而测试集使用六个选项
evaluation_steps_en: Run multimodal models zero-shot using uniform frame sampling or frame-rate sampling
Match predicted options exactly to ground truth for multiple-choice tasks and report per-task accuracy plus M-Avg
Use GPT-4 to judge generated Sub-scene Captions on Accuracy and Relevance
Use GPT-4 to judge Video Summaries on Completeness and Reliability
Average the 0-to-10 generation scores into G-Avg and report results by holistic, single-detail, and multi-detail groups
evaluation_steps_zh: 用均匀抽帧或帧率抽样对多模态模型做零样本推理
将预测选项与标准答案精确匹配并报告各选择任务准确率与 M-Avg
用 GPT-4 按准确性和相关性评判生成的子场景描述
用 GPT-4 按完整性和可靠性评判视频摘要
将 0 至 10 的生成分数平均为 G-Avg 并按整体单细节多细节组报告

source_locator: arXiv:2508.13186 Sections 2-4; official MMBrowseComp/MM-BrowseComp repository
evidence_summary_en: MM-BrowseComp assigns more than 20 expert annotators to 22 subtasks, reverse-constructs questions under mandatory visual-dependency, difficulty, stability, uniqueness, and checklist requirements, validates in three stages, resolves 300 candidates into 224 final questions, and reports Pass@1 OA, SA, and Average Checklist Score.
evidence_summary_zh: MM-BrowseComp 由超过 20 名专家负责 22 个子任务，在强制视觉依赖、难度、稳定性、唯一性和清单要求下反向构题，经三阶段验证将 300 个候选处理为 224 道最终题，并以 Pass@1 报告整体准确率、严格准确率和平均清单得分。
construction_steps_en: Define 22 multimodal web-browsing subtasks across Media, Technology, Society, Geography, and Academics
Assign each of more than 20 masters or PhD AI researchers two to three aligned subtasks and provide a gold example
Reverse-construct each question from a known verifiable fact and iteratively refine it toward a unique answer
Require essential information to be primarily visual and absent from text-only sources
Require failure by strong search-enabled models, difficulty for another annotator within five minutes, concise verifiability, temporal stability, and authoritative sourcing
Attach a verified checklist encoding the minimal irreducible sequential evidence and reasoning path
Pilot three items per subtask and use core-team review to calibrate quality standards
Complete full-scale construction and run a secondary core-team review and revision pass
Run final tool-dependency, factual, source, and answer-uniqueness verification
Resolve 300 candidates into 161 directly accepted, 63 revised, and 76 discarded items to retain 224 questions
construction_steps_zh: 定义覆盖媒体技术社会地理和学术五大类的 22 个多模态网页浏览子任务
将超过 20 名 AI 方向硕博研究人员各自分配到两至三个匹配子任务并提供黄金示例
从已知可核验事实反向构造每个问题并迭代细化至答案唯一
要求必要信息主要来自视觉内容且纯文本来源中不存在该证据
要求搜索增强强模型无法稳定回答另一标注员五分钟内也难以检索且答案简洁可验证时间稳定来源权威
为每题附上记录最小不可约顺序证据与推理路径的验证清单
每个子任务先试做三题并由核心团队审查以校准质量标准
完成全量构建后由核心团队进行二次审查与反馈修订
执行最终工具依赖性事实来源和答案唯一性验证
将 300 个候选处理为 161 个直接接受 63 个修订和 76 个丢弃样本并保留 224 题
evaluation_steps_en: Let a browsing agent search the web, inspect image or video evidence, and return one final answer plus supporting reasoning
Score the final answer at Pass@1 as Overall Accuracy
Require both the correct final answer and every checklist item for Strict Accuracy
Average completed checklist items as Average Checklist Score and analyze failures by subtask and evidence step
evaluation_steps_zh: 让浏览智能体搜索网页检查图像或视频证据并返回一次最终答案与支持推理
以 Pass@1 根据最终答案计算整体准确率
仅在最终答案正确且所有清单项通过时计入严格准确率
将已完成清单项平均为平均清单得分并按子任务和证据步骤分析失败
