visual_review.result: Both 1625 by 501 diagrams preserve five categories, 22 subtasks, expert assignment, reverse construction, multimodal and quality gates, irreducible checklists, all three validation stages, exact 300 to 224 accounting, final image-prompt distribution, and Pass@1 OA, SA, and Average Checklist Score without clipping, overlap, or connector-node crossings.

source_locator: arXiv:2504.07957 Sections 3.2-4.2 and Appendices A-B and E; official SYuan03/MM-IFEngine repository
evidence_summary_en: MM-IFEval filters diverse image-grounded sources, combines 16 task descriptions with 32 constraint subcategories, uses LLM compatibility checks plus human annotation and conflict mitigation, builds 300 compose-level and 100 perception-level questions, and evaluates them through rule functions, direct LLM judgment, and comparative LLM judgment.
evidence_summary_zh: MM-IFEval 过滤多样图像来源，将 16 类任务描述与 32 个约束子类别组合，经 LLM 兼容性检查、人工标注和冲突缓解构成 300 道组合级与 100 道感知级问题，并以规则函数、LLM 直接判断和 LLM 对比判断评测。
construction_steps_en: Gather images from natural scenes, user interfaces, diagrams, charts, mathematical expressions, and existing QA datasets
Define 16 image-grounded task descriptions spanning representative real-world applications
Filter source questions containing few-shot examples or multiple-choice options with regular expressions and length limits
Build a constraint pool with six major groups and 32 subcategories
Use an LLM to generate concrete constraints, preserve task correlation, and reject totally contradictory combinations
Human-annotate compose-level output constraints and perception-level visual constraints with ground-truth answers
Use an extra LLM post-processing pass to double-check and mitigate remaining constraint conflicts
Assemble 400 questions as 300 compose-level open-ended items and 100 perception-level items across 13 image classes
construction_steps_zh: 汇集自然场景用户界面图示图表数学表达式和已有问答数据集中的图像
定义覆盖代表性真实应用的 16 类图像相关任务描述
用正则表达式和长度限制过滤含少样本示例或多选选项的来源问题
建立包含六个主要类别和 32 个子类别的约束池
用 LLM 生成具体约束保持任务相关性并拒绝完全矛盾的组合
人工标注组合级输出约束和带标准答案的感知级视觉约束
用额外 LLM 后处理再次检查并缓解剩余约束冲突
汇总 400 道题其中 300 道为组合级开放题另 100 道为覆盖 13 类图像的感知题
evaluation_steps_en: Generate a response from the model using the image and full constraint-rich instruction
For 10 algorithmically verifiable constraint subcategories, extract parameters, select a specialized verification function, and manually validate that mapping
Use direct LLM judgment for clear constraints that are not handled by deterministic functions
For tone, style, or role-playing constraints, compare the constrained response with a second output generated without that constraint
Report compose-level, perception-level, and average accuracy across all 400 problems
evaluation_steps_zh: 向模型提供图像与完整的多约束指令并生成回答
对 10 个可算法验证的约束子类别提取参数选择专用函数并人工复核映射
对未由确定性函数覆盖且判断明确的约束使用 LLM 直接评判
对语气风格或角色扮演约束将受约束回答与移除该约束后生成的第二个回答比较
在全部 400 题上报告组合级感知级与平均准确率

visual_review.artifact: Draw.io Desktop English and Chinese PNG exports plus local page DOM and asset-link checks
visual_review.result: Both 1625 by 501 diagrams preserve image diversity, 16 tasks, source filtering, six constraint groups and 32 subcategories, LLM integration, human C/P annotation, conflict mitigation, the exact 300/100 split, 13 P-level image classes, 10 rule-verifiable subcategories, direct and comparative judges, and all three reported accuracies without clipping, overlap, or connector-node crossings.

source_locator: arXiv:2410.07073 Section 3 and Appendix A.5; official mistralai/MM-MT-Bench dataset
evidence_summary_en: MM-MTBench manually curates and second-labeler verifies 92 practical multimodal conversations across five image categories; each turn is answered independently using reference answers for prior history, GPT-4o rates correctness and completeness from 1 to 10, and the aggregate score correlates 0.91 with Vision Arena ELO.
evidence_summary_zh: MM-MTBench 人工策展并由第二组标注员复核覆盖五类图像的 92 个实用多模态对话；每轮使用标准历史答案独立作答，GPT-4o 按正确性与完整性给出一至十分，汇总分与视觉竞技场 ELO 的相关系数为 0.91。
construction_steps_en: Select practical extraction, summarization, and image-grounded reasoning use cases
Curate 21 charts, 19 tables, 24 PDF pages, 20 diagrams, and eight miscellaneous images
Manually write the images, prompts, and open-ended reference answers
Use a second labeler group to verify extracted information and coverage in every reference answer
Require every prompt to reference the image input for a correct answer
Structure 92 conversations as 69 single-turn, 18 two-turn, four three-turn, and one four-turn conversation
Release prompts and reference answers in the official multimodal conversation dataset
construction_steps_zh: 选择实用的信息抽取摘要生成和基于图像推理场景
策展 21 张图表 19 张表格 24 个 PDF 页面 20 张图示和八张其他图像
人工编写图像问题与开放式参考答案
由第二组标注员复核每个参考答案中抽取信息的正确性与覆盖完整性
要求每个问题都必须参考输入图像才能正确作答
将 92 个对话组织为 69 个单轮 18 个两轮四个三轮和一个四轮对话
在官方多模态对话数据集中发布问题与参考答案
evaluation_steps_en: Query each turn independently and in parallel while supplying gold reference answers for prior turns as conversation history
Pair each candidate turn with its reference answer and the entire conversation history without propagating prior model errors
Have GPT-4o independently judge every turn on correctness of extracted information and completeness against the reference
Assign each turn a rating from 1 to 10 and average turn-level ratings into the MM-MT-Bench score
Compare the benchmark score with Vision Arena ELO and report the paper's 0.91 Pearson correlation
evaluation_steps_zh: 各轮独立并行查询且对先前轮次使用标准答案作为对话历史
将每轮候选回答与参考答案及完整对话历史配对而不传播前序模型错误
由 GPT-4o 根据抽取信息正确性和相对参考答案的完整性独立评判每一轮
为每轮给出一至十分并将逐轮评分平均为 MM-MT-Bench 分数
将基准分数与视觉竞技场 ELO 对照并报告论文中的 0.91 皮尔逊相关系数

visual_review.artifact: Draw.io Desktop English and Chinese PNG exports plus local page DOM and asset-link checks
visual_review.result: Both 1625 by 501 diagrams preserve all five image categories and exact counts, manual curation, second-labeler verification, the exact 69/18/4/1 turn distribution, image dependence, gold prior-turn history, independent full-history GPT-4o judging, 1-to-10 correctness and completeness ratings, mean aggregation, and 0.91 ELO correlation without clipping, overlap, or connector-node crossings.

source_locator: arXiv:2410.19168 Section 3.2 and Appendix C; official MMAU project page
evidence_summary_en: MMAU follows a named seven-step pipeline from 13 audio corpora and 90 candidate tasks through expert annotation/filtering, GPT-4 option augmentation, expert review, and balanced finalization; 11,000 annotated pairs become 10,000 MCQs split 1,000/9,000 and scored by accuracy.
evidence_summary_zh: MMAU 采用论文命名的七步流水线，从 13 个音频语料库和 90 个候选任务出发，经过专家标注与过滤、GPT-4 选项增强、专家复核和平衡定稿，将 11,000 个标注对处理为按 1,000/9,000 拆分并以准确率评测的 10,000 道多选题。
construction_steps_en: Select 13 diverse speech, environmental sound, and music corpora while preferring real recordings over synthetic audio
Consult domain experts and filter 90 candidate tasks down to 27 real-world reasoning and knowledge-retrieval tasks
Select plausible audio clips aligned with the final tasks through multiple author iterations
Have domain experts write questions and gold answers that require complex reasoning and specialized knowledge
Use a separate expert team to remove ambiguous, overly complex, or low-quality-audio QA pairs
Use GPT-4 to generate additional context-aware answer options rather than random distractors
Have experts and authors review correct answers and options and tag each instance with its task and required skills
Reduce 11,000 annotated QA pairs by 800 during filtering and 200 during review to retain 10,000 questions
Balance 27 task types across speech, sound, and music and label easy, medium, or hard difficulty
Create a 1,000-question test-mini split mirroring task distribution and a 9,000-question main test split
construction_steps_zh: 选择 13 个多样语音环境声和音乐语料库并优先采用真实录音而非合成音频
咨询领域专家并将 90 个候选任务过滤为 27 个现实推理与知识检索任务
通过作者多轮迭代选择与最终任务对齐的合适音频片段
由领域专家编写需要复杂推理与专业知识的问题和标准答案
由独立专家团队去除歧义过度复杂或音频质量低的问答对
用 GPT-4 生成基于上下文的额外答案选项而不是随机干扰项
由专家和作者复核正确答案与选项并标记每个样本的任务和所需技能
将 11,000 个标注问答对在过滤时去除 800 个并在复核时去除 200 个最终保留 10,000 题
在语音声音和音乐三个领域平衡 27 类任务并标注简单中等或困难等级
创建与任务分布一致的 1,000 题小测试集和 9,000 题主测试集
evaluation_steps_en: Provide an audio clip and multiple-choice question to each audio-language model
Parse the model-selected answer option and compare it with the gold option
Report exact multiple-choice accuracy separately for sound, music, and speech
Report overall averages for both test-mini and the main test split
evaluation_steps_zh: 向每个音频语言模型提供音频片段与多选题
解析模型选择的答案选项并与标准选项比较
分别为声音音乐和语音报告精确多选准确率
分别报告小测试集和主测试集的整体平均值

visual_review.artifact: Draw.io Desktop English and Chinese PNG exports plus local page DOM and asset-link checks
visual_review.result: Both 1625 by 501 diagrams preserve all seven named stages, 13 corpora, 90-to-27 task curation, expert annotation and independent filtering, GPT-4 option augmentation, task/skill review, exact 11,000 minus 800 minus 200 accounting, three-domain and difficulty balance, the 1,000/9,000 split, and accuracy reporting without clipping, overlap, or connector-node crossings.

source_locator: arXiv:2406.14515 Section 3.1 and Appendices C-D; official opencompass/MMBench-Video dataset
evidence_summary_en: MMBench-Video collects 16 categories of long multi-shot YouTube video, uses a three-level 26-leaf ability taxonomy and human free-form QA, cross-validates items, removes 246 temporally dispensable questions through four GPT-4V single-frame trials plus GPT-4 scoring, and judges 1,998 final QA pairs over 609 videos on a 0-to-3 scale.
evidence_summary_zh: MMBench-Video 收集 16 类长时多镜头 YouTube 视频，按三级 26 项叶子能力体系人工编写自由问答并交叉验证，通过四次 GPT-4V 随机单帧实验与 GPT-4 评分移除 246 道时序非必要问题，最终在 609 个视频上的 1,998 个问答对以零至三分评判。
construction_steps_en: Have volunteers collect diverse YouTube videos across 16 major categories while preserving useful titles and subtitles
Reject videos shorter than 30 seconds and derive each QA pair from a clip no longer than six minutes
Define a three-level hierarchy with Perception and Reasoning at the top and 26 leaf capabilities
Have volunteers compose multiple independent free-form questions and detailed gold answers per video
Require capability alignment, encourage temporal indispensability, avoid explicit timestamps, diversify wording, and provide informative answers
Cross-validate every QA pair for correctness and compliance with the five authoring guidelines
For every question, use four random seeds to sample one random frame and run GPT-4V four times
Use GPT-4 to score the four single-frame answers and remove a question when the mean score is at least 2.5
Manually verify temporal filtering and discard 246 temporally dispensable questions
Assemble 609 videos and 1,998 QA pairs with mean duration 165.4 seconds and mean 32.6 shots per video
construction_steps_zh: 由志愿者从 16 个主要类别收集多样 YouTube 视频并保留有用标题与字幕
去除短于 30 秒的视频且每个问答对仅从不超过六分钟的片段构造
定义以感知和推理为顶层并包含 26 项叶子能力的三级分类体系
由志愿者为每个视频编写多个独立自由问题与详细标准答案
要求问题与能力对齐鼓励时序必要性避免明确时间戳丰富表达并提供信息充分的答案
交叉验证每个问答对的正确性及五项编写准则遵循情况
对每道题使用四个随机种子各抽一帧并运行 GPT-4V 四次
用 GPT-4 为四个单帧回答评分且平均分至少 2.5 时移除该题
人工复核时序过滤并共丢弃 246 道时序非必要问题
汇总 609 个视频和 1,998 个问答对且平均时长为 165.4 秒每视频平均 32.6 个镜头
evaluation_steps_en: Provide chronological sampled frames and optionally YouTube subtitles to a video or vision-language model
Preserve the model's free-form answer for each question
Give GPT-4 the question, annotated gold answer, and candidate answer and judge semantic content similarity while ignoring grammar
Assign an integer from 0 for entirely incorrect through 3 for entirely correct
Aggregate scores overall and by the hierarchy's perception and reasoning capabilities
evaluation_steps_zh: 向视频或视觉语言模型提供按时间排序的采样帧并可选加入 YouTube 字幕
保留模型对每道题的自由文本回答
向 GPT-4 提供问题标注答案和候选答案并忽略语法差异按语义内容相似度评判
给出从零分完全错误到三分完全正确的整数分数
按整体及分类体系中的感知与推理能力汇总分数

visual_review.artifact: Draw.io Desktop English and Chinese PNG exports plus local page DOM and asset-link checks
visual_review.result: Both 1625 by 501 diagrams preserve 16 categories, duration bounds, the three-level 26-leaf taxonomy, multi-question human authoring, five guidelines, cross-validation, four-seed GPT-4V single-frame probing, the 2.5 removal threshold and 246 count, exact 609-video and 1,998-QA totals, multi-frame inference, and 0-to-3 GPT-4 semantic grading without clipping, overlap, or connector-node crossings.

source_locator: arXiv:2412.15194 Sections 2-3; official microsoft/MMLU-CF repository
evidence_summary_en: MMLU-CF extracts 2.7 million MCQs from more than 200 billion public web documents, cleans them to 1.66 million, difficulty-samples 50,000, runs multi-model quality and safety checking plus semantic deduplication, applies three contamination-free transformations, and releases matched 10,000-question public-validation and closed-test splits.
evidence_summary_zh: MMLU-CF 从超过 2,000 亿份公共网页文档抽取 270 万道多选题，清洗至 166 万题后按难度抽样五万题，执行多模型质量安全检查与语义去重，再应用三项去污染变换，最终形成各一万题且分布匹配的公开验证集与封闭测试集。
construction_steps_en: Crawl more than 200 billion public web documents from over 3,000 domains and extract 14 fields
Rule-extract 2.7 million multiple-choice questions with choices, answers, and explanations
Require four complete choices, normalize labels and answers, remove malformed and non-English items, and deduplicate to 1.66 million
Use five-shot GPT-4o to assign difficulty scores from zero to nine
Sample a 50,000-question pool centered near difficulty six while balancing categories and domains and preferring explanations
Have GPT-4o, Gemini, and Claude rate quality and harmlessness from one to five and retain items with mean score above four
Use GPT-4o semantic comparison to remove redundant questions while retaining more than 1,000 source domains
Rephrase every question stem while preserving its meaning and answer
Shuffle answer choices, but preserve a final None-of-the-above or All-of-the-above option and shuffle only the first three in those cases
With 50 percent probability replace one randomly selected choice by None of the other choices, keep a replaced correct choice valid, and skip special-final-choice cases
Create matched 10,000-item public-validation and 10,000-item closed-test splits with similar difficulty and category distributions
construction_steps_zh: 从 3,000 多个域名抓取超过 2,000 亿份公共网页文档并抽取 14 项字段
通过规则抽取含选项答案和解析的 270 万道多选题
要求四个完整选项并规范标签答案去除格式异常和非英文题目后去重至 166 万题
用五样例 GPT-4o 为题目给出零至九分难度
以难度六分为中心并平衡类别和域名且优先带解析题目抽样五万题
由 GPT-4o Gemini 和 Claude 按一至五分评价质量与无害性并保留平均分高于四分的题目
用 GPT-4o 语义比较移除重复题且保留千余来源域名
在保持语义与答案的条件下改写每道题干
打乱答案选项但末项为以上皆非或皆是时保留末项且只打乱前三项
以 50% 概率将任意一个选项替换为其他选项均不正确且被替换的正确项仍有效并跳过特殊末项题
构造难度与类别分布匹配的各一万题公开验证集和封闭测试集
evaluation_steps_en: Prompt each evaluated language model in zero-shot and five-shot settings
Parse the option selected for each four-choice question
Compare the selected option with the gold answer
Report exact accuracy on the public-validation and closed-test splits

解析模型为每道四选一题选择的选项
将所选选项与标准答案比较
分别在公开验证集与封闭测试集报告精确准确率

source_locator: Accepted EMNLP 2025 paper Sections 2-4; official MMLU-ProX project and repository
evidence_summary_en: MMLU-ProX cleans MMLU-Pro, uses Claude 3.7 Sonnet for four-stage translation, externally checks translations with o3 or GPT-4.1, verifies sampled disciplines with native experts, and releases identical full and lite question sets across 29 languages.
evidence_summary_zh: MMLU-ProX 清洗 MMLU-Pro 后用 Claude 3.7 Sonnet 完成四阶段翻译，再由 o3 或 GPT-4.1 外部检查并以母语专家抽样核验，最终在 29 种语言发布题目一致的完整版与轻量版。
construction_steps_en: Start from MMLU-Pro's 57 subjects, 14 disciplines, and ten-choice reasoning questions
Remove or merge duplicate and partially duplicate English questions and fix grammar, symbols, and question-option inconsistencies
Use Claude 3.7 Sonnet for initial translation while preserving terminology, culture, formulas, code, currency, units, and formatting
Run self-reflection against the source for correspondence, names, terminology, additions, and omissions
Improve translations from the reflection while adding explanations only when the target language lacks an equivalent
Use o3 to examine Swahili, Zulu, Yoruba, and Wolof and GPT-4.1 to examine the other 25 languages
For 15 languages, have two native professional translators verify 20 shared items per each of 14 disciplines
Rate accuracy, fluency, and completeness from one to five and retranslate a discipline-language pair when both experts rate any dimension below three
Require category means above four and assemble 11,829 identical questions per each of 29 languages
Uniformly sample five percent of every discipline to produce a 658-question lite version per language
Reserve the same 70 validation questions for prompt construction, leaving 11,759 full and 588 lite evaluation items
construction_steps_zh: 从 MMLU-Pro 的 57 个学科 14 个领域和十选一推理题开始
删除或合并重复及部分重复英文题并修复语法符号和问题选项不一致
用 Claude 3.7 Sonnet 初译并保持术语文化公式代码货币单位和格式
对照源文执行自我反思以检查对应关系名称术语增译与漏译
根据反思改进翻译且仅在目标语言无对等表达时补充解释
由 o3 检查斯瓦希里语祖鲁语约鲁巴语和沃洛夫语并由 GPT-4.1 检查其余 25 种语言
在 15 种语言中由两名母语专业译者核验每个 14 领域的相同 20 题
按一至五分评价准确性流畅性完整性且两位专家对任一维度均低于三分时重译对应语言领域
要求各类别均分高于四分并汇总 29 种语言各 11,829 道完全一致的题目
从每个领域均匀抽取 5% 形成每语言 658 道轻量版
预留相同 70 道验证题构造提示使完整版与轻量版实际评测题量为 11,759 和 588
evaluation_steps_en: Evaluate every language with zero-shot and five-shot chain-of-thought prompts
Parse the selected answer among ten options
Compute exact accuracy per language on 11,759 full or 588 lite evaluation items
Average language scores and compare multilingual gaps and rankings
evaluation_steps_zh: 在每种语言使用零样本与五样本思维链提示评测
解析模型从十个选项中选择的答案
在 11,759 道完整版或 588 道轻量版实际评测题上计算各语言精确准确率
汇总语言平均分并比较多语言差距与排名

source_locator: arXiv:2406.04127 Sections 3-5; official edinburgh-dawg/mmlu-redux-2.0 dataset
evidence_summary_en: MMLU-Redux 2.0 samples 100 test questions from every one of MMLU's 57 subjects, has 14 experts annotate error types and trusted sources for all 5,700 rows, estimates a 6.49 percent full-MMLU error rate, and compares original exact match on all versus correct-only items.
evidence_summary_zh: MMLU-Redux 2.0 从 MMLU 全部 57 个学科各抽 100 道测试题，由 14 名专家为 5,700 条题目标注错误类型与可信来源，估计完整 MMLU 错误率为 6.49%，并对比全量与仅正确题目的原始精确匹配。
construction_steps_en: Sample 100 test questions from each of all 57 MMLU subjects for a 5,700-question audit
Define OK, Expert, bad-question, bad-options, no-correct-answer, multiple-correct-answers, and wrong-ground-truth annotations
Assign 14 human experts according to subject expertise
Trace original sources when available and otherwise consult trusted government, textbook, or reputable-organization sources
Record the question, choices, original answer, error type, source, suggested correct answer, and supporting explanation
Mark uncertain judgments as Expert rather than making an unsupported decision
Triple-annotate five error-rich subjects and obtain Cohen's kappa above 0.6
Assemble the full 57-subject MMLU-Redux 2.0 release
Aggregate subject samples to estimate a 6.49 percent error rate for full MMLU
construction_steps_zh: 从 MMLU 全部 57 个学科各抽 100 道测试题形成 5,700 题审计集
定义正常待专家问题不清选项不清无正确答案多个正确答案和错误真值等标注类型
按学科专长分配 14 名人类专家
有原始来源时追溯原出处否则查阅政府教材或信誉机构等可信来源
记录问题选项原始答案错误类型来源建议正确答案与支持性解释
将不确定判断标为待专家而不作无依据决定
对五个错误较多学科执行三人复标且 Cohen Kappa 高于 0.6
汇总完整覆盖 57 个学科的 MMLU-Redux 2.0 版本
聚合各学科抽样估计完整 MMLU 错误率为 6.49%
evaluation_steps_en: Score model predictions by exact match against the original MMLU answers on all audited items
Use error-type metadata to filter a correct-only view and exclude erroneous and Expert rows
Recompute exact-match accuracy on the correct-only subset
Compare score and ranking changes between all-item and correct-only evaluation
Do not replace original labels by suggested corrected answers in the paper's protocol
evaluation_steps_zh: 在全部审计题目上按原始 MMLU 答案计算模型预测精确匹配
用错误类型元数据过滤仅正确题目视图并排除错误和待专家行
在仅正确子集重新计算精确匹配准确率
比较全量与仅正确评测之间的分数和排名变化
论文协议不使用建议修正答案替换原始标签

visual_review.result: Both 1625 by 501 diagrams preserve the 57-by-100 sample, error taxonomy, 14 experts, source fallback, annotation fields, Expert escalation, agreement audit, 6.49 percent estimate, and all-versus-correct-only exact-match comparison without clipping, overlap, connector-node crossings, or the previous corrected-label overclaim.

source_locator: arXiv:2505.10610 Sections 3-4 and Appendices B-C; official EdinburghNLP/MMLongBench repository
evidence_summary_en: MMLongBench adapts 13,331 examples from 16 existing datasets into five long-context vision-language task categories, standardizes every example at 8K, 16K, 32K, 64K, and 128K cross-modal tokens, and evaluates 46 models with task-specific metrics.
evidence_summary_zh: MMLongBench 将 16 个现有数据集的 13,331 个样本改造为五类长上下文视觉语言任务，为每个样本提供 8K、16K、32K、64K、128K 五档跨模态长度，并以任务特定指标评测 46 个模型。
construction_steps_en: Select 16 existing datasets with natural and synthetic images and reuse their established annotations without new crowdsourcing
Organize Visual RAG, NIAH, Many-shot ICL, PDF summarization, and Long-document VQA categories
For Visual RAG split Wikipedia pages into 100-word passages, insert gold passages, and add distractors to the target length
For NIAH control negative images or chunked web pages and mix text and image needles for retrieval, counting, and reasoning
For Many-shot ICL use 5, 10, 20, 40, and 50 classes at 8K through 128K, balance exemplars, and randomly map integer labels to require in-context rule induction
Render GovReport and Multi-LexSum documents as image PDFs and decompose reference summaries into atomic claims
Adapt three Long-document VQA datasets while preserving answer-bearing pages during length control
Count image tokens from vision-encoder patches followed by pixel unshuffle and combine them with text tokens
Create 8K, 16K, 32K, 64K, and 128K versions using binary prefixes
Assemble 13,331 examples spanning all five categories and 16 datasets
construction_steps_zh: 选择含自然与合成图像的 16 个现有数据集并复用已有标注而不新增众包
组织视觉 RAG NIAH 多样本 ICL PDF 摘要和长文档视觉问答五类任务
视觉 RAG 将维基页面切为百词段落插入金标准证据并添加干扰项至目标长度
NIAH 控制负例图像或切分网页并混合文本与图像针以测试检索计数和推理
多样本 ICL 在 8K 至 128K 五档依次使用 5 10 20 40 50 类并平衡上下文示例且随机映射整数标签
将 GovReport 与 Multi-LexSum 渲染为图像 PDF 并把参考摘要分解为原子事实
改造三个长文档视觉问答数据集且在长度控制时保留包含答案的页面
按视觉编码器图像块与像素重排计算图像词元并与文本词元相加
按二进制前缀生成 8K 16K 32K 64K 和 128K 五档版本
汇总覆盖五类任务与 16 个数据集的 13,331 个样本
evaluation_steps_en: Sample 100 examples per dataset with additional needle depths and permutations to obtain 4,050 examples per input length
Evaluate 46 long-context vision-language models at each of five input lengths for 20,250 instances per model
Use Accuracy or Substring Exact Match for classification and answer tasks as specified per dataset
For summaries have GPT-4o judge atomic-claim precision and recall plus fluency and compute Fluency-F1
Aggregate scores by dataset, task category, and input length
evaluation_steps_zh: 每数据集抽样 100 题并加入针位置深度与排列后得到每档 4,050 个样本
在五档输入长度评测 46 个长上下文视觉语言模型使每模型共运行 20,250 个实例
按数据集规定为分类与回答任务使用准确率或子串精确匹配
摘要任务由 GPT-4o 评判原子事实精确率召回率和流畅度并计算流畅度 F1
按数据集任务类别与输入长度汇总分数

visual_review.result: Both 1625 by 501 diagrams preserve all five categories and their distinct construction logic, 16 datasets, 13,331 examples, cross-modal token counting, exact five lengths, 46 models, 4,050 by five evaluation accounting, and heterogeneous task metrics without clipping, overlap, or connector-node crossings.

source_locator: arXiv:2407.01523 Sections 3-4; official MMLongBench-Doc project
evidence_summary_en: MMLongBench-Doc uses ten experts and three rounds of semi-automatic quality control to build 1,082 single-page, cross-page, and unanswerable questions over 135 long PDFs, then extracts short answers with GPT-4o and reports generalized Accuracy and F1.
evidence_summary_zh: MMLongBench-Doc 由十名专家并通过三轮半自动质检，在 135 份长篇 PDF 上构建 1,082 道单页、跨页与不可回答问题，再由 GPT-4o 抽取简短答案并报告广义准确率与广义 F1。
construction_steps_en: Collect 76 existing and 59 new long PDFs for 135 documents across seven types with 47.5 pages and 21,214.1 tokens on average
Train ten doctor or PhD expert annotators and have them pre-annotate three documents before formal work
Run 54 batches of two to four documents and spend 60 to 90 minutes per document with iterative feedback
Review 425 existing questions against six quality issues and tag Retain, Revise, or Remove, initially collecting 211 questions
Write about three new questions per existing PDF and six per new PDF and record answers, evidence source, format, and location
Balance single-page, cross-page, and unanswerable questions and use text, table, chart, and image evidence
Without providing the PDF ask GPT-4o each question and remove 94 answerable-without-document items
With the PDF ask GPT-4o to self-reflect and return inconsistencies to experts, revising 13.8 percent
Have other experts cross-check, flag 17.5 percent inconsistency with kappa 0.42, and let two primary authors resolve final cases
Assemble 1,082 questions comprising 184 retained source and 898 newly annotated items
Preserve final counts of 494 single-page, 365 cross-page, and 223 unanswerable questions
construction_steps_zh: 收集 76 份已有与 59 份新增长篇 PDF 共 135 份七类文档且平均 47.5 页和 21,214.1 词元
培训十名医生或博士生专家并在正式工作前先标注三份文档
执行 54 批每批两至四份文档的标注且每文档投入 60 至 90 分钟并持续反馈
按六类质量问题复核 425 道已有题并标记保留修订或移除且初步收集 211 题
每份已有 PDF 约编写三题每份新 PDF 约六题并记录答案证据来源格式和位置
平衡单页跨页与不可回答题并使用文本表格图表和图像证据
不提供 PDF 让 GPT-4o 回答每题并移除 94 道无需文档可答题
提供 PDF 让 GPT-4o 自我反思并把不一致项返回专家共修订 13.8%
由其他专家交叉检查标记 17.5% 不一致且 Kappa 为 0.42 再由两名主要作者裁决
汇总 1,082 道问题其中 184 道为保留来源题且 898 道为新标注题
保持 494 道单页 365 道跨页和 223 道不可回答题的最终构成
evaluation_steps_en: Provide PDF page images to LVLMs or OCR-extracted text to LLM baselines
Generate a free-form answer for each question
Use GPT-4o as an answer extractor to convert the free-form output into a short answer
Apply the rule-based calculator for generalized Accuracy and generalized F1 including unanswerable cases
Compare LVLM PDF inputs with OCR-plus-LLM baselines
evaluation_steps_zh: 向 LVLM 提供 PDF 页面图像或向 LLM 基线提供 OCR 抽取文本
为每道问题生成自由文本回答
使用 GPT-4o 答案抽取器将自由文本输出转为简短答案
用规则计算器处理含不可回答样本的广义准确率与广义 F1
比较 LVLM 的 PDF 输入与 OCR 加 LLM 基线

source_locator: OpenAI MMMLU dataset card Locales and Sources; openai/simple-evals mmlu_eval.py, common.py, and run_multilingual_mmlu.py
evidence_summary_en: OpenAI professionally translates the 57-category MMLU test set into 14 locales and publishes the translations plus evaluation code; simple-evals adds the original EN-US baseline, uses a zero-shot chain-of-thought A-D prompt, parses localized answer markers, and reports exact overall and category accuracy.
evidence_summary_zh: OpenAI 将含 57 类学科的 MMLU 测试集交由专业译者翻译为 14 个 locale，并发布翻译数据与评测代码；simple-evals 加入原始 EN-US 基线，使用零样本思维链 A-D 提示、多语言答案标记解析，并报告总体及类别精确准确率。
construction_steps_en: Start from the MMLU test set covering 57 knowledge categories and fields for question, four choices, answer, and subject
Use professional human translators to translate the complete test set, including low-resource Yoruba
Preserve the item fields, gold answer, subject, and test-row correspondence
Produce Arabic, Bengali, German, Spanish, French, Hindi, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, Swahili, Yoruba, and Simplified Chinese versions
Publish one CSV per translated locale on Hugging Face
Publish the multilingual evaluation implementation in openai/simple-evals
construction_steps_zh: 从含 57 类知识学科且包含问题四个选项答案和学科字段的 MMLU 测试集开始
使用专业人工译者翻译完整测试集并纳入低资源约鲁巴语
保持题目字段标准答案学科及测试行对应关系
形成阿拉伯孟加拉德语西语法语印地印尼意大利日语韩语巴西葡萄牙斯瓦希里约鲁巴和简体中文版本
在 Hugging Face 为每个翻译 locale 发布一个 CSV
在 openai/simple-evals 发布多语言评测实现
evaluation_steps_en: Configure the official runner for the original EN-US test plus all 14 translated locales
Format each item with the official zero-shot chain-of-thought prompt and require a final Answer: LETTER line
Run every selected model-locale pair and normalize the free-form response
Search ordered localized answer markers and normalize Latin, Arabic, Bengali, and full-width answer letters to A-D
Assign one when the extracted letter exactly matches the gold answer and zero otherwise
Aggregate overall accuracy and STEM, humanities, social-sciences, and other category metrics per locale
evaluation_steps_zh: 为原始 EN-US 测试集及全部 14 个翻译 locale 配置官方运行器
用官方零样本思维链提示格式化每题并要求末行输出 Answer: 字母
运行每个模型与 locale 组合并规范自由文本回答
依次搜索本地化答案标记并将拉丁阿拉伯孟加拉和全角答案字母规范为 A-D
解析字母与标准答案精确一致时记一分否则记零分
按 locale 聚合总体及 STEM 人文社会科学和其他类别准确率

source_locator: DeepSeek-V3 Technical Report Section 4.4 and Table 3; OpenAI MMMLU dataset card
evidence_summary_en: The DeepSeek-V3 report derives MMMLU-non-English from OpenAI's 14 professional MMLU translations, evaluates the multiple-choice suite in a shared internal framework with five shots and perplexity-based scoring, and reports exact match for four base models under the same setting.
evidence_summary_zh: DeepSeek-V3 报告从 OpenAI 的 14 个专业 MMLU 翻译版本派生 MMMLU-non-English，在统一内部框架中以五样本和基于困惑度的多选题协议评测，并在相同设置下报告四个基础模型的精确匹配。
construction_steps_en: Use the 14 professionally translated locales released by OpenAI MMMLU
Retain the entire non-English locale suite and exclude the original English test from this reported variant
Preserve the 57 MMLU categories, four answer choices, and gold answer for every item
Register the derived suite under the MMMLU-non-English benchmark name used in the report
construction_steps_zh: 使用 OpenAI MMMLU 发布的 14 个专业人工翻译 locale
保留完整非英语 locale 套件并从该报告变体中排除原始英语测试
保持 57 类 MMLU 学科每题四个答案选项和标准答案
按报告采用的 MMMLU-non-English 名称登记派生套件

Aggregate the non-English EM score under the identical setting for DeepSeek-V2, Qwen2.5-72B, LLaMA-3.1-405B, and DeepSeek-V3
Report scores of 64.0, 74.8, 73.8, and 79.4 respectively

构造表三规定的五样本多选题设置
按报告的困惑度评测为候选选项打分并生成一个预测选项
将预测选项与标准答案执行精确匹配
在完全一致的设置下汇总 DeepSeek-V2 Qwen2.5-72B LLaMA-3.1-405B 和 DeepSeek-V3 的非英语 EM

source_locator: arXiv:2505.23764 Sections 3-5 and Appendix F; official OpenRobotLab/MMSI-Bench repository
evidence_summary_en: Six 3D-vision researchers spend more than 300 hours examining over 120,000 candidate images from eight real-world datasets, freely author 1,000 multi-image four-choice questions with rationales, and pass every item through three independent reviewers; the final 1,990-image benchmark evaluates 37 MLLMs with exact-match accuracy and four automated error modes.
evidence_summary_zh: 六名 3D 视觉研究者投入超过 300 小时，从八个真实世界数据集的 12 万余候选图像中自由编写 1,000 道多图四选一题及推理过程，并由三名独立审核者检查每题；最终含 1,990 张图像的基准以精确准确率和四类自动错误模式评测 37 个 MLLM。
construction_steps_en: Inspect more than 120,000 candidate images from ScanNet, Matterport3D, DTU, nuScenes, Waymo, Ego4D, AgiBot-World, and DAVIS 2017
Define ten basic spatial task types plus one multi-step category over camera, object, region, position, attribute, and motion
Have six 3D-vision researchers spend more than 300 hours creating questions without templates
Select image sets that require cross-image integration and reject any question answerable from one image
Use exactly two images for every non-multi-step category while allowing up to ten for multi-step questions
Write four-option questions with exactly one correct answer and plausible distractors
Annotate a detailed reasoning process and human-time-based difficulty for every item
Have three independent reviewers remove ambiguous, wrong, insufficient-evidence, single-image-solvable, or common-sense-solvable instances
Assemble 1,000 questions over 1,990 unique images with 2.55 images per question on average
construction_steps_zh: 检查来自 ScanNet Matterport3D DTU nuScenes Waymo Ego4D AgiBot-World 和 DAVIS 2017 的 12 万余候选图像

source_locator: arXiv:2506.04779 Sections 3-4 and Appendix C; official dingdongwang/MMSU repository
evidence_summary_en: MMSU follows four stages: expert-grounded linguistic task design, textbook and web MCQ collection with expert-in-loop GPT-4o option augmentation, 3,837 open-source plus 672 custom plus 491 Azure-TTS clips, and multi-round review by ten annotators and experts; the 5,000-item benchmark evaluates 12 SpeechLLMs and 10 OmniLLMs.
evidence_summary_zh: MMSU 遵循四阶段流程：专家参与的语言学任务设计、教材与网络选择题收集及专家参与的 GPT-4o 选项扩充、3,837 条开源加 672 条定制加 491 条 Azure TTS 音频，以及十名标注员与专家多轮审核；最终 5,000 题评测 12 个 SpeechLLM 和 10 个 OmniLLM。
construction_steps_en: Consult linguistics experts and ground task design in phonetics, prosody, rhetoric, syntactics, semantics, and paralinguistics
Define 47 tasks split into 24 perception and 23 reasoning tasks
Collect multiple-choice questions from authoritative linguistics textbooks and online sources
Use expert-in-the-loop GPT-4o prompts to generate additional plausible answer options
Prioritize 3,837 open-source real-world audio clips comprising 76.74 percent of the dataset
Record 672 custom clips with professional voice actors for missing phonological cues and 15 diverse speakers for uncovered semantic tasks
Generate 491 synthetic clips with 20 Azure TTS voices for 9.82 percent of the dataset
Have ten trained annotators run multiple review rounds and filter or refine low-quality or ambiguous questions, choices, and audio
Have experts and the research team perform final clarity, correctness, and diversity review and tag task, category, and linguistic subfield
Assemble 5,000 MCQs with 2,580 perception and 2,420 reasoning items, about 90 to 120 per task, and 7.01-second mean audio
construction_steps_zh: 咨询语言学专家并以语音学韵律修辞句法语义和副语言学为任务设计基础
定义 47 项任务并划分为 24 项感知和 23 项推理任务
从权威语言学教材和在线来源收集多项选择题
使用专家参与的 GPT-4o 提示生成额外可信答案选项
优先采用 3,837 条开源真实世界音频占数据集 76.74%
由专业配音演员为缺失音系线索录制并由 15 名多样说话人为未覆盖语义任务补充共 672 条定制音频
用 20 种 Azure TTS 音色生成 491 条合成音频占数据集 9.82%
由十名受训标注员执行多轮审核并过滤或改进低质及歧义的问题选项和音频
由专家与研究团队最终检查清晰度正确性多样性并标注任务类别和语言学子领域
汇总 5,000 道选择题其中感知 2,580 推理 2,420 每任务约 90 至 120 题且平均音频 7.01 秒
evaluation_steps_en: Evaluate 12 SpeechLLMs and 10 OmniLLMs using their official configurations unless otherwise specified
Present each audio clip and text prompt with randomly ordered and dataset-balanced A-D options under the same optimized instruction prompt
Use the average score of 15 undergraduate or master's evaluators on 1,000 sampled instances as the human baseline
Report overall accuracy and perception-versus-reasoning breakdowns for semantics, phonology, and paralinguistics

source_locator: arXiv:2404.16006 Sections 3-5 and Appendix; official MMT-Bench project and OpenGVLab repository
evidence_summary_en: MMT-Bench coauthors define 32 meta-tasks and decompose them into 162 qualifying subtasks, search and sample public datasets, standardize multimodal metadata, and use manual rules or ChatGPT to build 31,325 questions with up to eight choices; OpenCompass evaluates 32 public LVLMs with three-stage answer extraction, hierarchical accuracy, and 162 LoRA-derived task vectors.
evidence_summary_zh: MMT-Bench 合著者定义 32 个元任务并分解出 162 个合格子任务，再搜索抽样公开数据集、规范多模态元数据，并以人工规则或 ChatGPT 构建 31,325 道至多八选一问题；OpenCompass 通过三级答案抽取、分层准确率及 162 个 LoRA 任务向量评测 32 个公开 LVLM。
construction_steps_en: Have coauthors brainstorm candidate meta-tasks, deduplicate them, and retain 32 important meta-tasks
Decompose meta-tasks and retain a subtask only when it is fundamental, challenges current LVLMs, and has publicly accessible test samples
Search for source datasets through Google, Papers With Code, Kaggle, and ChatGPT and assess relevance and usability
Randomly sample at most 200 examples per subtask and balance samples across contributing datasets
Create uniform metadata containing multimodal inputs, information needed for question answering, capability tags, and visual prompt types
Use manually designed rules or ChatGPT to create multiple-choice questions with at most eight choices and one gold answer
Assemble 31,325 questions across 32 meta-tasks, 162 subtasks, 13 input types, and 14 capability types
construction_steps_zh: 由论文合著者构思候选元任务并去重且保留 32 个重要元任务
将元任务分解且仅保留属于基础能力能挑战当前 LVLM 并具有公开测试样本的子任务
通过 Google Papers With Code Kaggle 和 ChatGPT 搜索来源数据集并评估相关性与可用性
每个子任务随机抽取至多 200 个样本并在贡献数据集之间平衡
建立包含多模态输入问答所需信息能力标签和视觉提示类型的统一元数据
使用人工规则或 ChatGPT 创建最多八个选项且仅有一个标准答案的多项选择题
汇总覆盖 32 个元任务 162 个子任务 13 种输入类型和 14 类能力的 31,325 道问题
evaluation_steps_en: Evaluate 32 publicly available LVLMs through the OpenCompass pipeline with task-specific multimodal inputs
Extract the option letter first, match option content second, ask ChatGPT third, and assign Z if all extraction stages fail
Compare each extracted choice with the gold answer and compute subtask accuracy
Average subtask performance into meta-task scores and report hierarchical multitask results
LoRA-tune Qwen-VL-Chat for three epochs on each of 162 subtasks, derive task vectors, and compare them by cosine distance to cluster related tasks and study model-ranking consistency
evaluation_steps_zh: 通过 OpenCompass 流程与任务特定多模态输入评测 32 个公开 LVLM
依次尝试抽取选项字母匹配选项内容询问 ChatGPT 且全部失败时记为 Z
将每个抽取选项与标准答案比较并计算子任务准确率
将子任务表现平均为元任务分数并报告分层多任务结果
在 162 个子任务上分别对 Qwen-VL-Chat 执行三轮 LoRA 微调并提取任务向量再以余弦距离聚类相关任务和研究模型排名一致性

source_locator: arXiv:2401.06209 Sections 2-3 and Appendix B; MMVP construction, visual-pattern taxonomy, human study, and paired-accuracy protocol
evidence_summary_en: MMVP mines near-duplicate image pairs from ImageNet-1K and LAION-Aesthetics using high CLIP but low DINOv2 similarity, manually verifies subtle visual differences, and writes 300 direct questions over 150 pairs; evaluation treats each question independently but awards a pair only when both answers are correct.
evidence_summary_zh: MMVP 从 ImageNet-1K 与 LAION-Aesthetics 中以高 CLIP、低 DINOv2 相似度挖掘近重复图像对，人工确认细微视觉差异并围绕 150 对图像编写 300 道直接问题；评测逐题作答，但仅当一对中的两题均正确时才计该图像对正确。
construction_steps_en: Collect candidate images from ImageNet-1K and LAION-Aesthetics
Embed every image with CLIP ViT-L/14 and DINOv2 ViT-L/14
Retrieve candidate pairs whose CLIP similarity is above 0.95 but DINOv2 similarity is below 0.6
Manually inspect candidates and retain pairs that differ in a subtle yet meaningful visual detail
Write one direct and unambiguous question for each image without relying on the paired image
Assemble 150 image pairs and 300 questions with explicit answer choices
Use GPT-4 to categorize questions and options into nine visual patterns
Randomize the 300 questions for a human study and confirm 95.7 percent average per-question accuracy
construction_steps_zh: 从 ImageNet-1K 与 LAION-Aesthetics 收集候选图像
分别使用 CLIP ViT-L/14 与 DINOv2 ViT-L/14 为每张图像编码
检索 CLIP 相似度高于 0.95 且 DINOv2 相似度低于 0.6 的候选图像对
人工检查候选并保留存在细微但有意义视觉差异的图像对
针对每张图像单独编写无需依赖配对图像且表述直接无歧义的问题
汇总 150 对图像与 300 道带明确选项的问题
使用 GPT-4 将问题与选项归入九类视觉模式
随机打乱 300 道问题开展人类研究并确认逐题平均准确率为 95.7%
evaluation_steps_en: Present each image and its question independently to the evaluated model
Mark an image pair correct only when both associated questions are answered correctly
Compute paired accuracy over all 150 pairs
Break down results by the nine visual patterns and compare model performance with the human study
evaluation_steps_zh: 将每张图像及其问题独立呈现给被评模型
仅当同一图像对关联的两道题均回答正确时才将该对记为正确
在全部 150 个图像对上计算配对准确率
按九类视觉模式拆分结果并将模型表现与人类研究比较

source_locator: arXiv:2501.12380 Sections 3-4 and Appendices A-B; subject selection, expert annotation, validation, splits, and answer-evaluation protocol
evidence_summary_en: MMVU selects 27 subjects from proposals by 133 college or graduate students, then uses 67 trained subject experts to find licensed captioned YouTube videos and author video-dependent questions with knowledge-linked solutions; expert validation revises 523 items, excludes 72, and yields 3,000 questions over 1,529 videos.
evidence_summary_zh: MMVU 从 133 名本科生或研究生提交的方案中选出 27 个学科，再由 67 名受训领域专家寻找具有许可与字幕的 YouTube 视频，并编写依赖视频、附知识链接与解题过程的问题；专家复核后修订 523 题、剔除 72 题，形成覆盖 1,529 个视频的 3,000 道题。
construction_steps_en: Ask 133 college and graduate students to propose two examples each and select 27 subjects across four disciplines
Recruit and train 67 expert annotators with at least two annotators assigned to every subject
Review subject textbooks and chapters to identify dynamic concepts that benefit from video
Search YouTube for Creative Commons videos and verify licenses through the YouTube Data API
Exclude videos that require audio, rely heavily on on-screen text, or merely reproduce lecture shortcuts
Write two or three multiple-choice or open-ended questions per video and record the relevant timestamps
For multiple-choice items, create four plausible distractors, form five choices, and shuffle their order
Provide the required domain knowledge with Wikipedia links and a step-by-step solution for every item
Compensate annotation by measured time and record average annotation and validation times of 20 minutes 17 seconds and 4 minutes 12 seconds
Have experts validate answer correctness and video necessity, revising text-only, single-frame, or erroneous items
Revise 523 items, exclude 72, and finalize 3,000 questions over 1,529 videos with 1,858 multiple-choice and 1,142 open questions
construction_steps_zh: 邀请 133 名本科生与研究生各提出两个示例并从四大学科门类中选出 27 个学科
招募并培训 67 名专家标注员且每个学科至少分配两名标注员
查阅学科教材与章节以识别适合通过视频呈现的动态概念
在 YouTube 搜索知识共享许可视频并通过 YouTube Data API 核验许可
排除依赖音频大量屏幕文字或仅复现课堂解题捷径的视频
每个视频编写两到三道选择题或开放题并记录相关时间戳
为选择题创建四个合理干扰项形成五个选项并随机打乱顺序
为每题提供带 Wikipedia 链接的必需领域知识和分步解答
按实测时间补偿标注工作并记录平均标注 20 分 17 秒与复核 4 分 12 秒
由专家验证答案正确性与视频必要性并修订可纯文本作答仅需单帧或存在错误的题目
修订 523 题剔除 72 题并形成覆盖 1,529 个视频的 3,000 题其中 1,858 道选择题与 1,142 道开放题
evaluation_steps_en: Use the 1,000-item validation split for development and keep the 2,000-item test split hidden
Evaluate models with direct-answer and chain-of-thought prompting over the supplied videos
Use GPT-4o to extract answers and judge open-ended response correctness while scoring multiple-choice predictions against the gold option
Report accuracy and compare 32 evaluated models across subjects, disciplines, and question types
evaluation_steps_zh: 使用 1,000 题验证集进行开发并将 2,000 题测试集保持隐藏
基于所给视频分别采用直接回答与思维链提示评测模型
使用 GPT-4o 抽取答案并判断开放回答正确性且将选择题预测与标准选项比较
报告准确率并在学科门类和题型维度比较 32 个被评模型

source_locator: arXiv:2506.05523 Sections 2-3 and Appendix A; category design, iterative script-based generation and QC, input preprocessing, and answer scoring
evidence_summary_en: MORSE-500 converts expert-defined reasoning prototypes and adapted public tasks into deterministic-script-generated short videos across six reasoning categories, including real-world or generated physics material where appropriate, controls difficulty through five dimensions, and iterates automatic plus author review before finalizing 500 videos; models are scored by Qwen2.5-72B-AWQ answer extraction followed by string matching.
evidence_summary_zh: MORSE-500 将专家定义的推理原型与改编公开任务通过确定性脚本制作为覆盖六类推理的视频，并在适合的物理任务中纳入真实场景或生成式素材，以五个维度控制难度，再经自动检查与作者抽检迭代后形成 500 个视频；评测先由 Qwen2.5-72B-AWQ 抽取答案再做字符串匹配。
construction_steps_en: Define six reasoning categories: abstract, mathematical, physical, planning, spatial, and temporal
Create domain-expert conceptual prototypes and adapt suitable tasks from benchmarks, ARC-AGI, educational videos, robotics, and physics sources
Generate every video through deterministic Python scripts using Manim, Matplotlib, OpenCV, and MoviePy while incorporating real-world or video-generative physics material where appropriate
Embed the question in each video and retain the task metadata needed to recover its answer
Control difficulty through entity count, reasoning depth, distractors, temporal dependency, and visual complexity
Automatically verify at least 512p resolution, valid codec, complete rendering, and parameter-label consistency
Have authors inspect random slices for clarity and a unique answer, visual-semantic alignment, and intended difficulty
Revise generation scripts and task parameters for two or three iterations per category
Finalize 64 abstract, 84 mathematical, 64 physical, 100 planning, 108 spatial, and 80 temporal videos
Assemble exactly 500 videos totaling 3.1 hours
Release the videos, questions, answers, and category metadata for evaluation
construction_steps_zh: 定义抽象数学物理规划空间与时间六类推理任务
由领域专家建立概念原型并从现有基准 ARC-AGI 教育视频机器人与物理来源中改编适合任务
使用 Manim Matplotlib OpenCV 与 MoviePy 通过确定性 Python 脚本生成全部视频并在适合的物理任务中纳入真实场景或视频生成素材
将问题嵌入每个视频并保留可恢复答案所需的任务元数据
通过实体数量推理深度干扰项时间依赖与视觉复杂度控制难度
自动核验至少 512p 分辨率有效编解码完整渲染以及参数与标签一致性
由作者随机抽检问题清晰且答案唯一视觉语义一致性与预期难度
按类别对生成脚本与任务参数迭代两到三轮
最终保留抽象 64 数学 84 物理 64 规划 100 空间 108 与时间 80 个视频
汇总恰好 500 个视频且总时长为 3.1 小时
发布用于评测的视频问题答案与类别元数据
evaluation_steps_en: Feed native video to video-capable models; otherwise sample at 2 FPS with at most 32 frames and resize the long side to 512 pixels
Prompt every model with the fixed instruction Answer the question in this video.
Use Qwen2.5-72B-AWQ to extract the final answer from each free-form response and compare it with the reference by string matching
Compute overall accuracy and per-category accuracy across the six reasoning types
evaluation_steps_zh: 对原生视频模型输入完整视频而对其他模型以 2 FPS 至多抽取 32 帧并将长边缩放至 512 像素
统一使用提示语 Answer the question in this video.
使用 Qwen2.5-72B-AWQ 从自由回答中抽取最终答案并与参考答案执行字符串匹配
计算总体准确率以及六类推理任务的分类准确率

source_locator: OpenAI MRCR dataset card, Motivation, Description, Dataset Construction, Evaluation Criteria, Statistics, and Changelog
evidence_summary_en: MRCR uses 438 entities and ten writing formats to synthesize long multi-turn conversations whose GPT-4o assistant responses make target requests indistinguishable from distractors; each example repeats one request 2, 4, or 8 times and asks for an indexed response, producing 2,400 examples across eight length bins.
evidence_summary_zh: MRCR 使用 438 个实体与十种写作格式合成长多轮对话，并以 GPT-4o 生成助手回答，使目标请求与干扰内容同分布；每个样本将同一请求重复 2 次、4 次或 8 次，再要求返回指定序号的回答，最终在八个长度区间形成 2,400 个样本。
construction_steps_en: Create a catalog of 438 entities and ten writing-request formats
Synthesize long multi-turn user conversations and generate every assistant response with GPT-4o
Keep target needles and distractor turns drawn from the same writing-task distribution
Repeat an identical user request 2, 4, or 8 times within a conversation
Ask the model in the final turn to reproduce the i-th response using one-indexed ordering
Prefix the requested response with a random ten-character alphanumeric string
Measure the combined prompt and reference-answer token length
Assign examples to eight bins spanning 4,096 through 1,048,576 tokens
Sample 100 examples for every repetition count and length bin to obtain 2,400 examples
Apply the December 5 2025 correction that replaced examples with excessive target needles and repaired bad ground truth while recording date_added
construction_steps_zh: 建立包含 438 个实体与十种写作请求格式的目录
合成长多轮用户对话并使用 GPT-4o 生成全部助手回答
确保目标针与干扰轮次来自相同的写作任务分布
在同一对话中将完全相同的用户请求重复 2 次 4 次或 8 次
在最后一轮按从一开始的序号要求模型复现第 i 个回答
为目标回答添加随机十字符字母数字前缀
测量提示与参考回答合计的 token 长度
将样本分配到从 4,096 延伸至 1,048,576 token 的八个区间
对每个重复次数与长度区间抽取 100 个样本从而得到 2,400 个样本
应用 2025 年 12 月 5 日修订以替换目标针过多的样本修复错误标准答案并记录 date_added
evaluation_steps_en: Return zero when the model response does not contain the required random prefix
Otherwise strip the prefix from both the model response and reference answer
Score the remaining strings with difflib SequenceMatcher ratio and aggregate by repetition count and context-length bin

否则从模型回答与参考答案两侧移除该前缀

source_locator: arXiv:2505.20740 Sections 3-4 and Appendices E-G; official PrismaX/MSEarth repository and MSEarth_MCQ dataset
evidence_summary_en: MSEarthMCQ parses more than 400,000 Earth-science PDFs, filters papers and aligns figures with references, then uses GPT-4o to refine captions and create candidate questions; three-phase five-model and 70B-plus-model screening plus expert review removes 216 invalid items and yields 2,784 questions.
evidence_summary_zh: MSEarthMCQ 解析超过 40 万篇地球科学 PDF，筛选论文并对齐图表与正文引用，再用 GPT-4o 优化图注并生成候选问题；经五模型与 70B+ 三模型参与的三阶段筛选及专家复核，剔除 216 个无效样本，最终得到 2,784 道题。
construction_steps_en: Collect more than 400,000 Earth-science PDFs spanning five Earth spheres
Parse every PDF into structured JSON with MinerU
Use Qwen2.5-VL-72B to filter for image-rich papers and retain about 83,000 papers
Extract figures and captions from MinerU output and use regular expressions to align figure labels with textual references
Require reference context longer than two sentences and retain 64,560 papers
Use GPT-4o with the figure, raw caption, and context to produce a refined caption
Use GPT-4o with the figure and both captions to generate a candidate multiple-choice question
Run five models on the original-caption condition and discard items all models solve while routing items with more than 40 percent errors onward
Run the five models with refined captions and mark items with more than 60 percent correct as specialized
Run GPT-4o, InternVL2.5-78B, and Qwen2.5-VL-72B and mark items with more than 60 percent correct as hard
Sample 900 original-caption, 1,800 specialized, and 300 hard questions to form 3,000 candidates
Have Earth-science master's experts validate the candidates, remove 216 invalid items, and finalize 2,784 questions
construction_steps_zh: 收集覆盖地球五大圈层的超过 40 万篇地球科学 PDF
使用 MinerU 将每篇 PDF 解析为结构化 JSON
使用 Qwen2.5-VL-72B 筛选图像丰富的论文并保留约 8.3 万篇
从 MinerU 输出提取图表与图注并使用正则表达式将图号和正文引用对齐
要求引用上下文超过两句话并保留 64,560 篇论文
将图表原始图注与上下文交给 GPT-4o 生成优化图注
将图表及两版图注交给 GPT-4o 生成候选选择题
在原始图注条件下运行五个模型并剔除全部答对的题且将错误率超过 40% 的题送入后续流程
在优化图注条件下运行五个模型并将正确率超过 60% 的题标记为专业题
运行 GPT-4o InternVL2.5-78B 与 Qwen2.5-VL-72B 并将正确率超过 60% 的题标记为困难题
抽取 900 道原始图注题 1,800 道专业题与 300 道困难题形成 3,000 个候选
由地球科学硕士专家复核候选剔除 216 个无效样本并最终保留 2,784 道题
evaluation_steps_en: Format each single-image or multi-image item with its question and multiple-choice options
Extract the predicted option with the benchmark regular-expression parser
Compare the extracted option with the gold answer and report overall accuracy plus discovery and perception breakdowns
evaluation_steps_zh: 将每个单图或多图样本按问题与多项选择选项模板输入模型
使用基准正则表达式解析器抽取预测选项
将抽取选项与标准答案比较并报告总体准确率以及发现与感知分类结果

source_locator: arXiv:2502.17407 Section 2.1, Table 2, Section 3.3, and Appendices A.1/A.4; MCLM MT-AIME2024 translation, verification, and scoring protocol
evidence_summary_en: MT-AIME2024 is the MCLM paper's machine-translated AIME 2024 subset: all 30 numerical-answer problems are translated with GPT-4o into 55 languages while question and solution templates preserve details, equations, LaTeX, and code; answers and equations are verified unchanged before rule-based scoring and cross-language consistency analysis.
evidence_summary_zh: MT-AIME2024 是 MCLM 论文中由机器翻译构建的 AIME 2024 子集：全部 30 道数值答案题使用 GPT-4o 翻译为 55 种语言，问题与解答模板要求保留细节、公式、LaTeX 和代码，并在发布前确认答案与公式未被改变，随后采用规则验证器和跨语言一致性分析。
construction_steps_en: Start from all 30 numerical-answer problems in AIME 2024
Package each English question with its official solution and gold numerical answer
Use GPT-4o to translate every question into 55 languages without solving it
Use the separate solution template to translate the full reasoning while preserving its structure and details
Preserve all equations, LaTeX commands, code fragments, and other technical notation
Verify that translated questions and solutions leave the original answer and equations unchanged
Release 30 samples per language for a total of 1,650 multilingual problem records
construction_steps_zh: 从 AIME 2024 全部 30 道数值答案题开始
将每道英文问题与官方解答及数值标准答案打包
使用 GPT-4o 将每道问题翻译为 55 种语言并明确禁止求解
使用独立解答模板翻译完整推理过程并保留原有结构与细节
完整保留公式 LaTeX 命令代码片段及其他技术记号
检查译文中的原始答案与公式均未发生改变
按每种语言 30 个样本发布共 1,650 条多语言问题记录
evaluation_steps_en: Generate one answer for every problem in each target language
Parse the numerical result and compare it with the gold answer using the rule-based verifier
Compute accuracy separately for every language
Treat correctness across languages as categorical ratings and compute Fleiss' kappa
Report aggregate accuracy statistics and cross-language consistency
evaluation_steps_zh: 对每种目标语言中的每道题生成一个回答
解析数值结果并使用规则验证器与标准答案比较
分别计算每种语言的准确率
将各语言正确与否视为分类评分并计算 Fleiss kappa
汇总准确率统计与跨语言一致性

source_locator: arXiv:2402.14762 Sections 3.1-3.4 and 4.5 plus Appendices A-C; taxonomy, generation, annotation, judge, and human-validation protocol
evidence_summary_en: MT-Bench-101 derives a three-tier taxonomy with 13 tasks, uses task-specific GPT-4 prompts and 30 topics to generate more than 1,000 candidates per task, retains only dialogues unanimously accepted by five annotators, and evaluates 1,388 dialogues and 4,208 turns with golden context and task-specific GPT-4 scoring.
evidence_summary_zh: MT-Bench-101 建立包含 13 个任务的三层能力分类，使用任务专属 GPT-4 提示和 30 个主题为每个任务生成超过 1,000 个候选，仅保留五位标注员一致通过的对话，并以黄金上下文和任务专属 GPT-4 评分评估最终 1,388 段对话与 4,208 个轮次。
construction_steps_en: Derive a three-tier taxonomy of perceptivity, adaptability, and interactivity from real multi-turn dialogue data
Expand the taxonomy into 13 fine-grained multi-turn conversation tasks
Design task-specific GPT-4 generation prompts with explicit rules and handcrafted examples
Select 30 topics to diversify the content of every task
Generate more than 1,000 candidate dialogues for each task
Have five annotators independently inspect task validity, naturalness, and correctness
Retain a candidate only when all five annotators approve it
Finalize 1,388 multi-turn dialogues containing 4,208 turns
construction_steps_zh: 从真实多轮对话数据归纳感知性适应性与交互性三层分类
将分类展开为 13 个细粒度多轮对话任务
为每个任务设计包含明确规则与人工示例的 GPT-4 生成提示
选择 30 个主题以扩展各任务的内容多样性
为每个任务生成超过 1,000 段候选对话
由五位标注员独立检查任务有效性自然度与正确性
仅当五位标注员全部通过时保留候选
最终形成 1,388 段多轮对话与 4,208 个轮次
evaluation_steps_en: Feed the model the gold previous turns so every evaluated turn receives golden context
Apply the GPT-4 judge prompt specialized for the corresponding task
Assign each turn a score from 1 to 10 together with a justification
Use the lowest turn score as the overall dialogue score
Validate the judge on 100 dialogues with five human experts and majority aggregation
Report the observed 87 percent GPT-4-to-human agreement alongside task and capability results
evaluation_steps_zh: 向模型提供此前标准轮次使每个被评轮次都使用黄金上下文
按对应任务应用专属 GPT-4 裁判提示
为每个轮次给出 1 到 10 分及评分理由
将最低轮次分作为整段对话得分
由五位专家在 100 段对话上以多数票验证裁判
报告 87% 的 GPT-4 与人工一致率以及任务和能力维度结果

source_locator: arXiv:2405.11985 Sections 3.1-3.3 and 4.3.1-4.3.3; image collection, multilingual annotation, quality control, splits, and scoring
evidence_summary_en: MTVQA combines public, web, and manually collected text-rich images, filters multilingual OCR output from 8,980 to 8,895 images, runs trained native-speaker makers and independent checkers with a 10-percent per-language audit, and releases 8,794 images with 28,607 question-answer pairs across train and test splits.
evidence_summary_zh: MTVQA 混合公开数据、网络抓取与人工收集的文本密集图像，将多语言 OCR 结果从 8,980 张清理至 8,895 张，再由经过培训的母语标注员制作并由独立复核员检查，同时对每种语言抽查 10%，最终发布 8,794 张图像与 28,607 个问答对的训练和测试划分。
construction_steps_en: Collect text-rich images from public datasets at 30 percent, web search at 20 percent, and manual collection at 50 percent
Run ByteDance multilingual OCR and apply language, content, quality, and regulatory filters
Reduce the raw pool from 8,980 to 8,895 clean candidate images
Recruit annotators who are native speakers for at least ten years and hold a university degree
Train annotators with written guidelines, questions and answers, and a pilot exercise
Assign three makers per language to create five questions per image: three text-reading and two reasoning questions
Have two additional annotators independently check every question-answer pair
Audit 10 percent of each language and re-annotate a language batch when it fails quality control
Reduce 28,906 initial question-answer pairs to a final 28,607 pairs over 8,794 images
Split 6,678 images and 21,829 pairs for training and 2,116 images and 6,778 pairs for testing
construction_steps_zh: 按公开数据 30% 网络搜索 20% 与人工收集 50% 汇集文本密集图像
运行字节跳动多语言 OCR 并执行语言内容质量与合规过滤
将 8,980 张原始图像清理为 8,895 张候选图像
招募具有至少十年母语经历且拥有大学学历的标注员
通过书面指南问答说明与试标任务培训标注员
每种语言安排三位制作员为每张图像编写五道题即三道文字读取题与两道推理题
再由两位标注员独立检查每个问答对
对每种语言抽查 10% 并在不合格时重新标注该语言批次
将 28,906 个初始问答对清理为覆盖 8,794 张图像的 28,607 个最终问答对
划分 6,678 张图像与 21,829 个训练问答对以及 2,116 张图像与 6,778 个测试问答对
evaluation_steps_en: Present the multilingual text-centered image and its question to the evaluated model
Match the model output exactly against any accepted target answer
Compute overall and per-language accuracy on the test split
Ask ten native speakers per language to answer the test items for the human baseline
Compare model accuracy with the approximately 80-percent human result
evaluation_steps_zh: 向被评模型提供多语言文本中心图像及其问题
将模型输出与任一可接受目标答案进行精确匹配
在测试集上计算总体与各语言准确率
每种语言邀请十位母语者回答测试题以建立人工基线
将模型准确率与约 80% 的人工结果比较

source_locator: arXiv:2406.09411 Sections 3.1-3.2 and 4.1 plus Appendices A-C; task taxonomy, paired construction, quality control, and evaluation
evidence_summary_en: MuirBench harmonizes existing, derived, and newly collected data across 12 tasks and ten multi-image relations, pairs every answerable item with a minimal-change unanswerable counterpart, applies automatic and four-expert quality control, and retains 2,600 MCQs with 11,264 images for deterministic paired evaluation.
evidence_summary_zh: MuirBench 将已有、派生和新采集数据统一到 12 个任务与十类多图关系，为每个可回答样本构造语义变化最小的不可回答配对，经自动检查与四位专家质检后，保留包含 11,264 张图像的 2,600 道选择题用于确定性配对评测。
construction_steps_en: Define 12 multi-image understanding tasks and ten relation categories with fine-grained labels
Collect answerable items from existing data at 40.8 percent, derived data at 21.7 percent, and new collection at 37.5 percent
Harmonize reused, rewritten, generated, and newly authored items into multiple-choice format
Annotate task, relation, image type, image position, and the two-to-nine-image composition
Create one minimal-change unanswerable counterpart for every answerable item
Use image replacement or reordering for 24.2 percent, question modification for 35.3 percent, and option replacement for 40.5 percent
Run automatic checks for format, answers, metadata, coreference, and image accessibility
Have four experts remove ambiguous questions and unclear images, retaining 86.3 percent after quality control
Finalize 2,600 paired MCQs containing 11,264 images and 4.3 images per item on average
construction_steps_zh: 定义 12 个多图理解任务与十类关系并添加细粒度标签
按已有数据 40.8% 派生数据 21.7% 与新采集数据 37.5% 汇集可回答样本
将复用改写生成和新编样本统一为多项选择格式
标注任务关系图像类型图像位置以及每题二至九张图像的组成
为每个可回答样本创建一个最小变化的不可回答对应样本
分别以图像替换或重排 24.2% 问题修改 35.3% 与选项替换 40.5% 构造配对
对格式答案元数据指代关系与图像可访问性运行自动检查
由四位专家移除歧义问题与不清晰图像并在质检后保留 86.3%
最终形成包含 11,264 张图像且每题平均 4.3 张图像的 2,600 道配对选择题
evaluation_steps_en: Configure VLMEvalKit with temperature zero and up to ten retries
Concatenate multiple images when the evaluated model accepts only a single image
Extract the predicted option with predefined deterministic rules and compare it with gold
Compute overall, per-task, and per-relation accuracy across the evaluated multimodal models
Compare answerable and unanswerable accuracy and measure the paired robustness gap
Report breakdowns by task, relation, image position, and abstention behavior
evaluation_steps_zh: 使用温度零与最多十次重试配置 VLMEvalKit
当被评模型仅接受单图时将多张图像拼接
使用预定义确定性规则抽取预测选项并与标准答案比较
计算各多模态模型的总体任务与关系类别准确率
比较可回答与不可回答准确率并测量配对鲁棒性差距
按任务关系图像位置与拒答行为报告细分结果

source_locator: arXiv:2311.17005 Sections 3.1-3.3 and the task-generation appendix; static-to-dynamic design, filtering, MCQ generation, and scoring
evidence_summary_en: MVBench converts nine static spatial-task references into 20 temporal video tasks, draws filtered clips from 11 public benchmarks, creates and balances 200 MCQs per task with ChatGPT and templates, and uses a temporal prompt plus parenthesized answer extraction for deterministic accuracy over 4,000 items.
evidence_summary_zh: MVBench 将九个静态空间任务参考转换为 20 个时序视频任务，从 11 个公开基准筛选视频片段，再通过 ChatGPT 与模板为每个任务构造并平衡 200 道选择题，最终在 4,000 道题上使用时序提示与括号答案抽取进行确定性准确率评测。
construction_steps_en: Summarize nine static spatial benchmark tasks and use them as definitions for dynamic-video goals
Define 20 temporal tasks spanning perception through cognition and requiring whole-video reasoning
Collect video data from 11 public benchmarks across diverse viewpoints and scenes
Filter for temporal sensitivity, remove unsuitable durations, and keep clips mostly between five and 35 seconds
Shift STAR clip boundaries and exclude CLEVRER descriptions with more than ten conditions to balance difficulty
Use ChatGPT to generate annotation-grounded questions under each task definition
Build options from ground-truth templates or use an LLM to convert open-ended answers
Sample three to five choices, shuffle their order, and use an LLM to equalize option lengths
Select 200 MCQs per task and finalize 4,000 questions across all 20 tasks
construction_steps_zh: 总结九个静态空间基准任务并将其作为动态视频目标的定义参考
定义覆盖感知到认知且需要完整视频推理的 20 个时序任务
从 11 个公开基准收集覆盖多种视角与场景的视频数据
按时序敏感性筛选并移除不合适时长且主要保留五至 35 秒片段
移动 STAR 片段边界并排除条件超过十个的 CLEVRER 描述以平衡难度
使用 ChatGPT 按各任务定义生成基于原始标注的问题
从标准答案模板构造选项或使用大模型转换开放式答案
抽取三至五个选项打乱顺序并使用大模型统一选项长度
每个任务选择 200 道题并最终形成覆盖 20 个任务的 4,000 道选择题
evaluation_steps_en: Apply the temporal evaluation prompt that asks the model to inspect actions, poses, motion, and details
Present parenthesized choices and require one best option
Prefix the completion target with Best Option followed by an opening parenthesis
Use the resulting 100-percent option extraction procedure
Compare the extracted choice directly with the gold annotation
Report deterministic accuracy for every task and the overall average without an LLM judge
evaluation_steps_zh: 应用要求模型检查动作姿态运动与细节的时序评测提示
提供带括号的选项并要求返回唯一最佳选项
使用 Best Option 加左括号作为补全前缀
采用由此实现的 100% 选项抽取流程
将抽取选项直接与标准标注比较
无需大模型裁判并按任务及总体平均报告确定性准确率

source_locator: arXiv:2506.01776 Sections 3.1-3.2 and 4.1-4.2; questionnaire, multilingual construction, hybrid verification, and scoring
evidence_summary_en: MaXIFE expands real-user needs into 795 basic questions and 47 verifiable instruction types, translates them through distinct question and instruction pipelines into 23 languages, applies human linguistic QC, and evaluates 1,667 instruction checks through 32 rule-checked subtypes or 15 model-judged instructions before Loose and Strict aggregation.
evidence_summary_zh: MaXIFE 将真实用户需求扩展为 795 个基础问题和 47 种可验证指令，通过相互独立的问题与指令翻译链路覆盖 23 种语言并进行人工语言质检，再将 1,667 项指令核验路由至 32 个规则子类或 15 类模型裁判指令，最终汇总宽松分数与严格分数。
construction_steps_en: Survey in-group and external researchers, native speakers, and linguistics experts for real-user needs
Expand the basic-question pool with GPT-4o and Claude-3.5 Sonnet and retain 795 questions
Select 47 high-quality verifiable instruction types, organize 11 categories, and templatize 18 scalable types
Translate basic questions from English into 22 additional languages with LLM translation followed by native review and correction
Translate instructions with professional native translators who are proficient in English
Perform human quality control for uniqueness, grammar, vocabulary, ambiguity, and parallel meaning
Combine every question with one to three instructions and finalize 795 prompts per language across 23 languages
Label languages as high-, medium-, or low-resource using four resource dimensions plus expert and native feedback
construction_steps_zh: 调研组内与外部研究者母语者和语言学专家以收集真实用户需求
使用 GPT-4o 与 Claude-3.5 Sonnet 扩展基础问题池并保留 795 个问题
筛选 47 种高质量可验证指令组织为 11 大类并模板化 18 种可扩展类型
将基础问题从英语机器翻译至另 22 种语言再由母语者审校纠正
由同时精通英语的专业母语译者翻译约束指令
人工检查唯一性语法词汇歧义和语义平行性
每题组合一至三条指令并形成每种语言 795 个提示及 23 语种版本
结合四个资源维度及专家母语者反馈标注高中文低资源语言
evaluation_steps_en: Generate responses at temperature zero for 795 prompts in each of 23 languages and run the English-instruction cross-lingual setting
Assign every instruction a score from zero to one and route deterministically verifiable types to rule-based checks
Apply localized numeral and punctuation rules with binary or tiered scoring to seven categories and 32 subtypes
Use specialized prompts and Claude-3.5 Sonnet for the other 15 model-judged instructions
Average all 1,667 instruction scores for Loose Score and convert every non-perfect instruction score to zero for Strict Score
Report results by language, instruction category, and resource level
evaluation_steps_zh: 以温度零对每种语言 795 个提示生成回答并执行英文指令跨语言设置
每项指令赋予零至一分并将可确定核验类型路由至规则检查
对七大类 32 个子类使用语言特定数字标点规则及二元或分级评分
对其余 15 类指令使用专用提示和 Claude-3.5 Sonnet 裁判
平均全部 1,667 项指令分数得到宽松分数并将所有非满分项置零得到严格分数
按语言指令类别和资源等级报告结果

source_locator: arXiv:2405.12209 Sections 2-3 and Appendix A; taxonomy, bilingual question construction, circular filtering, and evaluation
evidence_summary_en: MathBench organizes theory and application questions by Stage, Subject Area, and Topic across five learning stages, uses GPT-4 CircularEval and manual review for bilingual quality control, releases 3,709 questions, and evaluates Chat models through CircularEval while Base models use few-shot perplexity.
evidence_summary_zh: MathBench 按学习阶段学科领域和主题组织五阶段理论题与应用题，使用 GPT-4 CircularEval 和人工复核控制双语质量，发布 3,709 道题，并分别以 CircularEval 评测 Chat 模型、以少样本困惑度评测 Base 模型。
construction_steps_en: Define the three-level Stage, Subject Area, and Topic taxonomy across Arithmetic, Primary, Middle, High, and College mathematics
Collect theory definitions and corollaries from textbooks and the web
Collect application questions from stage-appropriate exams, competitions, and licensed open-source datasets
Reformulate complex answers as typically four-choice questions with one answer and confusable distractors
Have graduate students process and annotate aligned Chinese and English versions
Use GPT-4 CircularEval over four option rotations to screen errors, unanswerable items, multiple answers, and unsuitable difficulty
Manually review CE-0, CE-1, and CE-2 items and repair question, answer, or option defects
Release 3,709 bilingual questions as 2,209 theory items and 1,500 application items
construction_steps_zh: 建立覆盖算术小学初中高中和大学数学的学习阶段学科领域主题三级体系
从教材和网络逐主题收集理论定义与推论
从匹配教育阶段的考试竞赛及许可开源数据集收集应用题
将复杂答案通常改写为含唯一答案和高混淆干扰项的四选一题
由研究生处理并标注相互对齐的中英文版本
使用 GPT-4 对四种选项轮换执行 CircularEval 以筛查错误不可回答多解和难度异常
人工复核 CE-0 CE-1 和 CE-2 题并修正题干答案或选项缺陷
发布 3,709 道双语题其中理论题 2,209 道应用题 1,500 道
evaluation_steps_en: Use zero-shot chain of thought for multiple-choice Chat evaluation and few-shot chain of thought for open answers with greedy generation up to 2,048 tokens
Permute a four-choice question four times in CircularEval and parse one answer from every run
Mark a CircularEval item correct only when all four option rotations are correct
Evaluate Base models with few-shot examples by selecting the candidate answer with the lowest perplexity
Report accuracy by learning stage, subject area, topic, theory versus application, and language
evaluation_steps_zh: Chat 模型选择题使用零样本思维链开放题使用少样本思维链并贪心生成至多 2,048 词元
CircularEval 对四选一题轮换选项四次并逐次解析唯一答案
仅当四次选项轮换全部正确时才将该题判为正确
Base 模型使用少样本示例并选择困惑度最低的候选答案
按学习阶段学科领域主题理论或应用及语言报告准确率
