source_locator: arXiv:2510.14958 Sections 3.1.2-3.2 and evaluation section; source-pool filtering, benchmark sampling, leakage control, and metrics
evidence_summary_en: MathCanvas-Bench is drawn from a 632K multimodal math pool after two GPT-5 filters, text-image deduplication, image enhancement, and GPT-4.1 taxonomy labeling; all MCQs are excluded, a category-balanced 3K sample is selected, training leakage is removed, and GPT-4.1-extracted subanswers are scored by Complete Accuracy and Weighted Scoring.
evidence_summary_zh: MathCanvas-Bench 从 632K 多模态数学题池出发，经两轮 GPT-5 筛选、图文去重、图像增强和 GPT-4.1 分类后排除全部选择题并加权抽取 3K 题，再移除训练泄漏，最后用 GPT-4.1 提取子问答案并计算完整准确率与加权评分。
construction_steps_en: Collect 632K multimodal middle- and high-school math problems and solutions from textbooks, exams, and websites
Use GPT-5 to remove image-irrelevant items and normalize math expressions to LaTeX, retaining about 367K
Use a second GPT-5 filter to remove errors, missing explicit answers, low-quality images, and drawing-only tasks, retaining about 303K
Deduplicate both text and images to obtain a pool of about 222K problems
Apply SwinIR super-resolution, resize images to 512 by 512, and classify eight major categories plus subcategories with GPT-4.1
Exclude every multiple-choice problem from the benchmark candidate pool
Draw 3K problems with each category weighted by its original proportion raised to 0.7
Remove a training problem when its 5-gram Jaccard similarity with a benchmark item exceeds 0.4 and retain about 219K training items
construction_steps_zh: 从教材考试和网站收集 632K 道初高中多模态数学题及解答
使用 GPT-5 移除图像无关项并将数学表达统一为 LaTeX 保留约 367K 题
第二轮 GPT-5 移除错误无明确答案低质图及纯绘图题保留约 303K 题
对文本和图像同时去重得到约 222K 题池
使用 SwinIR 超分辨率将图像缩放为 512 乘 512 并由 GPT-4.1 标注八大类及细类
从 benchmark 候选池排除全部多项选择题
按类别原占比的 0.7 次方加权抽取 3K 道题
若训练题与 benchmark 的五元词组 Jaccard 相似度超过 0.4 则移除并保留约 219K 训练题
evaluation_steps_en: Provide the problem and original image and require an interleaved visual-textual solution
Use GPT-4.1 to extract the final answer for every subquestion
Compare every extracted subanswer with the corresponding ground-truth answer
Assign Complete Accuracy one only when all subquestions are correct and zero otherwise
Compute Weighted Scoring with exponentially increasing subquestion weights and report overall and category results
evaluation_steps_zh: 输入题目与原始图像并要求生成图文交错解决方案
使用 GPT-4.1 提取每个子问题的最终答案
将每个提取答案与对应标准答案逐项比较
仅当所有子问均正确时完整准确率记一否则记零
按指数递增子问权重计算加权评分并报告总体与分类结果

visual_review.artifact: Draw.io Desktop English and Chinese PNG exports plus local production-page DOM, natural-dimension, and asset-link checks
visual_review.result: Both 1673 by 509 SVGs preserve all paper counts, the open-ended-only weighted 3K selection, leakage threshold, interleaved solution contract, GPT-4.1 subanswer extraction, and both metrics without clipped labels, formula overflow, overlap, connector-node crossings, or fallback-text defects; both localized pages loaded the expected SVG and all three language-specific asset links.

source_locator: Goedel-Prover-V2 arXiv:2508.03613 Section 4.2 and official Goedel-LM/MathOlympiadBench dataset card; human formalization, Lean checks, and proof evaluation
evidence_summary_en: MathOlympiad-Bench contains 360 human-verified Compfiles and IMOSLLean4 formalizations, each normalized to one Lean theorem and one informal statement and compile-checked with sorry; models generate whole proofs in Lean 4.9.0-rc1, optionally self-correct from compiler feedback twice, and are scored by Pass@N.
evidence_summary_zh: MathOlympiad-Bench 包含来自 Compfiles 与 IMOSLLean4 的 360 道人工核验形式化题，每题规范为一个 Lean 定理和一个非形式化陈述并以 sorry 编译检查；模型在 Lean 4.9.0-rc1 中生成完整证明，可根据编译反馈自我修正两轮，并以 Pass@N 评分。
construction_steps_en: Collect olympiad formalizations from Compfiles and IMOSLLean4
Assemble 158 IMO problems, 131 IMO Shortlist problems, 68 national-olympiad problems, and three puzzles
Human reviewers complete truncated statements and reconcile definitions or dependencies distributed across files
Split records that contain multiple theorems and normalize every benchmark item to exactly one formal theorem
Pair each formal theorem with its corresponding informal problem statement
Repair imports, namespaces, types, dependencies, and other Mathlib incompatibilities
Replace the proof with sorry and require every formal statement to compile
Cross-check overlapping MiniF2F IMO items and release 360 human-verified problems
construction_steps_zh: 从 Compfiles 和 IMOSLLean4 汇集奥林匹克形式化题
组成 158 道 IMO 正赛题 131 道 IMO 候选题 68 道全国赛题及三道谜题
由人工补齐截断陈述并合并分散在多个文件中的定义或依赖
拆分含多个定理的记录并将每个 benchmark 样本规范为恰好一个形式定理
将每个形式定理与对应非形式化原题配对
修复导入命名空间类型依赖及其他 Mathlib 不兼容问题
以 sorry 替代证明并要求全部形式化陈述能够编译
交叉检查与 MiniF2F 重叠的 IMO 题并发布 360 道人工核验题
evaluation_steps_en: Configure Lean 4.9.0-rc1 and provide the formal theorem with its valid context
Generate a whole proof with a maximum of 30,000 tokens
Submit each proof candidate to Lean and accept it only if compilation succeeds
For verifier-guided self-correction, return compiler feedback and allow up to two additional repair rounds
Cap total generation under self-correction at 40,000 tokens and report Pass@N by sample count
evaluation_steps_zh: 配置 Lean 4.9.0-rc1 并提供形式定理及有效上下文
以最多 30,000 词元生成完整证明
将每个候选证明提交 Lean 且仅在编译成功时接受
验证器引导自我修正时返回编译器反馈并允许最多两轮额外修复
将自我修正总生成预算限制为 40,000 词元并按采样数报告 Pass@N

visual_review.artifact: Draw.io Desktop English and Chinese PNG exports plus local production-page DOM, natural-dimension, and asset-link checks
visual_review.result: Both 1673 by 509 SVGs preserve the exact four-source counts, human repair and one-theorem contract, sorry compilation check, MiniF2F cross-check, Lean version, generation budgets, verifier-feedback loop, and Pass@N without clipping, overlap, connector-node crossings, or fallback-text defects; both localized pages loaded the expected SVG and all three language-specific asset links.

source_locator: arXiv:2402.14804 Section 3 and official mathllm/MATH-V evaluation/evaluate.py; four-stage curation, answer normalization, and accuracy
evidence_summary_en: MathVision extracts about 9K visual problems from 19 competitions, uses ten senior science annotators for text-image filtering and manual deduplication, independently labels 16 subjects and five difficulty levels, releases 3,040 items, and deterministically normalizes boxed or phrase answers for overall, subject, and level accuracy.
evidence_summary_zh: MathVision 从 19 项竞赛抽取约 9K 道视觉题，由十名高年级理科生完成图文筛选和人工去重，再独立标注 16 个学科与五级难度，发布 3,040 道题，并以确定性方式规范化 boxed 或答案短语后汇总总体学科和难度准确率。
construction_steps_en: Select 19 visual-input mathematics competitions spanning 12 grade levels and supporting ordered difficulty
Respect copyright and licenses and prioritize questions whose answers are not directly retrievable from the same page
Use Mathpix to extract text, formulas, and images from competition PDFs and form an initial pool of about 9K problems
Have ten senior college science annotators align text and images, remove missing, incorrect, private, or offensive content, and cross-verify
Retain 3,352 independently solvable problems after Stage-1 content filtering
Prefilter duplicate candidates by lexical overlap and Levenshtein distance and manually review them to retain 3,040 problems
Have three annotator groups label subjects independently with GPT-4V and Gemini Pro advice and aggregate 16 subject labels
Assign five difficulty levels using competition source and grade information and perform human verification
construction_steps_zh: 选择覆盖 12 个年级且可划分有序难度的 19 项视觉数学竞赛
遵守版权与许可并优先选择答案不在同页直接可检索的问题
使用 Mathpix 从竞赛 PDF 抽取文本公式和图像形成约 9K 道初始题
由十名高年级理科生对齐图文移除缺失错误隐私或不当内容并交叉核验
第一阶段内容筛选后保留 3,352 道可独立作答题
用词汇重叠和 Levenshtein 距离初筛重复候选并人工复核至 3,040 题
三组标注者独立分类并参考 GPT-4V 与 Gemini Pro 建议聚合为 16 个学科
依据竞赛来源和年级划分五级难度并进行人工核验
evaluation_steps_en: Release 3,040 problems consisting of 1,532 multiple-choice and 1,508 free-form items and provide a 304-item testmini
Prompt the multimodal model with the problem, options when present, and image and request the final answer in boxed form
Parse boxed content, common final-answer phrases, or a directly emitted choice letter
For multiple-choice items compare against both the gold letter and its corresponding option text and otherwise apply mathematical equivalence
Report deterministic accuracy overall and by subject and difficulty level and compare model with human performance
evaluation_steps_zh: 发布由 1,532 道选择题和 1,508 道自由回答题组成的 3,040 题全集并提供 304 题 testmini
向多模态模型输入题目配图及存在时的选项并要求将最终答案置于 boxed 中
解析 boxed 内容常见最终答案短语或直接输出的选项字母
选择题同时对照标准字母及对应选项文本其余答案使用数学等价性判断
按总体学科和难度报告确定性准确率并比较模型与人工表现

visual_review.artifact: Draw.io Desktop English and Chinese PNG exports plus local production-page DOM, natural-dimension, and asset-link checks
visual_review.result: Both 1673 by 509 SVGs preserve the 19-competition and four-stage curation path, all intermediate and final counts including the corrected 1,532 MCQ plus 1,508 free-form order, 304-item testmini, official non-LLM answer normalization, and fine-grained accuracy without clipping, overlap, connector-node crossings, or fallback-text defects; both localized pages loaded the expected SVG and all three language-specific asset links.

source_locator: arXiv:2310.02255 Sections 3-4, official MathVista project, and lupantech/MathVista evaluation code; data composition, annotation, answer extraction, normalization, and accuracy
evidence_summary_en: MathVista combines 28 existing datasets with IQTest, FunctionQA, and PaperQA into 6,141 visual-mathematics problems, annotates five tasks and seven reasoning skills, releases labeled testmini and hidden-label test splits, and evaluates normalized short answers with deterministic accuracy after direct or GPT-4-assisted extraction.
evidence_summary_zh: MathVista 将 28 个已有数据集与新建的 IQTest、FunctionQA、PaperQA 合并为 6,141 道视觉数学题，标注五类任务和七类推理能力，发布有标签 testmini 与隐藏标签 test 两个划分，并在直接或 GPT-4 辅助提取短答案后规范化计算确定性准确率。
construction_steps_en: Gather nine math-targeted QA datasets and 19 general-purpose VQA datasets
Create IQTest from logical figure puzzles, FunctionQA from function plots, and PaperQA from scientific figures
Preprocess, filter, clean, and relabel the source items while aligning every question with its image
Consolidate 31 sources into 6,141 multiple-choice and free-form visual-mathematics problems
Annotate five task types, seven reasoning skills, source, category, context, grade, language, and answer type
Standardize question, image, choices, answer, unit, precision, and input-query fields
Release 1,000 labeled testmini items and 5,141 disjoint hidden-label test items
construction_steps_zh: 汇集九个数学定向问答数据集和 19 个通用视觉问答数据集
从逻辑图形题创建 IQTest 从函数图创建 FunctionQA 从科学图创建 PaperQA
对来源样本预处理筛选清洗重标并对齐每道题与图像
将 31 个来源整合为 6,141 道选择题和自由回答视觉数学题
标注五类任务七类推理能力以及来源类别上下文年级语言和答案类型
统一题目图像选项答案单位精度和输入查询字段
发布 1,000 道有标签 testmini 与 5,141 道互斥隐藏标签 test 样本
evaluation_steps_en: Build an answer-type-aware prompt from the task, question, choices, and metadata
Generate a model response from the visual and textual context and retain the raw reasoning
Extract a short answer directly for simple cases and with GPT-4 for general cases
Normalize choice letters or text, integers, precision-controlled floats, lists, and free text according to the answer contract
Compare the normalized prediction with the gold answer and assign deterministic item correctness
Report overall accuracy and breakdowns by task, skill, source, context, grade, answer type, and language
evaluation_steps_zh: 依据任务题目选项元数据和答案类型构造提示
输入视觉与文本上下文生成模型回答并保留原始推理
简单情况直接提取短答案一般情况使用 GPT-4 提取
按答案合同规范化选项字母或文本整数指定精度浮点数列表和自由文本
将规范化预测与标准答案比较并确定性判定每题正误
报告总体准确率及任务能力来源上下文年级答案类型和语言分项

visual_review.artifact: Draw.io Desktop English and Chinese PNG exports plus local English and Chinese page DOM, natural-dimension, and asset-link checks
visual_review.result: Both 1673 by 509 SVGs preserve the 28 plus three source composition, 6,141 total and two exact split counts, five-task and seven-skill annotation, type-aware prompting, assisted answer extraction, deterministic normalization, and accuracy aggregation without clipping, overlap, connector-node crossings, or fallback-text defects; both localized pages loaded the expected SVG and all three language-specific asset links returned 200.

source_locator: arXiv:2307.15343 Sections 3-4 and official Med-HALT project; three reasoning hallucination tests, four memory hallucination tests, datasets, and metrics
evidence_summary_en: Med-HALT applies three reasoning hallucination tests to 18,866 questions from four countries and four memory hallucination tests to 4,916 PubMed records, then parses model outputs and reports per-test Accuracy and Pointwise Score across the RHT and MHT families.
evidence_summary_zh: Med-HALT 对四国医学考试的 18,866 道题执行三类推理幻觉测试，对 4,916 条 PubMed 记录执行四类记忆幻觉测试，再解析模型输出并按 RHT 与 MHT 家族报告各测试的 Accuracy 和 Pointwise Score。
construction_steps_en: Collect 6,660 AIIMS PG and 2,855 NEET PG questions from MedMCQA for 9,515 Indian questions
Add 4,068 Spanish HeadQA, 2,801 US MedQA, and 2,482 Taiwan MedQA questions
Form an 18,866-item multinational medical multiple-choice pool for each reasoning hallucination test
Retain 4,916 PubMed records containing abstract, PMID, title, and link for each memory hallucination test
Create False Confidence by suggesting a random candidate answer and requesting validation plus option explanations
Create None of the Above by replacing the original correct option and requiring rejection of all choices
Create Fake Questions from human- and GPT-3.5-authored nonsensical medical queries
construction_steps_zh: 从 MedMCQA 收集 6,660 道 AIIMS PG 与 2,855 道 NEET PG 题形成 9,515 道印度题
加入 4,068 道西班牙 HeadQA 2,801 道美国 MedQA 和 2,482 道台湾 MedQA
为每类推理幻觉测试形成 18,866 道跨国医学选择题池
保留含摘要 PMID 标题和链接的 4,916 条 PubMed 记录供每类记忆幻觉测试使用
随机建议一个候选答案并要求判断及解释所有选项以构造 False Confidence
替换原正确选项并要求拒绝全部选项以构造 None of the Above
由人工与 GPT-3.5 编写无意义医学问题以构造 Fake Questions
evaluation_steps_en: Run abstract-to-link, PMID-to-title, title-to-link, and link-to-title memory tests over the PubMed pool
Run the three reasoning tests and four memory tests with Text-Davinci, GPT-3.5, Llama-2, MPT, and Falcon using default configurations
Parse the expected structured outputs and handle malformed JSON and execution exceptions
Map every parsed output to a test-specific prediction and assign binary correctness
Compute Accuracy and Pointwise Score for each test and average results within RHT and MHT
Compare all seven modalities and analyze model hallucination tendencies
evaluation_steps_zh: 在 PubMed 题池上执行摘要到链接 PMID 到标题 标题到链接及链接到标题四类记忆测试
使用默认配置对 Text-Davinci GPT-3.5 Llama-2 MPT 和 Falcon 执行三类推理与四类记忆测试
解析预期结构化输出并处理畸形 JSON 与执行异常
将每个解析结果映射为测试特定预测并判定二元正误
计算每类测试的 Accuracy 与 Pointwise Score 并分别在 RHT 和 MHT 内平均
比较全部七种测试模态并分析模型幻觉倾向

visual_review.result: Both 1673 by 509 SVGs preserve the exact four-country and PubMed sample counts, three RHT transformations, four bidirectional MHT tasks, representative model family, structured parsing, binary judgment, and dual metrics without clipping, overlap, connector-node crossings, decision-shape misuse, or fallback-text defects; both localized pages loaded the expected SVG and all three language-specific asset links returned 200.

source_locator: arXiv:2501.14654 Sections 3-4 and official stanfordmlgroup/MedAgentBench repository; physician tasks, STARR-to-FHIR environment, AgentBench harness, and success scoring
evidence_summary_en: MedAgentBench pairs 300 physician-authored clinical tasks with a synthetic-identity 100-patient STARR cohort transformed into 785,207 FHIR records, exposes nine functions through an AgentBench-compatible HAPI FHIR environment, and separately verifies 150 query and 150 action tasks before reporting success rates.
evidence_summary_zh: MedAgentBench 将 300 项医生编写的临床任务与 100 名 STARR 患者的合成身份队列配对并转换为 785,207 条 FHIR 记录，通过 AgentBench 兼容的 HAPI FHIR 环境暴露九个函数，再分别验证 150 项查询任务和 150 项操作任务并报告成功率。
construction_steps_en: Have two internal-medicine physicians author and curate 300 relevant inpatient and outpatient tasks
Organize ten specific task categories into seven broad retrieval, documentation, and order-oriented types
Randomly sample 100 deidentified STARR patients anchored on a morning sodium laboratory test
Extract five years of laboratories, vital signs, diagnoses, procedures, and medications through 2023-11-13
Create unique seven-digit medical-record numbers and Faker names, phones, and addresses while retaining patient-level temporal jitter
Map the cohort to 785,207 Observation, Procedure, Condition, and MedicationRequest resources
Load resources by parallel POST into persistent H2-backed HAPI FHIR JPA and package the environment in Docker
construction_steps_zh: 由两名内科医生编写并筛选 300 项相关住院与门诊任务
将十个具体任务类别组织为七类检索记录与医嘱相关任务
以晨间血钠检验为锚点随机抽取 100 名去标识 STARR 患者
抽取截至 2023-11-13 的五年化验生命体征诊断操作和用药数据
生成唯一七位病历号及 Faker 姓名电话地址并保留患者级时间扰动
将队列映射为 785,207 条 Observation Procedure Condition 与 MedicationRequest 资源
通过并行 POST 写入持久化 H2 支撑的 HAPI FHIR JPA 并以 Docker 打包环境
evaluation_steps_en: Integrate the environment with AgentBench and expose nine FHIR functions supporting GET, POST, and FINISH
Allow one function per turn while the agent plans, reads FHIR responses, optionally changes the EHR, and returns a structured result
Split the benchmark into 150 query-based and 150 action-based tasks
For query tasks compare the final answer against physician-written reference solutions and expected formats
For action tasks inspect the POST payload and run manual rule-based checks on the resulting EHR modification
Assign binary pass or fail for every task
Report overall success rate, query success rate, and action success rate with task-type analysis
evaluation_steps_zh: 将环境接入 AgentBench 并暴露支持 GET POST 与 FINISH 的九个 FHIR 函数
每轮仅允许一个函数调用由智能体规划读取 FHIR 响应按需修改 EHR 并返回结构化结果
将 benchmark 划分为 150 项查询任务和 150 项操作任务
查询任务将最终答案与医生编写的参考解及预期格式比较
操作任务检查 POST 负载并对生成的 EHR 修改执行人工规则检查
逐任务赋予二元通过或失败结果
报告总体成功率查询成功率操作成功率及任务类型分析

source_locator: MedicalAgentsBench arXiv:2503.07459v3 Sections 2-4 and current gersteinlab/MedicalAgentsBench repository; multi-source hard filtering, clinician review, MELD, and accuracy-cost evaluation
evidence_summary_en: The current MedicalAgentsBench paper builds 862 hard questions from eight medical QA sources and nine evaluation subsets by retaining items answered correctly by fewer than half of tested models, balancing sources, validating reasoning depth and clinical correctness with four clinical-year medical students, removing 21 invalid items, and screening contamination with MELD before joint accuracy, cost, and latency analysis.
evidence_summary_zh: 当前 MedicalAgentsBench 论文从八个医学问答来源和九个评测子集构建 862 道难题：保留被测模型正确率低于一半的题并平衡来源，由四名临床阶段医学生核验推理深度与临床正确性，移除 21 道无效题，再用 MELD 筛查污染，最后联合分析准确率成本与时延。
construction_steps_en: Aggregate MedQA, PubMedQA, MedMCQA, MedBullets, MMLU, MMLU-Pro, MedExQA, and MedXpertQA
Standardize question, options, gold answer, dataset identifiers, and the MedXpert R and U subsets
Probe each item with diverse model architectures and retain candidates with less than 50% accuracy
Balance nine evaluation subsets with 100 items in seven subsets, 89 MedBullets items, and 73 MMLU items
Have four clinical-year medical students annotate multi-step reasoning with a five-level depth rubric
Review gold correctness, context, currency, and clinical relevance and remove 21 invalid questions
Apply MELD by generating the second half from the option-free first half and measuring Levenshtein similarity
Release 862 hard questions averaging 147.4 tokens across eight sources and nine subsets
construction_steps_zh: 汇集 MedQA PubMedQA MedMCQA MedBullets MMLU MMLU-Pro MedExQA 与 MedXpertQA
统一题目选项标准答案数据集标识并拆分 MedXpert 的 R 与 U 子集
使用多种模型架构探测每题并保留正确率低于 50% 的候选题
平衡九个评测子集其中七个各 100 题 MedBullets 89 题 MMLU 73 题
由四名临床阶段医学生按五级深度量表标注多步推理
复核标准答案上下文时效性和临床相关性并移除 21 道无效题
用不含选项的前半题干生成后半题干并以 Levenshtein 相似度执行 MELD
发布来自八个来源九个子集且平均 147.4 词元的 862 道难题
evaluation_steps_en: Evaluate ten base models comprising seven non-reasoning models and three internalized reasoners with unified prompts and parsing
Evaluate nine externalized methods spanning chain of thought, self-consistency, advanced prompting, and collaborative or search agents
Parse the predicted option and compare it with the gold index
Aggregate accuracy by all nine subsets and across source datasets
Measure commercial token price, open-model hosting cost, and full interaction time
Compare internalized and externalized reasoning on accuracy, cost, latency, and the Pareto frontier
evaluation_steps_zh: 使用统一提示与解析评测由七个非推理模型和三个内化推理模型组成的十个基础模型
评测覆盖思维链自一致性高级提示及协作或搜索智能体的九种外化方法
解析预测选项并与标准索引比较
按九个子集及来源数据集聚合准确率
测量商用模型词元价格开源模型托管成本及完整交互时间
按准确率成本时延和 Pareto 前沿比较内化与外化推理

source_locator: arXiv:2308.14089 Sections 3-4 and appendices; three-stage clinician curation, OMOP-to-XML EHR pairing, generation settings, and blinded evaluation
evidence_summary_en: MedAlign converts longitudinal OMOP EHR data to XML and uses 15 clinicians from seven specialties to deduplicate 1,314 raw instructions into 983, retrieve BM25 top-five records from 77,200 patients, identify 303 relevant instruction-EHR pairs and references grounded in 276 EHRs, and evaluate six LLMs with blinded clinician judgments plus automated metrics.
evidence_summary_zh: MedAlign 将纵向 OMOP EHR 转为 XML，并由七个专科的 15 名临床医生把 1,314 条原始指令去重为 983 条，再从 77,200 名患者中检索 BM25 top-five，形成 303 个相关指令-EHR 配对及基于 276 份 EHR 的参考回答，最后以盲评临床判断和自动指标评测六个 LLM。
construction_steps_en: Represent structured and textual longitudinal EHR events in OMOP CDM and convert each patient record to one XML document
Recruit 15 practicing clinicians from seven specialties
Collect 1,314 workflow-grounded instructions with patient and clinical context through an online form
Treat ROUGE-L above 0.7 as near-duplicate, retain 983 instructions, and mark 407 as generally applicable
Append patient and clinical metadata to generally applicable instructions to form retrieval queries
Retrieve BM25Okapi top five records per query from a 77,200-patient subsample and compare with random retrieval
Have instruction authors judge relevance and retain 303 queries with at least one relevant top-five EHR
Prefer same-specialty non-authors to write feasible and sufficient references anchored at the latest EHR timestamp
construction_steps_zh: 以 OMOP CDM 表示结构化和文本纵向 EHR 事件并将每名患者记录转为一个 XML 文档
招募来自七个专科的 15 名执业临床医生
通过在线表单收集 1,314 条带患者与临床上下文的日常工作流指令
将 ROUGE-L 大于 0.7 视为近重复保留 983 条指令并标记 407 条通用指令
将患者与临床元数据附加到通用指令形成检索查询
从 77,200 名患者子样本为每个查询检索 BM25Okapi top five 并与随机检索比较
由指令作者判断相关性并保留 top-five 中至少一份相关 EHR 的 303 个查询
优先由同专科非作者在最新 EHR 时间点撰写可行且信息充分的参考回答
evaluation_steps_en: Release 983 instructions, 303 expert reference responses, and 276 distinct paired EHRs
Run six closed and open general-domain LLMs while reserving 256 output tokens and retaining the most recent context when truncation is required
For records longer than the context window apply iterative refinement over 30,000-token chunks
Blind and shuffle model outputs for nine clinician evaluators
Judge clinical correctness as binary and rank relevance and appropriateness with ties allowed
Compute COMET, BERTScore, METEOR, chrF, BLEU, ROUGE, and other automated NLG metrics
Report correctness, win rate, rank, context-length effects, and Kendall tau agreement between automated and human rankings
evaluation_steps_zh: 发布 983 条指令 303 条专家参考回答和 276 份不同配对 EHR
评测六个闭源与开源通用 LLM 预留 256 输出词元并在截断时保留最新上下文
对超过上下文窗口的记录按 30,000 词元分块迭代细化回答
对九名临床评审者隐藏并打乱模型输出身份
以二元方式判断临床正确性并允许并列地排序相关性和适当性
计算 COMET BERTScore METEOR chrF BLEU ROUGE 及其他自动 NLG 指标
报告正确率胜率排名上下文长度影响及自动排名与人工排名的 Kendall tau 一致性

visual_review.result: Both 1673 by 509 SVGs preserve the three-stage clinician workflow, 1,314 to 983 deduplication, 407-query retrieval pool, 77,200-patient BM25 experiment, 303 references over 276 EHRs, long-context refinement, blinded clinical review, and human-auto comparison without clipping, overlap, connector-node crossings, or fallback-text defects; both localized pages loaded the expected SVG and all three language-specific asset links returned 200.

source_locator: arXiv:2407.10990 Sections 2-4 and Appendices A-C; official medbench.opencompass.org.cn platform
evidence_summary_en: MedBench integrates eight public datasets and twelve newly constructed datasets into 300,901 Chinese questions across 43 specialties and five dimensions, verifies medical content with senior physicians, and evaluates a balanced 8,913-record sample through a cloud platform with physical question/gold separation, exhaustive choice shuffling, random prompts, task-specific metrics, and blinded human validation.
evidence_summary_zh: MedBench 将八个公开数据集与十二个自建数据集合并为覆盖 43 个专业和五个维度的 300,901 道中文题，经资深医生核验后，在物理隔离题目与标准答案的云平台上平衡采样 8,913 条，并以全部选项循环排列、随机提示、任务专属指标和盲法人工评估完成验证。
construction_steps_en: Define MLU, MLG, MKQA, CMR, and HSE as the five evaluation dimensions
Integrate seven CBLUE datasets and CMB-Clin as eight public sources
Construct twelve new datasets from exams, textbooks, and clinical cases
Apply collection, screening, rewriting, compilation, and verification while protecting accuracy and privacy
Rewrite DDx-basic, DDx-advanced, and MedTreat to SCARE 2023 with one senior doctor and require approval from two additional senior doctors
Have two physicians with over ten years of experience verify and standardize medical content
Form 300,901 Chinese questions across 20 datasets and 43 specialties
construction_steps_zh: 定义医学语言理解生成知识问答复杂推理及医疗安全伦理五个评测维度
整合七个 CBLUE 数据集和 CMB-Clin 共八个公开来源
基于考试教材和临床病例自建十二个数据集
执行收集筛选改写编制核验并保证准确性与隐私
由一名资深医生依照 SCARE 2023 改写 DDx-basic DDx-advanced 与 MedTreat 并要求另两名资深医生共同通过
由两名拥有十年以上经验的医生复核并标准化医学内容
形成覆盖 20 个数据集和 43 个专业的 300,901 道中文题
evaluation_steps_en: Deploy a cloud platform with physical separation between questions and ground truth and refresh data every three months
Draw a random balanced sample of 8,913 records
Circularly shuffle every possible choice ordering and award credit only when all orderings are correct
Randomly choose one of three prompts appropriate to the question type
Run hidden-gold model inference and automatic evaluation
Apply Accuracy, Micro-F1, BLEU, or ROUGE-L and normalize text-generation metrics to 0-100
Average scores within each of five dimensions and then across all dimensions
Compare model rankings on 50 items from five datasets with blinded ratings from three senior physicians
evaluation_steps_zh: 部署物理隔离题目与标准答案且每三个月更新数据的云端平台
随机平衡抽取 8,913 条评测记录
循环遍历全部选项排列且仅当所有排列均答对时计分
按题型从三个提示模板中随机选择一个
在隐藏标准答案的条件下运行模型推理和自动评测
使用 Accuracy Micro-F1 BLEU 或 ROUGE-L 并将文本生成指标归一化至 0-100
先在五个维度内求平均再对全部维度求总平均
用三名资深医生对五个数据集 50 道题的盲评排序验证模型结果

visual_review.artifact: Draw.io Desktop English and Chinese PNG exports plus local English and Chinese page DOM, natural-dimension, and asset-link checks
visual_review.result: Both 1673 by 509 SVGs preserve the five dimensions, eight plus twelve dataset sources, expert case-rewrite and verification routes, exact corpus and sample counts, quarterly cloud protocol, dynamic shuffling and prompting, task metrics, aggregation, and human validation without clipping, overlap, connector-node crossings, or fallback-text defects; both localized pages loaded the expected SVG and all three language-specific asset links returned 200.

source_locator: arXiv:2402.18060v6 Sections 2-4 and appendices; current HanjieChen/ChallengeClinicalQA repository
evidence_summary_en: The paper builds Medbullets as 308 text-only Step 2/3 cases with five choices and expert explanations, derives a randomized four-choice variant, keeps the 1,524-item JAMA Clinical Challenge as a distinct companion dataset, and evaluates seven LLMs with three prompt families, answer Accuracy, automatic explanation metrics, and a 30-item human study.
evidence_summary_zh: 论文将 Medbullets 构建为 308 道含五个选项和专家解析的纯文本 Step 2/3 病例题，随机派生四选项版本，将 1,524 条 JAMA Clinical Challenge 保持为独立伴随数据集，并通过三类提示、答案准确率、自动解释指标及 30 题人工研究评测七个模型。
construction_steps_en: Identify publicly linked Medbullets Step 2/3 posts dated April 2022 through December 2023
Collect case descriptions, questions, five choices, correct answers, and expert explanations
Exclude image-dependent cases and retain complete publicly available text examples
Standardize each record while preserving rationales for correct and incorrect options
Release 308 English Medbullets cases
Create Medbullets-5 and randomly remove one incorrect choice to create Medbullets-4
Keep the 1,524-item, 13-domain JAMA Clinical Challenge as a separate companion evaluation track
construction_steps_zh: 定位 2022 年 4 月至 2023 年 12 月公开链接的 Medbullets Step 2/3 帖子
收集病例描述问题五个选项正确答案和专家解析
排除依赖图像的病例并仅保留上下文完整的公开纯文本样本
标准化每条记录并保留正确与错误选项的理由
发布 308 道英文 Medbullets 病例题
形成 Medbullets-5 并随机删除一个错误选项得到 Medbullets-4
将含 1,524 题和 13 个领域的 JAMA Clinical Challenge 保持为独立伴随评测轨道
evaluation_steps_en: Evaluate GPT-3.5, GPT-4, PaLM 2, Llama 2, Llama 3, MedAlpaca, and Meerkat
Run direct X-to-Y prompting under zero-, two-, and five-shot leave-one-out settings
Run two-stage X-to-R-to-Y chain-of-thought prompting
Generate X-plus-gold-Y-to-R answer-conditioned explanations
Parse choices and report answer Accuracy
Score explanations with ROUGE-L, BERTScore, BLEURT, BARTScore variants, CTC, and G-Eval
Human-evaluate 30 Medbullets-5 outputs from GPT-4 and PaLM 2 with three ratings each for completeness, correctness, and relevance
evaluation_steps_zh: 评测 GPT-3.5 GPT-4 PaLM 2 Llama 2 Llama 3 MedAlpaca 和 Meerkat
在零样本二样本和五样本留一法设置下运行 X 到 Y 直接提示
运行 X 到 R 再到 Y 的两阶段思维链提示
在 X 加标准 Y 条件下生成 R 解释
解析预测选项并报告答案准确率
使用 ROUGE-L BERTScore BLEURT BARTScore 系列 CTC 与 G-Eval 评估解释
对 GPT-4 与 PaLM 2 的 30 道 Medbullets-5 输出各收集三份完整性正确性相关性人工评分

visual_review.artifact: Draw.io Desktop English and Chinese PNG exports plus local English and Chinese page DOM, natural-dimension, and asset-link checks
visual_review.result: Both 1673 by 509 SVGs preserve the source dates, text-only gate, exact 308-item structure, randomized four-choice variant, explicit non-merger with the JAMA companion track, seven models, three prompt families, answer and explanation metrics, and human study without clipping, overlap, connector-node crossings, or fallback-text defects; both localized pages loaded the expected SVG and all three language-specific asset links returned 200.

source_locator: arXiv:2406.12036v4 Sections 3-5 and Appendix A; current ncbi-nlp/MedCalc-Bench repository
evidence_summary_en: MedCalc-Bench selects 55 MDCalc tasks, combines LLM-filtered and extracted Open-Patients notes with template- or clinician-synthesized notes for missing calculators, verifies attributes medically, generates calculator-specific gold solutions, and evaluates eight LLMs on 1,047 instances with three prompts and subtype-specific accuracy tolerances.
evidence_summary_zh: MedCalc-Bench 选择 55 个 MDCalc 任务，将经 LLM 筛选抽取的 Open-Patients 病历与为缺失计算器模板生成或医生撰写的病历结合，医学核验属性并以计算器模板生成标准解答，最终在 1,047 条样本上用三种提示和子类型专属准确率评测八个模型。
construction_steps_en: Select 55 popular MDCalc tasks and classify 19 as rule-based and 36 as equation-based across seven subtypes
Compile more than 180,000 Open-Patients notes from PMC-Patients, MedQA-USMLE, TREC CDS, and Clinical Trials
Use GPT-3.5-Turbo to identify eligible notes with a target of at most 20 per calculator
Use GPT-4 to extract calculator-required attributes
Have medical professionals verify and correct examples covering 34 calculators
For the remaining 21 calculators create 20 notes each using templates for ten equation tasks and clinician writing for eleven rule tasks
Use templates for all 55 calculators to generate step-by-step explanations and final answers
Release exactly 1,047 manually reviewed test instances with notes, questions, entities, explanations, and answers
construction_steps_zh: 选择 55 个常用 MDCalc 任务并划分为 19 个规则型和 36 个公式型共七个子类型
从 PMC-Patients MedQA-USMLE TREC CDS 与 Clinical Trials 汇编超过 18 万份 Open-Patients 病历
使用 GPT-3.5-Turbo 识别合格病历且每个计算器最多保留 20 条
使用 GPT-4 提取计算器所需属性
由医疗专业人员核验并纠正覆盖 34 个计算器的样本
为其余 21 个计算器各补 20 条其中十个公式任务用模板而十一个规则任务由医生撰写
用覆盖全部 55 个计算器的模板生成逐步解释和最终答案
发布恰好 1,047 条含病历问题实体解释和答案的人工复核测试样本
evaluation_steps_en: Evaluate two medical and six general LLMs on knowledge, extraction, and arithmetic
Run zero-shot direct, zero-shot chain-of-thought, and same-calculator one-shot chain-of-thought prompts
Require exact match for rule-based and date calculations
Accept laboratory, physical, and dosage calculations within 5% of the gold answer
Report overall Accuracy and Accuracy across all seven subtypes
Classify failures as knowledge, extraction, computation, or other and validate the error classifier
evaluation_steps_zh: 在医学知识属性抽取和算术计算上评测两个医疗模型与六个通用模型
运行零样本直接回答零样本思维链和同计算器单样本思维链提示
对规则型和日期计算要求精确匹配
对实验室体征和剂量计算允许标准答案 5% 内误差
报告总体准确率和全部七个子类型准确率
将失败归为知识抽取计算或其他并验证错误分类器

source_locator: arXiv:2406.06331 Sections 2-4 and appendices; BioNLP 2024 paper and current knowlab/MedExQA repository
evidence_summary_en: MedExQA collects public exam questions from five underrepresented specialties, removes exact, semantic, and law-related items, shuffles options, attaches two distinct validated explanations, splits 965 items into 25 development and 940 test examples, and jointly evaluates answer classification and explanation generation with automatic and human metrics.
evidence_summary_zh: MedExQA 从五个代表不足的专业收集公开考试题，移除完全重复语义近重复及法律相关题，打乱选项并为每题配两份不同且核验通过的解释，把 965 题划分为 25 条开发集和 940 条测试集，并以自动与人工指标联合评估答案分类及解释生成。
construction_steps_en: Define biomedical engineering, clinical laboratory science, clinical psychology, occupational therapy, and speech-language pathology as the five specialties
Collect questions and available explanations from free public mock tests and exams tailored to each profession
Remove duplicate questions and duplicate explanations
Use BERT cosine similarity to remove semantically near-duplicate questions
Use a manual keyword list to remove law and regulation questions
Shuffle answer options while preserving the correct-label mapping
Provide two explanations per question in distinct writing styles and human-validate questions and both explanations
Form exactly 965 questions with specialty counts 148, 377, 111, 194, and 135
construction_steps_zh: 定义生物医学工程临床检验科学临床心理学作业治疗和言语语言病理学五个专业
从面向各专业的免费公开模拟测试和考试收集题目及可用解释
移除重复问题和重复解释
使用 BERT 余弦相似度移除语义近重复题
使用人工关键词表移除法律法规题
打乱答案选项并保留正确标签映射
为每题提供两份不同写作风格解释并人工核验问题和两份解释
按 148 377 111 194 和 135 的专业计数形成恰好 965 题
evaluation_steps_en: Select five examples per specialty for a 25-item development set and place the remaining 940 in the test set
Evaluate 18 open baselines, three GPT models, and MedPhi-2 zero-shot with batch size one and temperature zero
Parse base-model choices from next-token logits and chat-model choices with regular expressions and fuzzy answer matching
Score explanations with BLEU, ROUGE-L, METEOR, and SciBERT BERTScore
Set every explanation score to zero when its answer classification is wrong
Have three health-related MSc annotators score the 25 development examples as 0, 0.5, or 1 and correlate human with automatic metrics
evaluation_steps_zh: 每个专业选五条形成 25 条开发集并将其余 940 条放入测试集
以批量一温度零的零样本设置评测 18 个开放基线三个 GPT 模型和 MedPhi-2
从基础模型下一词元 logits 解析选项并以正则和模糊答案匹配解析聊天模型
使用 BLEU ROUGE-L METEOR 和 SciBERT BERTScore 评估解释
答案分类错误时将全部解释指标记为零
由三名健康相关硕士对 25 条开发样本按 0 0.5 或 1 评分并计算人工与自动指标相关性

source_locator: arXiv:2505.23802 Sections 2-5 and appendices; official Stanford CRFM MedHELM latest page
evidence_summary_en: MedHELM validates and expands a clinician-reviewed taxonomy to 121 tasks, assembles 35 benchmarks from 17 existing, five reformulated, and 13 new sources, uniformly evaluates nine frontier models, scores closed tasks automatically and open tasks with a three-model jury, validates that jury with clinicians, and reports macro win rate plus cost.
evidence_summary_zh: MedHELM 将临床医生审查的分类体系验证扩展至 121 项任务，从 17 个现有基准五个重构基准及 13 个全新基准组装 35 个基准，统一评测九个前沿模型，对封闭题自动评分并对开放题使用三模型评审团，再以医生验证评审团并报告宏平均胜率与成本。
construction_steps_en: Draft five categories, 21 subcategories, and 98 candidate medical tasks
Recruit 29 clinicians across 14 specialties and four institutions to review coverage and mappings
Measure 96.7% mapping agreement and 4.21 of 5 comprehensiveness and incorporate 107 comments
Finalize five categories, 22 subcategories, and 121 tasks
Map 17 existing benchmarks to the taxonomy
Reformulate five data collections with standard prompts and metrics
Construct 13 new benchmarks with Stanford Health Care, 12 using EHR data
Form a 35-benchmark suite covering all 22 subcategories with 13 open, 22 closed, 14 public, seven gated, and 14 private benchmarks
construction_steps_zh: 起草五个大类 21 个子类和 98 项候选医学任务
招募来自四家机构覆盖 14 个专业的 29 名临床医生审查覆盖度与映射
测得 96.7% 映射一致率和 4.21 分完整性并吸收 107 条意见
定稿五个大类 22 个子类和 121 项任务
将 17 个现有基准映射到分类体系
用标准提示和指标重构五个数据集合
与 Stanford Health Care 构建 13 个全新基准其中 12 个使用 EHR 数据
形成覆盖全部 22 个子类且含 13 个开放题 22 个封闭题 14 个公开 7 个受限和 14 个私有基准的 35 基准套件
evaluation_steps_en: Specify context, prompt, metric, and an applicable gold reference for each benchmark item
Evaluate nine frontier models with uniform prompting and decoding while recording responses and token usage
Score closed tasks with exact match or Micro-F1
Score open tasks without chain-of-thought using GPT-4o, Claude 3.7 Sonnet, and Llama 3.3 70B on accuracy, completeness, and clarity and average nine 1-to-5 ratings
Validate the jury with 20 clinicians on 31 ACI-Bench and 25 MEDIQA outputs and compare jury ICC 0.47 with human ICC 0.43
Compute normalized pairwise win rate and macro-average all 35 benchmarks equally
Report performance against token-based cost using prices frozen on 2025-05-12
evaluation_steps_zh: 为每个基准样本定义上下文提示指标及适用时的标准参考
以统一提示和解码评测九个前沿模型并记录响应与词元用量
使用精确匹配或 Micro-F1 评估封闭任务
由 GPT-4o Claude 3.7 Sonnet 和 Llama 3.3 70B 在不使用思维链的条件下按准确性完整性清晰度评估开放任务并平均九个 1 至 5 分评分
由 20 名临床医生在 31 个 ACI-Bench 和 25 个 MEDIQA 输出上验证评审团并比较评审 ICC 0.47 与人工 ICC 0.43
计算归一化成对胜率并对全部 35 个基准等权宏平均
以冻结于 2025 年 5 月 12 日的词元价格报告性能成本关系

source_locator: arXiv:2502.14302 Sections 3-4, Figure 2, and Algorithm 1; official medhallu.github.io project page
evidence_summary_en: MedHallu draws exactly 1,000 expert-labeled and 9,000 randomly selected artificial PubMedQA records, generates controlled medical hallucinations, filters them with three discriminator LLMs and bidirectional entailment, refines failures with TextGrad, assigns easy/medium/hard tiers, and evaluates binary detection under knowledge-free and context-aware settings.
evidence_summary_zh: MedHallu 从 PubMedQA 精确组合 1,000 条专家标注记录与随机抽取的 9,000 条人工记录，受控生成医学幻觉，以三个判别大模型和双向蕴含过滤，用 TextGrad 优化失败候选，划分简单中等困难三档，并在无知识与上下文增强设置下评测二元检测。
construction_steps_en: Take 1,000 records from PubMedQA pqa_labeled and randomly select 9,000 from pqa_artificial
Provide each question, relevant knowledge, ground-truth answer, and four medical hallucination definitions to Qwen2.5-14B
Generate candidates at temperature 0.3-0.7, top-p 0.95, up to 512 tokens, and within 10 percent of gold-answer length
Have GPT-4o mini, Gemma2-9B, and Qwen2.5-7B independently compare candidate and ground-truth answers
Retain candidates that fool at least one discriminator and assign easy, medium, or hard by the number fooled
Reject semantically equivalent candidates with bidirectional DeBERTa-large-MNLI entailment at confidence 0.75
Use GPT-4o mini-backed TextGrad feedback to refine candidates that fail quality or correctness checks
Regenerate and recheck for at most five total generation attempts
If all attempts fail select the candidate with highest cosine similarity to gold and label it easy
Release 10,000 medical QA pairs with correct and hallucinated answers across three difficulty tiers
construction_steps_zh: 从 PubMedQA pqa_labeled 取 1,000 条并从 pqa_artificial 随机抽取 9,000 条
向 Qwen2.5-14B 提供问题相关知识标准答案和四类医学幻觉定义
以温度 0.3 至 0.7、top-p 0.95、最长 512 词元且长度在标准答案 10% 内生成候选
由 GPT-4o mini、Gemma2-9B 和 Qwen2.5-7B 独立比较候选答案与标准答案
保留至少骗过一个判别模型的候选并按被骗模型数划分简单中等困难
使用 DeBERTa-large-MNLI 在置信度 0.75 下做双向蕴含并排除语义等价候选
使用 GPT-4o mini 驱动的 TextGrad 反馈优化未通过质量或正确性检查的候选
重新生成并复检且总生成尝试最多五次
全部尝试失败时选择与标准答案余弦相似度最高的候选并标为简单
发布 10,000 个含正确与幻觉答案且分三档难度的医学问答对
evaluation_steps_en: Evaluate general-purpose and medical LLMs under zero-shot and ground-truth-context settings
Ask each model to classify every answer as hallucinated or non-hallucinated
Report overall F1 and precision plus easy, medium, and hard F1
Measure gains from domain knowledge and from adding a not-sure answer class
evaluation_steps_zh: 在零样本和提供标准知识上下文两种设置下评测通用与医学大模型
要求模型把每个答案分类为幻觉或非幻觉
报告总体 F1 与精确率以及简单中等困难三档 F1
衡量领域知识与加入不确定类别带来的增益

source_locator: arXiv:2603.23519 Sections 3-5 and Figures 4-5; ICLR 2026 OpenReview submission aKyBCsPOHB and linked supplementary material
evidence_summary_en: MedMT-Bench maps open medical text and images to departments and scenarios, uses five agents to synthesize long dialogues and atomic test points across three diagnosis stages, relies on professional medical editing and two-layer cross-review, retains 400 cases missed by multiple models, and validates Gemini-2.5-Pro judging against experts.
evidence_summary_zh: MedMT-Bench 将开放医学文本和图像映射到科室及场景，以五个智能体跨诊前三阶段合成长对话和原子测试点，经专业医学编辑与两层交叉复核后保留多个模型均答错的 400 个用例，并用专家标注验证 Gemini-2.5-Pro 评判。
construction_steps_en: Define pre-diagnosis, in-diagnosis, and post-diagnosis scenarios plus five difficult instruction-following dimensions
Collect open medical text and images and map each source to a department and scenario
Use a system agent to synthesize scenario prompts, roles, workflows, and safety constraints
Use user and responder agents to generate long multi-turn medical conversations
Use a generator agent to evolve dimension-targeted final questions and synchronously create atomic test points
Use a verifier agent with multiple models to filter and select potentially challenging candidates
Carry prior-stage conversations forward through portrait extraction for scene-by-scene synthesis
Have about 20 full-time medical MSc or PhD editors correct coherence, categorization, medical, and scoring issues
Apply two-layer independent cross-review and third-reviewer adjudication while discarding unreasonable samples
Retain questions multiple models fail and finalize 400 cases across 24 departments and nine sub-scenarios averaging 22 and reaching 52 turns
construction_steps_zh: 定义诊前诊中诊后三阶段及五类困难指令遵循维度
收集开放医学文本和图像并将每个来源映射至科室及场景
由系统智能体合成场景提示角色工作流和安全约束
由用户与响应智能体生成长多轮医学对话
由生成智能体演化瞄准能力维度的末轮问题并同步生成原子测试点
由验证智能体调用多个模型过滤并选择可能具有挑战的候选
通过画像抽取把上一阶段对话传入下一阶段以逐场景合成
由约 20 名全职医学硕博编辑修正连贯性分类医学和评分问题
执行两层独立交叉复核并由第三评审裁决同时丢弃不合理样本
保留多个模型均答错的问题并形成覆盖 24 科室九个子场景且平均 22 轮最长 52 轮的 400 个用例
evaluation_steps_en: Run seven frontier and ten open-source models on the text and image-text subsets with consistent inference settings
Use Gemini-2.5-Pro at temperature zero to judge each instance-specific atomic test point as yes or no
Report accuracy overall and by diagnosis stage and instruction-following dimension
Compare automatic judgments with expert annotations and report the best human-LLM agreement of 91.94 percent
evaluation_steps_zh: 以一致推理设置在文本和图文子集运行七个前沿模型与十个开源模型
使用温度零的 Gemini-2.5-Pro 对每个实例专属原子测试点做是或否判断
报告总体准确率以及按诊疗阶段和指令遵循维度拆分的准确率
对照专家标注验证自动判断并报告最高 91.94% 的人机一致率

visual_review.result: Both 1673 by 509 SVGs preserve the three diagnosis stages, five dimensions, open text and image sources, five synthesis agents, atomic test points, portrait transfer, approximately 20 expert editors, two-layer cross-review, exact case and turn statistics, 17-model inference, binary judging, and 91.94 percent agreement without clipping, overlap, connector-node crossings, or visible fallback-text defects; the bilingual 14-node and 13-edge topologies are identical.

source_locator: arXiv:1808.06752 Sections 2-4; official jgc128.github.io/mednli MIMIC-III-derived dataset page
evidence_summary_en: MedNLI extracts Past Medical History sentences from MIMIC-III, asks clinicians to write entailment, neutral, and contradiction hypotheses, validates guidelines in a two-radiologist pilot with kappa 0.78, expands annotation to four clinicians and 14,049 pairs, splits without premise overlap, and evaluates clinical NLI accuracy and domain adaptation.
evidence_summary_zh: MedNLI 从 MIMIC-III 抽取既往病史句子，请临床医生分别撰写蕴含中立矛盾假设，以两名放射科医生试点和 0.78 的 kappa 验证指南，再扩展为四名医生与 14,049 个句对，按前提不重叠划分并评测临床 NLI 准确率和领域适配。
construction_steps_en: Use de-identified MIMIC-III v1.3 records from 38,597 patients and 2,078,705 English clinical notes
Segment notes with rule-based section-header patterns and extract Past Medical History
Apply a biomedical-trained LingPipe sentence splitter and randomly sample candidate premises
Show each premise without surrounding note context and ask clinicians for definitely true, might-be-true, and definitely false hypotheses
Develop guidelines in a pilot where two board-certified radiologists each receive 100 unique premises
Discard 16 invalid premises and cross-label 552 generated pairs to obtain Cohen kappa 0.78
Recruit two additional clinicians so four clinicians annotate 4,683 premises over six weeks
Form 14,049 unique entailment, neutral, and contradiction sentence pairs
Split by non-overlapping premises into 11,232 train, 1,395 development, and 1,422 test pairs
construction_steps_zh: 使用含 38,597 名去标识化患者和 2,078,705 份英文临床病历的 MIMIC-III v1.3
按章节标题格式规则切分病历并抽取既往病史
应用生物医学训练的 LingPipe 分句器并随机抽取候选前提
不展示病历其他上下文并请临床医生撰写肯定为真可能为真和肯定为假三类假设
在两名专科认证放射科医生各处理 100 个唯一前提的试点中制定指南
丢弃 16 个无效前提并交叉标注 552 个已生成句对得到 Cohen kappa 0.78
再招募两名临床医生使四名医生在六周内标注 4,683 个前提
形成 14,049 个蕴含中立矛盾三类唯一句对
按前提不重叠划分为 11,232 条训练 1,395 条开发和 1,422 条测试句对
evaluation_steps_en: Train feature-based, bag-of-words, InferSent, and ESIM clinical NLI baselines with comparable hyperparameters
Test direct, sequential, and multi-target transfer from SNLI and MultiNLI
Incorporate biomedical and MIMIC embeddings plus UMLS-derived knowledge methods
Predict the three NLI labels on the held-out test set and report classification accuracy
evaluation_steps_zh: 以可比超参数训练特征词袋 InferSent 和 ESIM 临床 NLI 基线
测试从 SNLI 和 MultiNLI 进行直接顺序及多目标迁移
加入生物医学和 MIMIC 词向量以及源自 UMLS 的知识方法
在留出测试集预测三类 NLI 标签并报告分类准确率

visual_review.result: Both 1673 by 509 SVGs preserve the MIMIC-III source counts, Past Medical History and LingPipe extraction, three-hypothesis clinician protocol, exact pilot and agreement evidence, four-clinician annotation, 14,049 pairs, premise-disjoint split counts, baseline models, transfer methods, and accuracy reporting without clipping, overlap, connector-node crossings, or visible fallback-text defects; the bilingual 14-node and 13-edge topologies are identical.

source_locator: arXiv:2408.12547 Sections 2 and 4 plus Supplementary A.1-A.2; maintained henrychur.github.io/MedS-Bench platform and MAGIC-AI4Med/MedS-Ins code
evidence_summary_en: The MedS-Bench paper reformats 28 source datasets into 52 tasks across 11 categories with hand-written instructions, separates model recall from context retrieval, controls train-test leakage and evaluation cost, and uses task-specific prompting and metrics; the maintained dynamic platform has since expanded the integrated source count to 39.
evidence_summary_zh: MedS-Bench 论文把 28 个来源数据集重构为覆盖 11 类的 52 项任务并手工编写指令，区分模型知识回忆与上下文检索，控制训练测试泄漏和评测成本，再采用任务专属提示与指标；维护中的动态平台后来已把整合来源数扩展到 39。
construction_steps_en: Define 11 clinical task categories beyond conventional multiple-choice question answering
Integrate 28 existing datasets into 52 distinct tasks and about 0.3 million paper-release samples
Reformat every dataset into an instruction-prompted question-answering structure
Hand-write task definitions that specify the required input-output behavior
Manually classify eight categories as model-fact recall and three as retrieval from provided context
Use each source's predefined train-test split or create a random 9:1 split when none exists
Exclude test instances from few-shot demonstrations and keep test gold answers held out
Use all MCQA test items and cost-aware random samples, around 1,500 where the paper specifies
Maintain the post-paper official platform as a dynamic expansion now listing 39 integrated datasets
construction_steps_zh: 定义超越传统多项选择问答的 11 类临床任务
整合 28 个现有数据集形成 52 项不同任务和论文版约 30 万样本
将每个数据集重构为指令提示问答结构
手工编写任务定义以规定所需输入输出行为
人工把八类任务划为模型知识回忆并把三类划为给定上下文检索
使用来源的既有训练测试划分或在缺失时随机按 9 比 1 划分
从少样本演示中排除测试实例并隐藏测试标准答案
多选题使用完整测试集而其他任务按论文指定做成本感知随机抽样通常约 1,500 条
将论文后的官方平台作为动态扩展维护且当前列出 39 个整合数据集
evaluation_steps_en: Evaluate GPT-4, Claude-3.5, Llama 3, Mistral, InternLM 2, and MEDITRON
Use hand-written task definitions and three-shot prompting for clinical tasks
Use zero-shot prompting for MCQA to align with prior studies
Apply Accuracy for closed decisions, Precision Recall and F1 for label tasks, and BLEU and ROUGE for generation
Publish task-level results on the dynamic leaderboard and accept code or CSV submissions
evaluation_steps_zh: 评测 GPT-4 Claude-3.5 Llama 3 Mistral InternLM 2 和 MEDITRON
临床任务使用手工任务定义与三样本提示
多项选择问答使用零样本提示以对齐先前研究
封闭决策用准确率标签任务用精确率召回率 F1 而生成任务用 BLEU 与 ROUGE
在动态榜单发布分任务结果并接受代码或 CSV 提交

visual_review.result: Both 1673 by 509 SVGs clearly distinguish the paper's 28-dataset, 52-task, 0.3-million-sample release from the current 39-dataset platform, while preserving instruction formatting, hand-written definitions, eight-versus-three skill grouping, split and leakage controls, sampling, six-model evaluation, prompting exception, task metrics, and dynamic leaderboard without clipping, overlap, connector-node crossings, or visible fallback-text defects; the bilingual 14-node and 13-edge topologies are identical.

source_locator: arXiv:2606.05112 Sections 2.1 and 4.1-4.3 plus Figures 1 and 8; current MAGIC-AI4Med/MedSP1000 repository
evidence_summary_en: MedSP1000 filters 1,073 MedEdPORTAL articles for complete text, converts 1,017 articles into Markdown, uses a source-faithful Codex pipeline to retain 613 articles and form 1,638 role-separated cases, freezes 24,602 rubrics, validates construction and runtime with clinicians, and scores closed-loop clinical trajectories by equal-case macro completion.
evidence_summary_zh: MedSP1000 从 1,073 篇 MedEdPORTAL 文章筛选文本完整来源，把 1,017 篇转为 Markdown，以忠实来源的 Codex 流水线保留 613 篇并形成 1,638 个角色隔离病例，冻结 24,602 条 rubric，由临床医生验证构建与运行，再按病例等权宏平均完成率评估闭环临床轨迹。
construction_steps_en: Search MedEdPORTAL for simulation case and standardized patient to retrieve 1,073 articles and 22,244 attachments
Keep 931 fully text-extractable articles and manually review 142 multimodal articles, retaining 86 and discarding 56
Convert the resulting 1,017 articles into 7,147 Markdown files with MarkItDown, MinerU2, and OCR
Use Codex to assess text simulatability and extract metadata, retaining 613 source articles
Split multi-scenario articles into 1,638 executable cases and assign 17 clinical specialties
Construct scenario-initialization, patient, environment-controller, and evaluator packets by copying source text then deleting privileged passages
Self-audit packets for leakage, portrayal sufficiency, and cross-encounter consistency and iteratively correct anomalies
Copy scoring points verbatim into 24,602 frozen rubric items and map them to six ACGME competencies
Have 12 clinicians double-rate 100 cases and 100 runtime simulations and correct a 100-case verified subset
construction_steps_zh: 以 simulation case 和 standardized patient 检索 MedEdPORTAL 得到 1,073 篇文章及 22,244 个附件
保留 931 篇完全可抽取文章并人工审查 142 篇多模态文章其中保留 86 篇丢弃 56 篇
用 MarkItDown MinerU2 和 OCR 将所得 1,017 篇文章转为 7,147 个 Markdown 文件
使用 Codex 评估文本仿真可行性并抽取元数据最终保留 613 篇来源文章
把多场景文章拆成 1,638 个可执行病例并分配至 17 个临床专科
通过复制来源原文后删除角色不可见段落形成场景初始化病人环境控制器和评估者角色包
对角色包做泄漏扮演充分性和跨场景一致性自审计并迭代修正异常
逐字复制评分点形成 24,602 条冻结 rubric 并映射至六项 ACGME 能力
由 12 名临床医生对 100 个病例和 100 次运行做双人评分并修正形成 100 例验证子集
evaluation_steps_en: Reveal only scenario initialization and require the assessed clinician model to output speak, actions, and eos
Route speech to the patient agent and clinical actions to the environment controller in a closed loop
Advance only through source-defined states and mark unsupported clinical results rather than fabricating them
Pass the full completed trajectory and frozen rubric packet to an evaluator for one binary judgment per item
Report per-case rubric completion and macro-average cases equally with specialty and competency breakdowns

在闭环中把话语路由给病人智能体并把临床行动路由给环境控制器

将完整结束轨迹和冻结 rubric 交给评估者并对每条做一次二元判断

source_locator: arXiv:2403.03744 Sections 3.1-4.2 and Appendices A-C; AI4LIFE-GROUP/med-safety-bench official repository
evidence_summary_en: MedSafetyBench operationalizes nine AMA ethics principles, creates 1,800 harmful medical requests from equal GPT-4 and GCG-jailbroken Llama-2 sources, pairs them with manually checked safe responses, makes balanced Eval and Improve splits, validates coverage with doctors, and measures or improves safety while checking medical utility.
evidence_summary_zh: MedSafetyBench 将九项 AMA 医学伦理原则操作化，以等量 GPT-4 与 GCG 越狱 Llama-2 来源构建 1,800 条有害医疗请求并配对人工核验的安全回应，形成均衡的 Eval 与 Improve 划分，经医生验证覆盖后评测或提升安全性并检查医疗效用。
construction_steps_en: Define medical safety and harmful medical requests from the nine AMA Principles of Medical Ethics
Prompt GPT-4 for medical-jargon requests that violate each principle
Apply the Greedy Coordinate Gradient jailbreak to Llama-2-7b-chat with an affirmative target
Manually remove duplicate and irrelevant generations and retain 900 requests from each model source
Pair all 1,800 harmful requests with GPT-4 refusals that briefly explain the unsafe or unethical aspect
Manually verify and edit the safe responses
Randomly stratify the data by all nine principles into 900-item Eval and 900-item Improve splits
Place 450 GPT-4 and 450 Llama-2 examples in each split
Ask 25 doctors to each rate 25 random requests for violation and applicable principles
construction_steps_zh: 依据九项 AMA 医学伦理原则定义医疗安全和有害医疗请求
提示 GPT-4 生成违反各原则且包含医学术语的请求
对 Llama-2-7b-chat 以肯定式目标应用贪婪坐标梯度越狱
人工删除重复和无关生成并从每种模型来源各保留 900 条请求
为全部 1,800 条有害请求配对由 GPT-4 生成的拒绝及简短危害解释
人工核验并编辑安全回应
按九项原则随机分层为各 900 条的 Eval 与 Improve 划分
每个划分放入 450 条 GPT-4 与 450 条 Llama-2 样本
由 25 名医生每人随机评 25 条请求的违规性及对应原则
evaluation_steps_en: Prompt general and medical LLMs with harmful requests from MedSafety-Eval and the 330-item GenSafety-Eval without revealing safe responses
Use GPT-3.5 under the AMA medical policy to score compliance from 1 for full refusal to 5 for full compliance
Fine-tune Medalpaca-7b, Medalpaca-13b, and Meditron-7b on 900 general, 900 medical, or 1,800 combined safety demonstrations
Repeat safety evaluation and run three-shot Accuracy on MedQA, MedMCQA, PubMedQA, and MMLU-Medical
evaluation_steps_zh: 以 MedSafety-Eval 及 330 条 GenSafety-Eval 有害请求提示通用与医疗大模型且不展示安全回应
由 GPT-3.5 依据 AMA 医疗政策按完全拒绝为 1 到完全服从为 5 评定服从度
分别用 900 条通用安全 900 条医疗安全或 1,800 条合并示范微调 Medalpaca-7b Medalpaca-13b 和 Meditron-7b
重复安全评测并在 MedQA MedMCQA PubMedQA 与 MMLU-Medical 上运行三样本准确率

source_locator: arXiv:2501.18362 Sections 3.1-4.3 and Appendices C, E, H, and I; TsinghuaC3I/MedXpertQA official repository
evidence_summary_en: MedXpertQA reduces 37,543 authoritative examination questions through human and eight-model difficulty filtering, edit and semantic duplicate checks, proprietary-model question and option augmentation, and licensed-physician review to 4,460 Text and MM items, then labels reasoning dimensions and evaluates 18 models against accuracy and human baselines.
evidence_summary_zh: MedXpertQA 将 37,543 道权威考试题依次经人类与八模型难度筛选、编辑和语义重复检查、闭源模型题干与选项增强以及执业医师复核，缩减为 4,460 道 Text 与 MM 题，再标注推理维度并以准确率和人类基线评测 18 个模型。
construction_steps_en: Collect 37,543 difficult questions from medical licensing, specialty-board, radiology, NEJM image, and textbook sources
Retain human response distributions, expert explanations, and prior difficulty ratings
Calibrate adaptive Brier thresholds by prior rating and use 14 sampling votes from eight AI experts
Reduce the bank through human and AI difficulty filters to 10,146 and then 4,737 questions
Apply edit-distance filtering to 4,713 questions
Embed questions with MedCPT, detect high cosine-similarity IQR outliers, and keep the harder item to reach 4,683
Use GPT-4o and Claude 3.5 Sonnet to rephrase questions without removing clinical information
Remove low-response distractors and expand Text to 10 and MM to 5 options
Have licensed physicians correct factual, narrative, formatting, and option errors and delete remaining failures
Release 2,455 Text and 2,005 MM items, reserve five development examples per subset, and retain 2,450 plus 2,000 test items
construction_steps_zh: 从医学执照考试专科委员会考试放射科考试 NEJM 图像挑战和教材收集 37,543 道难题
保留人类作答分布专家解析和先验难度评级
按先验评级校准自适应 Brier 阈值并由八个 AI 专家对每题做 14 次采样投票
经人类与 AI 难度筛选依次缩减至 10,146 和 4,737 题
执行编辑距离过滤得到 4,713 题
用 MedCPT 编码并以 IQR 发现高余弦相似异常题对且保留更难题得到 4,683 题
用 GPT-4o 与 Claude 3.5 Sonnet 在不丢失临床信息的前提下改写题干
删除低人类选择率干扰项并把 Text 扩至 10 项把 MM 扩至 5 项
由执业医师修正事实叙事格式和选项错误并删除残余不合格题
发布 2,455 道 Text 与 2,005 道 MM 且每子集留五道开发题形成 2,450 加 2,000 道测试题
evaluation_steps_en: Label body systems, three tasks and fine-grained subtasks, and Reasoning versus Understanding with GPT-4o under expert-written guidance
Have experts review a random 10 percent of reasoning labels
Evaluate 18 LLMs and LMMs using zero-shot chain of thought, greedy decoding where available, and answer cleansing
Compare model Accuracy overall and by subset, specialty, task, and reasoning label against aggregated pre-licensed human responses
evaluation_steps_zh: 依据专家编写指南用 GPT-4o 标注身体系统三类任务细粒度子任务以及推理与理解类别
由专家复核随机 10% 的推理标签
以零样本思维链可用时的贪婪解码和答案清洗评测 18 个 LLM 与 LMM
把模型总体及分子集专科任务推理标签准确率与汇总的准执业人类作答比较

source_locator: arXiv:2507.05257v4 Sections 3.1-4.1 and Appendices B, D, and F; ai-hyz/MemoryAgentBench official dataset
evidence_summary_en: MemoryAgentBench reconstructs existing long-context tasks and builds EventQA and FactConsolidation to cover accurate retrieval, test-time learning, long-range understanding, and selective forgetting, then standardizes 2,071 queries across 130 sequences into an incremental inject-once-query-multiple protocol for three memory-agent families.
evidence_summary_zh: MemoryAgentBench 重构既有长文本任务并新建 EventQA 与 FactConsolidation，以覆盖准确检索、测试时学习、长程理解和选择性遗忘，再把 130 个序列中的 2,071 个问题统一成面向三类记忆智能体的增量式一次注入多次查询协议。
construction_steps_en: Define accurate retrieval, test-time learning, long-range understanding, and selective forgetting
Rebuild single-hop and multi-hop document QA and consolidate LongMemEval into five long histories
Create EventQA from five books by selecting the top ten characters with NER, extracting 101 events per book with GPT-4o, and forming 500 six-way continuation questions
Reconstruct BANKING77, CLINC150, NLU, TREC Coarse, and TREC Fine by shuffling labeled examples into long contexts
Concatenate Redial dialogues for movie recommendation
Adopt InfiniteBench English summarization and create a 71-question DetectiveQA set from ten novels
Build single-hop and multi-hop FactConsolidation from MQUAKE counterfactual edit pairs with newer contradictory facts ordered later
Concatenate FactConsolidation contexts at 6K, 32K, 64K, and 262K tokens
Standardize every dataset as ordered chunks, questions, and answers and wrap chunks with memorization instructions
Release 2,071 questions across 130 sequences with inject-once-query-multiple interaction
construction_steps_zh: 定义准确检索测试时学习长程理解和选择性遗忘
重构单跳和多跳文档问答并把 LongMemEval 合并为五段长历史
从五本书以 NER 选前十名角色由 GPT-4o 每书抽取 101 个事件并形成 500 道六选一续接题以构建 EventQA
把 BANKING77 CLINC150 NLU TREC Coarse 与 TREC Fine 带标签样本打乱拼成长上下文
拼接 Redial 对话形成电影推荐任务
采用 InfiniteBench 英文摘要并从十本小说构造 71 题 DetectiveQA
从 MQUAKE 反事实编辑对构建单跳与多跳 FactConsolidation 并把新的矛盾事实排在后面
将 FactConsolidation 上下文拼接至 6K 32K 64K 和 262K 词元
把每个数据集统一为有序片段问题答案并为片段包装记忆指令
发布 130 个序列 2,071 个问题并采用一次注入多次查询交互
evaluation_steps_en: Use 512-token chunks for synthetic retrieval and forgetting tasks and 4,096 for continuous text, classification, and recommendation, with costly agents fixed at 4,096
Evaluate long-context, simple and embedding and structure-augmented RAG, and agentic external-memory systems
Feed chunks sequentially, update memory incrementally, and query only after all chunks are processed
Report Accuracy and substring exact match, Recall@5, GPT-4o judgments and summary F1, plus context-length, construction, query, cost, and latency analyses
evaluation_steps_zh: 合成检索与遗忘任务用 512 词元分块连续文本分类和推荐用 4,096 且高成本智能体固定用 4,096
评测长上下文简单向量及结构增强 RAG 和智能体式外部记忆系统
顺序输入片段并增量更新记忆且仅在全部片段处理后提问
报告准确率与子串精确匹配 Recall@5 GPT-4o 裁判和摘要 F1 并分析上下文长度构建查询成本与延迟

source_locator: arXiv:2503.13399 Sections 3-5 and Appendices E-F; jmhb0.github.io/microvqa official project
evidence_summary_en: MicroVQA begins with 1,061 microscopy VQA samples created by 12 biology experts, converts them with 50 gold MCQs and a supervised DSPy prompt, uses RefineBot and multi-seed dual-model gates to remove text-only shortcuts, fully rechecks the result with the original experts, and releases 1,042 MCQs across three research tasks.
evidence_summary_zh: MicroVQA 先由 12 名生物学专家创建 1,061 条显微图像 VQA，再用 50 道金标 MCQ 和受监督 DSPy 提示转换，通过 RefineBot 与多随机种子双模型门槛清除纯文本捷径，由原专家全量复核后发布覆盖三类研究任务的 1,042 道 MCQ。
construction_steps_en: Interview nine microscopy PIs and postdocs to define expert image understanding, hypothesis generation, and experiment proposal
Recruit 12 biology experts from diverse microscopy fields to create about 90 samples each
Source redistributable images from contributor experiments, image databases, and research papers published since 2024
Create 1,061 raw samples containing an image set, question, detailed answer, experimental context, and motivation at 30 to 40 minutes per sample
Review research-level difficulty, task alignment, and image diversity and give each contributor feedback after the first 10 and 40 samples
Have a physician-scientist manually convert 50 raw pairs into NBME- and Bloom-aligned gold one-best-answer MCQs
Optimize a DSPy prompt against the gold set using content-similarity, formatting, and extraneous-clue metrics
Generate Stage-one exam-style MCQs while preserving the original question-answer meaning
Run the RefineBot evaluator and reflector without images, rewrite easy distractors, and check semantic equivalence after each iteration
Rerun failures with new seeds and require incorrect answers for two seeds from both GPT-4o and Claude 3.5
Have the original creator manually review and minimally correct every released question, yielding 1,042 MCQs
construction_steps_zh: 访谈九名显微研究 PI 与博士后以定义专家图像理解假设生成和实验方案设计
从不同显微研究领域招募 12 名生物学专家且每人创建约 90 条样本
从贡献者实验图像数据库和 2024 年以来发表的研究论文收集可再分发图像
以每条 30 至 40 分钟创建含图像组问题详细回答实验上下文和动机的 1,061 条原始样本
检查研究级难度任务对齐和图像多样性并在每名贡献者提交前 10 与前 40 条后反馈
由医师科学家人工把 50 个原始问答对转换为符合 NBME 与 Bloom 原则的唯一最佳答案金标 MCQ
以内容相似度格式和额外线索指标对金标集监督优化 DSPy 提示
在保留原问答语义的前提下生成第一阶段考试风格 MCQ
让 RefineBot 评估与反思器在无图条件下作答并重写容易排除的干扰项且每轮检查语义等价
对失败题更换随机种子重跑并要求 GPT-4o 与 Claude 3.5 各两个种子均回答错误
由原创建者人工复核并最小修正每道发布题最终得到 1,042 道 MCQ
evaluation_steps_en: Evaluate open, closed, reasoning, small, and medical multimodal models across the three tasks
Use the MMMU-Pro chain-of-thought prompt and parse the numbered final answer, with model-specific handling where documented
Report overall and per-task multiple-choice Accuracy and run no-image ablations
Use expert review of chain-of-thought outputs to analyze perception, knowledge, and overgeneralization errors
evaluation_steps_zh: 在三类任务上评测开源闭源推理小型和医疗多模态模型
采用 MMMU-Pro 思维链提示并解析数字形式最终答案且按论文对特定模型做处理
报告总体及分任务多项选择准确率并运行无图消融
由专家复核思维链输出以分析感知知识和过度泛化错误

source_locator: arXiv:2109.00110 Sections 3-4 and Appendix A; openai/miniF2F version-1 repository
evidence_summary_en: MiniF2F manually formalizes 488 Olympiad-style statements from AMC, AIME, IMO, MATH, and custom exercises, aligns them across formal systems, stratifies them into equal validation and test sets, freezes stable versions, and measures machine-checked proof-search success with Pass-at-N.
evidence_summary_zh: MiniF2F 从 AMC、AIME、IMO、MATH 和自编练习中人工形式化 488 条奥赛型陈述，在多个形式系统间对齐后分层划成等量验证与测试集并冻结稳定版本，再以 Pass@N 衡量经机器检查的证明搜索成功率。
construction_steps_en: Define an end-to-end machine-verifiable cross-system formal-to-formal benchmark
Collect Olympiad-style problems from IMO, AIME, AMC, MATH, and high-school or undergraduate exercises
Select statements expressible across formal systems with emphasis on algebra, number theory, inequalities, and varied difficulty
Avoid geometry and combinatorics where formal-system support is immature
Formalize the correct option for multiple-choice questions, explicitly model or discard word problems, and turn witness tasks into answer-correctness and uniqueness proofs
Have trained practitioners manually formalize statements in about 15 minutes on average and review them in about half that time
Align the same mathematical statements in Metamath and Lean with partial Isabelle and HOL Light ports
Assemble 488 statements in version 1 with provenance and difficulty metadata
Randomly stratify version 1 into 244 validation and 244 test statements with equal problem-type and available-difficulty coverage
Freeze each released version, allowing only error corrections and using prover-compatible licenses
construction_steps_zh: 定义端到端机器可验证且跨系统的形式化输入到形式化证明基准
从 IMO AIME AMC MATH 以及高中或本科练习收集奥赛型题目
筛选可在多个形式系统表达的陈述并侧重代数数论不等式和多种难度
避开形式系统支持尚不成熟的几何与组合题
选择题形式化正确选项文字题显式建模或丢弃且见证题改为证明答案正确及唯一
由受训实践者人工形式化且平均约 15 分钟并以其一半时间复核
在 Metamath 与 Lean 中对齐相同数学陈述并部分移植到 Isabelle 与 HOL Light
汇总含来源和难度元数据的 v1 共 488 条陈述
按题型与可用难度随机分层为各 244 条的验证集与测试集
冻结每个发布版本仅允许错误修正并对各证明器部分采用兼容许可证
evaluation_steps_en: Run a 700M GPT-f baseline on Metamath and tidy, GPT-f, and PACT baselines on Lean
Sample N formal proof-search attempts per system-aligned statement
Execute each candidate in the target prover and count the statement solved when any attempt is machine accepted
Report unbiased low-variance Pass@N estimates on validation and test and compare formal systems
evaluation_steps_zh: 在 Metamath 运行 700M GPT-f 并在 Lean 运行 tidy GPT-f 与 PACT 基线
对每条与系统对齐的陈述采样 N 次形式化证明搜索
在目标证明器执行每个候选且任一次获机器接受即计该题成功
在验证与测试集报告无偏低方差 Pass@N 估计并比较形式系统

source_locator: arXiv:2109.00110 Sections 3-4 and Appendix A; facebookresearch/miniF2F version-1 test split
evidence_summary_en: MiniF2F-Test is the frozen 244-statement held-out half of MiniF2F version 1, created by manually formalizing and reviewing Olympiad-style problems across formal systems and stratifying 488 statements by type and available difficulty before machine-checked Pass-at-N evaluation.
evidence_summary_zh: MiniF2F-Test 是 MiniF2F v1 冻结的 244 条留出测试半集：奥赛型题目经跨系统人工形式化和复核后，将 488 条陈述按题型与可用难度分层划分，再以机器检查的 Pass@N 评测。
construction_steps_en: Collect Olympiad-style problems from IMO, AIME, AMC, MATH, and custom high-school or undergraduate exercises
Select portable algebra, number-theory, and inequality statements while limiting unsupported geometry and combinatorics
Formalize correct choices for MCQs, model or discard word problems, and prove witness correctness and uniqueness
Have trained practitioners manually formalize each statement in about 15 minutes on average
Review each formalization in about 7.5 minutes on average and correct errors
Align the same mathematical statements in Metamath and Lean with partial Isabelle and HOL Light ports
Assemble 488 version-1 statements and randomly stratify them by problem type and available difficulty
Split equally into 244 validation and 244 test statements
Form the test set from 20 IMO, 15 AIME, 45 AMC, 70 MATH algebra, 60 MATH number-theory, and 34 custom statements
Freeze version 1 and permit only error corrections while reserving test for final evaluation
construction_steps_zh: 从 IMO AIME AMC MATH 及高中或本科自编练习收集奥赛型题目
筛选可跨系统表达的代数数论和不等式陈述并限制支持不足的几何与组合题
选择题形式化正确选项文字题建模或丢弃且见证题证明答案正确及唯一
由受训实践者人工形式化且每题平均约 15 分钟
每题平均用约 7.5 分钟复核形式化结果并纠正错误
在 Metamath 与 Lean 对齐相同陈述并部分移植到 Isabelle 与 HOL Light
汇总 488 条 v1 陈述并按题型和可用难度随机分层
等量划分为 244 条验证陈述和 244 条测试陈述
测试集由 20 IMO 15 AIME 45 AMC 70 MATH 代数 60 MATH 数论和 34 道自编题构成
冻结 v1 仅允许错误修正且测试集留作最终评测
evaluation_steps_en: Use the 244-statement validation split for development and keep the test split held out
Sample N formal proof-search attempts for every system-aligned test statement
Execute every candidate in its target formal system and count an item solved when any attempt is accepted

Select the first 80 test examples for parallel translation
Define English, Chinese, Arabic, Spanish, Japanese, Korean, Thai, French, Portuguese, and Vietnamese across seven language families
Use GPT-4o-2024-05-13 to translate the eight missing languages while preserving question and choice correspondence
Have a professional translation team exhaustively review every translation
Correct errors, localize vocabulary and expressions, and remove non-translatable instances
Align passage, question, four choices, and correct answer across all language configurations
Release 80 parallel questions in ten languages for 800 total instances through P-MMEval

选择测试集前 80 道题进行平行翻译

evaluation_steps_en: Normalize task prompts from OpenCompass and lm-eval-harness with a fixed JSON answer format
Evaluate English-prompt, native-language-prompt, and English-few-shot settings
Request a direct answer rather than chain of thought and parse the selected option
Report exact-choice Accuracy by language and prompt setting
Compute CACR and analyze cross-language transfer for a Chinese-origin benchmark

请求直接答案而非思维链并解析所选选项
按语言与提示设定报告选项精确准确率
计算 CACR 并分析中文源基准的跨语言迁移

Create pull-request-style required changes and hints written by humans

Run an agentic rollout that may use command-line tools and Python to inspect and modify the repository
At completion run the human-written hidden unit tests against the final modifications
Mark success only when all task-specific tests pass and aggregate binary outcomes into success rate

完成后对最终改动运行人工编写的隐藏单元测试

evidence_summary_en: MotionBench combines intricate-interaction, specific-field, and Unity-synthetic videos, applies dynamic-caption and QA annotation plus a three-model first-frame shortcut filter and human review, and releases 5,385 videos with 8,052 QAs across six motion categories for accuracy evaluation.
evidence_summary_zh: MotionBench 合并复杂交互、特定领域和 Unity 合成三路视频，通过动态字幕与问答标注、三模型首帧捷径过滤和人工复核，发布 5,385 个视频与 8,052 道覆盖六类运动任务的问答并以准确率评测。
construction_steps_en: Collect intricate interactions from Panda-70M, Pexels, and self-collected movie clips and segment event-level clips with PySceneDetect
Collect MedVid, SportsSloMo, and Ha-ViD videos with minimum spatial dimension above 448 and duration from 3 to 60 seconds
Render 600 Unity videos from 20 motions, six avatars, five scenes, and a 15-viewpoint pool and manually remove occlusions
Have 15 degree-qualified annotators write dynamic captions over 20 working days with secondary review
Use GPT-4o to generate six intricate-interaction QAs per video from the dynamic captions
Use first-frame-only GPT-4o, Qwen2-VL, and GLM-4V-plus and discard a question when all three answer correctly
Have ten annotators over five days remove ambiguous or wrong questions, categorize them, and apply secondary review
Directly annotate specific-field QAs and automatically generate synthetic QAs from known ground truth
Combine 2,355 intricate videos with 4,922 QAs, 2,430 specific-field videos with 2,530 QAs, and 600 synthetic videos with 600 QAs
Assign six categories and randomly split 8,052 QAs into 4,020 development and 4,034 test items
construction_steps_zh: 从 Panda-70M Pexels 和自收集电影片段收集复杂交互视频并用 PySceneDetect 切成事件片段
从 MedVid SportsSloMo 和 Ha-ViD 筛选最小空间边大于 448 且时长 3 至 60 秒的视频
用 20 种动作六个角色五个场景和 15 个候选视角在 Unity 渲染 600 个视频并人工移除遮挡
由 15 名本科以上标注员在 20 个工作日内编写动态字幕并做二次复核
用 GPT-4o 根据动态字幕为每个复杂交互视频生成六道问答
让仅看首帧的 GPT-4o Qwen2-VL 与 GLM-4V-plus 作答且三者全对时丢弃该题
由十名标注员在五天内删除歧义或错误题分类并二次复核
直接标注特定领域问答并按已知真值自动生成合成问答
合并 2,355 个复杂视频 4,922 题 2,430 个特定领域视频 2,530 题和 600 个合成视频 600 题
标注六类任务并把 8,052 题随机划为 4,020 道开发题与 4,034 道测试题
evaluation_steps_en: Append the instruction to reply only with the best option and evaluate video-language models
Parse the first uppercase answer letter with a regular expression
Report overall multiple-choice Accuracy and Accuracy for motion recognition, location, action order, repetition count, motion objects, and camera motion
Compare against a random baseline and report annotation density of 68.4, with test labels evaluated by online submission

用正则表达式解析回答中的首个大写字母
报告总体选择题准确率以及运动识别位置动作顺序重复计数运动对象与相机运动六类准确率
与随机基线比较并报告 68.4 的标注密度且测试标签通过在线提交评测

evidence_summary_en: MuSR instantiates three reasoning domains from structured gold and diversity facts, recursively completes and validates GPT-4 reasoning trees, converts scenario leaves into chaptered and fact-checked narratives, and releases 564 narratives with 756 questions for Accuracy-based prompting and neurosymbolic evaluation.
evidence_summary_zh: MuSR 从结构化黄金事实与多样性事实实例化三类推理领域，递归补全并校验 GPT-4 推理树，把场景叶子转成分章节且经事实检查的叙事，发布 564 篇叙事与 756 道问题用于基于准确率的提示和神经符号评测。
construction_steps_en: Define murder mystery, object placement, and team allocation templates and their domain-specific answer requirements
Create gold facts F that determine each answer and diversity facts G that vary the scenario
Use GPT-4 to recursively expand conclusions into reasoning trees whose children jointly entail their parents
Apply tree validators to reject vacuous deductions and shortcuts and retry failed expansions
Separate scenario-specific leaves S(T), which enter the story, from implicit commonsense leaves C(T)
Chunk S(T) thematically, generate one chapter per chunk with GPT-4, then concatenate and smooth the chapters
Check that every scenario fact is entailed by the story and rewrite inconsistent chapters
Assemble 250 murder questions, 256 questions from 64 object-placement narratives, and 250 team-allocation questions
Use heuristic baselines and a human subset to validate challenge, coherence, and solvability
construction_steps_zh: 定义谋杀谜案物体放置和团队分配模板及各领域的答案要求
创建决定答案的黄金事实 F 和改变场景的多样性事实 G
用 GPT-4 递归把结论展开为子节点共同蕴含父节点的推理树
用树校验器拒绝空洞推导和推理捷径并重新生成失败展开
把写入故事的场景叶子 S(T) 与保持隐含的常识叶子 C(T) 分开
按主题切分 S(T) 用 GPT-4 为每块生成章节后拼接并润色
检查故事是否蕴含每条场景事实并重写不一致章节
汇总 250 道谋杀题来自 64 篇物体叙事的 256 道题和 250 道团队分配题
用启发式基线和人工子集验证挑战性连贯性与可解性
evaluation_steps_en: Evaluate language models with Regular, CoT, CoT+, one-shot CoT+, and few-shot CoT+ prompts
Evaluate domain-specific decomposed prompting, SymbolicTOM, and program-aided approaches where applicable
Report Accuracy for each domain and compare prompting and neurosymbolic methods with human performance
evaluation_steps_zh: 使用常规 CoT CoT+ 单样本 CoT+ 和少样本 CoT+ 提示评测语言模型
按适用领域评测分解提示 SymbolicTOM 和程序辅助方法
报告各领域准确率并比较提示方法神经符号方法与人工表现

evidence_summary_en: MulDimIF samples ShareGPT instructions and applies a 3-pattern, 4-category, 13-subcategory, 4-level framework through GPT-4o constraint expansion, conflict checks, rewriting, six-annotator review, and dual-approved validation code to release 7,906 training and 1,200 test items.

construction_steps_en: Randomly sample single-turn English source instructions from ShareGPT
Represent constraints along example, listing, and incorporation patterns, four categories with thirteen subcategories, and four difficulty levels
Use GPT-4o to choose an unused category and add one or two constraints while progressing from Level I to Level IV
Check that added constraints are present and mutually compatible, discard failures, and continue valid expansions

Have six trained annotators review and refine all 9,106 items over four weeks with at least two reviewers per item
Group items by category, use DeepSeek-V3 to draft Python validators, and require two annotators to approve the refined code
Split the validated data into 7,906 training instructions and 1,200 test instructions with 300 test items per level

按示例列表融入三种形式四类十三个子类和四个难度描述约束
用 GPT-4o 选择未覆盖类别并加入一至两个约束从等级 I 递进到 IV
检查新增约束是否存在且相互兼容丢弃失败项并继续有效扩展
采样展示形式并重写指令其中示例式使用三组匹配问答
由六名训练标注员在四周内复核修订全部 9,106 条数据且每条至少两人参与
按类别分组让 DeepSeek-V3 起草 Python 校验器并要求两名标注员批准修订代码
把验证数据划为 7,906 条训练指令和 1,200 条测试指令且每个难度 300 条
evaluation_steps_en: Evaluate 18 LLMs across six families on the 1,200-item test set with greedy decoding and final answers only
Run each item's Python validation code and report Accuracy by constraint pattern, category, and difficulty level
Train six models up to 14B with GRPO using the number of satisfied constraints as reward
Compare instruction-following and general knowledge, reasoning, and coding performance before and after GRPO
evaluation_steps_zh: 在 1,200 条测试集上用贪心解码和仅最终答案评测六个家族的 18 个 LLM
运行每条数据的 Python 验证代码并按约束形式类别和难度报告准确率
以满足约束数量为奖励用 GRPO 训练六个不超过 14B 的模型
比较 GRPO 前后的指令遵循和通用知识推理与代码能力

evidence_summary_en: Multi-IF expands English IFEval prompts to three turns, filters cross-turn conflicts with Llama 3.1 405B and humans, translates and audits seven additional languages, removes sensitive prompts, and releases 4,501 conversations evaluated by four strict and loose rule-based accuracies.
evidence_summary_zh: Multi-IF 把英文 IFEval 提示扩展为三轮，用 Llama 3.1 405B 与人工过滤跨轮冲突，把数据翻译并审核为另外七种语言且删除敏感提示，发布 4,501 段以四项严格和宽松规则准确率评测的对话。

Skip constraints that do not apply to a target language
Have multilingual professional annotators audit every translation for fidelity and native style and rewrite fifteen percent on average
Use an LLM to flag potential sensitive content and humans to remove actual sensitive prompts
Release 4,501 conversations, each with three user turns, across eight languages

第 2 和第 3 轮各从 30 类指令中采样一类并让 Llama 3.1 405B 根据既往提示生成自然后续提示
用 Llama 3.1 405B 扫描跨轮指令冲突后由人工移除矛盾提示
用 Llama 3.1 405B 把黄金英文集合翻译为法语印地语意大利语葡萄牙语中文西班牙语和俄语
跳过不适用于目标语言的约束
由多语言专业标注员审核每条翻译的忠实度和母语风格并平均重写 15%
用 LLM 标记潜在敏感内容后由人工删除确有敏感内容的提示
发布覆盖八种语言的 4,501 段对话且每段含三轮用户输入

Compute instruction-level strict and loose Accuracy and conversation-level strict and loose Accuracy
Average the four scores as the final metric for each turn and language
Report turn-wise and language-wise performance for fourteen leading models
evaluation_steps_zh: 生成第一轮回答并在每个后续轮次前拼接既往提示和回答
计算指令级严格和宽松准确率以及对话级严格和宽松准确率

evidence_summary_en: Multi-LogiEval separately composes propositional and first-order versus non-monotonic reasoning chains at depths one through five, uses Claude-2 to naturalize them, manually corrects every item, and retains 1,552 binary entailment examples for zero-shot-CoT Accuracy evaluation.

construction_steps_en: Catalog propositional, first-order, and non-monotonic logic ingredients including core PL/FOL rules and eight NM patterns
Use single rules at depth one and chain PL/FOL rules by feeding each conclusion into a later premise
Create 71 monotonic rule combinations covering depths two through five
Create non-monotonic depth-one examples from eight patterns and mix one NM rule with classical logic for deeper chains
Manually define 12, 2, 2, and 1 non-monotonic combinations for depths two, three, four, and five
Use Claude-2 few-shot prompts with rule, format, diversity, task, and example components to generate context-question pairs
Replace symbolic labels with real entities across diverse ontologies and derive yes or no answers
Manually check logical relations, correct story errors, grammar, and typos, and select or update high-quality items
Release 1,552 items: 525 PL, 535 FOL, and 492 NM, with exact depth and answer distributions
construction_steps_zh: 整理命题一阶和非单调逻辑构件包括核心 PL/FOL 规则与八种 NM 模式

创建覆盖深度二至五的 71 种单调逻辑组合
从八种模式生成深度一非单调数据并在更深链中把一条 NM 规则与经典逻辑混合
为深度二三四五人工定义 12 2 2 和 1 种非单调组合
用包含规则格式多样性任务与示例的 Claude-2 少样本提示生成上下文问题对
用不同概念集合中的真实实体替换符号标签并推导是或否答案
人工检查逻辑关系修正故事错误语法与拼写并筛选或改写高质量数据
发布 1,552 条数据包括 PL 525 FOL 535 和 NM 492 且保留精确深度与答案分布

Parse each model's yes or no prediction and compute Accuracy
Report Accuracy separately by propositional, first-order, and non-monotonic logic and by depth one through five
Inspect generated reasoning chains to analyze execution and error propagation

解析每个模型的是或否预测并计算准确率
按命题一阶非单调逻辑和深度一至五分别报告准确率
