source_locator: arXiv:2501.17399 Sections 3-5 and Appendix A; ekwinox117/multi-challenge official repository
evidence_summary_en: MultiChallenge uses MMSE Planner, User, and randomly sampled frontier Responder agents to generate failure-driven conversations, applies human editing plus two independent review layers and an at-least-three-of-six failure gate, and releases 273 conversations with final-response-only binary rubrics.
evidence_summary_zh: MultiChallenge 用 MMSE 的规划用户与随机采样前沿回答智能体生成失败驱动对话，再经人工编辑两层独立复核和至少六个模型中三个失败的门槛，发布 273 段带仅依赖最终回答二元量表的对话。
construction_steps_en: Define instruction retention, inference memory, reliable versioned editing, and self-coherence challenge categories
Sample hierarchical topic seeds, PersonaHub personas, and five-part category evaluation configurations
Have the Planner agent create a conversation blueprint and the User agent realize it as natural user turns
Randomly sample one of six frontier LLMs as the Responder agent for each candidate
After every response have the Planner detect the category failure or update the blueprint and continue
Save candidates when a failure occurs and discard conversations that reach the maximum turn limit without failure
Have humans check category fit and naturalness and require at least three of six frontier models to fail reasonably
Edit or reject unsatisfactory candidates and require two additional review layers from a distinct reviewer pool
Release 273 conversations with exact category counts, average five turns, at most ten turns, and average 1,231.7 words
Have humans write one judge-answerable binary rubric question per item using only the final response as context
construction_steps_zh: 定义指令保持推断记忆可靠版本编辑和自洽性四类挑战
采样分层主题 PersonaHub 画像和五部分的类别评测配置
由规划智能体创建对话蓝图并由用户智能体实现为自然用户消息
为每个候选从六个前沿 LLM 中随机采样一个回答智能体
每次回答后由规划智能体检测类别失败或更新蓝图并继续
发生失败时保存候选达到最大轮次仍未失败时丢弃对话
由人工检查类别匹配和自然度并要求六个前沿模型中至少三个合理失败
修改或拒绝不合格候选并由完全不同的复核池再完成两层审核
发布 273 段保留精确类别计数平均五轮最多十轮且平均 1,231.7 词的对话
由人工为每条数据编写只用最终回答且裁判可回答的二元量表问题
evaluation_steps_en: Generate a target model's final response from the complete multi-turn conversation history
Use GPT-4o or Claude to answer the item-specific binary rubric from only that final response
Convert each rubric judgment to pass or fail and report Accuracy overall and by challenge category
Compare frontier and open models and report 93.95 percent alignment between the automatic method and experienced human raters
evaluation_steps_zh: 让目标模型根据完整多轮对话历史生成最终回答
让 GPT-4o 或 Claude 只根据最终回答回答该条实例专属二元量表
把每次量表判断转为通过或失败并报告总体和各挑战类别准确率
比较前沿与开源模型并报告自动方法与资深人工评审 93.95% 的一致率

evidence_summary_en: MultiMedQA combines six existing English medical QA datasets with 3,375 newly curated HealthSearchQA questions, then evaluates four multiple-choice groups by exact accuracy and 140 long-form answers through blinded review by nine clinicians.
evidence_summary_zh: MultiMedQA 汇集六个既有英文医疗问答数据集与新整理的 3,375 条 HealthSearchQA 问题，再以精确准确率评测四组多选任务，并由九名临床医生盲评 140 道长回答。
construction_steps_en: Define a broad medical QA suite spanning professional exams, biomedical research, and consumer health questions
Select MedQA, MedMCQA, PubMedQA, six MMLU clinical topics, LiveQA, and MedicationQA as six existing dataset components
Preserve each source dataset format, split, and answer convention rather than forcing heterogeneous references into one schema
Seed consumer-health topics with medical conditions and associated symptoms that reflect real search concerns
Query public search suggestions and curate 3,375 commonly searched questions into HealthSearchQA
Assemble the seven-dataset suite while keeping multiple-choice, context-grounded, and free-text tasks distinct
construction_steps_zh: 定义覆盖专业考试生物医学研究和消费者健康问题的广泛医疗问答套件
选择 MedQA MedMCQA PubMedQA MMLU 六个临床主题 LiveQA 和 MedicationQA 作为六个既有组成
保留每个来源的数据格式划分和答案约定而不强行统一异构参考答案
以医疗状况和相关症状设置反映真实搜索关切的消费者健康主题
查询公开搜索建议并整理 3,375 条常见问题形成 HealthSearchQA
汇编七数据集套件并区分多选带上下文和自由文本任务
evaluation_steps_en: Score MedQA, MedMCQA, PubMedQA, and MMLU clinical topics by exact option accuracy
Compare few-shot, chain-of-thought, and 11-path self-consistency prompting for PaLM and Flan-PaLM
Sample a disjoint long-form set of 100 HealthSearchQA, 20 LiveQA, and 20 MedicationQA questions
Collect qualified clinician references and generate model answers with answer sources hidden from raters
Have nine clinicians from the United States, United Kingdom, and India rate consensus, reasoning, completeness, harm, bias, relevance, and helpfulness
Report per-dataset accuracy and bootstrap human-rating intervals against clinician answers
evaluation_steps_zh: 对 MedQA MedMCQA PubMedQA 和 MMLU 临床主题按选项精确准确率评分
比较 PaLM 与 Flan-PaLM 的少样本思维链和 11 路径自一致性提示
抽取与提示调优不相交的 100 条 HealthSearchQA 20 条 LiveQA 和 20 条 MedicationQA 长回答样本
收集合格临床医生参考答案并生成模型回答且向评审隐藏答案来源
由来自美国英国和印度的九名医生评判共识推理完整性伤害偏见相关性和有用性
报告各数据集准确率及相对临床医生回答的人工评分 bootstrap 区间

source_locator: arXiv:2511.16940v3 Sections 3.3-3.5 and Appendices B, D, E, and H; CyberChangAn/MultiPriv-PII official repository
evidence_summary_en: MultiPriv defines 36 fine-grained privacy attributes in seven categories, curates attribute evidence and 40 fully synthetic individual profiles into 1,119 images and 7,414 bilingual VQA pairs, and evaluates four perception plus five reasoning tasks with hierarchical metrics and separate refusal reporting.
evidence_summary_zh: MultiPriv 定义七大类 36 个细粒度隐私属性，将属性证据和 40 个全合成个体档案整理为 1,119 张图像与 7,414 条双语 VQA，并用四项感知任务和五项推理任务及分层指标评测。
construction_steps_en: Build a GDPR- and CCPA-grounded taxonomy with seven categories and 36 fine-grained attributes
Filter licensed public attribute sources and exclude ambiguous visual privacy categories
Curate attribute-level images from public sources and controlled synthesis with approximately 18 percent generated by Doubao
Create 40 fully synthetic textual profiles spanning identity, finance, health, travel, and other attributes without real identifiable people
Establish stable links between profile attributes and identity records across documents
Generate or edit ten coherent multimodal records per synthetic individual using controlled tools and templates
Design four perception tasks and five reasoning tasks across Chinese and English
Assemble 1,119 images and 7,414 manually designed bilingual VQA pairs
construction_steps_zh: 依据 GDPR 与 CCPA 构建七大类 36 个细粒度属性分类体系
筛选许可公开属性来源并排除含义模糊的视觉隐私类别
从公开来源和受控合成整理属性级图像其中约 18% 由豆包生成
创建 40 个涵盖身份金融健康出行等属性且不包含真实可识别个体的全合成文本档案
建立档案属性与身份记录跨文档的稳定关联
用受控工具和模板为每个合成个体生成或编辑十条一致的多模态记录
设计中英文四项感知任务和五项推理任务
汇编 1,119 张图像与 7,414 条人工设计双语 VQA
evaluation_steps_en: Verify 93 percent of ground truth by deterministic rule matching and the remaining 7 percent with Qwen2.5-72B plus human confirmation
Evaluate more than 50 VLMs spanning five commercial, 30 foundation, and 18 reasoning models
Score perception with recognition F1, identity exact match, and region mIoU
Score reasoning with mean accuracy, completion percentages, and re-identification or cross-modal completion
Aggregate bilingual hierarchical risk metrics and report safety refusals separately as mitigation rather than successful privacy extraction
evaluation_steps_zh: 用确定性规则匹配验证 93% 标准答案其余 7% 由 Qwen2.5-72B 加人工确认
评测五个商业模型 30 个基础模型和 18 个推理模型等超过 50 个 VLM
用识别 F1 身份精确匹配和区域 mIoU 评测感知任务
用平均准确率完成百分比以及重识别或跨模态完成率评测推理任务
汇总双语分层风险指标并把安全拒答作为缓解情况单独报告而不视为成功隐私提取

evidence_summary_en: NOVA-63 uses a four-stage native-language pipeline for collection, LLM-assisted formatting and annotation, multi-model difficulty screening, and supplementation plus balancing, releasing 89,107 questions across 14 languages and 63 secondary disciplines.
evidence_summary_zh: NOVA-63 通过母语收集、LLM 辅助格式化与标注、多模型难度筛选、补充和均衡四阶段流程，发布覆盖 14 种语言与 63 个二级学科的 89,107 道问题。
construction_steps_en: Collect native-language questions from local educational websites, academic publications, and exams from secondary school through postgraduate level
Use in-context LLM extraction to normalize question, options, and answer fields and classify MCQ versus free-form QA
Manually verify extracted components and formatting while preserving native wording
Annotate readability, completeness, clarity, missing context, and academic hierarchy and discard any deficient item
Assign 13 primary, 63 secondary, and 262 tertiary disciplines plus recitation- or reasoning-based labels
Run small at-most-14B and large above-14B model screening and retain questions with large-model accuracy below 50 percent
Manually review suspicious small-versus-large accuracy reversals and concentrated wrong-option cases
Convert 2,425 hard QA items to MCQ using model errors as distractors and manually review every conversion
Perform final native review for relevance, fluency, originality, completeness, and translation artifacts
Balance every language-discipline cell to at least 50 and at most 150 questions
Release 89,107 native questions across 14 languages, eight language families, and 63 secondary disciplines
construction_steps_zh: 从本地教育网站学术出版物和考试收集中学至研究生层级的母语问题
用上下文示例驱动 LLM 抽取并规范题干选项答案且区分多选和自由问答
人工核验抽取组成和格式同时保留母语原始表达
标注可读性完整性清晰度缺失上下文和学科层级并删除任一不合格问题
分配 13 个一级 63 个二级 262 个三级学科及记忆型或推理型标签
用不超过 14B 的小模型和大于 14B 的大模型筛选并保留大模型准确率低于 50% 的问题
人工复核小模型与大模型准确率反转和错误选项过度集中的可疑问题
把 2,425 道困难问答用模型错误答案转为干扰项并人工复核每道转换题
由母语者最终检查相关性流畅度原创性完整性和翻译痕迹
把每个语言学科单元均衡到至少 50 题且至多 150 题
发布覆盖 14 种语言八个语系和 63 个二级学科的 89,107 道母语问题

Score exact selected options at the question level
Average accuracy by secondary and primary discipline and use the primary-discipline mean as the main score

在问题级按精确选项评分

source_locator: arXiv:2407.11963 Sections 3.1-3.2 and Appendices E-G; OpenCompass NeedleBench V2 official configuration README
evidence_summary_en: NeedleBench V2 constructs bilingual fictional needles for three information-sparse tasks and an information-dense Ancestral Trace Challenge, sweeping 4k to 1,000k contexts and 2 to 512 ATC needles with task-specific exact-match and effective-length metrics.
evidence_summary_zh: NeedleBench V2 为三项信息稀疏任务与信息密集祖先追溯挑战构造双语虚构针，覆盖 4k 至 1,000k 上下文和 ATC 2 至 512 条针，并采用任务专属精确匹配与有效长度指标。
construction_steps_en: Generate fictional facts and kinship relations with randomized names and templates to avoid pretrained factual overlap
Build English sparse haystacks from PaulGrahamEssays and Chinese haystacks from ChineseDomainModelingEval
Instantiate single-needle retrieval, multi-needle retrieval, and fictional-kinship multi-needle reasoning with two to five facts
Sweep 4k, 8k, 32k, 128k, 200k, 256k, and 1,000k contexts across controlled depths with ten repetitions and tokenizer buffers
For the dense task sample n plus one unique names, assign parent weight one and grandparent weight two, vary templates, and shuffle relations
Compute graph ground truth for eldest, nth ancestor, nth descendant, and relation-distance questions
Generate bilingual ATC configurations at powers of two from 2 to 512 needles with every sentence relevant
construction_steps_zh: 用随机姓名和模板生成虚构事实与亲属关系以避免预训练事实重叠
用 PaulGrahamEssays 构建英文稀疏干草并用 ChineseDomainModelingEval 构建中文干草
实例化单针检索多针检索和含 2 至 5 条事实的虚构亲属多针推理
在受控深度和十次重复下扫描 4k 8k 32k 128k 200k 256k 和 1,000k 上下文并设置分词缓冲
信息密集任务采样 n 加一个唯一姓名设置父母权重一祖父母权重二并变换模板和打乱关系
为最长辈第 n 代祖先第 n 代后裔和关系距离问题计算图结构标准答案
按 2 到 512 条针的二次幂配置生成每句均相关的双语 ATC
evaluation_steps_en: Score sparse predictions by keyword-aware exact match with full credit when any predefined keyword appears
Average sparse scores across context length, depth, and ten repetitions and then equally average the three sparse tasks
Extract ATC answers from boxed output and compute exact match weighted by needle count
Report sparse and dense results separately and use ENL-50 to summarize effective continuous-reasoning length
evaluation_steps_zh: 用关键词感知精确匹配评分稀疏任务命中任一预定义关键词即满分
跨上下文长度深度和十次重复平均稀疏分数再等权平均三项稀疏任务
从 boxed 输出抽取 ATC 答案并按针数量加权计算精确匹配
分别报告稀疏和密集结果并用 ENL-50 概括有效连续推理长度

evidence_summary_en: NExT-QA selects interaction-rich VidOR videos, runs one year of three-stage human annotation with 100 trained undergraduates, and releases 52,044 QA pairs over 5,440 videos plus 47,692 manually checked five-option questions.
evidence_summary_zh: NExT-QA 筛选交互丰富的 VidOR 视频，由 100 名受训本科生用一年完成三阶段人工标注，最终发布 5,440 个视频上的 52,044 条问答及 47,692 道人工复核五选一题。
construction_steps_en: Select 6,000 longer interaction-rich VidOR videos sourced from YFCC-100M and split them 7:1:2 by video
Run causal, then temporal, then descriptive annotation over one year with 100 trained undergraduates under supervision
Separate question and answer annotator roles so answerers fix or delete bad questions
Require questions to rely on visible objective evidence and target at most 22 question words and six answer words
Remove boring videos, balance yes and no answers in validation and test, and delete counting answers above 20
Retain 5,440 videos and 52,044 QA pairs with 3,870 train, 570 validation, and 1,000 test videos
For nonbinary multiple choice group questions by type and retrieve the top 50 similar questions using Sentence-BERT
Use their answers as candidates, remove lemma duplicates and similarities above 0.9, and retain hard negatives above 0.2
Sample four distractors, insert the correct answer evenly, and manually check or amend every five-option tuple
Release 47,692 multiple-choice questions alongside all 52,044 open-ended QA pairs
construction_steps_zh: 从 YFCC-100M 来源的 VidOR 中选择 6,000 个更长且交互丰富的视频并按视频 7:1:2 划分
由 100 名受训本科生在监督下用一年依次完成因果时序和描述三阶段标注
分离提问者与回答者角色由回答者修复或删除不合格问题
要求问题依赖可见客观证据并以最多 22 个问题词和六个答案词为目标
删除无聊视频平衡验证和测试集的是否答案并删除大于 20 的计数答案
保留 5,440 个视频与 52,044 条问答其中训练 3,870 验证 570 测试 1,000 个视频
对非二元多选按题型分组并用 Sentence-BERT 检索最相似的 50 个问题
把其答案作为候选删除词元重复和相似度高于 0.9 的项并保留高于 0.2 的困难负例
采样四个干扰项均匀插入正确答案并人工检查或修改每个五选一元组
发布 47,692 道多选题并保留全部 52,044 条开放式问答
evaluation_steps_en: Score five-option multiple-choice questions by exact-choice accuracy and report causal, temporal, and descriptive subsets
For open-ended answers remove stop words, lemmatize, and compute WUPS semantic similarity while using accuracy for binary and counting questions
Compare visual and blind baselines and report human performance for context
evaluation_steps_zh: 用精确选项准确率评测五选一题并分别报告因果时序和描述子集
开放式回答删除停用词并词形还原后计算 WUPS 语义相似度二元和计数问题使用准确率
比较视觉与盲答基线并报告人类表现作为参照

source_locator: arXiv:2010.05444 Sections 3–4 and Appendices E and G; current CLUEbenchmark/OCNLI repository
evidence_summary_en: OCNLI collects 56,486 original-Chinese premise-hypothesis pairs from five written and spoken genres through four controlled elicitation strategies, verifies subsets with five labels and majority vote, creates about 50k/3k/3k train/dev/test splits, and evaluates Chinese NLI models and an independent human sample by accuracy.
evidence_summary_zh: OCNLI 从五种书面与口语原生中文体裁出发，经四种受控假设生成策略收集 56,486 个前提—假设对，以五标签多数投票复核子集，形成约 50k/3k/3k 的训练/开发/测试划分，并以准确率评测中文 NLI 模型与独立人工样本。
construction_steps_en: Collect original Chinese premises from government reports, news, two novels, TV talk shows, and telephone conversations
Remove Callhome annotation symbols and keep premise sentences containing 8–50 Chinese characters
Recruit 145 native Chinese undergraduate and graduate students majoring in Chinese or other languages
Adapt the MNLI entailment-neutral-contradiction protocol and cap hypothesis-premise lexical overlap at 70%
Collect SINGLE 11,986, MULTI 12,328, MULTI ENCOURAGE 16,584, and MULTI CONSTRAINT 15,627 pairs
Combine the four elicitation subsets into 56,486 original-Chinese premise-hypothesis pairs
Relabel roughly 15% per subset with four independent labels plus the writer label and assign majority-vote gold, marking no-majority cases as -
Randomize 6,000 verified MULTI ENCOURAGE/CONSTRAINT pairs into balanced 3,000-item dev and test sets and retain about 50,000 training pairs
Release the main training data and a roughly 30,000-pair premise-nonoverlap train.small variant
construction_steps_zh: 从政府报告新闻两部小说电视谈话节目和电话对话收集原生中文前提句
移除 Callhome 标注符号并保留 8 至 50 个汉字的前提句
招募 145 名中文母语且主修中文或其他语言的本科生和研究生
改编 MNLI 的蕴含中立矛盾协议并将假设与前提词汇重叠限制为不超过 70%
分别收集 SINGLE 11,986 条 MULTI 12,328 条 MULTI ENCOURAGE 16,584 条和 MULTI CONSTRAINT 15,627 条
合并四种生成子集形成 56,486 个原生中文前提—假设对
每个子集约抽取 15% 由四人独立复标并加入原撰写者标签，以多数票定标准标签且无多数票标为 -
从已复标的 MULTI ENCOURAGE/CONSTRAINT 随机取 6,000 条平衡划为各 3,000 条的开发集和测试集并保留约 50,000 条训练数据
发布主训练集及约 30,000 条且前提不重叠的 train.small 版本
evaluation_steps_en: Check that three or more of the five labels agree on 98.3–98.8% of relabeled pairs
Train CBOW, biLSTM, ESIM, Chinese BERT-base, and Chinese RoBERTa-large baselines
Report accuracy on the 3,000-item development and test sets
Ask five new undergraduate native Chinese speakers to label a random 300-item test sample
Compare 90.3% human accuracy with 78.2% RoBERTa accuracy and report the roughly 12-point gap
evaluation_steps_zh: 检查已复标样本中至少三票一致率达到 98.3% 至 98.8%
训练 CBOW biLSTM ESIM 中文 BERT-base 与中文 RoBERTa-large 基线
在各 3,000 条的开发集和测试集上报告准确率
请五名未参与前序实验的中文母语本科生标注随机 300 条测试样本
比较人工 90.3% 与 RoBERTa 78.2% 的准确率并报告约 12 个百分点差距

visual_review.result: Both 1673 by 509 SVGs preserve the five genres, exact four-subset counts, verification contract, splits, baselines, and human comparison without clipping, overlap, connector-node crossings, missing nodes, or bilingual topology drift.

source_locator: arXiv:2305.07895 Sections 3.1 and 3.3 and Appendix A; current Yuliang-Liu/MultimodalOCR repository
evidence_summary_en: OCRBench consolidates a broad 29-dataset OCR study into 1,000 manually filtered and corrected items spanning 300 recognition, 200 scene VQA, 200 document VQA, 200 KIE, and 100 HMER examples, then sums gold-containment correctness across the five components to a maximum score of 1,000.
evidence_summary_zh: OCRBench 将覆盖 29 个数据集的广泛 OCR 研究压缩为 1,000 条人工筛选校正样本，包括 300 条文本识别、200 条场景 VQA、200 条文档 VQA、200 条 KIE 和 100 条 HMER，并将五组件的标准答案包含式正确数相加为最高 1,000 分。
construction_steps_en: Integrate 29 OCR-related datasets across text recognition, scene text VQA, document VQA, KIE, and HMER
Create 3,000-image Semantic Text and Non-Semantic Text controls from the IIIT5K dictionary by shuffling the same characters
For the broad study, sample 3,000 instances from large datasets and remove answers shorter than four symbols to reduce containment false positives
Standardize task-specific prompts for English, Chinese, digit strings, KIE keys, and LaTeX HMER output
Select 300 recognition items: regular, irregular, artistic, handwriting, digit string, and non-semantic with 50 each
Select 200 scene-text VQA and 200 document VQA items from four 50-item sources each
Select 200 KIE items split SROIE 67, FUNSD 66, and POIE 67 plus 100 HME100K HMER items
Manually verify and correct all 1,000 QA pairs and add alternative correct answer candidates
Release the five-component 1,000-item compact OCRBench
construction_steps_zh: 整合 29 个 OCR 相关数据集并覆盖文本识别场景文本 VQA 文档 VQA KIE 与 HMER
从 IIIT5K 词典制作各 3,000 张的语义文本与同字符打乱的非语义文本对照集
在广泛实验中从大型数据集各抽取 3,000 条并移除少于四个符号的答案以降低包含判断误报
为英文中文数字串 KIE 键和 LaTeX HMER 输出统一任务专属提示
选择 300 条文本识别样本并在规则不规则艺术字手写数字串非语义六类中各取 50 条
从四个来源各取 50 条形成 200 条场景文本 VQA 并同样形成 200 条文档 VQA
选择 SROIE 67 条 FUNSD 66 条 POIE 67 条共 200 条 KIE 以及 100 条 HME100K HMER
人工核验校正全部 1,000 个问答对并补充其他正确答案候选
发布五组件 1,000 条紧凑版 OCRBench
evaluation_steps_en: Run large multimodal models zero-shot with each image and task-specific prompt
Prefix KIE prompts with the instruction to answer directly using text in the image
Treat an item as correct when a gold or alternative answer appears in the free-form model response
Count correct items separately for recognition, scene VQA, document VQA, KIE, and HMER
Sum component counts to report the final OCRBench score from 0 to 1,000
evaluation_steps_zh: 将图像与任务专属提示输入大多模态模型执行零样本推理
在 KIE 提示前加入直接使用图中文字回答的指令
当标准答案或其他正确候选出现在自由文本回答中时判定该题正确
分别统计文本识别场景 VQA 文档 VQA KIE 与 HMER 的正确数
相加五组件正确数并报告 0 至 1,000 的 OCRBench 最终分数

visual_review.result: Both 1673 by 509 SVGs preserve the distinction between the 29-dataset study and the exact 1,000-item five-component release, manual answer correction, prompt rules, containment judging, and 1,000-point score without clipping, overlap, connector-node crossings, missing nodes, or bilingual topology drift.

source_locator: arXiv:2501.00321 Sections 3–5 and Appendices A.2–A.6; current Yuliang-Liu/MultimodalOCR repository and OCRBench v2 project
evidence_summary_en: OCRBench v2 screens 81 datasets and added private data into a bilingual, single-image benchmark with 10,000 public QA pairs and a withheld 1,500-image private set across 31 scenarios, 23 tasks, and eight capabilities, using task-routed structural, localization, extraction, reading, counting, and VQA metrics.
evidence_summary_zh: OCRBench v2 筛选 81 个数据集并补充私有数据，构建覆盖 31 个场景、23 项任务和八类能力的双语单图基准，包含 10,000 个公开问答和 1,500 张不公开私有图像，并按任务路由结构定位抽取长文本计数与 VQA 指标。
construction_steps_en: Manually harvest and screen 81 text-rich academic datasets and add private data for missing practical scenarios
Limit the benchmark to bilingual single-image text tasks across 31 scenarios
Define 23 tasks grouped into recognition, referring, spotting, extraction, parsing, calculation, understanding, and reasoning
Convert source annotations into task-specific QA instructions and include Markdown, JSON, or LaTeX output examples for structured tasks
Normalize localization coordinates by image dimensions and scale them to 0–1,000
Manually annotate added images to complete task and scenario coverage
Review every public instruction and correct about 1% annotation errors
Release 10,000 human-verified public QA pairs over 7,400 English and 2,600 Chinese images
Separately collect and annotate 1,500 private images over the same 23 tasks and keep them withheld for leaderboard evaluation
construction_steps_zh: 人工收集筛选 81 个文本密集型学术数据集并以私有数据补齐实际场景
将范围限制为覆盖 31 个场景的双语单图文本任务
定义识别指代端到端检测抽取解析计算理解推理八类能力下的 23 项任务
将来源标注转为任务专属问答指令并为结构任务提供 Markdown JSON 或 LaTeX 输出示例
按图像尺寸归一化定位坐标并缩放到 0 至 1,000
人工标注新增图像以补齐任务与场景覆盖
审核每条公开指令并修正约 1% 的标注错误
发布基于 7,400 张英文图和 2,600 张中文图的 10,000 个经人工核验的公开问答
另行收集标注覆盖同一 23 项任务的 1,500 张私有图像并不公开以用于排行榜评测
evaluation_steps_en: Run each LMM on one image and its task-specific instruction and parse the required output format
Use TEDS for parsing, IoU for localization, and F1 for relation extraction
For long reading, average BLEU, METEOR, F1, and normalized edit distance
Use exact match for character counting and normalized L1 for word counting
Use exact match for multiple choice, containment for answers shorter than five words, and ANLS for longer VQA answers
Compute the eight capability scores and report their average on a 0–100 scale
Compare public and private evaluation trends and maintain the private-set leaderboard
evaluation_steps_zh: 将单张图像与任务专属指令输入模型并解析要求的输出格式
解析任务使用 TEDS 定位任务使用 IoU 关系抽取使用 F1
长文本读取取 BLEU METEOR F1 与归一化编辑距离相似度的平均值
字符计数使用精确匹配且词数统计使用归一化 L1
选择题使用精确匹配少于五词的回答使用包含判断更长 VQA 回答使用 ANLS
计算八类能力分数并报告其 0 至 100 的平均值
比较公开与私有评测趋势并维护私有集排行榜

visual_review.result: Both 1673 by 509 SVGs preserve the 81-source screen, single-image bilingual scope, 31 scenarios, 23-task/eight-capability taxonomy, public/private split, coordinate contract, manual review, metric routing, and 100-point aggregation without clipping, overlap, connector-node crossings, missing nodes, or bilingual topology drift.

source_locator: arXiv:2509.24871 Section 4, Section 5.1, and Appendix C; current MCG-NJU/StreamForest repository
evidence_summary_en: ODV-Bench selects and verifies first-person videos from six autonomous-driving datasets, builds 6,322 multiple-choice QA pairs over 1,190 clips and twelve tasks in three scenario categories, and evaluates online models at 1 FPS using only frames available before each query timestamp.
evidence_summary_zh: ODV-Bench 从六个自动驾驶数据集中筛选并复核第一视角视频，在 1,190 段视频上构建覆盖三类场景十二项任务的 6,322 个多选问答，并以每秒一帧且只能使用查询时间戳之前帧的方式评测在线模型。
construction_steps_en: Curate six first-person autonomous-driving datasets spanning routine driving, hazards, and accidents across countries
Select task-relevant clips through existing-annotation filtering, YOLO detection, and manual inspection
Convert strong source labels directly or generate coarse VLLM-plus-YOLO meta-annotations with spatiotemporal and semantic detail
Apply structured human verification to correct and finalize meta-annotations
Define six static-target tasks, three dynamic-target tasks, and three multi-agent event tasks
Fill task-specific templates from verified annotations and create two-to-four-choice questions with plausible option-pool distractors
Run multiple manual review rounds for question clarity, answer accuracy, and distractor plausibility
Sample proportionally to video length to balance scenarios and task types
Release 1,190 unique 5–90-second clips and 6,322 QA pairs with an average query timestamp of 18.9 seconds
construction_steps_zh: 汇集六个跨国家且覆盖日常驾驶危险与事故的第一视角自动驾驶数据集
通过已有标注筛选 YOLO 检测与人工检查选择任务相关视频
直接转换高质量来源标签或使用 VLLM 加 YOLO 生成含时空与语义细节的粗元标注
通过结构化人工核验修正并确定元标注
定义六项静态目标任务三项动态目标任务和三项多智能体事件任务
将已核验标注填入任务模板并从选项池加入合理干扰项形成二至四选项问题
执行多轮人工复审以检查问题清晰度答案准确性与干扰项合理性
按视频长度比例抽样以平衡场景和任务类型
发布 1,190 段独立且长度 5 至 90 秒的视频和 6,322 个问答且平均查询时间为 18.9 秒
evaluation_steps_en: Process each streaming video at 1 FPS
For each query, expose only frames available at or before its timestamp
Answer every two-to-four-option multiple-choice question
Compute accuracy for each of the twelve tasks
Average task results into static-target, dynamic-target, and event-oriented category scores
Report overall accuracy across all 6,322 questions, equivalently weighting category accuracy by question count
evaluation_steps_zh: 以每秒一帧处理每段流式视频
对每个问题只提供其时间戳及之前已经到达的帧
回答每个含二至四个选项的多选问题
分别计算十二项任务准确率
将任务结果汇总为静态目标动态目标与事件导向三类分数
在全部 6,322 个问题上报告总体准确率等价于按问题数加权三类准确率

visual_review.result: Both 1673 by 509 SVGs preserve the semi-automatic video and annotation pipeline, exact 247/1,639, 162/2,973, and 781/1,710 category counts, twelve tasks, QA quality controls, final scale, causal 1-FPS protocol, and hierarchical accuracy without clipping, overlap, connector-node crossings, missing nodes, or bilingual topology drift.

source_locator: arXiv:2506.10481 Sections 3–5 and Appendices A.4 and A.9–A.10; current AGI-Eval/OIBench release
evidence_summary_en: OIBench commissions 250 unpublished bilingual Olympiad-in-Informatics problems from experienced coaches, verifies robust tests and canonical C++ solutions with contest participants and translators, and evaluates zero-shot programs in four languages by all-tests-correct accepted rate plus time/space completion curves.
evidence_summary_zh: OIBench 由资深教练命制 250 道从未公开的双语信息学奥赛题，通过竞赛参与者和翻译人员复核高强度测试及 C++ 标准解，并以四种语言零样本程序的全测试通过率和时间/空间完成曲线评测。
construction_steps_en: Ask experienced ACM-ICPC and OI coaches to select from private repositories or author new problems
Require every problem to be original and unpublished and reject cosmetic adaptations of known problems
Assign Codeforces-style difficulty and competition-level tags
Create large, resource-intensive, and edge-focused official test cases
Provide a canonical C++ solution and execute it against all tests to confirm solvability and test correctness
Use six Informatics Olympiad participants to review clarity, solvability, sample input/output, and TeX/Markdown
Recruit professional translators and use a coach-and-contestant OI glossary to produce English versions
Search online and verify that no problem is directly retrievable as of the May 2025 release
Release 250 bilingual problems with tests, difficulty tags, canonical solutions, baseline responses, and reproduction information
construction_steps_zh: 请资深 ACM-ICPC 与 OI 教练从私有题库选择或原创命题
要求每题原创且从未公开并拒绝仅修改数值或表述的已知题改编
标注 Codeforces 风格难度和竞赛级别
编写覆盖大输入资源压力与边界情况的官方测试
提供 C++ 标准解并执行全部测试以确认可解性和测试正确性
由六名信息学奥赛参赛者复审表述可解性样例输入输出以及 TeX/Markdown
招募专业翻译并使用教练与参赛者共建的 OI 术语表制作英文版本
联网检索并确认截至 2025 年 5 月发布时没有题目可被直接查到
发布 250 道双语题及测试难度标签标准解基线回答和复现信息
evaluation_steps_en: Prompt models zero-shot with the full problem and OJ input/output format in C++, Java, Python, and JavaScript
Allow up to 32,768 inference tokens for reasoning models
Use greedy temperature-zero decoding except temperature 0.6 for DeepSeek-R1 and Qwen3-32B
Compile and execute generated programs in fixed Docker runtimes while monitoring time and memory
Mark a problem accepted only when the generated program passes every official test case
Report overall and per-programming-language AC rates plus Chinese-versus-English results
Plot time and space completion curves as ratios to canonical-solution resource use
Optionally evaluate the paper’s pseudocode and four code-understanding derived tracks separately from the main OIBench score
evaluation_steps_zh: 将完整题面与 OJ 输入输出格式输入模型并以 C++ Java Python JavaScript 四种语言零样本生成
推理模型最多允许生成 32,768 个 token
默认使用温度 0 的贪心解码但 DeepSeek-R1 与 Qwen3-32B 使用温度 0.6
在固定 Docker 运行时编译执行生成程序并监控时间和内存
仅当生成程序通过某题全部官方测试时才将该题判为通过
报告总体与各编程语言 AC 率以及中文和英文题面结果
以相对标准解资源使用比例绘制时间与空间完成曲线
将论文中的伪代码轨道与四项代码理解派生轨道作为主 OIBench 分数之外的独立评测

visual_review.result: Both 1673 by 509 SVGs preserve the expert private authoring contract, originality gate, difficulty/tests/canonical-solution checks, six-participant review, professional bilingual translation, pre-release search, 250-item release, four-language Docker execution, all-tests-correct grading, and efficiency curves without clipping, overlap, connector-node crossings, missing nodes, or bilingual topology drift.

source_locator: arXiv:2601.10343 Sections 3–5 and appendix; official MiniMaxAI/OctoBench dataset card
evidence_summary_en: OctoBench packages seven instruction-source families into 34 executable environments, expands 72 human seeds to 217 tasks, derives 7,098 binary checks from 16 reference rollouts per task with joint audit, and grades normalized full trajectories with three judges using ISR and CSR.
evidence_summary_zh: OctoBench 将七类指令源打包为 34 个可执行环境，把 72 个人工种子扩展到 217 个任务，基于每题 16 次参考运行与联合审计形成 7,098 项二元检查，并由三评审在规范化完整轨迹上计算 ISR 与 CSR。
construction_steps_en: Collect repository policies, skill documents, system and user prompts, memory, tool schemas, and reminders
Normalize constraint artifacts and package repositories plus persistent state into self-contained Docker environments
Instantiate Claude Code, Kilo, and Droid scaffolds
Manually author 72 seed instances under activation, verifiability, and feasibility constraints
Use model-assisted evolution to expand and validate 217 instances
Run GPT-5.1 in 16 independent rollouts per task and record normalized reference trajectories
Propose atomic evidence-backed binary success or failure checks from every present instruction source
Deduplicate and harmonize checks, then perform joint human-LLM review, a 20% manual spot check, and stratified double-annotator audit
Release 34 environments, 217 tasks, and 7,098 checks, with a separate 32-instance conflict set
construction_steps_zh: 收集代码库策略技能文档系统与用户提示记忆工具模式和提醒
规范化约束工件并将代码库与持久状态打包为自包含 Docker 环境
实例化 Claude Code Kilo 与 Droid 三种脚手架
按激活性可核验性与可执行性约束人工编写 72 个种子实例
使用模型辅助演化扩展并验证 217 个实例
每个任务用 GPT-5.1 独立运行 16 次并记录规范化参考轨迹
从每个实际出现的指令源提出有证据支撑的原子二元成功或失败检查
去重统一检查项后执行人机联合复审20%人工抽查和分层双标注员审计
发布34个环境217个任务和7098项检查并另设32个冲突实例
evaluation_steps_en: Run candidate agents in the packaged environments with repository and tool access
Capture model responses and tool actions through the proxy logger
Normalize full logs into messages and tools while deduplicating and truncating without losing evidence
Have GPT-5.1, Claude Sonnet 4.5, and Gemini 3 Pro independently judge every applicable check
Average the three judge scores per check
Report ISR only when all applicable checks pass and CSR as check-level partial credit, including category views
evaluation_steps_zh: 在打包环境中给予代码库与工具访问并运行候选智能体
通过代理记录器捕获模型响应与工具动作
将完整日志规范为消息与工具格式并在保留证据的前提下去重截断

source_locator: arXiv:2603.08655 benchmark construction, quality-control, and evaluation methodology; official databricks/officeqa repository
evidence_summary_en: OfficeQA Full builds 246 grounded questions from 1939–2025 Treasury Bulletins after text-layer removal, human authoring, independent reproduction, adjudication, two agent-QA passes, and parametric-knowledge filtering, then labels 113 Easy and 133 Pro items using two frontier agents.

construction_steps_en: Assemble Treasury Bulletins from 1939–2025, totaling about 89,000 pages and more than 26M numeric values
Remove embedded text layers while preserving scans, tables, charts, prose, and changing historical layouts
Define realistic enterprise criteria requiring multi-step retrieval and analysis rather than trivia
Author seed questions and answers grounded in the corpus and scale annotation through SuperAnnotate and Turing
Review topical relevance and fiscal interpretation with USAFacts collaborators
Have a new annotator independently reproduce each answer and use a third annotator to adjudicate mismatches
Run two end-to-end agent-QA rounds and let humans inspect alternative answers, ambiguities, and incorrect gold labels
Use Claude Opus 4.5 and GPT-5.1 to remove questions answerable from parametric knowledge, retaining 246
Label questions both frontier agents solve from the parsed corpus as Easy and the remainder as Pro, yielding 113 Easy and 133 Pro

定义需要多步检索与分析而非琐碎事实的真实企业问题标准
人工编写语料落地种子问答并通过SuperAnnotate与Turing扩展标注
与USAFacts合作复核主题相关性和财政解释
由新标注员独立复现每个答案并在不一致时交由第三位标注员裁决
执行两轮端到端智能体问答并由人工检查替代答案歧义和错误标准答案
使用Claude Opus 4.5与GPT-5.1过滤可凭参数知识回答的问题并保留246题
两个前沿智能体都能基于解析语料答对的标为Easy其余标为Pro得到113比133

Generate answers in a full-corpus or oracle-pages setting
Normalize punctuation, mathematical symbols, abbreviations, and common text variants
Use exact match for unambiguous answers and absolute relative error for numeric answers with a default 0.0% threshold
Apply overlap and fuzzy rules to complex or non-numeric answers
Report deterministic accuracy over all 246 questions and by Easy versus Pro difficulty

复杂或非数值答案使用重叠与模糊匹配规则

source_locator: arXiv:1906.00067 Sections 3–4; official OK-VQA project and evaluation protocol
evidence_summary_en: OK-VQA samples COCO images, crowdsources knowledge-dependent questions and five answers, manually filters 86,700 candidates to 34,921, removes answer-frequency bias and zero agreement, then releases 14,055 questions over 14,031 images with category labels and the standard open-ended VQA score.
evidence_summary_zh: OK-VQA 抽取 COCO 图像并众包需要外部知识的问题和五个答案，人工把 86,700 个候选筛到 34,921 个，再消除答案频率偏差与零一致项，最终发布基于 14,031 张图像的 14,055 题及类别标签并采用开放式 VQA 分数。
construction_steps_en: Randomly sample visually complex images from the original COCO training and validation splits
Ask first-round MTurk workers to write image-related questions that require outside knowledge rather than simple detection or counting
Collect five independent open-ended answers per image-question pair in a second MTurk round
Manually remove counting, detection, ungrounded, or nonsensical questions, reducing 86,700 candidates to 34,921
Reduce answer-frequency bias by removing items whose modal answer occurs more than five times
Remove questions with zero inter-annotator answer agreement
Create 9,009 training and 5,046 test questions without adding a synthetic knowledge corpus
Have five workers assign one of ten knowledge categories and use plurality or Other
Release 14,055 questions over 14,031 images with five answers per question
construction_steps_zh: 从原始COCO训练与验证划分随机抽取视觉复杂图像
让第一轮MTurk标注员编写与图像相关且需要外部知识而非简单检测计数的问题
第二轮MTurk为每个图像问题对收集五个独立开放式答案
人工移除计数检测无依据或无意义问题把86700个候选降至34921个
删除众数答案出现超过五次的项目以降低答案频率偏差
删除标注员答案之间零一致的问题
构建9009道训练题与5046道测试题且不添加合成知识库
由五名标注员分配十类知识标签并采用多数标签或Other
发布基于14031张图像的14055个问题且每题五个答案
evaluation_steps_en: Present each image and question and ask for an open answer without multiple-choice options
Normalize answer morphology and apply Porter stemming
Duplicate each of the five human answers to match the ten-answer VQA convention
Compute the standard agreement-based VQA score for every question
Report overall OK-VQA performance and scores for the ten knowledge categories plus Other

规范化答案词形并应用Porter词干化
将五个人工答案各重复一次以匹配十答案VQA约定
为每题计算标准的基于一致性的VQA分数
报告OK-VQA总体结果和十个知识类别及Other的分解分数

Measure signal-to-noise using the final 50 OLMo 2 13B checkpoints, ten comparable external checkpoints, and repeated preliminary runs
Expand noisy 1K subsets, remove BoolQ, separate CruxEval, and tune generative and pass@k sample counts
Add BasicSkills, Gen2MC, 17-language MBPP, and masked perplexity over chat data
Assemble the 43-task Base Easy and Base Main suite while reserving MMLU Pro, DeepMind Math, LBPP, and BigBench Hard as held-out before release

用最后50个OLMo 2 13B检查点10个同算力外部检查点及重复预备运行测量信噪比
扩展噪声较高的1K子集移除BoolQ拆分CruxEval并调整生成与pass@k样本数
加入BasicSkills Gen2MC 17语言MBPP和聊天数据掩码困惑度四类新组件
组装43任务Base Easy与Base Main并将MMLU Pro DeepMind Math LBPP和BigBench Hard作为发布前独立留出集

Use BPB over gold or human continuations for Base Easy proxies
Evaluate Base Main multiple-choice STEM, multiple-choice non-STEM, generative QA, math, code, and code-FIM clusters
Apply each task's accuracy, F1, BPB, or pass@k metric with tuned sampling
Macro-average task results within each capability cluster
Keep the four held-out benchmarks separate and unused for development before release

Select 20 internal tasks spanning performance regressions, anomalous training metrics, and subtle implementation bugs

Collect a diagnosis and root-cause explanation from one attempt
Grade the submitted solution with an internal method that is not publicly disclosed
Aggregate successful diagnoses over the 20 tasks as pass@1

Have GPT-4-turbo-2024-04-09, Llama-3-70B, and Gemini-1.5-Pro explain and classify every rewrite
Accept prompts judged safe by majority vote and hold the remainder for response-based recovery
Let Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 answer flagged prompts, reassess the responses, and recover prompts whose responses are safe
Release OR-Bench-80K from safe prompts and OR-Bench-Toxic from roughly 600 remaining harmful prompts
Select OR-Bench-Hard-1K from safe prompts rejected by at least three largest or newest models in each family

去除重复种子并保持类别覆盖
使用Mixtral 8x7B与五个少样本示例把每个种子改写为五条无害边界提示
禁止改写中出现显式安全合法提示词与虚构理论表达
由GPT-4-turbo-2024-04-09 Llama-3-70B与Gemini-1.5-Pro解释并分类每条改写
接纳多数票判安全的提示并暂存其余提示用于回答恢复
让Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3回答被拦提示复审回答并恢复回答安全的原提示
用安全提示发布OR-Bench-80K并用约600条其余有害提示发布OR-Bench-Toxic
从每个模型族最大或最新模型中至少三个拒答的安全提示选出OR-Bench-Hard-1K

Use GPT-4 to judge responses on OR-Bench-Hard-1K and OR-Bench-Toxic
Report rejection rate on benign prompts as over-refusal where lower is better
Report rejection rate on toxic prompts as safety where higher is better
Break results down over the ten refusal categories

evidence_summary_en: OSWorld derives 369 open-domain Ubuntu tasks from real computer-use cases, gives each a natural-language instruction, reproducible initial-state configuration, and custom example-wise execution evaluator, audits them in four rounds, and measures interactive agents in real virtual machines.

construction_steps_en: Build a scalable real-computer environment over virtual machines with headless and parallel execution
Gather real-world open-domain use cases involving common applications and websites
Cover web and desktop applications, OS file I/O, single-app work, and cross-app workflows
Annotate every example with a natural-language instruction describing the desired outcome
Write an initial-state setup configuration with files and setup actions, including intermediate states
Write a custom example-wise execution evaluator that inspects application state and result files
Compose the task evaluators from 134 reusable execution-based functions
Jointly revise positive and negative cases to reduce false activations and missing conditions

Release 369 Ubuntu tasks, including 268 single-app and 101 multi-app tasks, plus 43 Windows analysis tasks

在人类与基线实验中投入超过400人时完成四轮质量检查
发布369个Ubuntu任务其中268个单应用101个跨应用并另有43个Windows分析任务

Give the agent the task instruction plus screenshot, accessibility tree, or combined observations
Let the agent interact through mouse and keyboard actions until it stops or reaches the step limit
Retrieve files and application state and run any required post-processing
Execute the task-specific evaluator and aggregate execution-based task outcomes as success rate
Report the paper's human baseline and initial agent results under the original protocol
evaluation_steps_zh: 恢复虚拟机快照并执行任务初始态配置
向智能体提供任务指令及截图无障碍树或组合观察
允许智能体通过鼠标键盘操作直至停止或达到步数上限
获取文件与应用状态并运行所需后处理
执行逐题评测器并把基于执行的任务结果汇总为成功率

source_locator: arXiv:2505.13227 Section 2.1 and Appendix A.1; official xlang-ai/OSWorld-G repository
evidence_summary_en: OSWorld-G mines grounding failures from OSWorld model trajectories, has software experts pair 720p or 1080p screenshots with unambiguous instructions and precise boxes, validates them in real software and multiple review rounds, and releases 564 examples over five capabilities and 32 UI types.
evidence_summary_zh: OSWorld-G 从 OSWorld 模型轨迹挖掘定位失败，由软件专家为 720p 或 1080p 截图配无歧义指令与精确框，经真实软件及多轮复核后发布覆盖五类能力和 32 类 UI 元素的 564 个样例。
construction_steps_en: Collect trajectories from previous state-of-the-art models running in OSWorld
Gather grounding failure cases and categorize their primary capability requirements
Sample diverse 720p and 1080p screenshots from the failed screen states
Have software-experienced experts write descriptive low-level instructions with unique targets
Use CVAT to annotate precise bounding boxes for each instruction and screenshot pair
Include fine-grained regions sufficient for character-level editing and small controls
Verify annotations by executing intended interactions in the real software, especially edge cases
Run multiple verification rounds using preliminary and strong-model predictions to resolve inconsistencies
Write a refined paraphrase that decomposes required GUI knowledge while keeping the same target
Assign one or more of 32 fine-grained UI-type tags and release 564 examples including 54 refusal cases
construction_steps_zh: 收集先前先进模型在OSWorld中的运行轨迹
汇集GUI定位失败并按主要能力要求分类
从失败界面状态抽取多样的720p与1080p截图
由熟悉软件的专家编写目标唯一的描述性底层操作指令
使用CVAT为每个指令截图对标注精确边界框
纳入足以支持字符级编辑与小型控件的精细区域
在真实软件中执行目标交互以验证标注并重点检查边界案例
利用初步与强模型预测开展多轮复核并解决不一致
编写拆解所需GUI知识但保持同一目标的精炼改写指令
分配32类细粒度UI元素标签并发布含54个拒绝案例的564个样例
evaluation_steps_en: Present the screenshot and an original or knowledge-refined instruction without GUI code or API access
Ask the model to output an executable point or bounding-box action
For feasible actions, count a prediction as correct when its coordinate falls inside the annotated box
For infeasible instructions, evaluate whether the model appropriately refuses to act
Report overall accuracy and breakdowns by grounding capability and UI tag
evaluation_steps_zh: 在不开放GUI代码或API的情况下提供截图与原始或知识精炼指令
要求模型输出可执行的点或边界框动作
对可执行动作在预测坐标落入标注框时计为正确
对不可执行指令检查模型是否恰当拒绝操作
报告总体正确率以及按定位能力与UI标签的细分结果

source_locator: Official XLANG OSWorld-Verified report; original arXiv:2404.07972 foundation; official xlang-ai/OSWorld project
evidence_summary_en: OSWorld-Verified retains the original 369-task foundation, validates and fixes 300-plus reports with a minimally invasive evaluator-first policy, stabilizes volatile tasks and infrastructure, moves parallel runs to AWS, and reruns agents under a public verified protocol.
evidence_summary_zh: OSWorld-Verified 保留原 369 题基础，以优先修评测器的最小侵入原则核验并修复 300+ 条反馈，稳定易变任务与基础设施，迁移 AWS 并行运行并按公开验证协议复跑智能体。
construction_steps_en: Start from the original 369 OSWorld tasks after 15 months of community use
Collect approximately 300 issue reports from institutions and accessible community channels
Have a roughly ten-person team verify, validate, and repair the feedback over nearly two months
Triage web and access drift, time-sensitive tasks, instruction ambiguity, evaluator robustness, and system stability
Prefer evaluator repairs over task changes to preserve task and score continuity
Use URL and fuzzy web validation, environment-change flags, proxies, fixed IPs, or equivalent sites where needed
Clarify paths, formats, time windows, scope, and multiple valid outcomes only when task text must change
Add tolerant document, image, spreadsheet, formatting, color, unit, and case comparison logic
Stabilize synchronous operations, timing, VM images, fonts, media, and file hosting on Hugging Face
Migrate parallel evaluation to AWS with up to 50 environments and establish a unified public platform
construction_steps_zh: 从经历15个月社区使用的原369个OSWorld任务出发
从机构与所有可用社区渠道收集约300条问题反馈
由约十人团队用近两个月逐条核验确认并修复反馈
分类网页访问变化时间敏感任务指令歧义评测器鲁棒性与系统稳定性
为保持任务与分数连续性优先修复评测器而非任务本身
按需使用URL与模糊网页校验环境变化标记代理固定IP或等价网站
仅在必须改任务文本时澄清路径格式时间范围与多个有效结果
增加文档图像表格格式颜色单位与大小写的容错比较逻辑
稳定同步操作时序虚拟机镜像字体媒体以及Hugging Face文件托管
将并行评测迁至最多50环境的AWS并建立统一公开平台
evaluation_steps_en: Calibrate leading agent implementations through preliminary experiments
Run agents on the repaired 369-task set under unified infrastructure and settings
Evaluate multiple step budgets where the official reruns require them
Execute the corrected task-specific evaluators and retain monitoring data and trajectories
Publish verified success rates and comparable leaderboard results
Continue issue logging and review cycles as the maintained benchmark evolves
evaluation_steps_zh: 通过预备实验校准主流智能体实现
在统一基础设施与设置下运行修复后的369题集合
按官方复跑需要评测多种步数预算
执行修正后的逐题评测器并保留监控数据与轨迹
发布经验证成功率与可比榜单结果
随持续维护继续记录问题并开展复核周期

source_locator: arXiv:2501.00584 Sections 3.1-3.3 and 4.1-4.2; official MCG-NJU/VideoChat-Online project
evidence_summary_en: OVBench builds six online-video task types and 16 subtasks around past, current, and future contexts, curates leakage-aware source splits from six domains, creates about 7,000 human-reviewed spatiotemporal annotations over 1,463 videos, and evaluates models in sliding-window and streaming modes.
evidence_summary_zh: OVBench 围绕过去当前未来三种时间上下文构建六类任务和16个子任务，从六个领域整理防泄漏源数据，经人工时空标注与质检形成1,463个视频约7,000条标注，并用滑窗和流式模式评测。
construction_steps_en: Define past, current, and future temporal contexts for online video use
Formulate six task types and 16 subtasks spanning spatial and temporal perception, memory, hallucination checks, and future prediction
Curate task-aligned video collections from six real-world domains
Use validation and test splits from source datasets to reduce training-set leakage
Reuse detailed timestamps, bounding boxes, trajectories, actions, and object annotations where available
Have humans construct task-specific QA with spatiotemporal templates and query-time semantics
Generate typical-but-wrong distractors from other timestamps or objects in the same video
Manually check question clarity, option ambiguity, and annotation accuracy
Trim each video at the earliest relevant frame while preserving required context
Balance duration-proportional sampling, scene diversity, and task types and release 1,463 videos with about 7,000 annotations
construction_steps_zh: 为在线视频使用定义过去当前未来三种时间上下文
制定覆盖空间时间感知记忆幻觉检查与未来预测的六类任务和16个子任务
从六个真实领域整理与任务匹配的视频集合
只使用源数据集验证集与测试集以降低训练数据泄漏
在可用时复用精确时间戳边界框轨迹动作和对象标注
由人工按任务模板和查询时刻语义构造时空问答
从同视频其他时间戳或对象生成典型但错误的干扰项
人工检查问题清晰度选项歧义和标注准确性
在最早相关帧处裁剪视频并保留回答所需上下文
平衡按时长采样场景多样性和任务类型并发布1,463个视频约7,000条标注
evaluation_steps_en: Present offline models with a 32-second window before the query at 2 FPS
Stream video frames from the start to the query at 2 FPS for online models
Keep query timing and multiple-choice answer semantics consistent across modes
Score each answer by accuracy and aggregate results across the 16 subtasks
Report capability-level comparisons for the six task types
evaluation_steps_zh: 对离线模型以2 FPS提供查询前32秒滑动窗口
对在线模型以2 FPS从视频开头流式输入到查询时刻
在两种模式间保持查询时机和多选答案语义一致
按准确率判定每题并汇总16个子任务结果
报告六类任务的能力级比较

source_locator: arXiv:2501.05510 Sections 3.1-3.4 and 4.1; official JoeLeelyf/OVO-Bench project
evidence_summary_en: OVO-Bench organizes online long-video understanding into backward tracing, real-time visual perception, and forward active responding, uses human-AI collaborative timestamp and QA annotation with reviewed distractors, and releases 644 unique videos with 2,814 paper-release QA/meta-annotations across 12 tasks.
evidence_summary_zh: OVO-Bench 将在线长视频理解组织为后向追溯实时视觉感知和前向主动响应三种模式，通过人机协同时间戳问答标注与干扰项复核，发布644个独立视频和论文版2,814条问答或元标注共12类任务。
construction_steps_en: Define backward tracing, real-time visual perception, and forward active responding
Collect curated public-dataset videos and self-crawled YouTube videos across seven domains
Use validation or test splits and cover 12 tasks while preserving long-form online context
Collect event meta-annotations from existing precise labels, Gemini-1.5 coarse timestamps, and volunteers
Have humans refine timestamps, inspect source videos, correct event boundaries, and verify meta-annotations
Sample short clips and use GPT-4o with human-refined prompts to generate candidate QA
Add human-proposed QA to reduce model preference bias and cover difficult CRR cases
Construct visually grounded and rule-based distractors that remain video-relevant but wrong
Manually inspect each option set, remove answer leakage and bias, and shuffle options
Release 644 unique videos with 2,814 paper-release QA/meta-annotations over 12 tasks and three modes
construction_steps_zh: 定义后向追溯实时视觉感知和前向主动响应三种模式
从公开数据集和自抓取YouTube视频整理七个领域的素材
仅用验证或测试划分覆盖12类任务并保留长视频在线上下文
从已有精确标签Gemini-1.5粗时间戳和志愿者收集事件元标注
由人工细化时间戳检查源视频修正事件边界并核验元标注
抽取短片段并用GPT-4o配合人工细化提示词生成候选问答
补充人工提出的问答以降低模型偏好并覆盖困难CRR样例
构造与视频相关但错误的视觉落地和规则式干扰项
人工检查选项集合去除答案泄漏与偏差并打乱选项
发布644个独立视频论文版2,814条问答或元标注共12类任务三种模式
evaluation_steps_en: Feed video from the start to the query timestamp for backward and real-time tasks
Prompt the model with multiple-choice options and score past/current answers by accuracy
Issue dense timeline queries for future responding and record the wait-or-answer decision and trigger time
Apply task-specific timing and response scores for forward active responding
Use GPT-4o judges for SSR and CRR where semantic comparison is required
Report mode-level results across backward, real-time, and forward tasks and compare with humans
evaluation_steps_zh: 对后向和实时任务从视频开头输入到查询时间戳
提供多项选择并按准确率评判过去与当前回答
对前向响应在时间线上密集提问并记录等待或回答决策与触发时刻
为前向主动响应应用任务特定的时机和回答评分
需要语义比较时使用GPT-4o评判SSR和CRR
汇报后向实时前向三种模式结果并与人类比较

source_locator: arXiv:2402.14008 Sections 2.1-2.3 and 3.1-3.2; official OpenBMB/OlympiadBench project
evidence_summary_en: OlympiadBench converts official Olympiad and Gaokao PDFs through Mathpix and manual verification, structures expert Problem-Solution-Answer records, deduplicates and labels them, and releases 8,476 bilingual multimodal math and physics problems with automatic numeric and symbolic scoring for definitive answers.
evidence_summary_zh: OlympiadBench 将官方奥赛与高考PDF经Mathpix和人工核验转为结构化专家问题解答答案记录，完成去重和标签标注，发布8,476道双语多模态数理题并对确定性答案自动进行数值与符号评分。
construction_steps_en: Define Olympiad-level bilingual math and physics scope, including Gaokao and mock exams
Collect official PDFs from global Olympiads and Chinese regional and national competitions
Convert PDF text and formulae to Markdown with Mathpix while retaining embedded images
Manually compare OCR output with source PDFs and repair scientific notation and extraction errors
Structure every item as Problem-Solution-Answer with expert reasoning and consistent markup
Embed items with a math-trained language model and remove near duplicates by cosine similarity
Manually annotate math and physics topics, subfields, and open-ended or theorem-proof types
Preserve shared passages and dependent subquestions for progressive physics problems
Classify definitive answers as numeric, expression, equation, interval, or tuple
Release 8,476 problems with complete solutions, including 6,728 open-ended, 1,748 theorem-proof, and 4,869 image-bearing problems
construction_steps_zh: 确定含高考和模拟题的奥赛级双语数学物理范围
从全球奥赛和中国区域全国竞赛收集官方PDF
用Mathpix把PDF文本公式转为Markdown并保留内嵌图像
人工对照源PDF核验OCR并修复科学记号和提取错误
将每题结构化为问题解答答案并保留专家推理与统一标记
用数学训练语言模型嵌入题目并按余弦相似度去除近重复
人工标注数理主题子领域和开放题或定理证明类型
为递进物理题保留共享材料与依赖子问题
把确定性答案分为数值表达式方程区间或元组
发布8,476道全部带解答的题其中6,728道开放题1,748道证明题4,869道含图题
evaluation_steps_en: Build bilingual prompts with subject, answer type, output-format instructions, and images when required
Run text or multimodal models and extract their final answers
Normalize equations, parse intervals and tuples, and separate numeric and symbolic cases
Score numeric answers with the default 1e-8 tolerance and physics-specific adjustments
Check equation normalization, element-wise structure, and SymPy symbolic equivalence
Aggregate accuracy for definitive-answer math and physics problems and analyze theorem proving separately
evaluation_steps_zh: 构造含学科答案类型输出格式指令并按需插图的双语提示
运行文本或多模态模型并提取最终答案
归一化方程解析区间元组并区分数值与符号样例
按默认1e-8容差和物理题特定调整评分数值答案
检查方程归一化逐元素结构和SymPy符号等价
汇总确定性答案数理题准确率并单独分析定理证明

source_locator: arXiv:2406.12753 Sections 2.1-2.4 and 3.1-3.3; official GAIR-NLP/OlympicArena project
evidence_summary_en: OlympicArena converts licensed material from 62 competitions into 11,163 bilingual multimodal problems across seven fields, uses trained annotators, multi-step validation, deduplication, and GPT-4V-assisted verified skill labels, then evaluates answer correctness, CS execution, and sampled reasoning processes.
evidence_summary_zh: OlympicArena 将62项竞赛的许可材料转成七个领域11,163道双语多模态题，通过训练标注员多步验证去重和经人工核验的GPT-4V能力标签构建，再从答案正确性CS执行和抽样推理过程评测。
construction_steps_en: Collect publicly accessible licensed PDFs from 62 Olympiad competitions in seven scientific fields
Download problems and available solutions, record copyright constraints, and collect CS test cases
Convert PDFs to Markdown with Mathpix while preserving interleaved images
Have about 30 STEM students extract problems and record solutions and metadata through the released interface
Run multi-step validation to correct initial annotations and malformed extraction
Deduplicate within competitions using model embeddings and remove same-year repeated problems
Use GPT-4V to label cognitive difficulty as knowledge recall, concept application, or cognitive reasoning and verify labels manually
Label eight logical reasoning and five visual reasoning abilities with GPT-4V support and human checks
Release 11,163 problems with 7,571 images, 13 answer types, and 7,904 problems with solutions
Create a 548-problem OlympicArena-ot set, a 638-problem validation set with steps, and the remaining official test set
construction_steps_zh: 从七个科学领域62项奥赛收集公开可访问且许可的PDF
下载题目和可用解答记录版权约束并收集计算机测试用例
用Mathpix把PDF转为Markdown并保留图文交错内容
由约30名理工科学生通过发布的界面提取题目记录解答和元数据
运行多步验证修正初始标注和异常提取
在竞赛内用模型嵌入去重并去除同年重复题
用GPT-4V标注知识回忆概念应用认知推理难度并人工核验
在GPT-4V辅助和人工检查下标注八类逻辑与五类视觉推理能力
发布11,163道题7,571张图像13类答案且7,904道题有解答
划分548题OlympicArena-ot集638题带步骤验证集及其余官方测试集
evaluation_steps_en: Run zero-shot multimodal, image-caption replacement, and text-only settings
Use rule matching for fixed answers and execution-based pass@k for CS problems
Use GPT-4V for other answer types and validate a manual sample of its judgments
Sample 96 solved problems for process evaluation and use GPT-4 to structure reference and model solutions
Have GPT-4V score each reasoning step as 0 or 1 and verify agreement against humans
Report answer accuracy, CS Pass@1, process scores, and cognitive and visual skill analyses
evaluation_steps_zh: 运行零样本多模态图像描述替换和纯文本设置
对固定答案使用规则匹配对计算机题使用执行式pass@k
对其他答案类型使用GPT-4V并人工抽样验证判定
抽取96道有解答题做过程评测并用GPT-4结构化参考解和模型解
由GPT-4V对每个推理步骤打0或1分并与人工验证一致性
报告答案准确率CS Pass@1过程分以及认知和视觉能力分析

source_locator: arXiv:2409.15272 Sections 2.1-2.4 and 3.1-3.2; official multimodal-art-projection/OmniBench project
evidence_summary_en: OmniBench has 16 annotators and five inspectors author 1,142 four-option questions whose correct answers jointly require image and audio evidence, filters unimodally solvable items with repeated LLaVA checks, and evaluates full tri-modal accuracy, modality ablations, and a human musician baseline.
evidence_summary_zh: OmniBench 由16名标注员和5名质检员编写1,142道四选一题且正确答案必须联合图像与音频证据，通过重复LLaVA检查过滤单模态可解题，并评测完整三模态准确率模态消融和人类音乐家基线。
construction_steps_en: Define image-audio-text input with a textual answer and build a taxonomy of three primary categories and eight tasks
Form an annotation team of 16 annotators and five quality inspectors with higher-education backgrounds
Author four-option multiple-choice questions with exactly one correct answer and at least one confusing distractor
Require that both image and audio evidence are necessary and reject single-modality-solvable questions
Enforce minimum 480p images, audio duration at most 30 seconds, and source, speaker, and question repetition limits
Annotate audio transcripts or music captions plus image- and audio-specific rationales
Cross-inspect every item, record failure reasons, return failed samples, and revise targeted problems
Repeat LLaVA-1.6-34B checks three times under image-plus-text, transcript-plus-text, and text-only inputs
Accept only limited-modality rejections or errors and revise, recycle, or discard items that remain solvable
Release 1,142 QA pairs across speech, sound events, and music in three categories and eight tasks
construction_steps_zh: 定义图像音频文本输入和文本答案并建立三个主类别八类任务体系

编写四选一题确保仅一个正确答案且至少一个迷惑干扰项
要求正确答案必须同时使用图像和音频并拒绝单模态可解题
限制图像不低于480p音频不超过30秒以及来源说话人题目重复
标注音频转写或音乐描述以及图像和音频特定的理由
逐题交叉质检记录失败原因退回问题样例并定向修订
在图像加文本转写加文本和纯文本输入下分别重复三次LLaVA-1.6-34B检查
仅接受有限模态拒答或报错并修订回收或丢弃仍可解题

evidence_summary_en: OmniDocBench clusters more than 200,000 PDFs, samples 6,000 candidates, balances 981 pages, combines model pre-annotations with character-level human correction and three-researcher quality control, and evaluates normalized document outputs at end-to-end, task, and attribute levels.
evidence_summary_zh: OmniDocBench 从20多万份PDF聚类后采样6,000个候选并平衡为981页，结合模型预标注、逐字符人工修订和三名研究人员质检，再对归一化文档输出执行端到端、逐任务和逐属性评测。
construction_steps_en: Collect more than 200,000 PDFs from Common Crawl, Google, Baidu, and internal sources
Extract ResNet-50 visual features, cluster with Faiss into ten centers, and sample 6,000 candidates
Annotate page type, layout, and language attributes and balance the final set to 981 pages across nine document types
Generate pre-annotations with fine-tuned LayoutLMv3, PaddleOCR, UniMERNet, and GPT-4o
Annotate 19 layout classes, reading order, affiliations, cross-page relations, text, formulae, and tables
Have humans correct boxes, ordering, relations, and every character with specialized tools
Use CDM rendering checks and three researchers for final quality control
Release more than 100,000 annotations with 15 attribute labels

提取ResNet-50视觉特征用Faiss聚为十个中心并采样6,000个候选

evaluation_steps_en: Normalize Markdown, remove excluded content, and extract tables, formulae, code, text paragraphs, and reading order
Match predictions to ground truth by adjacency search and normalized-edit-distance fuzzy matching with ignore rules
Score text with NED, tables with TEDS and NED, formulae with CDM, NED, and BLEU, and reading order with NED
Report end-to-end, task-specific, and attribute-level results
evaluation_steps_zh: 归一化Markdown移除排除内容并提取表格公式代码文本段落和阅读顺序

evidence_summary_en: OmniMedVQA converts 73 real medical classification datasets into balanced, human-checked multiple-choice VQA through templates, inverse-proportional sampling, and GPT-3.5 rewriting and distractors, then reports response-similarity and visual-prefix-likelihood scores separately.
evidence_summary_zh: OmniMedVQA 将73个真实医学分类数据集通过模板、反比例采样和GPT-3.5改写及干扰项生成转为经人工复核的平衡多选问答，并分别报告回答相似度分数和视觉前缀似然分数。
construction_steps_en: Collect 73 real medical image-classification datasets covering 12 modalities and more than 20 anatomical regions
Construct dataset-specific QA templates from original categories plus modality and anatomy attributes
Use inverse-proportional sampling to balance templates and reduce repetitive QA bias
Organize items into five medical question types
Use GPT-3.5 to reformulate questions without changing their meaning
Use GPT-3.5 to generate incorrect answers and form two-to-four-option multiple-choice items
Perform a human double check and release 118,010 images with 127,995 QA items

按原始类别及模态解剖属性建立逐数据集问答模板
执行反比例采样平衡模板并减少重复问答偏差
把条目组织为五类医学问题
用GPT-3.5在不改变语义的前提下改写问题
用GPT-3.5生成错误答案并形成二至四选项多选题
执行人工双重检查并发布118,010张图像和127,995条问答
evaluation_steps_en: Combine each image, question, and candidate options into the LVLM prompt
For Question-answering Score, generate a response and choose the candidate with maximum response similarity
For Prefix-based Score, prefix visual features into text embeddings and choose the question-option pair with maximum likelihood
Compare selected options with ground truth and report the two accuracies by question type and overall

问答分数先生成回答再选择与回答相似度最高的候选项

将所选选项与真值比较并按问题类型及总体分别报告两种准确率

Curate prompts from public internet data, user inputs, and established datasets
Cluster scenes and semantic dimensions, filter cosine-similarity duplicates, and maintain subset proportions
Use GPT-4o to rewrite prompts into short, medium, and long groups at about a 1:2:1 ratio
Manually remove sensitive content and conflicting semantics
Manually translate and verify the 1,120 English prompts and add 200 multilingual prompts
Release six prompt sets with 1,120 English and 1,320 Chinese records

从公开互联网数据用户输入和既有数据集整理提示

人工翻译核验1,120条英文提示并增加200条多语种提示

Extract and clean rendered text and combine edit distance, completion rate, and word accuracy

evidence_summary_en: OneMillion-Bench uses a three-stage expert pipeline, frontier-agent adversarial filtering, dispute resolution, and bidirectional difficulty truncation to create 400 bilingual professional tasks with asymmetric expert rubrics, Expert Score, Pass Rate, and economic-value reporting.
evidence_summary_zh: OneMillion-Bench 通过三阶段专家流程、前沿智能体对抗筛选、争议仲裁和难度双向截断构建400个双语专业任务，并使用非对称专家量规、专家分数、通过率和经济价值报告。
construction_steps_en: Define economically valuable workflows across five domains, 37 subdomains, and 92 tertiary categories
Have a domain expert write each semi-open task, reference reasoning, and detailed rubrics
Run concurrent adversarial validation across frontier-agent families and retain tasks that several agents fail
Use an independent same-subdomain specialist for peer review and collaborative consensus revision
Send risky or unresolved items to a third expert for independent audit and adjustment
Remove universally solved tasks and review or revise universally low-scoring tasks
Encode criterion, weight, capability tag, and verified source with weights from -20 to 10
Release 400 tasks split into 200 English Global and 200 Chinese local-context items
construction_steps_zh: 在五领域37个子域92个三级类别中定义高经济价值工作流
由领域专家编写半开放任务参考推理和详细量规
跨前沿智能体家族并发对抗验证并保留多个智能体失败的任务
由同一子域独立专家同行评审并协作修订至共识
将高风险或未决条目交第三位专家独立审计调整
移除所有智能体均解出的任务并复查修订普遍低分任务
记录标准权重能力标签和核验来源且权重范围为-20至10
发布英文全球语境200题和中文本地语境200题共400题
evaluation_steps_en: Run vanilla models, web-search-enabled agents, and deep-research agents
Judge criteria tagged Web Search, Reasoning, Verbalization, and Instruction Following with positive and negative weights
Compute the weighted clipped Expert Score and binary Pass Rate
Aggregate by domain and rubric type, balance the overall score across five domains, and relate performance to estimated economic value
evaluation_steps_zh: 运行基础模型启用网页搜索的智能体和深度研究智能体

evidence_summary_en: Oolong filters ten atomic classification sources, adds controlled user and date metadata, constructs 1K-to-4M-token synthetic contexts with three aggregation question families, pairs CRD3 transcripts with CritRoleStats gold data for 55K-to-1.3M-token real contexts, and applies answer-type-specific scoring.

construction_steps_en: Select ten natural text-classification datasets with two to ten labels
Remove items misclassified by both GPT-4.1 nano and Llama 4 Maverick to control atomic difficulty
Add user IDs with an 80/20 skew and dates uniformly distributed over forty months
Build synthetic contexts targeting 1K to 4M tokens at about 95 percent fill and reuse each context for 25 questions
Generate counting, user cross-reference, and timeline or temporal questions
Use CRD3 transcripts from Critical Role campaigns one and two for Oolong-real
Link CritRoleStats human records of dice rolls and spells by episode and character
Concatenate one to twenty-four episodes into 55K-to-1.3M-token real contexts and release both splits
construction_steps_zh: 选择十个类别数为2至10的自然文本分类数据集

用临界角色第一与第二季CRD3转写构建Oolong-real
按剧集角色连接CritRoleStats人工掷骰与法术记录
拼接1至24集形成55K至1.3M token真实上下文并发布两个分集

Compare random baselines and report by split, question family, and context length, with the main model study through 128K

Require each case to have taken a team more than one day to solve and caused at least a one-day delay to a major project

Score one submitted solution per task with pass@1
Aggregate across twenty tasks; the grader implementation and rubric are not disclosed

Adopt 300 Spoken Llama Questions with reference answers
Randomly sample 1,000 Web Questions and 1,000 TriviaQA items
Select helpful-base and vicuna AlpacaEval subsets, remove math and code, and retain 199 items

source_locator: arXiv:2504.16891 Sections 2-4; official nvidia/OpenMathReasoning dataset card; NVIDIA NeMo-Skills code
evidence_summary_en: OpenMathReasoning extracts, classifies, filters, transforms, and decontaminates AoPS problems, then builds 3.2M CoT, 1.7M TIR, and 566K GenSelect records; the official card corrects the released solution-bearing problem count from the paper-stage 540K to 306K plus 193K problem-only items.
evidence_summary_zh: OpenMathReasoning 对AoPS问题执行抽取分类过滤转换和去污染，再构建3.2M条CoT、1.7M条TIR与566K条GenSelect；官方数据卡把论文阶段540K的有解问题发布数更正为306K，并另提供193K条仅问题样例。
construction_steps_en: Collect 620K AoPS discussions from all forums except Middle School Math
Use Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct to extract 580K problems and classify proof, multiple-choice, binary, and validity attributes
Remove multiple-choice, binary, and invalid items, convert proofs to answer questions, and extract final answers
Use LLM comparison to decontaminate popular math benchmarks; the paper-stage pipeline reports 540K problems
Reconcile the official release correction: only 306K problems enter the released solution splits, 193K additional records remain problem-only, and a pipeline bug lost 137K proof-based questions
Generate up to 32 long-CoT candidates per problem with DeepSeek-R1 and QwQ-32B and filter by final-answer equivalence
Build 3.2M CoT, iteratively generate and filter 1.7M TIR, and construct 566K GenSelect examples
Release about 5.68M rows together with NeMo-Skills code and OpenMath-Nemotron models
construction_steps_zh: 从除Middle School Math外的AoPS论坛收集620K条讨论
用Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct抽取580K个问题并分类证明多选二元和有效性属性
移除多选二元和无效问题把证明题转成答案题并抽取最终答案
用LLM比对热门数学基准执行去污染且论文阶段流水线报告540K问题
对齐官方发布更正即仅306K个问题进入公开解答分集193K条记录保持仅问题且流水线Bug丢失137K个证明题
用DeepSeek-R1和QwQ-32B每题生成最多32个长CoT候选并按最终答案等价性过滤
构建3.2M条CoT迭代生成过滤1.7M条TIR并建立566K条GenSelect
发布约5.68M行数据以及NeMo-Skills代码和OpenMath-Nemotron模型
evaluation_steps_en: Treat OpenMathReasoning as post-training data rather than a standalone fixed evaluation benchmark
In the paper, evaluate trained models on Comp-Math-24-25, AIME, HMMT, and AIMO-2 tasks with mathematical accuracy and selection methods
Compare CoT pass@1, majority voting, TIR, and GenSelect downstream results
evaluation_steps_zh: 将OpenMathReasoning定位为后训练数据而非独立固定评测基准
论文在Comp-Math-24-25、AIME、HMMT和AIMO-2任务上以数学准确率评测训练后模型及选择方法
比较CoT Pass@1多数投票TIR和GenSelect下游结果

source_locator: ICLR 2025 paper Sections 2.2-2.4, 3, and 4; official microsoft/OpenRCA repository
evidence_summary_en: OpenRCA selects 1,753 records from Telecom, Bank, and Market systems, balances to 412, standardizes and has three engineers calibrate telemetry-grounded labels, filters to 335 cases with 68.5 GB telemetry, synthesizes seven goal-driven query types, and uses all-element strict accuracy.
evidence_summary_zh: OpenRCA 从Telecom、Bank和Market筛选1,753条记录，平衡为412条，统一格式后由三名工程师校准遥测可验证标签并过滤为335个含68.5GB遥测的案例，再合成七类目标驱动查询并采用全要素严格准确率。
construction_steps_en: Select Telecom, Bank, and Market from real-world AIOps Challenge systems, retaining 1,753 failure records
Downsample larger datasets to balance system sizes and retain 412 records
Standardize telemetry names, schemas, formats, and labels
Have three experienced engineers verify that each root cause can be identified from its telemetry
Remove cases with missing telemetry, unidentifiable causes, or label-evidence mismatches to retain 335 failures
Package 68.5 GB and 523M lines of de-identified metrics, logs, and traces
Sample one of seven goals over time, component, and reason; add system, thirty-minute window, and failure count
Use an LLM such as GPT-4 to synthesize the query and have humans verify it
construction_steps_zh: 从真实AIOps挑战系统中选择Telecom、Bank和Market并保留1,753条故障记录
下采样较大数据集以平衡系统规模并保留412条记录
统一遥测名称模式格式和标签
由三名经验工程师验证每个根因可从其遥测中定位
移除遥测缺失根因不可识别或标签证据不一致案例后保留335个故障
打包68.5GB和523M行去标识化指标日志与追踪
从时间组件原因的七种目标中采样并加入系统30分钟窗口及故障数
用GPT-4等LLM合成查询并由人工核验
evaluation_steps_en: Provide each natural-language query with its associated telemetry
Run balanced or oracle telemetry sampling or RCA-agent controller and Python executor
Predict the requested subset of root-cause time, component, and reason in structured JSON
Award one point only when all requested elements match and average over 335 cases
evaluation_steps_zh: 向每个自然语言查询提供对应遥测
运行平衡或Oracle遥测抽样或RCA-agent控制器与Python执行器
以结构化JSON预测被要求的根因时间组件和原因子集
仅当全部目标要素匹配时得一分并对335个案例取平均

source_locator: arXiv:2605.23657 Sections 2.1-2.3 and Appendices A.1-A.3; official OpenSkillEval project page
evidence_summary_en: OpenSkillEval reverse-constructs 677 grounded tasks in five artifact-producing families, filters thirty time-sensitive community skills by adoption, compares no-skill and force-use agents in isolated runners, and jointly evaluates ATIF trajectories and task-specific final artifacts.
evidence_summary_zh: OpenSkillEval 在五类工件生成任务中反向构造677个有来源依据的案例，按采用度筛选30个时间敏感的社区skill，在隔离runner中比较无skill和强制使用设置，并联合评测ATIF轨迹及任务专用最终工件。
construction_steps_en: Define presentation, front-end web, poster, data-visualization, and report-generation families
Collect and snapshot category-specific artifacts or source materials from public repositories and data portals
Use Claude-4.6-Opus and GPT-5.2 to reverse-construct structured task_input.json specifications and instruction.md requests
Use a verifier LLM to check completeness, grounding, and internal consistency and filter weak cases
Release source package, specification, and instruction for 677 dynamic instances
Collect task-relevant community skills from multiple repositories as a time-sensitive snapshot
Use download counts as an adoption signal under cost-conscious selection and retain thirty skills
construction_steps_zh: 定义演示文稿前端网页海报数据可视化和报告生成五类任务
从公开仓库和数据门户按类别收集并快照工件或源材料
用Claude-4.6-Opus和GPT-5.2反向构造task_input.json结构化规格和instruction.md请求
由Verifier LLM检查完整性来源依据及内部一致性并过滤薄弱案例
为677个动态实例发布来源包规格和指令
从多个仓库收集任务相关社区skill并视为时间敏感快照
在成本敏感选择下以下载量为采用度信号并保留30个skill
evaluation_steps_en: Run agents in unified isolated environments under no-skill and force-use settings
Normalize execution traces with ATIF and use an agent judge to compare intended skill steps with actual trajectories
Evaluate final artifacts with task-specific VLM, screenshot, interaction, code, data-accuracy, and rubric checks
Report quality, completeness, skill gain, diversity, trajectory behavior, tokens, time, and cost-performance trade-offs
evaluation_steps_zh: 在统一隔离环境中按无skill和强制使用skill设置运行Agent
用ATIF归一化执行轨迹并由Agent裁判比较预期skill步骤和实际轨迹
以任务专用VLM截图交互代码数据准确性和量规检查评估最终工件
报告质量完整性skill增益多样性轨迹行为Token时间及成本性能权衡

source_locator: arXiv:2411.09116 Sections 3-4 and Tables 2-3; official Qwen/P-MMEval dataset card
evidence_summary_en: P-MMEval screens fundamental multilingual datasets with three model-size pairs and paired t-tests, adds five specialized datasets, completes ten-language coverage with GPT-4o plus professional review, and evaluates eight parallel components under three prompt settings with task-specific metrics.
evidence_summary_zh: P-MMEval 用三组模型规模对及配对t检验筛选基础多语言数据集，加入五个专项数据集，再以GPT-4o补译和专业复核统一十语言覆盖，最终在三种提示设置下以任务专用指标评测八个平行组成部分。
construction_steps_en: Define ten languages from seven families and collect eleven fundamental understanding and generation candidates
For each candidate, evaluate English plus four supported languages with at most 250 instances per language using Qwen2.5, LLaMA3.1, and Mistral model-size pairs
Apply paired-sample t-tests and retain XNLI, MHellaSwag, and Flores-200 only when every model pair shows p below 0.01
Add HumanEval-XL, MGSM, MLogiQA, MMMLU, and MIFEval as capability-specialized components
Use GPT-4o to fill missing languages, then have professional translators correct, localize, validate equivalence, and remove unmappable items
Finalize eight benchmark components across seven tasks and ten languages with 2,158 instances per language and 21,580 language-specific instances total
construction_steps_zh: 确定来自七个语系的十种语言并汇集11个基础理解与生成候选数据集
对每个候选使用Qwen2.5 LLaMA3.1和Mistral三组规模模型对评测英文加四种受支持语言且每种语言最多250条
执行配对样本t检验并仅在三组模型对均满足p小于0.01时保留XNLI MHellaSwag和Flores-200
加入HumanEval-XL MGSM MLogiQA MMMLU和MIFEval五个能力专项组成部分
用GPT-4o补齐缺失语言再由专业翻译团队修订本地化验证等价性并移除不可映射条目
形成覆盖七类任务和十种语言的八个基准组成部分且每种语言2,158条共21,580条分语言实例
evaluation_steps_en: Adapt OpenCompass and lm-evaluation-harness instructions and constrain final answer formats
Run English, native-language, and English few-shot prompts, using chain of thought for MGSM and direct answering for the other tasks
Use Accuracy for classification-style tasks, BLEU for Flores-200, and Pass@1 for HumanEval-XL
Report scores by task and language and use CACR to compare cross-lingual transfer consistency
evaluation_steps_zh: 改编OpenCompass与lm-evaluation-harness指令并约束最终答案格式
运行英文母语和英文少样本提示且MGSM使用思维链而其余任务直接作答
分类类任务使用准确率Flores-200使用BLEU且HumanEval-XL使用Pass@1
按任务与语言报告得分并以CACR比较跨语言迁移一致性

source_locator: arXiv:2607.02032 methodology and experiments; official neulab/pace repository and neulab/pace-bench dataset card
evidence_summary_en: PACE-Bench is the concrete four-target output of PACE: strict leave-one-model-out calibration combines target relevance and global leverage over cheap source instances, builds approximately 100-instance weighted proxies, and predicts both absolute agentic scores and pairwise rankings.
evidence_summary_zh: PACE-Bench是PACE框架面向四个目标的具体产物：严格留一模型校准结合低成本来源实例的目标相关性与全局杠杆度，构建约100实例的带权代理，并同时预测Agent绝对得分和成对排序。
construction_steps_en: Evaluate 14 models on GAIA, SWE-Bench Verified, SWE-Bench Multimodal, and SWT-Bench with OpenHands Index
Collect instance-level scores from 19 cheaper non-agentic source benchmarks spanning 11 capability groups
Under strict leave-one-model-out evaluation, use 13 models for calibration and hold out the remaining model
Bootstrap target instances with replacement, build source and target score matrices, and compute a thin SVD of the source matrix
Calculate global leverage from the right singular vectors and absolute Spearman target relevance from calibration models
Select C_L Local instances by relevance and C_G Global instances by leverage times relevance, then resolve overlap and extend both rankings in a fixed ratio until C=100 unique instances
Produce four target-specific weighted proxy files with source identifiers, content, metrics, weights, and images when applicable
construction_steps_zh: 用OpenHands Index评测14个模型在GAIA SWE-Bench Verified SWE-Bench Multimodal和SWT-Bench上的表现
从覆盖11类能力的19个低成本非Agent来源基准收集实例级得分
在严格留一模型评测中使用13个模型校准并留出其余模型
有放回自助采样目标实例构建来源与目标得分矩阵并计算来源矩阵的薄SVD
由右奇异向量计算全局杠杆度并由校准模型计算与目标的绝对Spearman相关性
按相关性选择C_L个Local实例并按杠杆度乘相关性选择C_G个Global实例再处理重叠且按固定比例扩展两条排序直至C等于100个唯一实例
生成四个目标专用带权代理文件并包含来源标识内容指标权重以及适用时的图像
evaluation_steps_en: Project Local and Global proxy scores with subset-specific SVD features
Fit linear least squares for absolute target scores and logistic regression for pairwise model ordering
Blend Local and Global predictors with mixture coefficient lambda and predict the held-out model
Repeat LOOCV and report MAE, Spearman correlation, pairwise accuracy, and target-evaluation cost
evaluation_steps_zh: 使用各子集的SVD特征投影Local与Global代理得分
以线性最小二乘拟合目标绝对得分并以逻辑回归拟合模型成对顺序
使用混合系数lambda集成Local与Global预测器并预测留出模型
重复留一验证并报告MAE Spearman相关性成对准确率和目标评测成本

source_locator: arXiv:2504.16074 dataset construction, human validation, prompting, and metric sections; official PHYBench page
evidence_summary_en: PHYBench starts from 757 human-authored symbolic physics problems created with 178 PKU students, applies expert review and independent validation by 81 students, retains 500, and scores boxed symbolic answers with exact equivalence and graded expression-tree edit distance.
evidence_summary_zh: PHYBench由178名北大学生参与人工编写757道符号物理题，经专家审查和81名学生独立验证后保留500题，再以精确等价与分级表达式树编辑距离评价方框符号答案。
construction_steps_en: Recruit 178 Peking University physics students to author original or substantially adapted symbolic-expression problems
Build an initial pool of 757 self-contained problems spanning mechanics, electromagnetism, thermodynamics, optics, and modern or advanced physics
Require defined variables, one uniquely checkable symbolic expression, no equations as answers, and no floating-point approximations
Submit drafts to an internal Question Bank and run multi-round expert correctness, clarity, and solvability review
Show o1 and DeepSeek-R1 outputs only to reveal ambiguity or unintended interpretations, never to generate questions or ground truth
Have 81 students independently solve subsets, including 50 Chinese Physics Olympiad gold medalists, and filter unclear or unreliable items
Finalize 500 original problems from high-school through undergraduate and Physics Olympiad difficulty
construction_steps_zh: 招募178名北京大学物理专业学生人工编写原创或大幅改编的符号表达式物理题
形成757题初始池并覆盖力学电磁学热学光学以及近代或高等物理
要求定义变量答案为唯一可核验符号表达式且不接受方程形式和浮点近似
把草稿提交内部题库并进行多轮专家正确性清晰度与可解性审查
仅用o1和DeepSeek-R1输出暴露歧义或非预期理解且绝不用于生成题目或标准答案
由81名学生独立求解分配题目其中含50名中国物理奥赛金牌并过滤含糊或不可靠条目
最终保留500道从高中本科至物理奥赛难度的原创题
evaluation_steps_en: Use a unified zero-shot prompt that requests step-by-step reasoning and a final symbolic LaTeX expression in a box
Parse generated and reference expressions with SymPy and latex2sympy and check mathematical equivalence for binary accuracy
Build expression trees and compute normalized Zhang-Shasha edit distance with the paper's cluster-subtree discount
Report Accuracy and EED, assigning 100 when r=0, 60-100r when 0<r<0.6, and zero when r is at least 0.6
evaluation_steps_zh: 使用统一零样本提示要求逐步推理并在方框中给出最终符号LaTeX表达式
用SymPy与latex2sympy解析生成式和参考式并按数学等价性计算二元准确率
构建表达式树并计算归一化Zhang-Shasha编辑距离且应用论文的簇子树折扣
报告准确率与EED并在r等于0时给100分在0小于r且r小于0.6时给60减100r分在r至少为0.6时给零分

source_locator: arXiv:2603.08013 benchmark construction and evaluation sections; official PIRA-Bench leaderboard
evidence_summary_en: PIRA-Bench pairs 100 noisy sequential GUI trajectories with three user profiles, uses three-person intent annotation and two-of-three agreement, includes direct, profile-dependent, and empty-intent negative scenarios, and multiplies positive intent F1 by a normalized false-positive penalty.
evidence_summary_zh: PIRA-Bench把100条带噪连续GUI轨迹与三种用户画像配对，经三人独立意图标注和三取二一致性形成直接画像依赖及空意图负样本，并用正样本意图F1乘归一化误报惩罚得到总分。
construction_steps_en: Collect 100 real mobile and desktop passive-observation trajectories with an average of 32 sequential screenshots
Inject irrelevant application switching, idle screens, and random browsing to simulate noisy multithreaded activity
Pair each trajectory with three profiles varying socioeconomic background, preferences, and personal characteristics
Construct direct-recommendation, profile-dependent, and pure-noise or profile-negated scenarios
Show each trajectory-profile pair to three independent annotators and ask for explicit actionable intents
Retain intents supported by at least two annotators and assign an empty ground-truth set to negative cases
construction_steps_zh: 采集100条真实移动端与桌面端被动观察轨迹且每条平均32张连续截图
注入无关应用切换空闲屏幕与随机浏览以模拟带噪多线程活动
为每条轨迹配对三种在社会经济背景偏好和个人特征上不同的画像
构建直接推荐画像依赖以及纯噪声或画像否决场景
向三名独立标注者展示每个轨迹画像配对并要求标注明确可行动意图
保留至少两名标注者支持的意图并为负样本设置空标准意图集
evaluation_steps_en: Provide the sequential screenshots and user profile without an explicit instruction and request a set of proactive recommendations
Use Gemini-3-flash to semantically match predicted and ground-truth intent sets
Compute macro Average Intent F1 over positive cases and false positives per negative sample
Normalize false positives as 1/(1+ln(1+FPS)) and multiply by Average Intent F1 for the Final Score
evaluation_steps_zh: 只提供连续截图与用户画像而不给显式指令并要求输出主动推荐集合
使用Gemini-3-flash对预测意图集与标准意图集进行语义匹配
在正样本上计算宏平均Intent F1并统计每个负样本的误报数
以1除以1加ln括号1加FPS归一化误报并乘Average Intent F1得到最终得分
