source_locator: arXiv:2305.10415 Sections 4.1 and 4.3.2, Figure 4, and Table 3; official xiaoman-zhang/PMC-VQA repository
evidence_summary_en: PMC-VQA generates caption-grounded four-choice QAs from 381K PMC-OA figures, filters text-only and caption-only questions with two learned stages, obtains 226,946 QAs over 149,075 images, and manually verifies a 2,000-item test subset for Choice and Blanking evaluation.
evidence_summary_zh: PMC-VQA从381K个PMC-OA图像与图注生成基于图注的四选一问答，再以两个学习式阶段过滤纯文本及仅图注可答问题，形成149,075张图像上的226,946组问答，并人工核验2,000题测试子集用于Choice与Blanking评测。
construction_steps_en: Start from the 1.6M-pair PMC-OA source and select 381K first-stage figure-caption pairs without automatic subfigure separation
Prompt ChatGPT to generate five four-option QAs per caption with one correct answer at a randomized position
Remove repeated, refused, dummy, and format-invalid outputs to retain 1,497,808 QA pairs
Split the data in half, fine-tune text-only LLaMA-7B on each half, and infer on the other half
Shuffle options and infer five times, removing a question when the text-only model is correct at least three times and retaining 848,433 pairs
Manually label 2,192 pairs for image answerability, split them 1,752/440, and train an 81.77-percent-accurate classifier
Apply the classifier to remove caption-only information and finalize 226,946 QAs over 149,075 images
Randomly select 50,000 image-disjoint initial test pairs and manually verify 2,000 for image relevance, distractor complexity, and image quality
construction_steps_zh: 从160万对PMC-OA来源中选取381K个第一阶段图像与图注且不自动切分子图
提示ChatGPT为每条图注生成五组四选一问答且一个正确答案的位置随机
移除重复拒答虚假和格式无效输出后保留1,497,808组问答
把数据分成两半在每一半微调纯文本LLaMA-7B并到另一半推理
打乱选项并推理五次且纯文本模型至少答对三次即移除最终保留848,433组
人工标注2,192组图像可回答性样例按1,752与440划分并训练准确率81.77%的分类器
应用分类器移除仅依赖图注信息的问题并形成149,075张图像上的226,946组问答
随机选择50,000组图像隔离初始测试样本并按图像相关性干扰项难度与图像质量人工核验2,000题
evaluation_steps_en: For Choice evaluation, provide four candidate answers and require the correct A, B, C, or D option
For Blanking evaluation, omit the options and require a free-form generated answer
Report Accuracy for Choice and both Accuracy and BLEU-1 for Blanking on the manually verified PMC-VQA-test
evaluation_steps_zh: Choice评测提供四个候选答案并要求输出正确的A B C或D选项
Blanking评测省略选项并要求生成自由文本答案
在人工核验PMC-VQA-test上对Choice报告准确率并对Blanking报告准确率与BLEU-1

source_locator: arXiv:2510.24358 Sections 2.1-2.3 and Figure 2; official AGI-Eval-Official/PRDBench repository
evidence_summary_en: PRDBench filters public all-Python product requirements, selects 50 projects across 20 GPT-4-labeled domains, builds PRDs and executable test criteria through agents plus human execution checks, and scores 1,262 unit, shell, and file-comparison evaluation points by pass rate.
evidence_summary_zh: PRDBench筛选数据完全公开的纯Python产品需求，经GPT-4领域标注后从20个领域选取50个项目，以Agent生成PRD与可执行测试标准并由人工执行检查，最终按1,262个单元测试Shell交互和文件比较评分点的通过率计分。
construction_steps_en: Collect seed requirements from AI-product user requests and academic theses or projects
Retain requirements implemented fully in Python with every required data asset publicly available
Use GPT-4 to label domains and select 50 projects spanning 20 domains
Use GPT-4.1 and coding agents to draft the PRD and an Arrange-Act-Assert metric outline
Generate a project scaffold and executable criteria for unit, shell-interaction, and file-comparison checks
Have humans execute and inspect the tests while feeding failures back to agents for iterative repair
Remove the scaffold and retain the PRD, criteria, artifacts, and public data as the benchmark package
construction_steps_zh: 从AI产品平台用户请求以及学术论文或项目中收集种子需求
仅保留完全使用Python实现且所需数据资产全部公开的需求
使用GPT-4标注领域并从20个领域中选取50个项目
使用GPT-4.1与代码Agent起草PRD和Arrange-Act-Assert指标大纲
生成项目脚手架以及单元测试Shell交互和文件比较三类可执行标准
由人工运行并检查测试且把失败反馈给Agent进行迭代修复
移除脚手架并保留PRD评分标准产物与公开数据作为最终基准包
evaluation_steps_en: Ask the candidate to implement the project from the retained PRD and provided artifacts
Run EvalAgent over 409 unit-test, 729 shell-interaction, and 124 file-comparison evaluation points
Record each executable criterion as passed or failed during development and debugging rounds
Report overall pass rate across all 1,262 evaluation points
evaluation_steps_zh: 要求候选系统依据保留的PRD与所提供资产实现完整项目
由EvalAgent执行409个单元测试729个Shell交互和124个文件比较评分点
在开发与调试轮次中把每条可执行标准记录为通过或失败
在全部1,262个评分点上报告总体通过率

source_locator: arXiv:2504.01848 Sections 2-4 and Appendices A-C; official openai/frontier-evals PaperBench project
evidence_summary_en: PaperBench selects 20 reproducible ICML 2024 Spotlight or Oral papers across 12 topics, develops weighted hierarchical rubrics through two engineers and original-author review, runs candidates for up to 12 hours on fresh A10 VMs, and uses validated per-leaf SimpleJudge decisions to compute Replication Score.
evidence_summary_zh: PaperBench从12个主题筛选20篇可复现的ICML 2024 Spotlight或Oral论文，由两名工程师与原作者共同完成加权分层rubric，在全新A10虚拟机中给予候选系统最多12小时复现时间，并以经JudgeEval验证的SimpleJudge逐叶判定聚合Replication Score。
construction_steps_en: Apply automated eligibility filters for commercial or geographic constraints, empirical content, hardware, closed models, human data, framework, and accessible dependencies
Randomly inspect remaining ICML 2024 Spotlight and Oral papers and contact 42 author teams
Secure 20 papers spanning 12 topics whose authors agree to support benchmark construction
Have two research engineers independently study each paper and draft a hierarchical rubric
Organize leaves under Code Development, Execution, and Result Match and distribute weights among siblings
Run internal review followed by multi-round verification with the original paper authors and add an author addendum
Finalize 8,316 scorable leaf outcomes while withholding rubrics and author code from candidates
construction_steps_zh: 按商业或地域限制实证内容硬件封闭模型人类数据框架和依赖可访问性执行自动资格过滤
随机审阅剩余ICML 2024 Spotlight与Oral论文并联系42组作者
获得覆盖12个主题且作者同意支持基准构建的20篇论文
由两名研究工程师分别研读每篇论文并起草分层rubric
把叶节点组织到代码开发执行和结果匹配三类并在同级节点间分配权重
先做内部复核再由论文原作者多轮验证并补充作者addendum
定稿8,316个可评分叶节点且不向候选系统公开rubric与作者代码
evaluation_steps_en: Provide the candidate with only the paper and author addendum while prohibiting author code and blacklisted replications
Copy the submission to a fresh Ubuntu 24.04 VM with one A10 GPU
Run reproduce.sh for at most 12 hours to produce outputs and reproduce.log
Select the ten most relevant files per leaf and let SimpleJudge issue a binary pass or fail decision
Roll weighted leaf decisions up the rubric tree to Replication Score and validate judging against JudgeEval expert gold labels
evaluation_steps_zh: 只向候选系统提供论文与作者addendum并禁止使用作者代码或黑名单复现
把提交复制到配备一张A10 GPU的全新Ubuntu 24.04虚拟机
运行reproduce.sh至多12小时并生成复现结果与reproduce.log
为每个叶节点选择最相关的十个文件并由SimpleJudge二元判定通过或失败
沿rubric树加权汇总叶节点得到Replication Score并以JudgeEval专家金标验证评分器

source_locator: arXiv:2310.02255 Sections 3.2, 4.1, 4.2, and 5.1 plus Appendix A; official MathVista repository and project page
evidence_summary_en: MathVista's PaperQA subset contains 107 manually authored scientific figure and table questions from August 2023 Hugging Face Papers; three independent reviewers verify the new examples, metadata captures task and reasoning attributes, and normalized answers are scored by deterministic accuracy after GPT-4 extraction.
evidence_summary_zh: MathVista的PaperQA子集包含107个来自2023年8月Hugging Face Papers学术图表的人工科学问答，由三名审阅者独立核验，元数据记录任务与推理属性，并在GPT-4答案抽取和归一化后按确定性准确率计分。
construction_steps_en: Collect informative academic tables, figures, charts, and plots from papers released on Hugging Face Papers in August 2023
Ask STEM graduate students to author figure-question-answer examples requiring scientific and chart reasoning
Assign question type, answer type, language, source, category, task, grade, context, and reasoning-skill metadata
Have three reviewers independently inspect every newly collected example
Resolve the six disagreements among 736 new MathVista questions by team consensus after 99.2-percent consistency
Select 107 paper figure-question-answer examples for the PaperQA subset
Package PaperQA in the unified MathVista format and distribute it across testmini and test
construction_steps_zh: 从2023年8月Hugging Face Papers发布论文中收集信息丰富的学术表格图形图表与曲线图
由STEM研究生编写需要科学推理与图表推理的图像问答样例
标注问题类型答案类型语言来源类别任务年级上下文和推理技能元数据
由三名审阅者独立检查每个新采集样例
在736个MathVista新问题达到99.2%一致性后由团队共识解决六处分歧
选出107个论文图形问答样例形成PaperQA子集
按统一MathVista格式封装PaperQA并划入testmini与test
evaluation_steps_en: Provide the paper figure or table together with its natural-language question
Generate a free-form response with the evaluated multimodal model
Use GPT-4 to extract the concise answer from the response and normalize its format
Compare the normalized prediction deterministically with the reference answer
Report Accuracy for the PaperQA subset
evaluation_steps_zh: 向被评多模态模型提供论文图形或表格及其自然语言问题
生成自由文本响应
使用GPT-4从响应中抽取简洁答案并进行格式归一化
把归一化预测与参考答案进行确定性比较
报告PaperQA子集准确率

source_locator: arXiv:2604.00842 Sections 3-5 and Appendices B-D; official deepakn97/pare repository
evidence_summary_en: Pare-Bench builds 143 scenarios on nine FSM apps plus three core apps, uses a Claude Agent SDK generator for story, state, event-flow, and validation stages with oracle retries, adds human semantic review and optional failures or notifications, and evaluates proactive assistance with repeated-run success and intervention metrics.
evidence_summary_zh: Pare-Bench在9个FSM应用与3个核心应用上构建143个场景，使用Claude Agent SDK生成器完成故事状态事件流和校验四阶段并在oracle模式下重试，再经人工语义复核并可加入失败或通知噪声，最终以重复运行成功率和干预指标评估主动助手。
construction_steps_en: Extend ARE with nine stateful FSM applications and the System, Agent UI, and FileSystem core apps
Expose state-dependent actions to simulated users while giving proactive assistants flat APIs over shared persistent state
Define each scenario through initial app state, an environment event flow, and oracle validation conditions
Launch a read-only Claude Agent SDK generation agent with Pare code and a target application set
Generate a natural-language scenario description and reject duplicates with an LLM-as-a-judge uniqueness check
Populate initial app state, build environment plus user and agent oracle events, and author final-state conditions with required actions
Run stages two through four in oracle mode and feed failures back for retry
Have humans verify semantic coherence, event realism, and validation criteria before finalizing 143 scenarios
construction_steps_zh: 在ARE上扩展9个有状态FSM应用以及System Agent UI和FileSystem三个核心应用
向模拟用户暴露状态依赖动作而主动助手通过扁平API访问共享持久状态
以初始应用状态环境事件流和oracle校验条件定义每个场景
启动只读Claude Agent SDK生成Agent并提供Pare代码与目标应用集合
生成自然语言场景描述并以LLM-as-a-judge唯一性检查拒绝重复故事
填充初始应用状态构建环境与用户和Agent oracle事件并编写最终状态及必需动作条件
在oracle模式运行第二至第四阶段并把失败反馈用于重试
由人工核验语义连贯性事件真实性与校验标准后定稿143个场景
evaluation_steps_en: Run each proactive assistant on the scenario while user actions and scheduled environment events update the FSM state
Optionally inject tool failures and Poisson spurious notifications for robustness evaluation
Check final-state conditions and required proposal or execution actions against the oracle
Repeat four times to compute Success@4 and Success^4 alongside mean Success Rate
Report Proposal Rate, Acceptance Rate, and average read-only actions
evaluation_steps_zh: 在用户动作与计划环境事件持续更新FSM状态时运行主动助手
可注入工具失败与泊松分布的虚假通知以评估鲁棒性
依据oracle检查最终状态条件以及必需的提议或执行动作
重复运行四次并计算Success@4与Success^4以及平均Success Rate
报告Proposal Rate Acceptance Rate和平均只读动作数

source_locator: arXiv:2003.10286 Sections 2-4, Figure 1, and Tables 1-2; official UCSD-AI4H/PathVQA repository
evidence_summary_en: PathVQA extracts textbook and PEIR pathology images and captions, generates seven open and yes/no question types with CoreNLP and Tregex, manually proofreads every pair, creates image-disjoint splits totaling 4,998 images and 32,799 QAs, and applies type-specific accuracy, exact match, macro F1, and BLEU metrics.
evidence_summary_zh: PathVQA从病理教材与PEIR抽取图像和图注，以CoreNLP和Tregex生成七类开放式及是非问答并逐题人工校对，按图像隔离划分共4,998张图像与32,799个问答，再按题型使用准确率Exact Match宏F1和BLEU指标。
construction_steps_en: Collect pathology figures from Textbook of Pathology, Basic Pathology, and the PEIR digital library
Extract 1,670 textbook image XObjects with PyPDF2 and caption text plus coordinates with PDFMiner
Match textbook captions by Fig or Figure expressions, position, and reading order
Crawl 3,328 PEIR images and captions with Requests and BeautifulSoup
Remove non-pathology images and manually repair image-caption mismatches
Use Stanford CoreNLP for sentence splitting, tokenization, POS, NER, constituency, and dependency parsing
Simplify caption sentences and apply Tregex templates for seven open question types
Create yes questions by inversion and no questions by replacing a phrase with a same-POS phrase from another caption
Proofread every QA for spelling, syntax, semantics, ambiguity, shortness, symbols, and articles
construction_steps_zh: 从Textbook of Pathology Basic Pathology与PEIR数字图书馆收集病理图像
使用PyPDF2抽取1,670个教材图像XObject并以PDFMiner提取图注文本与坐标
依据Fig或Figure表达式位置和阅读顺序匹配教材图像与图注
使用Requests与BeautifulSoup抓取3,328张PEIR图像及图注
移除非病理图像并人工修复图像图注错配
使用Stanford CoreNLP完成分句分词词性命名实体成分和依存分析
简化图注句子并应用Tregex模板生成七类开放式问题
通过倒装生成是题并用其他图注中的同词性短语替换生成否题
逐题校对拼写句法语义歧义过短问题以及符号和冠词
evaluation_steps_en: Split by image into 2,499 train, 1,499 validation, and 1,000 test images with 17,325, 9,462, and 6,012 QAs
Evaluate the 8,145 yes and 8,189 no questions with Accuracy
Evaluate the 16,465 open-ended questions with Exact Match, macro F1, and BLEU-1, BLEU-2, and BLEU-3
Report results over the final 32,799 QA pairs and 4,998 images
evaluation_steps_zh: 按图像划分2,499张训练1,499张验证和1,000张测试图像且分别含17,325 9,462和6,012个问答
对8,145个是题与8,189个否题使用准确率评测
对16,465个开放式问题使用Exact Match宏F1以及BLEU-1 BLEU-2和BLEU-3评测
在最终32,799个问答与4,998张图像上报告结果

source_locator: Official agentscope-ai/PawBench repository README, benchmark composition, task pages, submission contract, grading documentation, and leaderboard slices
evidence_summary_en: PawBench standardizes 150 tasks from six sources, tags five orthogonal dimensions, and holds prompts, workspaces, timeouts, transcripts, and result schemas fixed while crossing nine models with QwenPaw, OpenClaw, and Hermes. Automated, LLM-judge, or hybrid grading produces overall and sliced scores plus trace-based Model by Harness diagnostics.
evidence_summary_zh: PawBench将六个来源的150个任务统一格式并标注五个正交维度，在交叉评测9个模型与QwenPaw OpenClaw Hermes三种Harness时固定提示词工作区超时转录和结果结构，再以自动评分LLM裁判或混合评分生成总分切片分数及基于轨迹的模型与Harness诊断。
construction_steps_en: Define Model by Harness by Task as the co-evaluation unit so runtime effects remain separable from model effects
Reuse 52 ClawEval, 29 QwenClawBench, 23 PinchBench, 15 SkillsBench, 10 WildClawBench, and 21 self-built tasks
Normalize all 150 tasks into one format with shared prompt, workspace, and runnable grader contracts
Tag scenario, capability, complexity, modality, and environment as five orthogonal dimensions
Package each task with expected behavior, grading criteria, checker or rubric, workspace files, and metadata
Integrate QwenPaw, OpenClaw, and Hermes behind the same task interface
Enforce identical prompt, workspace, timeout, transcript, and final-result schemas across harnesses
Cross nine models with the three harnesses while holding each task definition fixed
Execute tasks and retain transcripts, metrics, and optional final workspaces or Docker images
construction_steps_zh: 将模型乘Harness乘任务定义为联合评测单元以区分模型效应和运行时效应
复用52个ClawEval 29个QwenClawBench 23个PinchBench 15个SkillsBench 10个WildClawBench及21个自建任务
把150个任务统一为相同提示词工作区和可执行评分器合同
以场景能力复杂度模态和环境五个正交维度标注任务
为每个任务封装预期行为评分标准检查器或Rubric工作区文件和元数据
把QwenPaw OpenClaw和Hermes接入相同任务接口
跨Harness固定提示词工作区超时转录和最终结果结构
在固定任务定义下交叉运行9个模型与3种Harness
执行任务并保存转录指标以及可选最终工作区或Docker镜像
evaluation_steps_en: Select the task's official automated, LLM-judge, or hybrid grading mode
Run deterministic checker code or the task-specific rubric with Claude Opus 4.6 as the documented judge baseline
Convert task outcomes to percentages and aggregate comparable Model by Harness scores
Publish slices by source, scenario, capability, complexity, modality, environment, grading type, model, and harness
Fix one axis, compare the other, and inspect traces plus grader failures to diagnose harness gaps
evaluation_steps_zh: 按任务选择官方自动评分LLM裁判或混合评分模式
运行确定性检查器或任务专属Rubric并以Claude Opus 4.6作为文档中的裁判基线
把任务结果转换为百分比并聚合可比的模型乘Harness分数
按来源场景能力复杂度模态环境评分类型模型和Harness发布切片
固定一个轴比较另一个轴并检查轨迹和评分失败以诊断Harness差距

source_locator: OpenAI o3 and o4-mini System Card Appendix PersonQA disclosure and Deep Research System Card PersonQA discussion; no standalone paper, repository, dataset, or item-level methodology is public
evidence_summary_en: OpenAI describes PersonQA only as questions based on publicly available facts about people across 18 fact categories, scored with attempted-answer Accuracy and Hallucination Rate. Item counts, category names, source selection, annotation, splits, prompts, graders, data, and code are not disclosed, and OpenAI warns that stale reference facts can overstate hallucination.
evidence_summary_zh: OpenAI仅披露PersonQA以公开可得的人物事实构造问题并覆盖18类事实，使用已尝试答案准确率和幻觉率评分。样本量类别名称来源选择标注划分提示词评分器数据和代码均未公开，OpenAI还指出过时参考事实可能夸大幻觉率。
construction_steps_en: Bound the reconstruction to OpenAI system-card disclosures because no standalone paper or repository exists
Use publicly available facts about people as the stated source basis
Cover 18 fact categories while keeping undisclosed category names and balance explicitly unknown
Form person-fact questions and reference facts at the high level stated by OpenAI
Mark item totals, train-validation-test sizes, and split policy as not disclosed
Mark collection, exclusion, provenance, reference-date, and refresh rules as not disclosed
Mark annotator qualifications, review, adjudication, and quality-control statistics as not disclosed
Mark prompts, parsers, graders, dataset records, and evaluation code as not released
construction_steps_zh: 因不存在独立论文或仓库而把复原范围限定在OpenAI系统卡披露内容
以公开可得的人物事实作为官方说明的来源基础
覆盖18类人物事实并明确类别名称和类别平衡未披露
仅按OpenAI公开的高层描述形成人物事实问题与参考事实
明确样本总量训练验证测试规模和划分策略未披露
明确收集排除溯源参考日期和刷新规则未披露
明确标注者资质复核仲裁和质量控制统计未披露
明确提示词解析器评分器数据记录和评测代码未发布
evaluation_steps_en: Ask the person-fact questions to the evaluated model snapshot and record whether an answer is attempted
Compute Accuracy over attempted answers, with the exact correctness procedure remaining undisclosed
Identify hallucinated answers and compute Hallucination Rate, with the exact labeling procedure undisclosed
Report Accuracy and Hallucination Rate separately because greater answer coverage can affect both
Compare evaluated model snapshots only within the disclosed attempted-answer scope
Audit reference freshness because an outdated gold fact can make a currently correct answer appear hallucinated
evaluation_steps_zh: 向被评模型快照提出人物事实问题并记录模型是否尝试回答

source_locator: arXiv:2505.15929 benchmark construction and evaluation sections; official killthefullmoon/PhyX repository and phyx-bench.github.io project page
evidence_summary_en: PhyX collects 3,300 expert-authored visual physics candidates across six domains, 25 subdomains, and six reasoning types, creates OE and MC counterparts plus Full-Text, Text-DeRedundancy, and Text-Minimal views, then removes lexical duplicates, applies Physics PhD validation, and filters the shortest 10 percent to produce 3,000 problems and 18,000 core instances. A proportional 1,000-problem testmini is evaluated with zero-shot CoT, rule extraction, and DeepSeek-V3 judging.
evidence_summary_zh: PhyX由专家收集3,300个视觉物理候选题覆盖6个领域25个子领域和6类推理，构造开放题与选择题对应版本及Full-Text Text-DeRedundancy Text-Minimal三种文本视图，再经词法查重物理学博士科学复核和最短10%过滤形成3,000个问题与18,000个核心实例。按领域比例抽取的1,000题testmini以零样本思维链规则抽取和DeepSeek-V3裁判评测。
construction_steps_en: Define six physics domains, 25 subdomains, and six physical-reasoning types for university-level visual problems
Recruit STEM graduate annotators and collect redistributable visual physics problems under a detailed protocol
Convert every open-ended item to multiple choice and every multiple-choice item to open ended for an even format split
Create Full-Text, Text-DeRedundancy, and Text-Minimal views for each problem
Generate a GPT-4o caption for each visual to support self-contained text-only evaluation
Assemble 3,300 candidates while preserving images, ground-truth answers, domains, and reasoning labels
Analyze lexical overlap to flag possible duplicates for expert review
Have Physics PhDs confirm duplicate removal, scientific accuracy, and scenario bias
Filter the shortest 10 percent to finalize 3,000 unique problems and 18,000 core instances
Proportionally sample 1,000 problems by domain to form the 6,000-instance testmini subset
construction_steps_zh: 为大学水平视觉物理问题定义6个领域25个子领域和6类物理推理
招募STEM研究生并按详细协议收集许可再发布的视觉物理题
把每个开放题转为选择题并把每个选择题转为开放题以形成均衡题型
为每题创建Full-Text Text-DeRedundancy和Text-Minimal三种文本视图
使用GPT-4o为每个视觉生成自包含描述以支持纯文本评测
汇总3,300个候选题并保留图像标准答案领域和推理标签
分析词法重叠并把潜在重复题送交专家复核
由物理学博士确认去重科学准确性和场景偏差
过滤最短10%候选题并定稿3,000个唯一问题和18,000个核心实例
按领域比例抽取1,000题形成6,000实例的testmini子集
evaluation_steps_en: Prompt zero-shot Chain-of-Thought with either the image or its GPT-4o caption
Apply rule-based answer extraction to generated responses
Judge open-ended answers with DeepSeek-V3
For multiple choice, use extracted letters first and DeepSeek-V3 as fallback
Report accuracy slices by question format, text view, physics domain, and reasoning type
evaluation_steps_zh: 以图像或其GPT-4o描述进行零样本思维链提示
对生成回答应用基于规则的答案抽取
使用DeepSeek-V3裁判开放式答案
选择题优先使用抽取字母并在失败时回退到DeepSeek-V3
按题型文本视图物理领域和推理类型报告准确率切片

source_locator: arXiv:2605.14678 benchmark construction, environment, hidden-intent, and metric sections plus official Simplified-Reasoning/Pi-Bench repository
evidence_summary_en: Pi-Bench builds five domain-expert personas and one persistent 20-session episode per persona, totaling 100 tasks. Each episode contains six dependency groups of two to three tasks plus five largely independent tasks; 524 hidden intents, 510 rubric items, 168 deterministic rules, 187 tools, and 21 skills support three GPT-5.4-simulated trajectories and PROC plus COMP evaluation.
evidence_summary_zh: Pi-Bench为五类领域专家角色分别构建一个持久化20会话episode共100个任务。每个episode包含六组由2至3个任务组成的强依赖链及五个基本独立任务，并配有524个隐藏意图510个Rubric条目168条确定性规则187个工具和21项技能，以GPT-5.4模拟三条独立轨迹并计算PROC和COMP。
construction_steps_en: Select researcher, marketer, law trainee, pharmacist, and financier as five professional roles
Work with domain experts to define stable routines, preferences, working styles, and long-term goals
Ground tasks in authentic work and require concrete deliverables reviewed for realism and feasibility
Build persistent project environments exposing 187 unique tools and 21 reusable skills
Create one 20-session episode per persona for a total of 100 tasks
Within each episode, create six strong dependency groups of two to three tasks and five largely independent tasks
Write natural underspecified or environment-triggered starts whose missing requirements can be recovered
Annotate 524 session-local or cross-session hidden intents recoverable through action or clarification
Have human experts execute and review reference solutions and author 510 rubric plus 168 deterministic rule items
construction_steps_zh: 选择研究员营销人员法律实习生药剂师和金融从业者五类专业角色
与领域专家共同定义稳定日常偏好工作风格和长期目标
以真实工作和具体交付物构造任务并人工复核真实性与可行性
构建跨会话持久化项目环境并提供187个独特工具和21项可复用技能
为每个角色创建一个20会话episode共100个任务
每个episode创建六组2至3任务强依赖链及五个基本独立任务
编写自然的欠明确起始请求或环境触发会话并确保缺失要求可恢复
标注524个可通过行动或澄清恢复的会话内或跨会话隐藏意图
由人类专家执行和复核参考解并编写510个Rubric条目与168条确定性规则
evaluation_steps_en: Run the same Nanobot-derived agent scaffold with a GPT-5.4 simulated user at temperature zero
Execute three independent trajectories while persisting session history, artifacts, messages, tools, and workspace state
Track every hidden intent to completed, inferred, or user-provided terminal status
Compute PROC by crediting completed and inferred intents while excluding user-provided intents
Compute COMP as the mean of strict binary rubric judgments merged with deterministic rule outcomes and report mean plus standard deviation
evaluation_steps_zh: 使用相同Nanobot派生Agent脚手架和温度为0的GPT-5.4模拟用户
运行三条独立轨迹并持久化会话历史产物消息工具和工作区状态
把每个隐藏意图跟踪到已完成已推断或用户已提供三种终态之一
PROC计入已完成和已推断意图并排除用户已提供意图
COMP合并严格二元Rubric判断与确定性规则结果取均值并报告均值和标准差

source_locator: Molmo and PixMo paper counting-data construction and evaluation discussion; official allenai/pixmo-count Hugging Face data card and allenai/molmo repository
evidence_summary_en: PixMo-Count runs the non-VLM Detic detector over diverse web images, strictly filters detections, selects the most frequent class per image, and converts boxes to object-center points before accuracy and diversity filtering. Counts two through ten are sampled at 120 examples each and manually verified into 540 validation plus 540 test records without points; the released 36,916-record training split covers counts zero through ten with labels and points.
evidence_summary_zh: PixMo-Count在多样网页图像上运行非VLM的Detic检测器，严格过滤检测结果后为每张图选择检测最多的类别并把框转换为目标中心点，再进行准确性和多样性过滤。对计数2至10各抽取120例并人工核验形成各540条且不含点的验证集与测试集；发布的36,916条训练记录覆盖计数0至10并包含标签和点。
construction_steps_en: Source diverse web images while retaining image URLs
Run the standard non-VLM Detic detector to propose object instances
Apply a strict confidence threshold and remove low-confidence detections
Choose the class with the most detections as the single target class for each image
Convert retained boxes to x-y object-center points and count zero through ten instances
Pair each image and target class with its count while retaining points for training supervision
Filter inaccurate candidates and reduce redundant visual examples
For counts two through ten, sample 120 evaluation candidates per count
Manually verify true counts and reject inaccurate detector labels
Split verified examples into 540 validation and 540 test records without point fields
Release the remaining 36,916 training records with counts zero through ten, labels, and center points
Publish URL, SHA-256, count, label, and point fields under the ODC-BY-1.0 data license
construction_steps_zh: 获取多样网页图像并保留图像URL
运行标准非VLM的Detic检测器提出目标实例
应用严格置信度阈值并移除低置信度检测
为每张图选择检测数量最多的类别作为唯一计数目标
把保留框转换为x-y目标中心点并统计0至10个实例
把图像目标类别与计数配对并为训练监督保留点
过滤不准确候选并减少冗余视觉样例
对计数2至10各抽取120个评测候选样例
人工核验真实数量并剔除错误检测标签
把核验样例划分为各540条且不含点字段的验证集与测试集
发布剩余36,916条计数0至10且包含类别和中心点的训练记录
按ODC-BY-1.0数据许可发布URL SHA-256计数类别和点字段
evaluation_steps_en: Prompt the model with the image and target-object counting query
Compare direct count-only prediction with point-then-count reasoning
Score predicted integer counts against references with Accuracy
Use the manually verified validation or held-out test split
Analyze how point generation and point order affect counting accuracy
evaluation_steps_zh: 向模型提供图像与目标物体计数问题

使用Accuracy比较整数预测计数与参考答案
在人工核验验证集或留出测试集上评测

source_locator: arXiv:2502.18443v3 Section 3 olmOCR-Bench and Appendix F.1 benchmark-source details, cross-checked against the released allenai/olmOCR-Bench dataset
evidence_summary_en: olmOCR-Bench curates seven challenging document sources, removes PII and non-public files, decontaminates by URL, and manually verifies source-specific unit tests. The released 1,403 PDFs carry 7,010 binary presence, absence, reading-order, table, and formula tests plus sanity checks; normalized OCR outputs are scored per source and macro-averaged.
evidence_summary_zh: olmOCR-Bench筛选七类高难文档来源，移除个人信息与不可公开文件，按URL去污染，并人工核验按来源编写的单元测试。发布版1,403份PDF含7,010项存在缺失阅读顺序表格与公式二元测试及健全性检查，规范化OCR输出后按来源评分并宏平均。
construction_steps_en: Define a unit-test benchmark for faithful PDF text linearization without full-reference transcriptions
Collect arXiv math, old-scan math, tables, old scans, headers and footers, multi-column, and long tiny-text documents
Remove documents containing PII or lacking permission for public distribution
Deduplicate benchmark PDF URLs against olmOCR-mix-0225
Use humans, scripts, Gemini Flash 2.0, Claude Sonnet 3.7, DocLayout-YOLO, and KaTeX for source-specific test drafting
Manually verify every generated or split test and attach positional conditions where required
Release 1,403 PDFs with 721 presence, 823 absence, 1,061 reading-order, 1,020 table, and 3,385 formula tests
construction_steps_zh: 定义无需完整参考转录的PDF忠实文本线性化单元测试基准
收集arXiv数学老扫描数学表格老扫描页眉页脚多栏和长篇微小文字七类文档
移除包含个人信息或没有公开传播许可的文档

使用人工脚本Gemini Flash 2.0 Claude Sonnet 3.7 DocLayout-YOLO和KaTeX按来源起草测试
人工核验每项生成或拆分测试并在需要时附加位置条件
发布1,403份PDF及721项存在823项缺失1,061项阅读顺序1,020项表格和3,385项公式测试
evaluation_steps_en: Run each OCR system over every PDF and emit Markdown or plain text
Normalize whitespace, Markdown emphasis, quotes, hyphens, and Unicode NFC
Apply baseline non-empty, repetition-loop, and unexpected-script sanity checks
Score every content test as binary pass or fail and compute pass rates per document source
Macro-average the seven source scores and report bootstrap 95 percent confidence intervals
evaluation_steps_zh: 用每个OCR系统处理全部PDF并输出Markdown或纯文本

source_locator: arXiv:2606.22388 benchmark construction, interactive environment, retrieval, blocking, and evaluation-metric sections plus official JiayuJeff/PlanBench-XL repository
evidence_summary_en: PlanBench-XL generates and filters 56 retail datatypes, 1,665 typed tools, executable records, state-graph tasks, all valid paths, and 327 natural-language queries with shortest paths of 5-9 calls. Agents retrieve at most 30 tools and act for up to 100 turns, optionally under path-preserving explicit, implicit, or misleading blockers, with seven planning and execution metrics.
evidence_summary_zh: PlanBench-XL生成并过滤56种零售数据类型1,665个类型化工具可执行记录状态图任务全部有效路径和327条自然语言查询，最短路径需5至9次调用。Agent每次最多检索30个工具并运行最多100轮，可选应用保路径的显式隐式或语义误导阻断，并用七项规划与执行指标评测。
construction_steps_en: Have an LLM propose retail datatypes and filter vague, redundant, or unrealistic concepts into 56 datatypes
Combine one to five input datatypes and one output datatype to synthesize executable tools
Filter unreasonable or redundant tools and fix canonical names plus natural aliases
Create five noisy sibling variants for every executable tool
Populate concrete backend records and assign fixed unhelpful outputs to noisy tools
Define each task with initial datatypes and a target, build its state graph, and enumerate all ground-truth paths
Keep solvable tasks whose shortest valid paths require at least five calls and span 5-9 calls in the release
Sample concrete entities, have an LLM verbalize the query, and execute a valid path for the gold answer
Release 327 queries over 56 datatypes and 1,665 tools
construction_steps_zh: 由LLM提出零售数据类型并过滤模糊冗余或不真实概念得到56种数据类型
组合1至5种输入数据类型与一种输出数据类型合成可执行工具
过滤不合理或冗余工具并固定规范名称与自然别名
为每个可执行工具创建五类噪声同族变体
填充具体后端记录并为噪声工具分配固定无用输出
用初始数据类型和目标定义任务构建状态图并枚举全部真实路径
保留最短有效路径至少五次调用且发布版跨度为5至9次调用的可解任务
抽取具体实体由LLM语言化查询并执行有效路径得到标准答案
发布覆盖56种数据类型与1,665个工具的327条查询
evaluation_steps_en: Track hidden typed state, discovered tools, and obtained values while allowing retrieve, tool-call, and answer actions
Retrieve by input, output, or input-output bridge conditions and return at most 30 tools
Optionally replace path-critical tools with explicit, implicit, or semantically misleading blockers while preserving one valid path
Run the agent for at most 100 turns so it can accumulate evidence, detect failures, and re-plan
Report Accuracy, EGT datatype precision, average turns, mean EDT, search/call ratio, invalid tool-call rate, and untrusted-input rejection rate
evaluation_steps_zh: 跟踪隐藏类型状态已发现工具和已取得值并允许检索调用与回答动作
按输入输出或输入输出桥接条件检索且最多返回30个工具
可选用显式隐式或语义误导阻断替换路径关键工具并至少保留一条有效路径
最多运行100轮以累积证据识别失败并重新规划
报告Accuracy EGT数据类型精度平均轮数Mean EDT检索调用比无效工具调用率和不可信输入拒绝率

source_locator: arXiv:2505.09990v2 Point-Bench dataset-construction and evaluation-protocol sections and Figure 2, cross-checked against the official PointArena project
evidence_summary_en: Point-Bench, the static component of PointArena, builds 982 post-April-20-2025 text-image pairs across spatial, affordance, counting, steerable, and reasoning categories. Three anonymized MLLMs plus humans filter hard queries; point-seeded SAM masks are manually refined and independently verified; Success Rate requires the exact target count and every mask covered.
evidence_summary_zh: Point-Bench是PointArena的静态部分，使用2025年4月20日后公开图像构建空间可供性计数可操纵和推理五类共982组图文样例。三个匿名多模态模型与人工评审筛选高难查询，点提示SAM掩码经人工细化和独立复核，Success Rate要求预测点数等于目标数且覆盖每个掩码。
construction_steps_en: Gather public-source images posted after April 20, 2025 to reduce likely model-data exposure
Distribute candidates across spatial, affordance, counting, steerable, and reasoning categories
Have crowdworkers write natural category-aligned queries and avoid explicit object names for steerable items
Ask three anonymized MLLMs to answer each query
Have human judges retain valid hard items for which at most one model is correct
Have annotators place points on all intended targets
Use the points to seed SAM and generate initial target masks
Have annotators edit incorrect mask regions and remove unintended portions
Use a separate annotator group to verify every target mask
Release 982 text-image pairs with masks and five category labels
construction_steps_zh: 收集2025年4月20日后发布的公开来源图像以降低模型数据暴露可能
把候选均衡到空间可供性计数可操纵和推理五类
由众包标注者编写自然类别匹配查询且可操纵类避免显式物体名
让三个匿名多模态模型回答每条查询
由人工评审保留至多一个模型答对的有效高难样例
由标注者在全部预期目标上放置点
用这些点提示SAM生成初始目标掩码
由标注者编辑错误掩码区域并移除非预期部分
使用另一组标注者核验每个目标掩码
发布含掩码与五类标签的982组图文样例
evaluation_steps_en: Provide the RGB image and query and request coordinates in a standardized x-y format
Predict K points for K-star binary target masks
Require K equals K-star and at least one predicted point falls inside every target mask
For non-counting tasks request one point and evaluate only the first point if extras are emitted
Evaluate 16 MLLMs on all 982 pairs in three independent zero-shot runs and report mean plus standard deviation of category Success Rate
evaluation_steps_zh: 提供RGB图像与查询并要求按标准x-y坐标格式回答
针对K星个二元目标掩码预测K个点
要求K等于K星且每个目标掩码至少包含一个预测点
非计数任务要求一个点且多输出时仅评测第一点
让16个多模态模型在全部982组样例上独立零样本运行三次并报告各类Success Rate均值与标准差

source_locator: arXiv:2504.18428v4 benchmark construction, translation pipeline, and evaluation sections plus official QwenLM/PolyMath repository
evidence_summary_en: PolyMATH selects 500 English problems total, 125 at each of four thought-depth and knowledge-breadth levels, and translates the same set into 17 more languages through GPT-4o pretranslation, math-term extraction, and language-expert calibration. The resulting 9,000 instances use rule-based answer matching, average@16 for reasoning models, and 1/2/4/8 difficulty-weighted accuracy.
evidence_summary_zh: PolyMATH共筛选500道英文题，按思维深度与知识广度四档各125道，再通过GPT-4o预翻译数学术语提取和语言专家校准把同一批题扩展到另外17种语言。形成的9,000条样例使用规则答案匹配，推理模型计算average@16，并以1/2/4/8权重计算难度加权准确率。
construction_steps_en: Define low, medium, high, and top difficulty through thought depth and knowledge breadth
Select 500 English problems total with 125 per level from MGSM, official exams, competitions, and 25 HLE items
Have one mathematics expert assign each level and two additional experts confirm every tag
Use GPT-4o to pretranslate the 500 English problems into 17 target languages
Have mathematics experts extract problem-specific key terms
Have language experts with mathematics knowledge calibrate terminology, formulas, logic, and fluency
Align all 18 language versions to one answer and cover about 75 percent of native speakers
Release 500 by 18 equals 9,000 parallel instances with source and answer metadata
construction_steps_zh: 用思维深度与知识广度定义低中高和顶级四档难度
从MGSM官方考试竞赛及25道HLE题中共筛选500道英文题且每档125道
由一位数学专家分配档位并由另外两位专家确认每个标签
使用GPT-4o把500道英文题预翻译为17种目标语言
由数学专家提取题目专属关键术语
由具备数学知识的语言专家校准术语公式逻辑与流畅度
把18种语言版本对齐到同一答案并覆盖约75%母语人口
发布500乘18等于9,000条含来源与答案元数据的平行样例
evaluation_steps_en: Prompt every language version for step-by-step reasoning and a boxed final answer
Decode non-reasoning open models greedily
Run reasoning models 16 times with temperature 0.6, top-p 0.95, and top-k 20 and compute average@16
Use the human-validated rule matcher with greater than 98 percent precision to score answers
Report language and level accuracy, language consistency, and Difficulty-Weighted Accuracy with weights 1, 2, 4, and 8
evaluation_steps_zh: 对每种语言版本要求逐步推理并把最终答案放入方框
非推理开源模型使用贪心解码
推理模型以温度0.6 top-p 0.95和top-k 20运行16次并计算average@16
使用经人工验证且精度超过98%的规则匹配器评分
报告语言与难度Accuracy语言一致性及权重1/2/4/8的难度加权准确率

source_locator: arXiv:2212.10511v4 PopQA dataset-construction and open-domain QA evaluation sections plus official AlexTMallen/adaptive-retrieval repository
evidence_summary_en: PopQA randomly samples Wikidata triples from 16 relations over a broad popularity range, instantiates one manually written question template per relation, collects every valid object and alias, and adds Wikipedia page views. Its 14,267 open-domain questions use exact gold-answer substring accuracy and popularity, relation, retrieval, and adaptive-retrieval analyses.
evidence_summary_zh: PopQA从16种Wikidata关系中跨广泛流行度随机抽取三元组，为每种关系实例化一个人工问题模板，收集全部有效宾语及别名并附加维基百科访问量。14,267条开放域问题使用标准答案精确子串准确率，并分析流行度关系类型检索和自适应检索。
construction_steps_en: Select 16 interpretable Wikidata relations spanning people, places, works, and one-to-many facts
Randomly sample subject-relation-object triples over a broad entity-popularity range
Manually write one natural-language question template for each relation
Substitute the triple subject into the relation template
Collect every entity E satisfying the same subject-relation-E fact
Expand acceptable answers with aliases and store Wikidata IDs or URIs, Wikipedia titles, and relation metadata
Query monthly Wikipedia page views and attach subject and object popularity metadata
Release 14,267 open-domain questions across 16 relations
construction_steps_zh: 选择覆盖人物地点作品和一对多事实的16种可解释Wikidata关系
跨广泛实体流行度随机抽取主语关系宾语三元组
为每种关系人工编写一个自然语言问题模板
把三元组主语替换到关系模板中
收集每个满足同一主语关系E事实的实体E
用别名扩展可接受答案并保存Wikidata ID或URI维基标题和关系元数据
查询维基百科月度访问量并附加主语与宾语流行度元数据
发布覆盖16种关系的14,267条开放域问题
evaluation_steps_en: Provide no supporting paragraph and prompt models in zero- or few-shot open-domain QA settings
Compare vanilla parametric memory against BM25, Contriever, GenRead, and adaptive retrieval variants
Compare each prediction against every acceptable object and alias
Mark a question correct when any exact gold-answer string appears as a substring of the prediction
Report overall and per-relation accuracy and analyze correlation with log entity popularity
evaluation_steps_zh: 不提供支撑段落并在零样本或少样本开放域问答设置下提示模型
比较原始参数记忆与BM25 Contriever GenRead及自适应检索变体
把每条预测与全部可接受宾语及别名比较
任一标准答案精确字符串出现在预测子串中即判为正确
报告总体及各关系准确率并分析与实体流行度对数的相关

source_locator: arXiv:2602.20459 benchmark-construction, four-task, temporal-split, metrics, and simulation sections, cross-checked against the official allenai/prescience repository
evidence_summary_en: PreScience fixes an October 2023 to October 2025 AI arXiv snapshot, maps papers to Semantic Scholar, expands key references and author histories, applies S2AND author disambiguation, and aligns citation metadata to each target date. It releases 98K target papers within a 502K-paper graph, four forecasting tasks, and a 12-month composed simulation.
evidence_summary_zh: PreScience固定2023年10月至2025年10月的AI arXiv快照，映射Semantic Scholar论文，扩展关键参考文献与作者历史，使用S2AND消歧并把引用元数据对齐到目标日期。最终发布9.8万篇目标论文、50.2万篇论文图谱、四项预测任务和12个月组合模拟。
construction_steps_en: Fix a forecasting cutoff and exclude evidence that appears after each target paper
Filter the October 2023 to October 2025 arXiv snapshot to seven AI-related categories
Map arXiv IDs to Semantic Scholar Corpus IDs, remove unresolved or duplicate targets, and sort by publication date
Attach at most ten influential Semantic Scholar references published before every target
Expand target-author histories with pre-target publications and their references
Apply S2AND to merge author records, prune invalid name clusters, and repair missing authors as singletons
Count citations only before each target, compute cutoff h-index values, and build monthly citation trajectories
Restore snapshot text, assign target, reference, and history roles, and freeze the structured scholarly graph
Release October 2023 to October 2024 training targets and October 2024 to October 2025 test targets, totaling 98K targets and 502K papers
construction_steps_zh: 固定科研预测截止时间并排除每篇目标论文发表后的证据
从2023年10月至2025年10月arXiv快照筛选七个AI相关类别
把arXiv ID映射到Semantic Scholar Corpus ID并去除未解析或重复目标后按发表日期排序
为每篇目标附加发表在先且最多十篇的Semantic Scholar influential参考文献
用目标作者发表前论文及其参考文献扩展作者历史
使用S2AND合并作者记录裁剪无效姓名簇并把缺失作者修复为单例
只统计目标日前引用计算截止时作者h-index并构建月度引用轨迹
恢复快照文本分配目标参考和历史角色并冻结结构化学术图谱
发布2023年10月至2024年10月训练集和2024年10月至2025年10月测试集共9.8万目标与50.2万篇论文
evaluation_steps_en: Predict remaining collaborators from a seed author and prior publication history using nDCG and R-Precision
Rank temporally available key references from paper authors using nDCG and R-Precision
Generate title and abstract from authors plus key references and score LACERScore, ROUGE-L, and BERTScore
Forecast 12-month citation impact from target context and bibliometrics and report MAE, Pearson, and Spearman
Compose the tasks into a day-by-day 12-month simulation that feeds synthetic history forward and compares novelty and diversity with human papers
evaluation_steps_zh: 由种子作者与此前发表历史预测其余合作者并计算nDCG与R-Precision
由论文作者排序当时可获得的关键参考文献并计算nDCG与R-Precision
由作者和关键参考生成标题摘要并计算LACERScore ROUGE-L与BERTScore
由目标上下文与文献计量预测12个月引用影响并报告MAE Pearson与Spearman
把任务组合为逐日12个月模拟将合成历史传递到后续回合并与人类论文比较新颖性和多样性

source_locator: arXiv:2504.17550 HalluLens PreciseWikiQA construction, dynamic benchmarking, evaluator, and metrics sections, cross-checked against the official facebookresearch/HalluLens repository
evidence_summary_en: PreciseWikiQA is HalluLens Task 1, not an ERNIE-created benchmark. Each run stratifies 44,754 GoodWiki pages into ten WikiRank-centrality bins, samples 500 pages per bin, and uses separate Llama 3.1 70B question and answer generation to form 5,000 short-answer items. An LLM judge separates false refusals, attempted-answer hallucinations, and correct answers over three trials.
evidence_summary_zh: PreciseWikiQA是HalluLens任务一而非ERNIE创建的基准。每次运行把44,754个GoodWiki页面按WikiRank中心性分成十档，每档抽500页，再用Llama 3.1 70B分两阶段生成问题与答案，形成5,000道短答案题。LLM评审在三次试验中区分错误拒答、尝试回答后的幻觉和正确回答。
construction_steps_en: Define extrinsic hallucination evaluation over presumed training-data knowledge with concise factual answers
Start from 44,754 reproducible good-quality Wikipedia pages in GoodWiki
Join WikiRank harmonic centrality as a proxy for page importance and likely training frequency
Create ten difficulty bins numbered 0 to 9 from hardest to easiest
Sample 500 pages per bin to obtain 5,000 balanced source pages for each dynamic run
Split every article into sections and randomly select one hidden reference section
Use Llama 3.1 70B to generate a specific self-contained question from the section
Generate the gold answer separately from the same section to reduce answer leakage into wording
Keep a word or short phrase, reject answers over ten words, regenerate unanswerable questions, and freeze 5,000 QA pairs
construction_steps_zh: 定义使用假定训练数据知识和简短事实答案的外在幻觉评测
从GoodWiki的44,754个可复现高质量维基百科页面开始
关联WikiRank调和中心性作为页面重要性与可能训练频次的代理
由难到易创建编号0至9的十个难度档
每档抽500页为每次动态运行得到5,000个平衡来源页面
把每篇文章切分为章节并随机选择一个推理时隐藏的参考章节
使用Llama 3.1 70B从章节生成具体且自包含的问题
从同一章节单独生成标准答案以减少答案泄漏进问题措辞
答案限制为单词或短语淘汰超过十词答案重生成不可回答问题并冻结5,000组问答
evaluation_steps_en: Provide each question without the source context and allow a free-form answer or abstention
Use an LLM evaluator prompt to identify lack-of-knowledge refusal before judging correctness
For attempted answers compare against gold and label correct, incorrect, or unverifiable
Treat incorrect and unverifiable attempted answers as hallucinations
Report false-refusal rate, hallucination rate among attempted answers, and overall correct-answer rate averaged over three dynamic trials
evaluation_steps_zh: 不提供来源上下文只给问题并允许自由回答或弃答
先用LLM评审提示识别因缺乏知识而拒答再判断正确性
对已尝试回答与标准答案比较并标为正确错误或不可验证
把错误和不可验证的已尝试回答都计为幻觉
在三次动态试验上报告错误拒答率尝试回答后的幻觉率和总体正确回答率

source_locator: arXiv:2410.03117 benchmark-design, data-generation, response-normalization, and step-aware-metrics sections, cross-checked against the official ifujisawa/proc-bench repository
evidence_summary_en: ProcBench isolates direct procedural execution through 23 string, list, and integer task types with one fixed full-procedure template per task. Generators create ten examples at every length from 2 to 25 steps, yielding 240 examples per task and 5,520 total with all intermediate states. GPT-4o normalizes model responses to typed JSON before four exact step-aware metrics.
evidence_summary_zh: ProcBench通过23种字符串列表和整数任务隔离直接程序执行，每类任务使用一个完整程序固定模板。生成器在2至25步的每个长度生成10例，得到每类240例共5,520例并保存所有中间状态。模型回答经GPT-4o规范为带类型JSON后计算四项精确过程指标。
construction_steps_en: Remove path search where possible and minimize implicit domain knowledge to isolate instruction followability
Require complete procedures, only basic language knowledge, and straightforward human-executable steps
Define 23 distinct string, list, or integer manipulation task types
Write one fixed template per task that specifies the full procedure, intermediate outputs, and final format
Implement a reproducible generator that samples concrete values and executes the template operations
Vary procedure length from 2 to 25 steps while holding each task rule fixed
Sample ten examples at every one of the 24 lengths to produce 240 examples per task
Execute every operation to save all intermediate states and the final state
Combine templates and questions into 23 times 240 equals 5,520 benchmark examples
construction_steps_zh: 尽可能移除路径搜索并最小化隐式领域知识以隔离指令可遵循性
要求完整程序只需基础语言知识且每个人类执行步骤都直接
定义23种不同的字符串列表或整数操作任务
每类任务编写一个固定模板说明完整程序中间输出与最终格式
实现可复现生成器抽取具体值并执行模板操作
在保持每类任务规则不变时把程序长度从2步变到25步
在24种长度上各抽10例得到每类240例
执行每项操作并保存全部中间状态与最终状态
组合模板和问题形成23乘240等于5,520条基准样例
evaluation_steps_en: Group examples into short 2-6, medium 7-16, and long 17-25 step cohorts
Provide the full procedure plus a concrete question and request intermediate and final states
Use GPT-4o to convert free-form responses to typed JSON while preserving int, str, and list values
Compare predicted and gold state sequences exactly and find the longest matching prefix
Report Prefix Match Length, length-normalized Prefix Accuracy, Sequential Match, and Final Match by task and length
evaluation_steps_zh: 把样例划分为2至6步短组7至16步中组与17至25步长组
提供完整程序和具体问题并要求输出中间状态与最终状态
使用GPT-4o把自由回答转换为带类型JSON并保留int str与list值
精确比较预测与标准状态序列并寻找最长匹配前缀
按任务与长度报告Prefix Match Length归一化Prefix Accuracy Sequential Match和Final Match

source_locator: arXiv:2605.03546 dataset-construction, behavioral-test, environment, agent-protocol, and metrics sections, cross-checked against programbench.com and the official facebookresearch/ProgramBench repository
evidence_summary_en: ProgramBench is a 2026 black-box software-reconstruction benchmark, not a Claude system-card benchmark. A mini-SWE-agent plus Claude Sonnet 4.5 converts open-source programs into source-stripped offline tasks, builds coverage-driven observable behavioral tests, filters weak or invalid assertions, and releases 200 tasks with 248,853 test functions. Agents receive executable access and sanitized documentation under anti-cheating constraints.
evidence_summary_zh: ProgramBench是2026年的黑盒软件重建基准而非Claude系统卡基准。mini-SWE-agent与Claude Sonnet 4.5把开源程序转换为剥离源码的离线任务，构建覆盖率驱动的可观察行为测试并过滤弱断言或无效测试，最终发布200题与248,853个测试函数。智能体只能在反作弊约束下执行程序并阅读清洗文档。
construction_steps_en: Select candidate repositories that produce standalone programs and cover diverse software domains
Standardize collection with mini-SWE-agent, Claude Sonnet 4.5, and an Ubuntu 22.04 container
Compile the original source into a working gold executable and record one reproducible build script
Read source, documentation, and native tests and probe the gold program with varied inputs
Generate behavioral tests over stdout, stderr, exit codes, files, and side effects without source-level assertions
Measure line coverage and iteratively add tests for uncovered code paths
Lint exit-code-only, short-substring, and disjunctive assertions and ask the agent to repair weak tests
Reject tests that are nondeterministic on gold or pass a dummy binary
Remove source and native tests, sanitize documentation, and retain only task-visible information
Build an offline image with execute-only gold, sanitized docs, essential assets, no internet, and no binary reading
Release 200 program tasks with 248,853 test functions and a median of 770 tests per task
construction_steps_zh: 选择生成独立程序且覆盖多种软件领域的候选仓库

source_locator: arXiv:2310.14151 original 16-task benchmark construction, prompt template, submission, and scoring sections, cross-checked against the official michael-wzhu/PromptCBLUE repository and v0.2 data contract
evidence_summary_en: The original PromptCBLUE paper reformulates 16 Chinese medical NLP tasks into five cohorts and 94 instruction templates under a unified input-target JSONL contract. Version 0.2 contains 68,900 train, 10,360 validation, and 10,320 examples in each hidden-target test split. One shared LLM backbone and head produce text that task-specific standard-library post-processing converts before F1 or ROUGE scoring.
evidence_summary_zh: 原始PromptCBLUE论文把16项中文医疗NLP任务重构为五类并设计94个指令模板，统一使用input-target JSONL合同。v0.2含68,900条训练、10,360条验证及两个各10,320条且隐藏target的测试集。一个共享LLM主干和语言模型头生成文本，再由任务专用标准库后处理转换后计算F1或ROUGE。
construction_steps_en: Assemble 16 authentic Chinese medical NLP tasks from CBLUE and companion datasets
Organize them into information extraction, classification, inference, symptom-status, and generation cohorts
Convert spans, labels, and structures into generated-text targets while preserving task semantics
Author 94 natural-language instruction templates with answer choices where needed and no task identity in model input
Render every item as unified JSONL with input, target, task type, answer choices, and sample ID
Preserve 68,900 train, 10,360 validation, and two 10,320-example test splits while mixing all tasks within each split
Publish fixed test inputs with empty target strings to hide ground truth
construction_steps_zh: 从CBLUE及配套数据集汇集16项真实中文医疗NLP任务
组织为信息抽取分类推理症状状态与生成五类任务
把跨度标签与结构转换为生成文本目标并保留任务语义
编写94个自然语言指令模板在需要时加入答案选项且模型输入不暴露任务身份

evaluation_steps_en: Use fixed few-shot demonstrations by task or full-data and few-shot fine-tuning under one generation interface
Require one shared LLM backbone, one shared language-model head, and PEFT modules below one percent
Feed every fixed test input verbatim and preserve row order plus sample IDs
Use standard-library post-processing to convert text into task-specific entities, labels, sections, or structures
Score extraction and structured tasks with strict micro-F1, selected classifiers with macro-F1, and remaining inference tasks with micro-F1

Select the primary F1 or ROUGE-L for each task and average all 16 task scores on the online platform

source_locator: arXiv:2210.01240 Sections 3-5 and Appendix A, cross-checked against the original v1 branch of the official asaparov/prontoqa repository
evidence_summary_en: The original PrOntoQA benchmark generates each example from a small linear ontology and a unique chained-modus-ponens proof, translates both through an invertible controlled grammar, and evaluates model CoT by parsing it back into formal proof steps. The paper varies ontology condition, fact order, and 1, 3, or 5 proof hops, using 400 test examples per experimental configuration and eight independently generated demonstrations.
evidence_summary_zh: 原始PrOntoQA从小型线性本体与唯一的连锁肯定前件证明生成每条样例，经可逆受控语法翻译后，再把模型思维链解析回形式证明步骤。论文改变本体条件、事实顺序及1、3、5跳证明，每个实验配置使用400个测试样例与8个独立生成示例。
construction_steps_en: Restrict the controlled task to uniquely provable chains of modus ponens expressed with easily parsed sentences
Sample a linear ontology of 3 to 10 concepts with subtype relations and optional properties
Choose fictional, real-world-consistent true, or randomly counterfactual false ontology conditions
Choose a starting node uniformly and create an entity-membership axiom
Walk upward through the ontology until the target 1-, 3-, or 5-hop conclusion is reached
Translate ontology edges and properties into a natural-language context with a simple invertible grammar
Add distractors and order context facts top-down or bottom-up to control difficulty and block shortcuts
Convert the initial fact and proof conclusion into a true-or-false query, negating the conclusion with probability 0.5
Translate every proof conclusion into one gold CoT sentence and store context, query, CoT, and label
construction_steps_zh: 把受控任务限制为使用易解析句子表达且具有唯一证明的连锁肯定前件推理
抽取含3至10个概念及子类关系和可选属性的线性本体
选择虚构符合现实的真实或随机反事实错误本体条件
均匀选择起始节点并建立实体属于该概念的公理
沿本体向上遍历直至得到目标1跳3跳或5跳结论
用简单可逆语法把本体边与属性翻译成自然语言上下文
添加干扰句并自顶向下或自底向上排序事实以控制难度和阻断捷径
把初始事实与证明结论转换为判断查询并以0.5概率询问结论的否定
把每个证明结论翻译为一句标准思维链并保存上下文查询思维链和标签
evaluation_steps_en: Prompt with eight independently generated fully labeled examples and one unlabeled test question
Parse each predicted CoT sentence back into logical form with recursive-descent semantic parsing
Classify steps by strict or broad validity, atomicity, and whether they remain on the correct proof path
Compare the reconstructed proof and binary label with the unique gold proof and target conclusion
Report label accuracy and strict, skip, broad, and valid proof accuracy by hops, ordering, and ontology condition
evaluation_steps_zh: 用8个独立生成且完整标注的示例提示并追加一个未标注测试题
使用递归下降语义解析把预测思维链的每句话恢复为逻辑形式
按严格或广义有效性原子性及是否仍在正确证明路径上分类步骤
把重构证明与二元标签同唯一标准证明和目标结论比较
按跳数顺序和本体条件报告标签准确率及严格跨步广义和有效证明准确率

source_locator: arXiv:2406.05540 Sections 3.2, 4.3, 5, 6 and Datasheet B.2-B.4, cross-checked against the official tsynbio/ProteinLMBench dataset
evidence_summary_en: ProteinLMBench is not an Intern-S1-created benchmark. Paper authors use an LLM to read downloaded research papers and draft protein questions, validate candidates by machine and humans, and randomly sample 944 manually annotated items with explanations from a pool exceeding 100,000 QA pairs. The paper specifies six-choice questions and accuracy evaluation, although the current public JSON contains a small number of records whose option count differs from six.
evidence_summary_zh: ProteinLMBench并非由Intern-S1创建。论文作者让LLM阅读下载的研究论文起草蛋白质问题，经机器与人工验证后，从超过10万条问答池随机抽取944道带解释的人工标注题。论文规定六选一与准确率评测，但当前公开JSON中少量记录的选项数偏离六项。
construction_steps_en: Gather public protein resources and research literature from PubMed, PMC, UniProt, RefSeq, SIFTS, and Enzyme Nomenclature sources
Download research papers and remove literature that is not related to proteins
Use an LLM to read downloaded papers and create relevant protein questions, answers, and explanations
Aggregate more than 100,000 protein-related question-answer pairs into a candidate pool
Run custom machine and Python validation checks over generated candidates
Have paper authors perform human validation and manually annotate retained questions
Filter noise, rectify detected anomalies, and remove corrupted information
Randomly sample 944 questions from the greater-than-100K pool under manpower constraints
Store question, answer choices, correct option, and a correct-answer explanation for each item
Target six-choice questions and balance correct answers across option positions 1 through 6
Freeze one no-split benchmark spanning protein property prediction, descriptions, and sequence understanding
construction_steps_zh: 从PubMed PMC UniProt RefSeq SIFTS与Enzyme Nomenclature汇集公开蛋白质资源和研究文献
下载研究论文并删除与蛋白质无关的文献
让LLM阅读下载论文并生成相关蛋白质问题答案与解释
汇总超过10万条蛋白质问答对形成候选池
对生成候选题运行自定义机器与Python验证检查
由论文作者执行人工验证并人工标注保留题目
过滤噪声修正检测到的异常并移除损坏信息
在人力限制下从超过10万条候选池随机抽取944题
每题保存问题答案选项正确选项与正确答案解释
以六选一为目标格式并在选项1至6间平衡正确答案位置
冻结覆盖蛋白质性质预测描述与序列理解且不设推荐划分的基准
evaluation_steps_en: Present each question and its choices to base, SFT, or SSL-SFT model settings
Normalize the selected option and compare it with the gold answer over all 944 questions
Report benchmark-wide accuracy as the fraction of questions answered correctly
evaluation_steps_zh: 向基础SFT或SSL-SFT模型设置提供每道题及其选项
规范化模型选择并在全部944题上与标准答案比较
把正确题数占全部题目的比例报告为基准总准确率

source_locator: arXiv:2407.10362 Sections 2.1-2.4 and Appendices B.1-B.2, C.5, D, and E, cross-checked against the official Future-House/LAB-Bench repository
evidence_summary_en: ProtocolQA is the 135-question tool-free LAB-Bench subtask, not the 2,457-question full benchmark. Contracted biology experts extract protocols from protocols.io and STAR Protocols, deliberately inject errors and explain them, and additional experts validate the failure scenario and draft a troubleshooting MCQ. The paper releases about 80 percent publicly, holds 20 percent for contamination monitoring, and reports accuracy, precision, and coverage under zero-shot CoT with an explicit decline option.
evidence_summary_zh: ProtocolQA是LAB-Bench中135题的无工具子任务，而不是全基准2,457题。签约生物学专家从protocols.io和STAR Protocols提取方案、故意注入错误并解释，再由另一批专家核验失败场景并撰写故障排除选择题。论文公开约80%并私留20%监测污染，在带明确拒答项的零样本CoT下报告准确率、精确率与覆盖率。
construction_steps_en: Recruit contracted experts who hold biology-related PhDs or study in top PhD programs
Extract published experimental procedures from protocols.io and STAR Protocols
Introduce one or more errors that unambiguously change or ruin an output or intermediate step
Write an explanation of the injected error and its expected negative effect
Pass the altered protocol and explanation to additional experts in a second drafting round
Check that the error matches the explanation and would plausibly produce the negative outcome
Draft a hypothetical observed result and ask what protocol change would improve it
Format the scenario as an MCQ with one ideal corrective action and plausible alternatives
Use the Airtable authoring interface to revise, reject, or approve drafts and merge accepted items
Freeze 135 questions, release about 80 percent publicly, and retain 20 percent privately for contamination monitoring
construction_steps_zh: 招募拥有生物学相关博士学位或就读顶尖博士项目的签约专家
从protocols.io与STAR Protocols提取已发表实验流程
注入一个或多个会明确改变或破坏输出或中间步骤的错误
编写注入错误及其预期负面影响的解释
把修改后的方案与解释交给另一批专家进行第二轮起草
检查错误是否符合解释且确实可能产生所述负面结果
描述假想观察结果并询问何种实验方案改动可改善结果
把场景格式化为含一个理想纠正措施与合理替代项的选择题
使用Airtable创作界面修订拒绝或批准草稿并合入通过题目
冻结135题公开约80%并私留20%用于污染监测
evaluation_steps_en: Randomly permute options, add an Insufficient Information choice, and apply the zero-shot CoT answer-tag prompt without tools
Parse the tagged answer with a regex and fall back to Claude 2 when direct parsing fails
Report accuracy over all questions, precision over attempted questions, and coverage as attempted over all
Compare with expert quizzes and expert-grade a modified 20-question open-response ProtocolQA subset
evaluation_steps_zh: 随机打乱选项加入信息不足拒答项并在无工具条件下使用零样本CoT答案标签提示
用正则解析标签答案并在直接解析失败时回退到Claude 2
报告全部题上的准确率已尝试题上的精确率及已尝试占全部题的覆盖率
与专家测验比较并由专家评分改写后的20题ProtocolQA开放回答子集

source_locator: OpenAI o1 System Card ProtocolQA open-ended section, cross-checked against arXiv:2407.10362 ProtocolQA construction and open-response sections
evidence_summary_en: OpenAI converts 108 multiple-choice questions from FutureHouse ProtocolQA into open-ended short-answer tasks that preserve egregious errors in common published protocols, describe the observed wet-lab result, and ask how to fix the procedure. This derivative is distinct from both the original 135-item MCQ set and LAB-Bench's separate 20-item open-response analysis. The o1 System Card reports pass@1 plus a new baseline from 19 PhD scientists with more than one year of wet-lab experience, but does not disclose the grader implementation in that section.
evidence_summary_zh: OpenAI把FutureHouse ProtocolQA中的108道选择题改为开放式简答，保留常见已发表方案中的严重错误、描述观察到的湿实验结果并询问如何修复。该衍生集不同于原始135题选择题，也不同于LAB-Bench另做的20题开放回答分析。o1系统卡报告pass@1及19名具有一年以上湿实验经验的博士科学家新基线，但该节未披露评分器实现。
construction_steps_en: Start from the 135-item FutureHouse ProtocolQA multiple-choice subtask
Select a fixed subset of 108 protocol-troubleshooting source questions
Remove multiple-choice options to eliminate answer-choice cues and distractor elimination
Rewrite selection wording into answerable open-ended short-answer prompts
Preserve the deliberately introduced egregious error in each common published protocol
Describe the observed failed wet-lab result and connect it to the erroneous procedure
Ask how to fix the procedure without revealing the intended corrective answer
Freeze a 108-item open-ended evaluation described as harder and more realistic than the MCQ version
construction_steps_zh: 从FutureHouse ProtocolQA的135题多项选择子任务出发
固定选择108道实验方案故障排除来源题
移除多项选择选项以消除答案提示和干扰项排除捷径
把选择题措辞改写为可回答的开放式简答提示
保留每个常见已发表实验方案中有意引入的严重错误
描述观察到的湿实验失败结果并关联到错误流程
询问如何修复流程且不泄露预期纠正答案
冻结108题开放式评测集并将其定义为比选择题更难且更真实
evaluation_steps_en: Recruit 19 PhD scientists who each have more than one year of wet-lab experience
Have experts answer the same tasks and derive consensus and median expert baselines
Present each open-ended question to a model and collect one short-answer completion
Judge whether the completion passes against the intended repair while noting that grader details are not disclosed in the cited section
Aggregate one-attempt success as pass@1 over all 108 items
Compare model results with the 57 percent consensus and 42 percent median expert baselines
evaluation_steps_zh: 招募19名各自具有一年以上湿实验经验的博士科学家
让专家回答同一批题并得到专家共识与中位数基线
向模型提供每道开放问题并收集一个简答完成
依据预期修复判断回答是否通过同时注明所引章节未披露评分器细节
在全部108题上把单次尝试成功聚合为pass@1
把模型结果与57%专家共识及42%专家中位数基线比较

source_locator: arXiv:2504.21801 Section 3.5 and Appendix A, cross-checked against deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Prover-V2 and deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-ProverBench
evidence_summary_en: ProverBench is a 325-problem Lean 4 evaluation set, not the DeepSeek-Prover-V2 cold-start training pipeline. The authors select and formalize 15 number-theory and algebra questions from AIME 2024-2025 after excluding geometry, combinatorics, and counting, then curate and formalize 310 textbook or educational-tutorial problems across nine areas. Models complete Lean code in non-CoT or proof-plan-first CoT mode, and generated proofs are checked in Lean 4.9.0-rc2 before pass-ratio reporting.
evidence_summary_zh: ProverBench是325题的Lean 4评测集，而非DeepSeek-Prover-V2冷启动训练流程。作者在排除几何、组合和计数后，从AIME 2024-2025筛选并形式化15道数论与代数题，再从教材或教育教程精选并形式化310题覆盖九个领域。模型以非CoT或先给证明计划的CoT模式补全Lean代码，生成证明经Lean 4.9.0-rc2检查后报告通过率。
construction_steps_en: Define coverage across high-school competition and undergraduate mathematics
Collect candidate problems from AIME I and II in 2024 and 2025
Exclude geometry, combinatorics, and counting problems whose Lean representation is cumbersome
Select and formalize 15 elementary number-theory and algebra AIME problems with correct answers given
Curate high-school competition and undergraduate examples from textbooks and educational tutorials
Formalize 310 additional problems covering number theory, algebra, calculus, analysis, and probability
Assign the paper's nine-area distribution of 40, 30, 50, 40, 90, 30, 10, 10, and 10 problems
Package each item with name, area, Lean imports and header, and formal_statement ending at the unfinished proof body
Freeze and publish all 325 problems as one evaluation set
construction_steps_zh: 定义高中竞赛与本科数学的覆盖范围
收集AIME 2024与2025年I卷和II卷候选题
排除在Lean中表示繁琐的几何组合与计数问题
选择并在给定正确答案下形式化15道初等数论与代数AIME题

source_locator: arXiv:2407.11214 / NeurIPS 2024 Sections 3-4, cross-checked against trishullab/PutnamBench
evidence_summary_en: PutnamBench manually formalizes all 640 William Lowell Putnam Mathematical Competition source problems in Lean 4 and Isabelle and 412 of them in Coq, yielding 1,692 formalizations. For roughly 60 percent of source problems with a closed-form solution, the solution is factored out so theorem provers can be tested either on finding a solution and proof or on proving a supplied solution. Each formalization is independently verified by a second person, and generated proofs are certified by the target proof assistant before pass@n reporting.

construction_steps_en: Collect the statements and official solutions for all 640 Putnam competition source problems
Transcribe each source problem into a structured benchmark record while preserving the intended mathematics
Identify the roughly 60 percent of problems whose answer can be expressed in closed form
Factor each closed-form answer out of the theorem statement instead of baking it into the goal
Expose both a find-the-solution-and-proof task and a supplied-solution proof task where applicable
Manually formalize all 640 source problems in Lean 4 as the first formalization track
Manually produce the corresponding 640 Isabelle and 412 Coq formalizations
Align mathematical types, assumptions, and target propositions across the three proof assistants
Have a second person independently verify every formalization and repair discrepancies
Freeze 640 Lean 4, 640 Isabelle, and 412 Coq items as 1,692 formalizations

source_locator: ACL 2024 Sections 3.1-3.6, 4.1, 5.1 and Appendix A.5, cross-checked against declare-lab/LLM-PuzzleTest/PuzzleVQA and declare-lab/PuzzleVQA
evidence_summary_en: PuzzleVQA programmatically generates 2,000 abstract visual-pattern puzzles from 20 templates spanning 10 categories. Templates combine number, color, shape, and size concepts in single- or dual-concept patterns; each template produces 100 unique instances. The generator samples objects, hides the target, creates answer choices, renders the image with Python and Pillow, and stores the image, question, options, answer, caption, pattern explanation, and deduction. Models are evaluated with zero-shot chain-of-thought prompting, answer extraction, and accuracy, with guided perception, induction, and deduction used for diagnosis.
evidence_summary_zh: PuzzleVQA从覆盖10类的20个模板程序化生成2000道抽象视觉规律题。模板以单概念或双概念形式组合数字、颜色、形状与大小，每个模板生成100个唯一实例。生成器抽样对象、隐藏目标、制作答案选项，使用Python与Pillow渲染图像，并保存图像、问题、选项、答案、图注、规律解释与推导。模型使用零样本思维链提示、答案抽取与准确率评测，并以引导式感知、归纳、演绎进行诊断。
construction_steps_en: Define the benchmark goal as testing abstract visual-pattern reasoning rather than natural-image recognition
Choose number, color, shape, and size as the core visual concepts
Organize 10 puzzle categories into single-concept and dual-concept reasoning families
Create two programmatic layouts or pattern templates for each category, giving 20 templates
Randomly populate each template with concept-compatible visual objects and pattern parameters
Mask the target object whose value must be inferred from the remaining pattern
Generate multiple-choice candidates with four options except for three-way size questions
Render the puzzle image using Python and Pillow
Generate gold perception caption, pattern-induction explanation, and target deduction
Store image, question, options, answer, caption, explanation, and deduction in each record
Deduplicate and freeze 100 unique instances per template for 2,000 test samples

Generate a greedy response and extract the selected answer with the declared regular-expression parser
Use model-based answer extraction only as fallback when the deterministic parser cannot recover a choice
Compare the extracted choice with the gold answer and report accuracy over all 2,000 samples
Run guided perception, induction, and deduction variants to diagnose the source of reasoning failures

source_locator: arXiv:2411.15114 Sections 2-4 and Appendix C, cross-checked against METR/RE-Bench
evidence_summary_en: RE-Bench v1 contains seven hand-crafted, open-ended machine-learning research engineering environments. Each environment packages instructions and specification, a scoring function, a starting solution, and a reference solution. Candidate tasks are iteratively specified, implemented, baselined, refined, or discarded to retain realistic tasks with measurable progress. The paper compares time-bounded agents with 71 eight-hour attempts from 61 distinct human experts, normalizes raw scores so the starting solution is 0 and reference solution is 1 while allowing scores above 1, and summarizes repeated agent trials with score@k.
evidence_summary_zh: RE-Bench v1包含七个手工构建的开放式机器学习研究工程环境。每个环境封装任务说明与规范、评分函数、起始解和参考解。候选任务经过反复规范、实现、试跑、改进或淘汰，以保留真实且可测量进展的任务。论文以61名不同人类专家的71次八小时尝试对比限时智能体，把原始分数归一化为起始解0、参考解1且允许超过1，并用score@k汇总重复智能体试验。
construction_steps_en: Define the goal of forecasting AI research-engineering capability in realistic open-ended work
Set task criteria covering realism, autonomous executability, measurable progress, and an approximately eight-hour expert horizon
Propose candidate machine-learning research and engineering tasks
Write explicit instructions, deliverable constraints, and environment specifications for each candidate
Implement isolated environments that conform to the METR Task Standard
Implement continuous scoring functions that can distinguish incremental improvements
Provide a reproducible starting solution representing the task baseline
Develop a stronger reference solution and permit submissions that exceed its raw score
Pilot each task, inspect score behavior and feasibility, then refine or discard unsuitable candidates
Freeze seven hand-crafted environments as RE-Bench v1

实现符合METR Task Standard的隔离环境
实现可区分渐进改进的连续评分函数
提供可复现的起始解作为任务基线
开发更强参考解并允许提交超过其原始分数
试跑每项任务检查评分行为与可行性并改进或淘汰不合格候选
冻结七个手工环境作为RE-Bench v1

Run research agents in the same task environments under declared time and sampling budgets

Aggregate repeated trials with score@k and compare agent progress with human expert performance over time

source_locator: Qwen3-VL Technical Report Section 5.12.1-5.12.2 and Tables 11-12; no standalone RLWDQA paper, repository, or data card is cited
evidence_summary_en: RLWDQA appears only as a benchmark column in the Qwen3-VL Technical Report's vision-encoder and DeepStack ablations. The report cites no standalone RLWDQA paper, repository, or data card and discloses no provenance, collection, filtering, annotation, scale, split construction, contamination control, prompt, parser, or scorer implementation. It reports a same-1.7B-language-model ViT comparison of SigLIP-2 at 58.7 versus Qwen3-ViT at 66.1, plus a DeepStack ablation using an internal 15B-A2B language model where all variants are pretrained on 200B tokens and evaluated directly on validation sets without post-training, scoring 67.7 versus 68.1. The diagram therefore documents the evaluation and disclosure boundary rather than inventing a dataset build process.

source_locator: arXiv:2404.06654 Sections 3-4 and Appendices B-C, cross-checked against NVIDIA/RULER
evidence_summary_en: RULER extends needle-in-a-haystack evaluation with configurable synthetic tasks in four categories: retrieval, variable tracking, aggregation, and question answering. Its NIAH variants cover single, multi-key, multi-value, and multi-query retrieval with word, number, or UUID needles; variable tracking varies chains and hops; aggregation uses common- and frequent-word extraction; and QA inserts SQuAD or HotpotQA gold paragraphs among same-dataset distractors. The authors select 13 representative configurations, generate 500 examples per task at each of 4K, 8K, 16K, 32K, 64K, and 128K tokens, score target recall, and derive an effective context length relative to the Llama2-7B 4K qualitative threshold.
evidence_summary_zh: RULER以四类可配置合成长上下文任务扩展大海捞针评测：检索、变量追踪、聚合和问答。NIAH变体覆盖单针、多键、多值、多查询以及单词、数字或UUID针；变量追踪改变链数与跳数；聚合使用常见词和高频词提取；问答把SQuAD或HotpotQA标准段落插入同数据集干扰段落。作者选择13个代表性配置，在4K、8K、16K、32K、64K、128K每个长度上为每项任务生成500例，计算目标召回，并相对Llama2-7B 4K定性阈值得出有效上下文长度。
construction_steps_en: Define a long-context evaluation that tests abilities beyond single-needle retrieval
Organize tasks into retrieval, variable tracking, aggregation, and question-answering categories
Parameterize target length, number of needles or chains, hops, queries, and signal-to-noise ratio
Generate single-needle, multi-key, multi-value, and multi-query NIAH variants
Sample word, number, or UUID key-value needles and place them in noise or Paul Graham essay contexts
Generate variable-tracking statements with configurable binding chains and hops
Generate common-word and frequent-word extraction tasks under their declared distributions
Insert SQuAD or HotpotQA gold paragraphs among distractors drawn from the same source dataset
Use the correlation study to retain 13 representative task configurations
For every task and target length generate 500 examples at 4K, 8K, 16K, 32K, 64K, and 128K tokens

为每项任务在4K 8K 16K 32K 64K 128K每个目标长度生成500例

Run greedy bfloat16 inference under the paper's declared eight-A100 setup
Measure whether the expected target content is recalled with the task-specific recall-based accuracy
Average the 13 task scores at each tested length and compute weighted summaries
Report the maximum effective context length whose aggregate score remains above the Llama2-7B 4K qualitative threshold

source_locator: The Lancet Digital Health 2026 article, cross-checked against zhao-zy15/RareArena README Data Collection and evaluation description
evidence_summary_en: RareArena builds on PMC-Patients case summaries and uses GPT-4o for the disclosed data-processing stages. Rare-disease cases are filtered, their diagnoses are extracted and mapped to Orphanet with CODER term embeddings, unmapped cases are removed, and case text is truncated and rephrased to prevent diagnosis leakage. Rare Disease Screening stops before decisive diagnostic tests, while Rare Disease Confirmation stops before the final diagnosis; residual leakage is removed. The resulting resource covers nearly 50,000 patients and more than 4,000 diseases. Models return five diagnoses, GPT-4o aligns synonyms and hypernyms to the gold disease, and Top-1 and Top-5 recall are reported.
evidence_summary_zh: RareArena建立在PMC-Patients病例摘要之上，并在已披露的数据处理阶段使用GPT-4o。流程筛选罕见病病例、抽取诊断、用CODER术语向量映射到Orphanet、删除映射失败病例，再截断和改写病例文本以避免诊断泄漏。罕见病筛查在决定性诊断检查前截断，罕见病确认在最终诊断前截断，并继续移除残余泄漏。最终资源覆盖近5万名患者和4000多种疾病。模型返回5个诊断，GPT-4o把同义词和上位词与标准疾病对齐，报告Top-1与Top-5召回率。
construction_steps_en: Start from the PMC-Patients case-summary corpus sourced from PMC case reports
Filter case summaries that focus on rare-disease diagnoses and extract each ground-truth diagnosis
Map diagnosis terms to the Orphanet database using CODER term embeddings
Remove cases whose diagnosis cannot be mapped to Orphanet
Create Rare Disease Screening cases by truncating before decisive diagnostic tests
Create Rare Disease Confirmation cases by truncating before the final diagnosis
Use GPT-4o to rephrase retained case text so the diagnosis is not directly disclosed
Remove any remaining case with potential diagnosis leakage
Freeze the two settings across nearly 50,000 patients and more than 4,000 diseases

source_locator: arXiv:2402.06341v2 Sections 3.1-3.4, 4-5 and Appendix A, cross-checked against chenxz1111/RareBench
evidence_summary_en: RareBench combines 1,650 PUMCH EHRs with 1,122 public rare-disease cases and defines four tasks: phenotype extraction, diagnosis from incomplete information, common-versus-rare differential diagnosis, and universal rare-disease differential diagnosis. The task subsets contain 87, 33, 527, and 2,185 cases respectively. Four public knowledge bases are integrated into a rare-disease graph; an information-content random walk produces phenotype embeddings for dynamic three-shot retrieval. Models are evaluated with zero-shot, chain-of-thought, random few-shot, and dynamic few-shot prompting using task-specific extraction or Top-k recall measures. A separate study compares GPT-4 with 50 specialist physicians on 75 high-quality PUMCH cases.
evidence_summary_zh: RareBench结合1650份PUMCH电子病历和1122份公开罕见病病例，定义表型抽取、不完整信息诊断、常见病与罕见病鉴别、通用罕见病鉴别四项任务，各子集分别含87、33、527和2185例。论文整合四个公共知识库形成罕见病图谱，以基于信息量的随机游走生成表型向量用于动态三样本检索。模型在零样本、思维链、随机少样本和动态少样本提示下，用任务专属抽取指标或Top-k召回评测；另在75份高质量PUMCH病例上将GPT-4与50名专科医生比较。
construction_steps_en: Collect 1,650 PUMCH EHRs and 1,122 public cases spanning more than 362 rare diseases
Select 87 physician-annotated EHRs covering 34 diseases for phenotype extraction
Select 33 complete-history cases across three diseases for diagnosis from incomplete information
Build the 527-case common-versus-rare differential set from 60 rare and 467 common cases
Assemble 2,185 public and PUMCH cases covering 421 diseases for universal differential diagnosis
Integrate HPO, OMIM, Orphanet, and CCRD into a rare-disease knowledge graph
Run the information-content random walk to learn phenotype-node embeddings
Represent patients with phenotype embeddings and retrieve similar examples for dynamic three-shot prompts

Compare GPT-4 with 50 specialist physicians on 75 high-quality Task-4 PUMCH cases

source_locator: arXiv:2603.04191 Sections 3-4, cross-checked against GG14127/RealPref generation pipeline and dataset schema
evidence_summary_en: RealPref samples and manually filters 100 PersonaHub personas, extends them with demographics, biographies, and life events, and creates ten original plus three rationally inferred generalized preferences per user for 1,300 preferences. Each preference is expressed through four modes ranging from explicit to implicit. Preference, life-event, and random sessions are concatenated into histories averaging roughly 2K to 247K tokens. Original and generalized preferences receive multiple-choice, true-or-false, and open-ended queries. Classification tasks use accuracy, while open answers are judged against granular rubrics; results are sliced by expression type, context length, and unseen-scenario generalization.
evidence_summary_zh: RealPref从PersonaHub采样并人工筛选100个角色，扩展人口统计、传记和生活事件，为每名用户生成10个原始偏好和3个可合理推导的泛化偏好，共1300个偏好。每个偏好使用从显式到隐式的四种表达方式。偏好、生活事件和随机会话被拼接为平均约2K至247K词元的历史。原始与泛化偏好分别生成多选、判断和开放式问题；分类任务使用准确率，开放答案按细粒度量表由LLM评判，并按表达类型、上下文长度和未见场景泛化切分结果。

Generate ten diverse persona-related original preferences for every user
Generate three new preferences per user that can be rationally inferred from the originals
Attach an initializing life event that explains how each original preference developed
Express preferences through explicit-direct, contextualized, implicit-choice, and story-based sessions
Generate separate life-event conversations and profile-neutral random conversations
Insert random sessions to create histories averaging about 2K, 37K, 72K, 142K, or 247K tokens
Create multiple-choice, true-or-false, and open-ended queries for original preferences
Create parallel unseen-scenario queries for generalized preferences and attach detailed rubrics

为每名用户生成10个多样且与角色相关的原始偏好

插入随机会话形成平均约2K 37K 72K 142K或247K词元的历史
为原始偏好创建多选判断与开放式问题
为泛化偏好创建对应未见场景问题并附加详细量表

Score multiple-choice and true-or-false outputs with classification accuracy
Use the declared LLM-as-a-judge templates and granular rubrics for open-ended responses
Report performance by expression explicitness, history length, and generalized unseen scenario

source_locator: xAI official Hugging Face dataset card Introduction and release metadata; no accompanying paper or detailed annotation protocol is published
evidence_summary_en: RealWorldQA has no accompanying benchmark paper. The xAI dataset card documents an initial release of 765 anonymized real-world images, including images taken from vehicles and other real-world scenes, with one question and an easily verifiable answer per image. It describes the goal as real-world understanding and releases the data under CC BY-ND 4.0, but does not disclose image sourcing proportions, question-authoring procedure, annotator counts, quality-control stages, prompt formatting, or an official answer parser. The diagram therefore shows only those confirmed stages and marks simple answer accuracy as the public evaluation convention rather than inventing a hidden construction pipeline.
evidence_summary_zh: RealWorldQA没有配套基准论文。xAI数据卡记录首版包含765张匿名化真实世界图像，其中包括车载图像和其他真实场景；每张图像配一个问题和一个易于验证的答案。数据卡把目标描述为真实世界理解并以CC BY-ND 4.0发布，但未披露图像来源比例、问题编写流程、标注者数量、质检阶段、提示格式或官方答案解析器。因此流程图仅展示已确认步骤，并把简单答案准确率标为公开评测惯例，而不虚构隐藏构建链路。

Pair every image with one question and an easily verifiable reference answer
Release the initial 765 image-question-answer records under CC BY-ND 4.0

source_locator: Baichuan-Audio arXiv:2502.17239 Section 4.3 and Table 8, cross-checked against the baichuan-inc/OpenAudioBench dataset card; LongCat-Flash-Omni only reuses the subset in its result table
evidence_summary_en: ReasoningQA is not a standalone LongCat benchmark paper. It is the self-constructed logical-reasoning component of OpenAudioBench introduced in the Baichuan-Audio report. The official card lists 202 audio items and the report states that each answer is evaluated by GPT-4o against a reference answer before accuracy is calculated. Audio models are tested in speech-to-text mode or non-cascaded speech-to-speech mode; for the latter, interleaved output text is merged for scoring. Later LongCat reports reuse the same named subset in comparative result tables but do not document an alternative construction pipeline.
